en: We hope to see you again!$

en: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE CLUB\nTRADE CENTER.$

label: Text_WelcomeColosseum
en: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE CLUB\nCOLOSSEUM.$

label: Text_WelcomeTimeCapsule
en: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE CLUB\nTIME CAPSULE.$

label: Text_HavingDiscountSaleToday
en: Welcome!\pWe're having a discount sale today!$

label: Text_PlayerWhatCanIDoForYou
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, welcome!\pWhat can I do for you?$

label: Text_BagItemCanBeRegistered
en: An item in the BAG can be\nregistered to SELECT for easy use.$

label: Text_TrainerSchoolEmail
en: パソコンに\nポケモン　トレーナー　こうざの\lメールが　きている！\p‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\pポケモンが　おぼえられる　わざは　4つ！\pどんな　わざを　おぼえさせるかで\nトレーナーの　じつりょくが　とわれます！\p‥‥　‥‥　‥‥$

label: Text_LinkWasCanceled
en: つうしんは　キャンセルされました$

label: Text_GiveNicknameToReceivedMon
en: Want to give a nickname to the\n{STR_VAR_2} you received?$

label: Text_WelcomeWantToHealPkmn
en: Welcome to our POKéMON CENTER!\pWould you like me to heal your\nPOKéMON back to perfect health?$

label: Text_TakeYourPkmnForFewSeconds
en: Okay, I'll take your POKéMON for a\nfew seconds.$

label: Text_WeHopeToSeeYouAgain
en: We hope to see you again!$

label: Text_RestoredPkmnToFullHealth
en: Thank you for waiting.\nWe've restored your POKéMON to\lfull health.$

label: Text_DoorOpenedFarAway
en: どこか　とおくの　とびらが\nひらいたような　おとだ‥‥$

label: Text_BigHoleInTheWall
en: かべに\nおおきな　あなが　あいている！$

label: Text_WirelessClubUndergoingAdjustments
en: I'm terribly sorry.\nThe POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB is\lundergoing adjustments now.$

label: Text_GiveNicknameToThisMon
en: Do you want to give a nickname to\nthis {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: Text_CardKeyOpenedDoor
en: Bingo!\nThe CARD KEY opened the door!$

label: Text_AccessedProfOaksPC
en: Accessed PROF. OAK's PC…\pAccessed the POKéDEX Rating\nSystem…$

label: Text_HavePokedexRated
en: Would you like to have your\nPOKéDEX rated?$

label: Text_ClosedLinkToProfOaksPC
en: Closed link to PROF. OAK's PC.$

label: Text_VoiceRangOutDontRunAway
en: Someone's voice rang out,\n“Don't run away!”$

label: Text_IdLikeToSeeRequest
en: えっとー\n{STR_VAR_2}が　みてみたいなー\pそれも　{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_3}\n{STR_VAR_2}が　みてみたいなー$

label: Text_ThankYouForShowingMe
en: わぁー　すごい！\n{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_3}{STR_VAR_2}だー！\pありがとー\nまた　よろしくねー！$

label: Text_ThatsNotRight
en: それっ　ちがうよー！$

label: Text_TheDoorIsClosed
en: ドアは　しまっている‥$

label: Text_TheresBedLetsRest
en: ベッドが　ある‥‥\nやすんでいこう$

label: Text_MoveCanOnlyBeLearnedOnce
en: This move can be learned only\nonce. Is that okay?$

label: Text_TestMsg
en: テストよう　メッセージです！\nポケモンの　せかいへ　ようこそ！$

label: sText_MysteryGiftStampCard
en: Thank you for using the STAMP CARD\nSystem.\pYou have {STR_VAR_1} more to collect to\nfill your STAMP CARD.$

label: sText_MysteryGiftEgg
en:
Thank you for using the MYSTERY
GIFT System.\pFrom the POKéMON CENTER we
have a gift - a POKéMON EGG!\pPlease raise it with love and
kindness.$

label: sText_FullParty
en: Oh, your party appears to be full.\pPlease come see me after storing\na POKéMON on a PC.$

label: sText_MysteryGiftVisitingTrainer
en:
Thank you for using the MYSTERY
GIFT System.\pBy holding this WONDER CARD, you
may take part in a survey at a\lPOKéMON MART.\pUse these surveys to invite
TRAINERS to the SEVII ISLANDS.\p…Let me give you a secret
password for a survey:\p“GIVE ME
AWESOME TRAINER”\pWrite that in on a survey and send
it to the WIRELESS\lCOMMUNICATION SYSTEM.$

label: sText_MysteryGiftVisitingTrainer_2
en:
Thank you for using the MYSTERY
GIFT System.\pA TRAINER has arrived in the SEVII
ISLANDS looking for you.\pWe hope you will enjoy
battling the visiting TRAINER.\pYou may invite other TRAINERS by
entering other passwords.\pTry looking for other passwords
that may work.$

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard
en:
Thank you for using the MYSTERY
GIFT System.\pYour BATTLE COUNT CARD keeps
track of your battle record against\lTRAINERS with the same CARD.\pLook for and battle TRAINERS who
have the same CARD as you.\pYou may check the overall rankings
by reading the NEWS.\pPlease do give it a try!$

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard_2
en:
Thank you for using the MYSTERY
GIFT System.\pCongratulations!\pYou have won a prize for winning
three battles!\pWe hope you will be inspired to
battle some more.$

label: sText_AuroraTicket1
en: Thank you for using the MYSTERY\nGIFT System.\pYou must be {PLAYER}.\nThere is a ticket here for you.$

label: sText_AuroraTicket2
en: It appears to be for use at the\nVERMILION CITY port.\pWhy not give it a try and see what\nit is about?$

label: sText_AuroraTicketGot
en: Thank you for using the MYSTERY\nGIFT System.$

label: sText_AuroraTicketNoPlace
en: Oh, I'm sorry, {PLAYER}. Your BAG's\nKEY ITEMS POCKET is full.\pPlease store something on your PC,\nthen come back for this.$

label: sText_MysticTicket2
en: Thank you for using the MYSTERY\nGIFT System.\pYou must be {PLAYER}.\nThere is a ticket here for you.$

label: sText_MysticTicket1
en: It appears to be for use at the\nVERMILION CITY port.\pWhy not give it a try and see what\nit is about?$

label: sText_MysticTicketGot
en: Thank you for using the MYSTERY\nGIFT System.$

label: sText_MysticTicketNoPlace
en: Oh, I'm sorry, {PLAYER}. Your BAG's\nKEY ITEMS POCKET is full.\pPlease store something on your PC,\nthen come back for this.$

label: sText_MysteryGiftAlteringCave
en:
Thank you for using the MYSTERY
GIFT System.\pRecently, there have been rumors
of rare POKéMON appearances.\pThe rumors are about ALTERING
CAVE on OUTCAST ISLAND.\pWhy not visit there and check if
the rumors are indeed true?$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GotMyKoffingInCinnabar
en: I got my KOFFING in CINNABAR.\pIt's usually nice, but it breathes\npoison when it's angry.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GymIsGreatFullOfWomen
en: Heheh! This GYM is great!\nIt's full of women!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerIsBadForCitysImage
en: CELADON takes pride in its efforts\nto keep the city beautiful.\pThat's why the new GAME CORNER is\nbad for our city's image.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_BlewItAllAtSlots
en: Moan…\nI blew it all at the slots!\pI knew I should have cashed in my\nCOINS for prizes!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_MyTrustedPalPoliwrath
en: This is my trusted pal, POLIWRATH.\pIt evolved from a POLIWHIRL when\nI used a WATER STONE.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GetLostOrIllPunchYou
en: What are you staring at?\nGet lost, or I'll punch you.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_KeepOutOfTeamRocketsWay
en: Keep out of TEAM ROCKET's way!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_ExplainXAccuracyDireHit
en:
TRAINER TIPS\pX ACCURACY boosts the accuracy of
techniques.\pDIRE HIT jacks up the likelihood
of critical hits.\pGet your items at the CELADON
DEPT. STORE!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_CitySign
en: CELADON CITY\nThe City of Rainbow Dreams$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GymSign
en: CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\lThe Nature-Loving Princess!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_DeptStoreSign
en: Find what you need at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GuardSpecProtectsFromStatus
en: TRAINER TIPS\pGUARD SPEC. protects POKéMON\nfrom status-reduction moves during\lbattle.\pGet your items at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerSign
en: ROCKET GAME CORNER\nThe playground for grown-ups!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_ScaldedTongueOnTea
en:
Aaaagh, ow…
I scalded my tongue!\pThis nice old lady in the MANSION
gave me some TEA.\pBut it was boiling hot!
Gotta cool it to drink it.$

label: Text_SoftboiledTeach
en:
Hello, there!\pI've seen you about, but I never
had a chance to chat.\pIt must be good luck that brought
us together finally.\pI'd like to celebrate by teaching
you the move SOFTBOILED.$

label: Text_SoftboiledDeclined
en: I'll always be keeping an eye out\nfor you.\pI hope we can chat again.$

label: Text_SoftboiledWhichMon
en: So, who's the POKéMON that gets\nthe chance to learn SOFTBOILED?$

label: Text_SoftboiledTaught
en: I wish you the best of luck!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_SomeoneStoleSilphScope
en: Oh, what am I to do…\pSomeone stole our SILPH SCOPE.\pThe thief came running this way,\nI'm sure of it.\pBut I lost sight of him!\nWhere'd he go?$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_TryThisDrinkInstead
en: You shouldn't spend all your money\non drinks.\pTry this instead.$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_NothingBeatsThirstLikeTea
en: Nothing beats thirst like some hot\nTEA.\pIt really is the best.$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_MyDearMonsKeepMeCompany
en: My dear POKéMON keep me company.\nMEOWTH even brings money home!$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_DaisyComesToBuyTea
en:
Oh, hello, dearie.
Did you enjoy my TEA?\pBy the way, dear. Are you, by any
chance, from PALLET TOWN?\pA girl from PALLET TOWN, DAISY,
she enjoys TEA every day.\pShe visits the CELADON DEPT. STORE
to buy some TEA.$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImTheGraphicArtist
en: I'm the graphic artist!\nI drew you!$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_IWroteTheStory
en: I wrote the story!\nIsn't ERIKA cute?\pI like MISTY a lot, too!\nOh, and SABRINA, I like her!$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImGameDesignerShowMeFinishedPokedex
en: Is that right?\pI'm the game designer!\pFilling up your POKéDEX is tough,\nbut don't quit!\pWhen you finish, come tell me!$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsTheGameProgram
en: It's the game program! Messing with\nit could bug out the game!$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_SomeonesPlayingGame
en: Someone's playing a game instead of\nworking!$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsScriptBetterNotLookAtEnding
en: It's the script!\nBetter not look at the ending!$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_TheresNothingIDontKnow
en:
There is nothing that I don't know,
like I wrote on the blackboard.\pI know about the world of POKéMON
in your GAME BOY ADVANCE!\pGet together with your friends and
enjoy trading POKéMON!$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_BoxIsFull
en: ポケモンが　いっぱいだ\nボックスを　かえて　きなさい$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_WirelessAdapterLecture
en: POKéMON Lecture\pPlaying with the Wireless Adapter$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ExplainWirelessClub
en: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB is\nupstairs at any POKéMON CENTER.\pVisit one to link up with friend(s)\nusing your Wireless Adapter.$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ExplainDirectCorner
en:
To link only with a friend, go to
the DIRECT CORNER.\pIt is the right counter at the
POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.\pGo into the TRADE CORNER or the
COLOSSEUM with your friend.$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ExplainUnionRoom
en:
To link and communicate with
anyone, go to the UNION ROOM.\pIt is the left counter at the
POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.\pGo to the UNION ROOM and enjoy
meeting other TRAINERS.$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_PamphletOnTMs
en: It's a pamphlet on TMs.\p… …\pThere are fifty TMs in all.\pThere are also seven HMs that\ncan be used repeatedly.\pSILPH CO.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
en: Hello!\nWelcome to CELADON DEPT. STORE.\pThe board on the right describes\nthe store layout.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorDescriptions
en: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET\p3F: TV GAME SHOP\p4F: WISE MAN GIFTS\p5F: DRUGSTORE\pROOFTOP SQUARE: VENDING MACHINES$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_SuperRepelMorePowerfulRepel
en: SUPER REPEL keeps weak POKéMON at\nbay…\pHmm, it's a more powerful REPEL.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_BuyReviveForLongOutings
en: For long outings, you should buy\nREVIVE.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_FloorSign
en: Top-Grade Items for TRAINERS!\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_LanceComesToBuyCapes
en: We have a customer, LANCE, who\noccasionally comes.\pHe always buys capes.\pI wonder… Does he have many\nidentical capes at home?$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_OTStandsForOriginalTrainer
en: Captured POKéMON are registered\nwith an ID No. and the OT.\pOT stands for “Original TRAINER” -\nthe TRAINER that caught it first.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_BuddyTradingKangaskhanForHaunter
en: All right!\pMy buddy's going to trade me his\nKANGASKHAN for my HAUNTER!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_HaunterEvolvedOnTrade
en: Come on, HAUNTER!\pI love HAUNTER!\nI collect them!\pHuh?\pHAUNTER turned into a different\nPOKéMON while being traded!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_CanIdentifyTradeMonsByID
en: You can identify POKéMON you get\nin trades by their ID Numbers.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_AnRPG
en: An RPG!\nThere's no time for that!$

label: Text_CounterTeach
en:
Oh, hi!
I finally finished POKéMON.\pNot done yet? How about I teach
you a good move?\pThe move I have in mind is
COUNTER.\pNot like the one I'm leaning on,
mind you!$

label: Text_CounterDeclined
en: You're not interested? Come see\nme if you change your mind.$

label: Text_CounterWhichMon
en: Which POKéMON should I teach\nCOUNTER to?$

label: Text_CounterTaught
en: Are you using that COUNTER move\nI taught your POKéMON?$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_GettingPokeDollAsPresent
en: I'm getting a present for my\ngirlfriend.\pI guess a POKé DOLL will be it.\nIt's the popular thing.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_CanRunAwayWithPokeDoll
en: I heard something useful.\pIf a wild POKéMON appears, you can\ndistract it with a POKé DOLL.\pYou can run away while the wild\nPOKéMON is distracted.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FloorSign
en: Express yourself with gifts!\n4F: WISE MAN GIFTS\pEvolution Special!\nElement STONES on sale now!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ExplainStatEnhancers
en:
POKéMON stat enhancers can be
bought only here.\pHP UP increases the base HP of a
POKéMON.\pCALCIUM raises the base SP. ATK
stat of one POKéMON.\pZINC boosts the base SP. DEF stat
of one POKéMON.\pCARBOS enhances the base SPEED
stat.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_HereForStatEnhancers
en:
I'm here for POKéMON stat
enhancers.\pPROTEIN increases the base ATTACK
power.\pIRON increases the base DEFENSE
stat.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImThirstyGiveHerDrink
en: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!\p{FONT_NORMAL}Give her a drink?$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YayFreshWaterHaveThis
en: Yay!\pFRESH WATER!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM16
en: TM16 contains LIGHT SCREEN.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof special attacks by your foe.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YaySodaPopHaveThis
en: Yay!\pSODA POP!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM20
en: TM20 contains SAFEGUARD.\pIt's a move that prevents status\nproblems among your POKéMON.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YayLemonadeHaveThis
en: Yay!\pLEMONADE!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM33
en: TM33 contains REFLECT.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof physical attacks by your foe.$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
en: You don't have space for this!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImNotThirstyAfterAll
en: No, thank you!\nI'm not thirsty after all!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_MySisterIsImmature
en: My sister is a TRAINER, believe it\nor not.\pBut, she's so immature, she drives\nme nuts!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImThirstyIWantDrink
en: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_VendingMachineWhatDoesItHave
en: A vending machine!\nWhat does it have?$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NoMoreRoomForStuff
en: There's no more room for stuff!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CanExchangeCoinsNextDoor
en: Welcome!\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nfabulous prizes next door.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WelcomeBuySomeCoins
en: Welcome to ROCKET GAME CORNER!\pDo you need some game COINS?\nWould you like to buy some?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SorryDontHaveCoinCase
en: Oh, I'm sorry.\nYou don't have a COIN CASE.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RumoredTeamRocketRunsThisPlace
en: Keep this quiet.\pIt's rumored that this place is run\nby TEAM ROCKET.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ThinkMachinesHaveDifferentOdds
en: I think these machines have\ndifferent odds.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DoYouWantToPlay
en: Kid, do you want to play?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinsComeAndGo
en: Wins seem to come and go.\nNothing's a sure thing.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinOrLoseItsOnlyLuck
en: These slot games…\nWin or lose, it's only by luck.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GymGuyAdvice
en:
Hey!\pYou have better things to do,
champ in the making!\pCELADON GYM's LEADER is ERIKA.\pShe is a user of GRASS-type
POKéMON, and at one with nature.\pShe might appear docile because of
her flower arranging…\pBut she's not one to be taken
lightly!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RareMonsForCoins
en: They offer rare POKéMON that can\nbe exchanged for your COINS.\pBut, I just can't seem to win!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SoEasyToGetHooked
en: Games are scary!\nIt's so easy to get hooked!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedMoreCoinsForMonIWant
en: Darn! I need more COINS for the\nPOKéMON I want!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreSomeCoinsShoo
en: Hey, what? You're throwing me off!\nHere are some COINS, so shoo!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_YouveGotPlentyCoins
en: You've got plenty of your own\nCOINS!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WatchReelsClosely
en: The trick is to watch the reels\nclosely.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntIntro
en: I'm guarding this poster!\nGo away, or else!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntPostBattle
en: The TEAM ROCKET HIDEOUT might\nbe discovered!\pI better tell BOSS!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SwitchBehindPosterPushIt
en: Hey!\pA switch behind the poster!?\nLet's push it!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_FancyThatPorygon
en: I sure do fancy that PORYGON!\nBut, it's hard to win at slots!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_RakedItInToday
en: Gahaha! I raked it in today!\nIf only every day were like this…$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_WeExchangeCoinsForPrizes
en: We exchange your COINS for prizes.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_YouWantTM
en: Okay, a TM of {STR_VAR_2}\nis what you want?$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_NeedMoreCoins
en: Sorry, you'll need more COINS\nthan that.$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_OopsNotEnoughRoom
en: おきゃくさん もう もてないよ$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaIntro
en:
Hello…
Lovely weather, isn't it?\lIt's so pleasant…\p…Oh, dear…
I must have dozed off. Welcome.\pMy name is ERIKA.
I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.\pI am a student of the art of
flower arranging.\pMy POKéMON are solely of the
GRASS type.\p…Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that
you wished to challenge me.\pVery well, but I shall not lose.{PLAY_BGM MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaDefeat
en: Oh!\nI concede defeat.\lYou are remarkably strong.\pI must confer on you the\nRAINBOWBADGE.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaPostBattle
en: You are cataloging POKéMON?\nI must say I'm impressed.\pI would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRainbowBadgeTakeThis
en: The RAINBOWBADGE will make\nPOKéMON up to Lv. 50 obey.\pIt also allows POKéMON to use\nSTRENGTH in and out of battle.\pPlease also take this with you.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM19
en: TM19 contains GIGA DRAIN.\pHalf the damage it inflicts is\ndrained to heal your POKéMON.\pWouldn't you agree that it's a\nwonderful move?$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ShouldMakeRoomForThis
en: You should make room for this.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayIntro
en: I should tell you about this GYM.\pOnly real ladies are allowed in\nhere!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayPostBattle
en: Bleaah!\nI hope ERIKA wipes you out!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetPostBattle
en: GRASS-type POKéMON are tough\nagainst the WATER type.\pThey also have an edge on ROCK-\nand GROUND-type POKéMON.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaPostBattle
en: Oh, you were looking at ERIKA…\nYou weren't looking at me…$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaIntro
en: Look, look!\nSee my POKéMON!\pI like the GRASS type.\nI like how they're easy to raise.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaPostBattle
en: We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\pWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaIntro
en: Oh, hey!\pWe don't like BUG- or FIRE-type\nPOKéMON in here!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaPostBattle
en: Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriIntro
en: Pleased to meet you.\nMy hobby is POKéMON training.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriPostBattle
en: I have a blind date coming up.\nI have to learn to be polite,\lespecially if I have to battle.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
en: Welcome to CELADON GYM!\pYou'd better not underestimate\nthe nice ladies here.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
en: I didn't bring my best POKéMON.\nWait until next time!$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_ThisHotelIsForPeople
en: POKéMON?\nNo, this is a hotel for people.\pWe're full up, unfortunately.$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_OnVacationWithBrotherAndBoyfriend
en: I'm on vacation with my brother and\nboyfriend.\pCELADON is such a pretty city!$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_WhyDidSheBringBrother
en: Why?\nWhy did she bring her brother?$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_SisBroughtMeOnVacation
en: Yippee! I'm on vacation!\nMy sis brought me along! Awesome!$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_SlotsReelInTheDough
en: Hehehe!\pThe slots just reel in the dough,\nbig-time!$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_ShippedMonsAsSlotPrizes
en: CHIEF!\pWe just shipped two thousand\nmore POKéMON as slot prizes\lagain today!$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_DontTouchGameCornerPoster
en: Don't touch the poster at the GAME\nCORNER!\pThere's no secret switch behind it!$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeFluteAwakensSleepingMons
en: A POKé FLUTE awakens sleeping\nPOKéMON. You know that.\pIt does so with a sound that only\nthey can hear.$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RodeHereFromFuchsia
en: I rode here from FUCHSIA.\pIt's an uphill ride on CYCLING\nROAD, so I'm exhausted.$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToCyclingRoadIfIHadBike
en: If I had a BIKE, I would go to\nCYCLING ROAD!$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakingBreakRightNow
en: Hi!\pSorry, but we're taking a break\nright now.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_OftenGoToDrugstore
en: My POKéMON are weak, so I often\nhave to go to the DRUGSTORE.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_PsstBasementUnderGameCorner
en: Psst! There's a basement under the\nGAME CORNER, I hear.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ManLostItAllAtSlots
en: Munch…\pThe man at that table lost it all\nat the slots.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakeThisImBusted
en:
Go ahead! Laugh!
I'm flat-out busted!\pNo more slots for me!
I'm going straight!\pHere!
I won't be needing this anymore!$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ReceivedCoinCaseFromMan
en: {PLAYER} received a COIN CASE\nfrom the man.$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ThoughtIdWinItBack
en: I always thought I was going to\nwin it back…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro
en:
{RIVAL}: Yo! {PLAYER}!\pYou're still struggling along back
here?\pI'm doing great! I caught a bunch
of strong and smart POKéMON!\pHere, let me see what you caught,
{PLAYER}!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle
en:
{RIVAL}: Hey, guess what?\pI went to BILL's and got him to
show me his rare POKéMON.\pThat added a lot of pages to my
POKéDEX!\pAfter all, BILL's world famous as a
POKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage
System on PC, too.\pSince you're using his system,
you should go thank him.\pWell, I better get rolling!
Smell ya later!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAsFavor
en: Oh, yeah, right.\pI feel sorry for you. No, really.\nYou're always plodding behind me.\pSo here, I'll give you a little\npresent as a favor.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmellYa
en:
A chatty gossip like you…
That thing's perfect.\pI don't need it because I don't
give a hoot about others.\pAll right, this time I really am
gone. Smell ya!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalVictory
en: なんたって！\nおれは　てんさい　だからよ！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GruntIntro
en:
Hey! Stay out!
It's not your yard!\p…Huh?
Me?\pI'm an innocent bystander!
Don't you believe me?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GruntDefeat
en: GRUNT: Stop! I give up!\nI'll leave quietly!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RecoveredTM28FromGrunt
en: {PLAYER} recovered TM28 from\nthe TEAM ROCKET GRUNT.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_MakeRoomForThisCantRun
en: Make room for this!\nI can't run until I give it to you!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsntIt
en: You're a TRAINER, too?\pCollecting, battling…\nIt's a tough life, isn't it?$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTrees
en:
Did you know that you can CUT down
small trees?\pEven that small tree in front of
the shop can be CUT down.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCouldCutTree
en:
If that SLOWBRO wasn't there, you
could CUT down the small tree.\pThat way, you could get to the
other side.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmusing
en: You're making an encyclopedia on\nPOKéMON? That sounds amusing.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_PeopleHereWereRobbed
en: The people here were robbed.\pIt's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is\nbehind this most heinous crime!\pEven our POLICE FORCE has\ntrouble with the ROCKETS!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_HardToControlMonsObedience
en: No! That's wrong!\nIt's so hard to control POKéMON!\pYour POKéMON's obedience depends\non your abilities as a TRAINER.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle
en: I want a bright red bicycle.\pI'll keep it at home, so it won't\nget dirty.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave
en:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign
en: CERULEAN CITY\nA Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds\lIt$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems
en: TRAINER TIPS\pA POKéMON can be made to hold\nan item.\pSome items can even be used by\nthe holding POKéMON in battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign
en: Grass and caves handled easily!\nBIKE SHOP$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign
en: CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\lThe Tomboyish Mermaid!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WelcomeToBikeShop
en: Hi!\nWelcome to our BIKE SHOP.\pHave we got just the BIKE for\nyou!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_OhBikeVoucherHereYouGo
en: Oh, that's…\pA BIKE VOUCHER!\pOkay!\nHere you go!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedVoucherForBicycle
en: {PLAYER} exchanged the\nBIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_HowDoYouLikeNewBicycle
en: How do you like your new BICYCLE?\nDo you like how it rides?\pYou can take it out on CYCLING\nROAD and even into caves!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_MakeRoomForBicycle
en: You better make room for your\nBICYCLE!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_CityBikeGoodEnoughForMe
en: A plain city bike is good enough\nfor me.\pAfter all, you can't put a shopping\nbasket on a mountain bike.$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_BikesCoolButExpensive
en: These bikes are cool, but they're\nway expensive!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_GermanFoldableBicyleFinallyOnMarket
en: ついに　はつばい！\pドイツ　せい　さいこうきゅう\nおりたたみ　じてんしゃ！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyIntro
en:
Hi, you're a new face!\pOnly those TRAINERS who have a
policy about POKéMON can turn pro.\pWhat is your approach when you
catch and train POKéMON?\pMy policy is an all-out offensive
with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM03
en: TM03 teaches WATER PULSE.\pUse it on an aquatic POKéMON!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCascadeBadge
en:
The CASCADEBADGE makes all
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 obey.\pThat includes even outsiders you
got in trades.\pThere's more. You can now use CUT
anytime, even out of battle.\pYou can CUT down small trees to
open new pathways.\pYou can also have my favorite TM.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_BetterMakeRoomForThis
en: You better make room for this!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDefeat
en: Wow!\nYou're too much!\pAll right!\pYou can have the CASCADEBADGE to\nshow you beat me.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaIntro
en: What? You?\nI'm more than good enough for you!\pMISTY won't have to be bothered.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaPostBattle
en: You have to face other TRAINERS\nto see how good you really are.$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisPostBattle
en: MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\pShe won't lose to someone like you!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
en:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLet me give you some advice!\pThe LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who
uses WATER-type POKéMON.\pYou can drain all their water with
GRASS-type POKéMON.\pOr, you might use ELECTRIC-type
POKéMON and zap them!$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_WeMakePrettyGoodTeam
en: You beat MISTY!\nSee, what'd I tell ya?\pYou and me, kid, we make a pretty\ndarn-good team!$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazingSecrets
en: Only skilled TRAINERS can collect\nPOKéMON BADGES.\pI see you have at least one.\pThose BADGES have amazing secrets,\ndid you know?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBadge
en: Now then…\pWhich of the eight BADGES should\nI describe?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytime
en: Come visit me anytime you wish.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash
en: The ATTACK stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLASH outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut
en:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
CUT outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly
en: The SPEED stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLY outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strength
en:
POKéMON up to Lv. 50 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
STRENGTH outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf
en: The DEFENSE stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nSURF outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSmash
en:
POKéMON up to Lv. 70 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
ROCK SMASH outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfall
en: The SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats of\nall your POKéMON rise a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nWATERFALL outside of battle.$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMForDig
en:
Those miserable ROCKETS!\pLook what they've done to my
house!\pThey stole a TM for teaching
POKéMON how to DIG holes!\pI was going to use it on a
MANKEY or a SANDSHREW…\pThat cost me a bundle, it did!$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDigWithoutTM
en: I figure what's lost is lost.\pI decided to teach DIGLETT how to\nDIG without a TM.$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryingToDigIntoNoGood
en: TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG\ntheir way into no good!$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketLeftWayOut
en: TEAM ROCKET left a way out!$

label: CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWithMyHusband
en: My husband likes trading POKéMON.\pYou're collecting POKéMON for your\nPOKéDEX, aren't you?\pWould you please trade with him?$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NothingEntertaining
en: Sigh…\nToo much time, too little to do…\pIs nothing entertaining happening\nanywhere?$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NewNewsInformativeHaveThis
en:
Ah!
A new news report!\pHmm…\pI see!
That was quite informative!\pI applaud you for taking interest
in the news at your young age.\pAs my thanks for sharing the news
with me, I want you to have this.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_IncredibleNewsHaveBerries
en:
Oh, oh!
Th-this news report!\pHmm…\pAmazing!
What an incredible piece of news!\pI haven't seen a news story this
incredible in too long a time!\pThanks for sharing this fantastic
news. Have a bunch of BERRIES!$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_WishCouldShareNewsWithOthers
en: It seems such a shame to not share\nthis news with other folks…\pI wish I could tell someone…\nLet others know the news…$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_ThanksForSpreadingNewsTakeThis
en: Ah, you've spread the news for me?\pGood news becomes worthwhile when\nall sorts of people share it.\pAs my thanks for your spreading\nthe news, take this!$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_MagnificentNewsSpreadHaveBerries
en:
You've spread the news some more?
Magnificent!\pThat piece of news must be
delighted to be passed around so.\pYes, indeed!\pConsider this a show of
appreciation from me and the news.\pI'll give you more BERRIES than
I usually do.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_EnjoyingMyselfWithAllSortsOfNews
en: I'm quite enjoying myself with all\nsorts of news.\pYes, I am satisfied!\nI won't be bored for a while.$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_YourBerryPouchIsFull
en: Hm? Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nMy gift remains ungiven, then.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AnyInterestInBerries
en:
I concoct a variety of medicine
from BERRY POWDER.\pUsing good BERRY POWDER, I can
make any kind of medicine.\pNow tell me, have you any interest
in BERRIES?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThing
en: Ah, good! For you, then, I have\njust the thing.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesAtDirectCorner
en:
There's something new on the second
floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the\lDIRECT CORNER.\pThey installed a Wireless Adapter
machine for crushing BERRIES.\pThis is where you come in.\pI have a favor to ask, one that
I can entrust only to you.\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using that machine?\pDon't forget, the machine is at the
DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.\pI'll concoct medicine for you if
you bring me some BERRY POWDER.\pDon't forget, crush BERRIES into
BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNoBerries
en: Why must you lie to me?\pHow many BERRIES do you have?\nNot a one!$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInAllSortsOfThings
en: You have no interest in BERRIES?\pYoung one, it's important to take an\ninterest in all sorts of things.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtBerryPowder
en: Er-hem! Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?$

label: CeruleanCity_House5_Text_ExchangeWithWhat
en: With what would you like to \nexchange it?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBerryPowderForItem
en: Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY\nPOWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
en: Hm? You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryPowder
en: This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more BERRY\nPOWDER for something else?$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HopeToSeeYouAgain
en: That's fine, then.\nI'll hope to see you back again.$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLikeToTradePowder
en: Come see me if you'd like to trade\nyour BERRY POWDER.$

label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_RepelWorksOnWeakMons
en:
REPEL not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak POKéMON.\pPut your strongest POKéMON at the
left of the POKéMON LIST.\pIf your first POKéMON is strong,
REPEL's effect is boosted.$

label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_DoYouKnowAboutRareCandy
en: Do you know about RARE CANDY?\nThey don't sell it in shops.\pI think it makes POKéMON grow\nvery quickly all of a sudden.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillDoesWhateverForRareMons
en: That BILL!\pI heard that he'll do whatever it\ntakes to get rare POKéMON.\pHe's not above doing all sorts\nof things, I've heard.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneCallsBillPokemaniac
en: Have you heard about BILL?\pEveryone calls him a POKéMANIAC!\pI think people are just jealous of\nBILL, though.\pWho wouldn't want to boast about\ntheir POKéMON?$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCollectsRareMons
en: BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTradingUpstairs
en:
Why don't you go upstairs and try
trading POKéMON with your friends?\pYou could get a lot more variety
by trading.\pThe POKéMON you get in trades grow
quickly, too.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_BlaineLivedHereSinceBeforeLab
en: CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the\nodd fellow.\pHe's lived on the island since way\nbefore the LAB was built.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperimentInMansion
en: Scientists conduct experiments \nin the burned-out building.\pYou know, the one they call the\nPOKéMON MANSION.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IslandSign
en: CINNABAR ISLAND\nThe Fiery Town of Burning Desire$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign
en: CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\lThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ComeWithMeToOneIsland
en:
Look, it's me, BILL.
Long time no see!\pI hope you're still using my
PC system.\pWell, listen, since we met up here,
how about spending time with me?\pThere's this little island in the far
south called ONE ISLAND.\pA friend invited me, so I'm on my
way out there.\pHow about it?
Do you feel like coming with me?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IllBeWaitingInPokeCenter
en:
What, are you too busy?\pWell, all right.
The boat hasn't arrived yet anyway.\pI'll be waiting at the POKéMON
CENTER over there.\pCome see me when you're done with
your business here.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_MyPalsBoatArrived
en: Looks like my pal's boat arrived,\ntoo.\pHe sent it specially here to\nCINNABAR to pick me up.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IfYouHaveTriPassYouCanGoAgain
en:
Hey, wasn't that a long cruise?\pMy buddy CELIO seemed to enjoy
your company.\pI'm sure he'd welcome you if you
were to visit him again.\pIf you have a TRI-PASS, you can
always take a ferry there from\lVERMILION PORT.\pAll right, thanks for your company!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro
en:
Hah!\pI am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!\pMy fiery POKéMON are all rough
and ready with intense heat!\pThey incinerate all challengers!\pHah!
You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat
en: I have burned down to nothing!\nNot even ashes remain!\pYou have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltimateFireMove
en: FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire\ntechnique.\pDon't waste it on WATER POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBadge
en: Hah!\pThe VOLCANOBADGE heightens the\nSPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.\pHere, you can have this, too!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle
en: TM38 contains FIRE BLAST.\nTeach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.\pVULPIX or CHARMELEON would be\nideal for that move.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro
en: Do you know how hot POKéMON fire\nbreath can get?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle
en: Fire, or to be more precise,\ncombustion…\p…Oxygen in the air…\nBlah, blah, blah, blah…$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro
en: I was a thief, but I went straight\nas a TRAINER.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle
en: I get this uncontrollable urge to\nsteal other people's POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro
en: I've studied POKéMON thoroughly.\nYou can't win!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle
en: My theories are too complicated\nfor you to understand.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro
en: I like using FIRE-type POKéMON.\nI just do.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle
en: I wish there were a thief POKéMON.\nI'd use that!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro
en: I know why BLAINE became a\nTRAINER.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle
en:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro
en: I've been to many GYMS, but this\none best suits my style.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle
en: PONYTA, NINETALES…\nThose are popular FIRE POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle
en: Water beats fire, of course.\pBut fire melts ice, so the FIRE\ntype beats ICE-type POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
en:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pThe hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE
POKéMON pro.\pDouse his spirits with water!\pYou'd better take some
BURN HEALS, too.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules
en:
POKéMON Quiz!\pGet it right, and the door opens to
the next room.\pGet it wrong, and face a TRAINER!\pIf you want to conserve your
POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…\pThen get it right!
Here we go!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2
en: There are nine certified POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4
en: Are electric moves effective\nagainst GROUND-type POKéMON?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5
en: POKéMON of the same kind and level\nare not identical?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveXAttack
en: Don't they have X ATTACK?\pI like it because it raises the\nATTACK stat in battle.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_ExtraItemsNeverHurt
en: It never hurts to have extra items.\nYou never know what might happen.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CinnabarGymLocked
en:
I came to visit the CINNABAR GYM,
but the door is locked tight.\pThere should be a key for it
somewhere.\pCould it be in that burned-out
mansion?\pThe GYM LEADER's friend used to
live there, they say.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitUnionRoom
en:
Do you have lots of friends?\pLinking up with the usual friends
is fun, of course.\pBut how about visiting the
UNION ROOM every so often?\pWho knows, you may end up making
new friends.\pI think it would be worth your time
to check the UNION ROOM.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EvolutionCanWaitForNewMoves
en: POKéMON can still learn techniques\nafter canceling evolution.\pEvolution can wait until new moves\nhave been learned.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReadyToSailToOneIsland
en: BILL: Hey, you kept me waiting!\nReady to set sail to ONE ISLAND?$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhNotDoneYet
en: Oh, you're still not done yet?$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PhotoOfBlaineAndFuji
en: It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_StudyMonsExtensively
en: We study POKéMON extensively\nevery day.\pPeople often bring us rare POKéMON\nfor examination.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_PhotoOfLabFounderDrFuji
en: A photo of the LAB's founder…\nDR. FUJI?!$

label: Text_MetronomeTeach
en:
Tch-tch-tch!
I'll teach you a nifty move.\pTeach it to a POKéMON, and watch
the fun unfold!\pIt's a move called METRONOME.
Does it strike your fancy?$

label: Text_MetronomeDeclined
en: I tell you, it's a lot of fun!$

label: Text_MetronomeTaught
en: Tch-tch-tch!\nThat's the sound of a METRONOME.\pIt tweaks your POKéMON's brain into\nusing moves it doesn't even know.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HaveYouAFossilForMe
en:
Hiya!\pI am important doctor.
Yes, very much so, indeed.\pHere, I study rare POKéMON fossils.
All the time, I study.\pYou!
Have you a fossil for me?$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_TakesTimeGoForWalkJP
en: ちょっと　じかん　かかるよ！\pそこらへんを　すこし\nブラブラ　してくると　よろしー！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_FossilMonBackToLife
en: You late.\nWhere were you?\pYour fossil is back to life!\nIt was {STR_VAR_1} like I think!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_NoRoomForPokemon
en: ポケモン　いっぱいで　もてないね！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_ThatFossilIsOfMonMakeItLiveAgain
en:
Oh!
That is {STR_VAR_2}, it is!\pIt is fossil of {STR_VAR_1},
a POKéMON that is already extinct!\pMy Resurrection Machine will make
that POKéMON live again!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HandedFossilToWeirdDoctor
en: So!\nYou hurry and give me that!\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} handed over the\n{STR_VAR_2} to the weird doctor.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_TakesTimeGoForWalk
en: I take a little time!\nYou go for walk a little while!$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Lounge_Text_FoundFossilInMtMoon
en: I found this most remarkable fossil\ninside MT. MOON.\pI think it's of a rare, prehistoric\nPOKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_EeveeCanEvolveIntroThreeMons
en: EEVEE can evolve into one of three\nkinds of POKéMON.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_LegendaryBirdEmail
en:
There's an e-mail message.\p… … …\pThere are three legendary bird
POKéMON.\pThey are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and
MOLTRES.\pTheir whereabouts are unknown.\pWe plan to explore the cavern
close to CERULEAN.\pFrom: POKéMON RESEARCH TEAM…$

label: DiglettsCave_NorthEntrance_RockTunnelPitchBlack
en: I went inside ROCK TUNNEL, but it's\npitch-black and scary in there.\pIf I could get a POKéMON to use\nFLASH and light it up…$

label: DiglettsCave_SouthEntrance_Text_DiglettDugThisTunnel
en: Well, isn't this a surprise!\nDIGLETT dug this long tunnel!\pIt goes right to VIRIDIAN CITY,\nthey tell me.$

label: FiveIsland_Text_IslandSign
en: FIVE ISLAND\nChrono Island: Where Time Goes$

label: FiveIsland_Text_WeirdBuildingInMeadow
en: Oh, this stinks. I wanted to play in\nthe MEADOW.\pBut they put up a weird building\non it, so I can't play there.$

label: FiveIsland_Text_BeenGettingBusierAroundHere
en: It's been getting busier around\nthese parts lately.\pI haven't been catching many good\nfish lately, either.$

label: FiveIsland_House1_JPText_HusbandWentOffFishing
en: こんばんの　おかずは\nようい　しなくて　いいぞ！\pって　だんなが\nつりに　いったん　だけど‥\lしんじて　いいのかねえ$

label: FiveIsland_House1_Text_HusbandWentOffFishing
en:
Don't worry about buying anything
for dinner tonight!\p…That's what my husband said when
he went off fishing today.\pI'm not sure if I can count on him
to live up to that promise.$

label: FiveIsland_House2_Text_MeadowBelongedToFamily
en:
That MEADOW has belonged to our
family for generations.\pI should have had a giant mansion
built on it.\pIt would be preferable to having
those thugs run wild on it!$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonIntro
en: Aiyeeeeeh!\pI thought this was an ancient ruin.\nBut it's teeming with ghosts!$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonPostBattle
en: I'm trying to get out of here, but\nI always end up at the same spot.\pMaybe the number of boulders is\na hint…$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyIntro
en: W-what do you intend to do with\nme?$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyDefeat
en: Oh… I was afraid that you meant to\nharm me.$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_MayIAskYouToTakeMeHome
en:
I am so glad that you happened
here.\pI grew rather bored of walking,
and I am feeling fatigued.\pMay I ask you to take me home
from here?$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraIntro
en: I think there is a mysterious power\nat work in this cave.$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraDefeat
en: If you don't go into the right\ntunnel, you won't get ahead.$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraPostBattle
en: Earlier, a lady went into the caves\nahead.$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_DoorNeedsTwoPasswords
en: とびらを　あけるには\nパスワードが　2つ　いるようだ$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordAnotherNeeded
en: {PLAYER} entered a password.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\p… …  … …  … …\pAnother password is needed to\nopen the door…$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordDoorOpened
en: {PLAYER} entered two passwords.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\n“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\p… …  … …  … …\pThe WAREHOUSE's door opened!$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1PostBattle
en: You don't have any business here!\nGo home!$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Intro
en: There's nothing past here except\nour WAREHOUSE.\pSo what brings you here?$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2PostBattle
en: You're wanting to know what's inside\nthis WAREHOUSE?\pIt's better you didn't know.\nFor your own sake, I mean.$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Intro
en: You'd be wasting time even if you\nwere to get by me.$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3PostBattle
en: You won't be able to get in without\nthe passwords anyway.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloIntro
en: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the beak.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloPostBattle
en: You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from\nhere.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazIntro
en: I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the wings.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazPostBattle
en: There was a really somber guy\nover that way.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldIntro
en: I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the down.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldDefeat
en: Down is so comfy…\nIt makes me drowsy…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldPostBattle
en: It fills me with happiness when\nbird POKéMON beg playfully…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThisIsWhereIBuriedMyOnix
en: This is where I buried my ONIX…\nIt was named TECTONIX…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesTectonixLemonadeOffering
en: “Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.\pThere is a LEMONADE placed as an\noffering in front of the grave.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_LeaveAnotherLemonadeOffering
en: Would you like to leave another\nLEMONADE as an offering?$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_PlacedCanOfLemonade
en: {PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE\nin front of the grave.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThankYouPleaseTakeThis
en:
Th-thank you…\pThat was my TECTONIX's favorite
drink…\pI don't even know you, but your
act of kindness…\pIt's uplifted me a little.\pCan you please take this as my
thanks?$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_BeGoodToYourMonsToo
en: Please be good to your POKéMON,\ntoo.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_DontHaveRoomForIt
en: If you don't have room for it,\nI'll hold it for you till next time.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_StillHaveThingAsMyThanks
en: Oh, it's you from that time…\pI still have that thing I wanted\nyou to have as my thanks.$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesTectonix
en: Boulders and rocks are neatly piled\nup as a cairn.\p“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.$

label: FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnMyWayToPrepareMeal
en: I'm on my way to prepare a meal\nfor a certain high-society person.$

label: FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoureOnQuestToCatchEveryMon
en: You're on a quest to catch every\nsingle kind of POKéMON?\p…How incredible. Please tell me if\nyou catch a strong one!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntro
en: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPostBattle
en: Uh-oh, my paint tubes have\nscattered everywhere!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaIntro
en: Excuse me!\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaDefeat
en: This loss…\nI feel like I'm whiting out…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPostBattle
en: GILLIAN?\nPlease tilt your head slightly…\lThere! That's the look I want!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntro
en: Hmm…\nThe angle, it is not quite there…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPostBattle
en: The sky and the sea…\nThey are so fickle.\pTheir changing expressions make\nthem difficult to capture.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntro
en: I am visiting my friend's retreat,\nif you must know.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPostBattle
en: I find it pleasurable to leisurely\nbattle in the gentle sea breeze.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIntro
en: I'm thinking of having a pool\nmade specially for POKéMON.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPostBattle
en: A pool would be nice, but I must\nsay, a sun-room may be sublime.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinIntro
en: I'm a good runner.\nI'm really fast!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPostBattle
en: When I run with the wind, it feels\nlike I could fly!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro
en: I say, this marine life here at\nthis resort agrees with me.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyDefeat
en: That's a shocker!\nYou must be joking.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostBattle
en: Getting so serious over this…\nHow nonsensical.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphyThanksYouMayGoNow
en: SELPHY: Thank you.\pYou may go now.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_PleaseHearMyWish
en: SELPHY: Oh?\nDo I know you from somewhere?\pOh, but that doesn't matter.\pI am exquisitely bored.\nPlease, hear my wish.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_WishToSeeMonPlease
en: I wish to see a POKéMON.\nA darling {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to see one right away.\nPlease, make my wish come true.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhImTiredOfWaiting
en: SELPHY: Oh, I'm tired of this.\nI'm tired of waiting for you.\pI'll forgive you this time, but\nplease don't fail me next time.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_MonYouCaughtForMeThankYou
en:
SELPHY: Oh, hello, there.\pOh, my gracious. That must be the
{STR_VAR_1} you caught for me.\pGiggle…
I see a resemblance to you.\pThank you so kindly.\p… …  … …  … …
Is something the matter?\pYou may leave.\p… …  … …  … …
Oh, fine. I understand now.\pSEBASTIAN!
I need you here this instant!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_SelphyGiveTokenOfAppreciation
en: SELPHY: See to it that this person\nis given a token of appreciation.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerIShallDoAsYouBid
en: Butler: I shall do as you bid,\nmy lady.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerPleaseAcceptThisAsHerThanks
en: Butler: I sincerely thank you for\npleasing Lady SELPHY.\pPlease accept this as her thanks…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerBagAppearsToBeFull
en: Butler: Your BAG appears to be\nunfortunately full.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_SelphyWishYouBestOfLuck
en: SELPHY: I wish you the best of\nluck.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_LadySelphySmileHasBrillianceOfSun
en: Butler: The smile of Lady SELPHY\nhas the brilliance of the sun.\pPlease, I beg you to bring joy\nto Lady SELPHY.$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ManyMonsLockedInPen
en: There are many POKéMON locked\naway in the pen…$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_PenUnlockedMonsFled
en: The pen door is unlocked.\nThe POKéMON appear to have fled.$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Did you come here knowing it's\nTEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: What do you think you're doing?!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: TEAM ROCKET broke up?\nWhat planet are you from?$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: Oh, now your POKéMON look strong.\nYou're willing to sell them?\pOh?\nYou wanted to battle?$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: We can give you a great price.\nSell us your POKéMON!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: I got word about you from the\nothers.\pBut there's no way a kid like you'd\nknow our BOSS GIOVANNI!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: Don't mess in the doings of adults,\nyou jumped-up pip-squeak!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1Intro
en: I don't know or care if what I'm\ndoing is right or wrong…\pI just put my faith in GIOVANNI\nand do as I am told.$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1PostBattle
en: You're doing things according to\nyour beliefs and morals.\pI understand now…$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_MadeItSoYouCanComeBackThrough
en:
I've made it so you can come back
in through there.\pWhy don't you go get rested and
refreshed for what lies ahead?\pThe ADMIN after me outranks me
thoroughly as a TRAINER.\pYou'd better steel yourself for one
harsh challenge.$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Intro
en:
That's quite enough of you 
playing the hero, kid.\pSpreading lies about how TEAM
ROCKET has disbanded…\pIt's such an obvious attempt to
cause confusion in our ranks.\pFortunately, we're not so ignorant
to fall for the lies of a child!\pAnd now, I'll show you how scary
an angry adult can be!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Defeat
en:
Urgh…
You were too strong…\p…
Th-that's GIOVANNI's BADGE!\pSo it's true?
TEAM ROCKET really has disbanded?$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2PostBattle
en: We will abandon this WAREHOUSE…\pBut don't think this is over.\nI won't let this be the end.\pI will find GIOVANNI.\nAnd I will resurrect TEAM ROCKET!\lI will…\pUntil then, farewell!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ReportWithGraphsAndText
en: A report with graphs and text is on\nthe PC monitor.\p“The Influence of Magnetic Waves\non POKéMON Evolution”…\p… … … … … …\pIt's too difficult to understand…$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonIntro
en:
I almost managed to sell the
SAPPHIRE for huge money…\pThen, you just had to come along
and blow the whole deal apart!\pFufu… Fufufufu…
There's no forgiveness for you!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonPostBattle
en: If I can't sell it, it's worthless!\nGo ahead, take it!$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GetLostLeaveMeBe
en: What do you want now?\nGo on, get lost, leave me be.$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GiovannisKidHasRedHair
en:
What, you again?\pYou… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,
are you?\pNo, that can't be right!
GIOVANNI's kid has red hair.\pYou don't have any reasons for
bugging me. Leave me alone!$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_LetMeTakeLookAtMons
en:
You travel all over the place,
don't you?\pYou're not driving your POKéMON
too harshly, are you?\pLet me take a look.
… … …   … … …$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_TreatMonRightHaveThis
en: Oh, impressive.\nYou treat your POKéMON right.\pI think you can be entrusted with\nthis.\pPlease, I'd like you to have this.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_DontHaveSpaceInYourParty
en: …Unfortunately, you don't have\nspace for this in your party.\pYou'd better come back for it\nanother time.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_YouveComeBackForTheEgg
en: やあ\nタマゴを　もらいに\lきて　くれたんだね$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_GladIMetSomeoneLikeYou
en: I received that EGG while I was\ntraveling.\pI'm glad I met someone like you.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_CuteMonRemindsMeOfDaisy
en:
Oh, hello.
That's a cute {STR_VAR_2}.\pSeeing it reminds me of a sweet 
little girl I met while traveling.\pShe was gently grooming POKéMON…
She was a little angel.\pThat little girl's name…
I think it was DAISY.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeIntro
en: This is an excellent environment\nfor raising POKéMON.$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeDefeat
en: Your POKéMON are growing up\nadmirably well!$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizePostBattle
en: You know, I think you have the\ntalent to be a good BREEDER.$

label: FourIsland_Text_IslandSign
en: FOUR ISLAND\nThe Warm, Blue, Floe Island$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasReturned
en: LORELEI has returned.\pDid she find the city life too\nstressful, I wonder?$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiMetLaprasAsChild
en:
LORELEI has gone back.\pThe LAPRAS she has, I imagine it
to be the one she met as a child.\pI believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE
that she caught it.\pPerhaps that POKéMON has been with
her ever since.$

label: FourIsland_Text_RivalAlreadyGotEggBeSmellingYa
en:
{RIVAL}: Hey!
{PLAYER}!\pWhat are you doing here in the
SEVII ISLANDS?\pYou should quit copying me,
you know?\pAnyways, I already got my POKéMON
EGG, so I'm done with this island.\pHeh, I bet you don't even know
about POKéMON EGGS.\pYou'll never fill your NATIONAL
POKéDEX that way.\pBy the way, I saw someone we both
know on this island.\pWhy don't you go look around if
it makes you curious?\pMe, I don't have the time to
waste.\pBe smelling ya!$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasLotsOfStuffedDolls
en:
Oh, you found me!
Please don't tell LORELEI.\pDid you know that LORELEI has lots
and lots of stuffed dolls?\pEvery time she comes back to
FOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!$

label: FourIsland_Text_MadeSlushieUsingIcefallCaveIce
en: Ooh, chilly!\pI made a slushie using ice I\nshaved inside ICEFALL CAVE.\pIt's chilly and tasty!$

label: JPText_BodySlamTeach
en: そーれ　ぼよーん！\nどっちが　さきに　へたばるか？\lのしかかり　しょうぶ　してるんだ\pきみは　なかまに　はいったら\nつぶれそうだな‥\lかわりに　きみの　ポケモンに\lのしかかり　おしえて　やろっか？$

label: JPText_BodySlamDeclined
en: また　おいで　ぼよーん！$

label: JPText_BodySlamWhichMon
en: どの　ポケモンに\nおしえたい　かい？$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiKeepHandsOffMons
en: LORELEI: Keep your filthy hands\noff the POKéMON in the cave!\pDo as I say, or you'll have me to\nanswer to!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ShutItLadyLeaveUsBe
en: Aww, shut it, lady, and leave\nus be.\pDon't let your glasses get all\nsteamed up!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiPlayerHelpMeKickPoachersOut
en:
LORELEI: {PLAYER}?!
What are you doing here?\pNo, we can catch up later.
Right now, I need your help.\pHelp me kick these poachers out
before they do anything else.\pThey've been catching POKéMON
here, then selling them off!\pAre you ready?
You take that one, please!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_GruntIntro
en: W-what?!\pWho says we can't do what we want\nwith the POKéMON we catch?$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiWhereHaveYouTakenMons
en:
LORELEI: Humph.
So despicably weak.\pYou!
Tell me!\pWhere have you taken the captured
POKéMON?\pI'm smashing your ring once and
for all!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_NotTellingYouThat
en: N-no way!\nI'm not telling you that!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiWellDeepFreezeYou
en:
LORELEI: If you won't confess,
we'll deep-freeze you.\pMy LAPRAS is furious for what
you've done to its friends.\pGo, LAPRAS!
ICE BEAM…$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_OkayRocketWareHouseFiveIsland
en:
Wawaah! Okay!
I'll talk!\pThe POKéMON are in the ROCKET
WAREHOUSE on FIVE ISLAND.\pThere! I said it!
We'll be going now!\p…But I doubt you'll ever make it
into the ROCKET WAREHOUSE!\pHeheheheh!$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ThankYouThisIsAwful
en:
{PLAYER}, thank you.
But this is awful…\pI was born and raised here on
these islands.\pI had no idea that those horrible
criminals were loose here…$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IfAnythingWereToHappenToIsland
en:
LORELEI: There's something weighing
heavily on my mind.\pIf anything were to happen on
the island where I was born…\pI wouldn't know about it if I were
in the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI wonder if that would make me
irresponsible to my home…$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IllReturnToLeagueInShortWhile
en:
LORELEI: So, you managed to solve
all the problems here?\pThat's wonderful.\pThat means there isn't any reason
for me to be here all the time.\pThank you…\pI'll return to the POKéMON LEAGUE
in a short while.$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_WillDoWhatICanHereAndNow
en: I don't know what will happen in\nthe future, but…\pI will do what I can here and now.\nThat's all I can do.$

label: FourIsland_Mart_Text_LoreleiGrewUpOnThisIsland
en:
We've had a great and powerful
TRAINER grow up on this island.\pI bet even you'd know her.
It's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!\pWhen LORELEI was just a tyke,
I taught her about POKéMON.$

label: FourIsland_Mart_Text_IcefallCaveIsFrigid
en:
The SEVII ISLANDS are in a warm
region overall.\pBut there is one exception you
need to know about.\pThe ICEFALL CAVE is frigid because
of the POKéMON that live in it.$

label: Text_BodySlamTeach
en:
Ready?
Boing!\pWe're having a BODY SLAM match
to see who wimps out first.\pIf you were to join us, you'd be
squashed like a bug, though…\pHow about I teach BODY SLAM to
a POKéMON of yours instead?$

label: Text_BodySlamWhichMon
en: Which POKéMON wants to learn how\nto BODY SLAM?$

label: FourIsland_House1_Text_FatMan
en: それ　ぼよーん！\nおまえ　おもいなあー！$

label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RareIceMonsInCave
en: There's a rare kind of ICE POKéMON\nthat lives in the cave.\pWe get a lot of visitors hoping to\nsee that POKéMON.$

label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DayCarePeopleFoundEggBefore
en:
Oh? A POKéMON EGG?
…I have no idea.\p…Oh, wait. The DAY-CARE people
in town were saying something.\pThey said that they'd found EGGS
before on their property.$

label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NewPokemonJournalHasntArrived
en: What's this?\pThe new POKéMON JOURNAL hasn't\narrived on this island?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_DidYouTrySafariGame
en: Did you try the SAFARI GAME?\pThere are some rare POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneZooInFront
en: The SAFARI ZONE has a zoo in front\nof the entrance.\pOut back is the SAFARI GAME for\ncatching POKéMON.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_WheresSara
en: ERIK: Where's SARA?\nI said I'd meet her here.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_ItemBallInThere
en: That item ball in there…\nWere you wanting that?\pMe, too!\n…Huh? That's a POKéMON?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneOfficeSign
en: POKéMON PARADISE!\nWelcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\lSAFARI ZONE OFFICE$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign
en: FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\lThe Poisonous Ninja Master$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_ChanseySign
en: Name: CHANSEY\nCatching one is all up to chance.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_VoltorbSign
en: Name: VOLTORB\nThe very image of a POKé BALL.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_KangaskhanSign
en: Name: KANGASKHAN\pA maternal POKéMON that raises its\nyoung in a pouch on its belly.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SlowpokeSign
en: Name: SLOWPOKE\nFriendly and very slow moving.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_LaprasSign
en: Name: LAPRAS\nAKA the king of the seas.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_OmanyteSign
en: Name: OMANYTE\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_KabutoSign
en: Name: KABUTO\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.$

label: Text_SubstituteTeach
en:
Aww, I wish I was a KANGASKHAN
baby.\pI'd love to be a substitute for the
baby…\pAnd snuggle in the mother
KANGASKHAN's belly pouch.\pBut only POKéMON can use the
technique SUBSTITUTE…\pWant me to teach SUBSTITUTE to
one of your POKéMON?$

label: Text_SubstituteTaught
en: Boy, what I'd give to crawl inside\na KANGASKHAN belly pouch…$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_MyFatherIsGymLeader
en: My father is the GYM LEADER of\nthis town.\pI'm training to use POISON POKéMON\nas well as my father.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro
en:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pA mere child like you dares to
challenge me?\pThe very idea makes me shiver
with mirth!\pVery well, I shall show you true
terror as a ninja master.\pPoison brings steady doom.
Sleep renders foes helpless.\pDespair to the creeping horror of
POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat
en: Humph!\nYou have proven your worth!\pHere!\nTake the SOULBADGE!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle
en: When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON\nsuffers more and more.\pIt suffers worsening damage as the\nbattle wears on!\pIt will surely terrorize foes!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadge
en:
Now that you have the SOULBADGE,
the DEFENSE of your POKéMON rises.\pIt also lets you SURF outside of
battle.\pAh!
Take this, too!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06
en: Sealed within that TM06 lies\nTOXIC!\pIt is a secret technique dating\nback some four hundred years.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro
en: Strength isn't the key for POKéMON.\nDo you understand this?\pPOKéMON is about strategy!\pI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle
en: So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pThat's remarkable for a child\nTRAINER.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
en: I was a magician once upon a time.\pBut I dreamt of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this GYM.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
en: Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
en: Let's see you beat my special\ntechniques!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
en: I like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro
en: Stop right there!\pThe famed invisible walls of\nFUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle
en: You impressed me!\nHere's a hint!\pLook very closely for gaps in the\ninvisible walls!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro
en: I also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master KOGA!\pNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle
en: I still have much to learn.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
en: Master KOGA comes from a long line\nof ninjas.\pWhat did you descend from?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
en: Where there is light, there is\nshadow!\pLight and shadow!\nWhich do you choose?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
en:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pFUCHSIA GYM is a tricked-up place.
It's riddled with invisible walls!\pKOGA might appear close, but he's
blocked off.\pYou have to find gaps in the walls
to reach him.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
en: It's amazing how ninja can terrify,\neven now!$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WardenIsOldHasFalseTeeth
en: The SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN is old, \nbut he's still very much active.\pAll his teeth are false, though.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillIsMyGrandson
en: Hmm?\nYou've met BILL?\pHe's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillFilesHisOwnMonData
en: BILL files his own POKéMON data on\nhis PC.\pDid he show you?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_DoYouLikeToFish
en: I'm the FISHING GURU's older\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_LikeYourStyleTakeThis
en: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_ReceivedGoodRod
en: {PLAYER} received a GOOD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_GoodRodCanCatchBetterMons
en:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pA crummy OLD ROD could only catch
MAGIKARP, yes?\pBut with a GOOD ROD, you can
catch much better POKéMON.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_HowAreTheFishBiting
en: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForGift
en: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it!$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WouldYouLikeToForgetMove
en: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their\nmoves.\pWould you like me to do that?$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonHasForgottenMoveCompletely
en: It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_ComeAgainToForgetOtherMoves
en: Come again if there are other\nmoves to be forgotten.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_NoEggShouldKnowMoves
en: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveSafariZonePennants
en: Don't they have any pennants\npromoting the SAFARI ZONE?\pHow about some paper lanterns?\nAren't there even any calendars?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DidYouTryXSpeed
en: Did you try X SPEED?\nIt speeds up a POKéMON in battle.$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CantBecomeGoodTrainerWithOneMon
en: You can't become a good TRAINER\nwith just one strong POKéMON.\pBut raising many POKéMON evenly\nis no easy task, either.$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonLeagueWestOfViridian
en: There's a narrow trail west of\nVIRIDIAN CITY.\pIt goes to the POKéMON LEAGUE HQ.\nThe HQ governs all TRAINERS.$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitSafariZoneForPokedex
en: If you're working on a POKéDEX,\nvisit the SAFARI ZONE.\pAll sorts of rare POKéMON breed\nthere.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PlaySafariGameFor500
en: For just ¥500, you can play the\nSAFARI GAME.\pYou can roam the wide-open safari\nand catch what you like.\pWould you like to play?$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_ThatllBe500WeOnlyUseSpecialBalls
en: That'll be ¥500, please!\pWe only use a special kind of \nPOKé BALLS here.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_CallYouOnPAWhenYouRunOut
en: We'll call you on the PA when you\nrun out of time or SAFARI BALLS.\pWell, I'll wish you the best of\nluck!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_GoingToLeaveSafariZoneEarly
en: Are you going to leave the\nSAFARI ZONE early?$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PleaseReturnSafariBalls
en: Please return any SAFARI BALLS\nyou may have left.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_CatchFairShareComeAgain
en: Did you catch your fair share?\nCome again!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_FirstTimeAtSafariZone
en: Hi! Is it your first time here at\nthe SAFARI ZONE?$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_ExplainSafariZone
en:
The SAFARI ZONE actually has
four zones in it.\pEach zone has different kinds of
POKéMON, even some rare ones.\pUse the supplied SAFARI BALLS to
catch them.\pYou can also throw BAIT or ROCKS
besides the SAFARI BALLS.\pIf you throw BAIT, the POKéMON
becomes less likely to flee, but\lharder to catch.\pIf you throw ROCKS, the POKéMON
becomes more likely to flee, but\leasier to catch.\pWhen you run out of time or SAFARI
BALLS, it's game over for you!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_NicknamedWardenSlowpoke
en: We nicknamed the WARDEN\n“SLOWPOKE.”\pYou know, he has that vacant look\nlike a SLOWPOKE.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_WardenIsVeryKnowledgeable
en: WARDEN SLOWPOKE is very\nknowledgeable about POKéMON.\pHe even has some fossils of rare,\nextinct POKéMON.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_CouldntUnderstandWarden
en: WARDEN SLOWPOKE came in, but\nI couldn't understand him.\pI think he's got a speech problem!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_PrizeInSafariZone
en:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is running a
promotion campaign right now.\pTry to get to the farthest corner
of the SAFARI ZONE.\pIf you can make it, you'll win a
very convenient prize.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HifFuffHefifoo
en: WARDEN: Hif fuff hefifoo!\pHa lof ha feef ee hafahi ho.\nHeff hee fwee!$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_AhHowheeHoHoo
en: Ah howhee ho hoo!\nEef ee hafahi ho!$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HeOhayHeHaHoo
en: Ha?\nHe ohay heh ha hoo ee haheh!$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_GaveGoldTeethToWarden
en: {PLAYER} gave the GOLD TEETH\nto the WARDEN.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_WardenPoppedInHisTeeth
en: The WARDEN popped in his teeth!$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksSonGiveYouSomething
en:
WARDEN: Thanks, son!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksLassieGiveYouSomething
en:
WARDEN: Thank you, lassie!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ExplainStrength
en:
WARDEN: Inside HM04 you'll find
STRENGTH.\pIt lets POKéMON move boulders when
you're outside of battle.\pOh yes, did you find the SECRET
HOUSE in the SAFARI ZONE?$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_YouHaveTooMuchStuff
en: なんや　にもつ\nいっぱいやんけ！$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_MonPhotosFossilsOnDisplay
en: POKéMON photos and fossils are on\ndisplay.$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymGuyAdvice
en:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pAt the POKéMON LEAGUE, you will
face the ELITE FOUR all in a row.\pIf you lose, you have to start all
over again!\pThis is it!
Go for it!$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaceEliteFourGoodLuck
en: From here on, you face the\nELITE FOUR one by one.\pIf you win, a door opens to the\nnext TRAINER. Good luck!$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LoreleiIsAbsentClosedForTimeBeing
en:
I am so sorry, but you've wasted
your time coming here.\pLORELEI of the ELITE FOUR is
absent, you see.\pAs a result, the POKéMON LEAGUE is
closed for the time being.$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AgathaWhuppedUs
en:
AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are
horrifically terrifying in toughness.\pI took my FIGHTING-type POKéMON
and raised them to the max.\pI went at AGATHA feeling pretty
confident, but she whupped us.\pThat old lady's also got a really
short fuse, too.\pIt doesn't take anything to get
that scary lady hollering.$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LancesCousinGymLeaderFarAway
en: Maybe becoming an ELITE FOUR\nmember is in the blood.\pFrom what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\lsomewhere far away.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_JustImaginingWhiteHand
en: Hahaha, I guess not.\pThat white hand on your shoulder…\nI'm just imagining it.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_TownKnownAsMonGraveSite
en: This town is known as the grave\nsite of POKéMON.\pMemorial services are held in\nPOKéMON TOWER.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_GhostsAppearedInTower
en: Ghosts appeared in POKéMON TOWER.\pI think they're the spirits of\nPOKéMON that the ROCKETS killed.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_SilphScopeNotice
en: New SILPH SCOPE!\nMake the Invisible Plain to See!\pSILPH CO.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_PokemonTowerSign
en: POKéMON TOWER\nBecalm the Spirits of POKéMON$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_RocketsKilledCubonesMother
en: Those horrible ROCKETS!\nThey deserve no mercy!\pThat poor CUBONE's mother…\pIt was killed trying to escape from\nTEAM ROCKET.$
