label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_GhostOfPokemonTowerIsGone
en: The ghost of POKéMON TOWER is\ngone!\pSomeone must have soothed its\nrestless spirit!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_WantMeToRateNicknames
en: Hello, hello!\nI am the official NAME RATER!\pWant me to rate the nicknames of\nyour POKéMON?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_GiveItANicerName
en: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!\pBut, would you like me to give it\na nicer name?\pHow about it?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_WhatShallNewNicknameBe
en: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new\nnickname be?$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallBeKnownAsName
en: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallBeKnownAsSameName
en: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_TrulyImpeccableName
en: {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat is a truly impeccable name!\pTake good care of {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: LavenderTown_House2_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
en: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SearchingForStatRaiseItems
en:
I'm searching for items that raise
the stats of POKéMON.\pThey're effective over the course
of a single battle.\pX ATTACK, X DEFEND, X SPEED, 
and X SPECIAL are what I'm after.\pDo you know where I can get them?$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_DidYouBuyRevives
en: Did you buy some REVIVES?\nThey revive any fainted POKéMON!$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_TrainerDuosCanChallengeYou
en: Sometimes, a TRAINER duo will\nchallenge you with two POKéMON\lat the same time.\pIf that happens, you have to send\nout two POKéMON to battle, too.$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SoldNuggetFromMountainsFor5000
en: この　あいだ　やまおくで\nきんのたまを　ひろい　ましてね！\pつかえない　しなもの　ですが\nうったら　なんと　5000¥でした$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RocketsDoAnythingForMoney
en: TEAM ROCKET will do anything for\nthe sake of money!\pThere is no job too dirty, no deed\ntoo heinous, no crime too wicked!$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CubonesMotherKilledByRockets
en: I saw CUBONE's mother trying to\nescape from TEAM ROCKET.\pShe was killed trying to get away…$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PeoplePayForCuboneSkulls
en: You know how the CUBONE species\nwears skulls, right?\pPeople will pay a lot for one.$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HearMrFujiNotFromAroundHere
en: I recently moved to this town.\pI hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_WhereDidMrFujiGo
en: That's odd, MR. FUJI isn't here.\nWhere'd he go?$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MrFujiWasPrayingForCubonesMother
en: MR. FUJI had been praying alone\nfor CUBONE's mother.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MrFujiLooksAfterOrphanedMons
en: This is really MR. FUJI's house.\pHe's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MonsNiceToHug
en: It's so warm!\nPOKéMON are so nice to hug.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_IdLikeYouToHaveThis
en:
MR. FUJI: {PLAYER}…\pYour POKéDEX quest is one that
requires strong dedication.\pWithout deep love for POKéMON,
your quest may fail.\pI'm not sure if this will help you,
but I'd like you to have it.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_ReceivedPokeFluteFromMrFuji
en: {PLAYER} received a POKé FLUTE\nfrom MR. FUJI.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_ExplainPokeFlute
en: Upon hearing the POKé FLUTE,\nsleeping POKéMON will spring awake.\pTry using it on POKéMON that are\nsleeping obstacles.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_MustMakeRoomForThis
en: You must make room for this!$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_HasPokeFluteHelpedYou
en: MR. FUJI: Has my POKé FLUTE\nhelped you?$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_GrandPrizeDrawingClipped
en: POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.$

label: LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_PokemonMagazinesLineShelf
en: POKéMON magazines line the shelf.\pPOKéMON INSIDER…\pPOKéMON FAN…$

label: Text_ExplosionTeach
en:
Can you imagine?
If this volcano were to erupt?\pThe explosion would be the end of
us. How terrifying is that?\pWhile we're terrified, would you
like me to teach EXPLOSION?$

label: Text_ExplosionDeclined
en: Yeah, you're right.\nIt is too terrifying.$

label: Text_ExplosionWhichMon
en: You're terribly brave!\pWhich POKéMON should I teach\nEXPLOSION?$

label: Text_ExplosionTaught
en: Using EXPLOSION while on this\nvolcano…\pWhat a terrifying thrill!$

label: Text_ExplosionTeachJP
en: こ　この　かざんが\nもし　だいばくはつ　したら\lお　おれら　ひとたまりも\lないなあ　‥ブルブル！\pこ　こわい　ついでに\nだいばくはつ　でも　おぼえてみる？$

label: Text_ExplosionDeclinedJP
en: や　やっぱ　こわいもんな\nブルブル$

label: Text_ExplosionWhichMonJP
en: つ　つよきだね！\nじゃあ　どの　ポケモンに　する？$

label: Text_ExplosionTaughtJP
en: かざんで　だいばくはつを‥\nす　すごい　スリル！$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellTryDiggingHere
en: Over here.\nWe'll try digging here.\pThat treasure the ADMINS've been\ntalking about should be here.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_YoureInTheWayGetLost
en: What the…?\nYou're in the way. Get lost.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_PunchedThroughAtLast
en: Whew, punched through at last.\nLet's go treasure hunting!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WhatsPasswordAgain
en: Any treasure we find, we haul back\nto the WAREHOUSE, understood?\p…Oh, and what're the passwords?\nAt the ROCKET WAREHOUSE, I mean.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_FirstPasswordGoldeen
en: What, you forgot the password?\nThere're actually two.\pThe first one's “GOLDEEN need\nlog.”\pAnd the second one is…$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: You've been eavesdropping on us,\nhaven't you?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Trying to horn in on our treasure?\nDon't bet on it!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Develop amnesia conveniently and\nforget everything you heard!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellRegroupDontStepInsideThere
en:
What a setback…
We'll have to regroup.\pYou! Don't even think about taking
a step inside here!\pIf you know what's good for you,
don't even think about this!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganIntro
en: An active volcano is one that's\nerupting, or about to.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganDefeat
en: Whew… That was hot!\nSweat's erupting from me!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganPostBattle
en: They say there're over 1,500\nactive volcanoes in the world.\pJust thinking about them makes me\nfeel all hot and gooey inside!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethIntro
en: Do you know how caves form inside\nvolcanoes?$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethPostBattle
en: When lava at the surface of magma\nhardens, and the magma inside flows\lout, caverns are left behind.$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynIntro
en: I've been in training so I can mend\nmy broken heart…\pIt toughened me up physically at\nleast! Hi-yah!$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynDefeat
en: I think I tried to overdo it…$

label: MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: The way you battle, it reminds me\nof the guy who dumped me…$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosIntro
en: WHOA!\nYou shocked me!\l…Oh, you're just a kid!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosPostBattle
en: Kids like you shouldn't be\nwandering around here in the dark.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshIntro
en: Did you come to explore the cave,\ntoo?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshPostBattle
en: I came all the way down here to\nshow off to girls.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamIntro
en: Wow! It's way bigger in here than\nI thought!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamPostBattle
en: How do you get out of here?\nIt's so big, I may get lost.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanPostBattle
en: I have to find stronger POKéMON.\nWhere might they be?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisIntro
en: What?\nI'm waiting for my friends to find\lme here.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisPostBattle
en: I came because I heard there are\nsome very rare fossils here.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentIntro
en: Suspicious men are in the cave.\nWhat about you?$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_KentPostBattle
en: I saw them!\nI'm sure they're from TEAM ROCKET!$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyIntro
en: You need to go through this cave\nto get to CERULEAN CITY.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyPostBattle
en: ZUBAT is tough!\nBut if you can catch one, you'll\lbe able to count on it.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_BrockHelpsExcavateFossils
en: Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here\nunder MT. MOON.\pSometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM\nlends me a hand.$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelIntro
en: Hey, stop!\pI found these fossils!\nThey're both mine!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_WellEachTakeAFossil
en: We'll each take a fossil!\nNo being greedy!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_ThenThisFossilIsMine
en: All right.\nThen this fossil is mine!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_LabOnCinnabarRegeneratesFossils
en: Far away, on CINNABAR ISLAND,\nthere's a POKéMON LAB.\pThey do research on regenerating\nfossils.$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the\nfossils!\pReviving POKéMON from them will\nearn us huge riches!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: You made me mad!\nTEAM ROCKET will blacklist you!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: We, TEAM ROCKET, are POKéMON\ngangsters!\lWe strike fear with our strength!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Darn it all!\nMy associates won't stand for this!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: We're pulling a big job here!\nGet lost, kid!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: If you find a fossil, give it to me\nand scram!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Little kids shouldn't be messing\naround with grown-ups!\pIt could be bad news!$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: POKéMON lived here long before\npeople came.$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantDomeFossil
en: Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?$

label: MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantHelixFossil
en: Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?$

label: OneIsland_Text_BillLetsGoSeeCelio
en:
BILL: Here we are!
This is ONE ISLAND.\pThere are several islands around
here, and this is one of them.\pMy friend CELIO sent the boat to
fetch me here.\pHe's in charge of the island's PC
network by his lonesome.\p…Why am I telling you this now?
Let's just go see CELIO!$

label: Text_WhereDoYouWantToSail
en: Ahoy, there!\nWhere do you want to sail?$

label: OneIsland_Text_LuckyToHaveCelioHere
en:
Here we are on an island smack in
the middle of nowhere.\pWe're lucky to have an upstanding
young man like CELIO here.\pMy granddaughter was in a tizzy
over CELIO's friend.\pSomething about a famous
POKéMANIAC?\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!$

label: OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithKanto
en:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we now have PC linkage
with people in KANTO.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!$

label: OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithHoenn
en:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we finally have PC linkage
with people in HOENN.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man.\pHe would make a fine husband for
my granddaughter!$

label: OneIsland_Text_IslandSign
en: ONE ISLAND\nFriends Gather at Knot Island$

label: OneIsland_Text_PokemonNetCenterSign
en: Expanding the POKéMON World!\nPOKéMON NET CENTER$

label: OneIsland_Text_ReturnToCinnabar
en: グレンタウンに　もどりますか？$

label: OneIsland_Text_IsntWarmClimateHereGreat
en: Hi, sight-seeing, are you?\nIsn't the warm climate here great?$

label: OneIsland_House1_Text_GazeUponVolcanoOnSunnyDays
en: On sunny days, I step out and gaze\nupon the volcano.\pThat's my daily routine.$

label: OneIsland_House1_Text_LastTimeMtEmberErupted
en: Let me think… When was the last\ntime MT. EMBER erupted?$

label: OneIsland_House2_Text_IWantToStayHereForever
en: Young people all want to go off to\nbig cities.\pBut I want to stay here forever!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaIntro
en: The weather's gorgeous!\nPerfect for a battle!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaPostBattle
en: Please don't splash my face!\nYou'll ruin the makeup.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailIntro
en: I'm beginning to get a sunburn…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailPostBattle
en: I like that cap you have.\nMaybe I should wear one, too…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnIntro
en: Seen from here, MT. EMBER towers\ninto the sky.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnPostBattle
en: The sky is immense around these\nparts.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettIntro
en: I took a break from swimming,\nonly to have you challenge me?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettPostBattle
en: Instead of using SURF all the time,\nyou should swim some.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyIntro
en: Wait! Wait a second!\nI think I've hooked a big one!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyPostBattle
en: Not only did I lose, the big one\ngot away from me, too!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonIntro
en: Could you help me out with my\ntraining?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonDefeat
en: You were a cut above me.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonPostBattle
en: It's clear that you're skilled.\nI like you!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaIntro
en: There isn't a day in which we don't\ntrain!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaPostBattle
en: I'll train even harder from now on!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaIntro
en: Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaPostBattle
en: I lost because I'm pooped from all\nthe running I did…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughIntro
en: Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughPostBattle
en: Even martial artists are becoming\nfashion conscious these days…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceIntro
en: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BrycePostBattle
en: The water in volcanic regions is\ndelicious.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireIntro
en: My lunch filled us up, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClairePostBattle
en: What should I do?\nI feel famished again.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaIntro
en: KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaPostBattle
en: KIA: How could there be anyone\nbetter than my big brother?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaNotEnoughMons
en: KIA: If you want to battle with\nus, you have to bring at least two\lPOKéMON with you.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikIntro
en: MIK: Together with KIA, I'm afraid\nof nothing!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikPostBattle
en: MIK: How could my combination\nwith KIA fail?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikNotEnoughMons
en: MIK: Hey, do you want to battle\nwith us two?\pBring two or more POKéMON with\nyou, then.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_RouteSign
en: This is KINDLE ROAD.\pGo straight for MT. EMBER.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_EmberSpaSign
en: Light the Fire in Your Heart!\nEMBER SPA$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_WaterWarmsMeToCore
en:
Hm!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!\pAaaah! This is heavenly!
The water warms me to my core!\pYou should jump in, too.\pGo to the middle, relax, and get
good and warm!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_EnjoyBowlOfChowder
en: My favorite part of bathing comes\nup right after this.\pI enjoy a bowl of chowder to\nwarm me from the inside, too!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_WaterExquisiteFullyRefreshed
en: The water is perfectly warm.\nIt feels exquisite…\p{PLAYER} and the POKéMON were\nfully refreshed!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_HotSpringIsTherapeutic
en: Soaking in a hot spring pool is\ntherapeutic, people say.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_SeeHowSmoothMySkinIs
en: Have a look at my face.\nSee how smooth my skin is?\pThe hot spring's water keeps my\nskin younger than my age.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_BrunoVisitsSpaOnOccasion
en:
After an honest day of training,
nothing beats a relaxing soak in\lthe hot spring pool.\pBRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,
visits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both
his own and his POKéMON's.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_UsedThisToMakeEmberSpa
en:
Hot springs go hand-in-hand with
volcanoes.\pThe EMBER SPA here, well,
I made it years ago.\pI hewed the pool right out of a
gigantic boulder by hand.\pI was using this at the time.
I suppose I can part with it.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_ExplainHM06
en: That shatters boulders as if they\nwere made of crackers.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCantBelieveYouCameOut
en: CELIO: BILL!\nI can't believe you came out here.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHowsYourResearchComing
en: BILL: Well, absolutely!\nHow's your research coming along?\p…Oh, wait a sec.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThisIsMyBuddyCelio
en: {PLAYER}, this is my buddy CELIO.\nHe's one dedicated PC MANIAC!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIsRisingPokemonChamp
en: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, a rising\ncontender as the POKéMON CHAMP!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIsReigningPokemonChamp
en: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, the\nreigning POKéMON CHAMP!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioThatsReallyImpressive
en: CELIO: That's really impressive.\pI hate to say it, but I have zero\naptitude for battling.\pAnyways, I'm glad to meet you.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillBringMeUpToSpeed
en: BILL: So, bring me up to speed.\nHow's your machine running?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPCsCantLinkWithYours
en: CELIO: It's running fine, but we're\ntoo remote out here.\pThe PCs on this island just can't\nlink with your PC, BILL.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillLetMeHelpYou
en: BILL: Oh, yeah?\nOkay, let me take a look-see.\p…Hang on here…\nI think we can make it work.\lLet me help you, okay?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanYouDeliverThisMeteoritePlayer
en:
{PLAYER}, can I get you to wait for
me just a bit?\p…Actually, can I get you to do
me a favor?\pThe island next to this one's
called TWO ISLAND.\pThere's a guy there that runs
a GAME CORNER.\pHe has this thing for rare rocks
and gems.\pWe keep in touch, being fellow
maniacs.\pSo, can I get you to deliver this
METEORITE to him?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPleaseTakeThis
en: CELIO: {PLAYER}, if you are going\nto TWO ISLAND, please take this.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetsYouTravelBetweenIslands
en: It's a PASS for the ferry service\nserving the local islands.\pIt will let you travel between the\nISLANDS ONE, TWO, and THREE.\pOh, you should have this, too.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedExtraPageForTownMap
en: {PLAYER} received an extra page\nfor the TOWN MAP!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCatchYouLater
en: BILL: I'll catch you later!\nSay hi to the guy for me!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HmmHowAboutLikeThis
en: Hmm…\pHow about we try this like this…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GotPCWorkingStrollAWhileMore
en:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pDid you see?
We got the PC working!\pI've got a few things to show
CELIO here.\pCan you go out on a stroll or
something for a while more?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SorryForBeingPoorHost
en: I'm sorry for taking up so much of\nBILL's time.\pI'm also sorry for being such a \npoor host on your visit here.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeGotItDone
en: BILL: What kept you so long?\nBeen out having a good time?\pWe got it done.\nThe PCs are up and running!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioJobWentQuick
en: CELIO: The job went incredibly\nquick.\pBILL is one amazing guy…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillYouveLearnedALot
en: BILL: No, no! There was almost\nnothing left for me to do.\pCELIO, I have to hand it to you.\nYou've learned a lot.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeShouldHeadBackToKanto
en: BILL: Well, there you have it.\nI'm finished with the job.\lWe should head back to KANTO.\pCELIO, I'll be seeing you again.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPromiseIllShowYouAroundSometime
en: CELIO: {PLAYER}, I'm really sorry\nthat we sent you off alone today.\pI promise, I will show you around\nthese islands sometime.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioImModifyingMyNetworkMachine
en:
CELIO: Hello!
You look awfully busy as always.\pHow am I doing?\pWell, I'm modifying my Network
Machine.\pWhen I get done with the machine,
I hope you'll be first to use it,\l{PLAYER}.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCaughtMoreMonMaybeICanBeUseful
en:
CELIO: {PLAYER}, how have things
been for you?\pOh, is that right?
You've caught more POKéMON.\pDo you know what?
Maybe I can be useful to you.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullBeTradingFromTrainersFarAway
en:
I'm modifying the Network Machine
right now.\pI'm changing it so it can handle
trades over long distances.\pWhen I get finished, you'll be
trading for exotic POKéMON from\lTRAINERS far away.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeedsSpecialGemstone
en: But, there is a slight catch.\pFor the link to work, the Machine\nneeds a special gemstone.\pIt's supposed to be on ONE ISLAND,\nbut I haven't found one yet.\pWho knows where it could be.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryingToFindGem
en:
I was trying to find the gem
even while I was studying.\pAs a result, I've made no headway
in both my search and studies…\pIf I relied on BILL, I'm sure my
research would progress.\pBut this time, I want to try to do
things by myself.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MayIAskOneMoreFavor
en: Thank you!\n{PLAYER}, you're simply amazing.\p… … …  … … …\pUm… May I ask one more giant favor\nof you?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PleaseINeedYourHelp
en: It… It's not anything weird.\nPlease, I need your help.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AnotherGemstoneInSeviiIslands
en:
While I was studying gemstones,
I discovered something important.\pThere is another gem that forms
a pair with this RUBY.\pThat other gemstone is supposed to
be in the SEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I need you to go
find the other gem.\p{PLAYER}, may I have your ferry
PASS and the TOWN MAP?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReturnedTriPassForRainbowPass
en: {PLAYER} returned the TRI-PASS and\nreceived the RAINBOW PASS.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ObtainedExtraMapPage
en: Obtained an extra page for the\nTOWN MAP!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetYouGetToAllIslands
en: This is my own ferry PASS.\pIt will let you get to all the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I can't do\nit without your help.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThankYouGiveMeTime
en:
CELIO: So this is the gem that
forms a pair with the RUBY…\p{PLAYER}, you've gone through a lot
to get this, didn't you?\pYou don't have to tell me. I know
it wasn't easy.\pThank you so much!\pNow it's my turn to work for you!
Please give me a little time.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LinkedUpWithLanette
en: I did it!\nI linked up with LANETTE!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManagedToLinkWithHoennThankYou
en:
{PLAYER}…
{PLAYER}, I did it!\pI've managed to link up with
TRAINERS in the HOENN region!\pFinally, the Network Machine is
fully operational!\p{PLAYER}, I owe it all to you!\pThanks to you, my dream came
true…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishYouBestOfLuck
en: I…\nI'm not crying.\pThat's enough about me!\p{PLAYER}, you're going to keep\nlooking for exotic POKéMON, right?\pI wish you the best of luck!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioHearingRumorsAboutYou
en: CELIO: Hello!\p{PLAYER}, I've been hearing rumors\nabout you.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsFirstMonWasAbra
en:
{PLAYER}, what's your favorite kind
of POKéMON?\pBILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves
every kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught
was an ABRA.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsHometownInGoldenrod
en:
By the way, {PLAYER}, you're from
PALLET TOWN, aren't you?\pI've heard that it's a quiet and
pleasant place.\pBILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,
where his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the
festive, bustling city.\pI'd like to go there one day.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCantStomachMilk
en: {PLAYER}, is there anything that\nyou can't stand?\pApparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CameFromPalletDontKnowIt
en: Oh, you're a stranger here!\nHi! Where did you come from?\p…PALLET TOWN?\nI don't know it!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EnormousVolcanoOnIsland
en: On this island, there's an enormous\nvolcano.\pIt hasn't erupted lately, so why\nnot enjoy a hike?$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishICouldTradeWithBoyfriend
en: I wish I could trade POKéMON with\nmy boyfriend who lives far away…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedWithFarAwayBoyfriend
en: I traded POKéMON with my boyfriend\nfar away!\pEveryone's saying that we can\nthank you and CELIO.\pSo, thank you!$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineUnderAdjustment
en: Network Machine\nLink Level 0\p…POKéMON Storage System under\nadjustment…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineLinkedWithKanto
en: Network Machine\nLink Level 1\pLink established with the KANTO\nregion.$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineLinkedWithKantoAndHoenn
en: Network Machine\nLink Level 2\pLink established with the KANTO\nand HOENN regions.$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraIntro
en: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nIt's exquisite.$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraPostBattle
en: The sea is pleasantly warm in these\nparts.$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_GoodThingsWashUpOnBeach
en: Good things get washed up by the\nocean current onto this beach.\pThat's why I often come here for\nsome beachcombing.$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakGrassUnsafeNeedMon
en:
OAK: It's unsafe!
Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!\pYou need your own POKéMON for
your protection.\pI know!
Here, come with me!$

label: PalletTown_Text_RaisingMonsToo
en: I'm raising POKéMON, too.\pWhen they get strong, they can\nprotect me.$

label: PalletTown_Text_CanStoreItemsAndMonsInPC
en: Technology is incredible!\pYou can now store and recall items\nand POKéMON as data via PC.$

label: PalletTown_Text_TownSign
en: PALLET TOWN\nShades of your journey await!$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakLetMeSeePokedex
en: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\nYou're back, are you?\pHow much have you filled in your\nPOKéDEX?\pMay I see it?\pLet's see…$

label: PalletTown_Text_CaughtXPuttingInHonestEffort
en: You've caught {STR_VAR_2}…\pHm, it looks as if you're putting\nin an honest effort.\pWhen you manage to fill it some\nmore, come show me, please.$

label: PalletTown_Text_CaughtXImpressiveFollowMe
en:
You've caught… {STR_VAR_2}!?
Now, this is impressive!\pThere's something I wanted to ask
of you, {PLAYER}.\pCome.
Follow me.$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakYouEnjoyingTraveling
en:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!
You seem to be enjoying traveling.\pKnowing you, {PLAYER}, I can easily
imagine you going out to even more\lexotic locales.\pGood for you, good for you.
Hohoho.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllBoysLeaveOakLookingForYou
en: MOM: …Right.\nAll boys leave home someday.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllGirlsLeaveOakLookingForYou
en: MOM: …Right.\nAll girls dream of traveling.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldTakeQuickRest
en: MOM: {PLAYER}!\nYou should take a quick rest.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LookingGreatTakeCare
en: MOM: Oh, good! You and your\nPOKéMON are looking great.\lTake care now!$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnTVFourBoysOnRailroad
en: There's a movie on TV.\nFour boys are walking on railroad\ltracks.\p…I better go, too.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnTVGirlOnBrickRoad
en: There's a movie on TV.\nA girl with her hair in pigtails is\lwalking up a brick road.\p…I better go, too.$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PlayedWithNES
en: {PLAYER} played with the NES.\p…Okay!\nIt's time to go!$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PressLRForHelp
en: It's a posted notice…\pIf you're confused, ask for HELP!\nPress the L or R Button!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalNoFairWhatAboutMe
en: {RIVAL}: Hey! Gramps! No fair!\nWhat about me?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGoChoosePlayer
en: {RIVAL}: Heh, I don't need to be\ngreedy like you. I'm mature!\pGo ahead and choose, {PLAYER}!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalMyMonLooksTougher
en: {RIVAL}: My POKéMON looks a lot\ntougher than yours.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLetsCheckOutMons
en: {RIVAL}: Wait, {PLAYER}!\nLet's check out our POKéMON!\pCome on, I'll take you on!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGoToughenMyMon
en: {RIVAL}: Okay! I'll make my\nPOKéMON battle to toughen it up!\p{PLAYER}! Gramps!\nSmell you later!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalWhatDidYouCallMeFor
en: {RIVAL}: I almost forgot!\nWhat did you call me for?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLeaveItToMeGramps
en: {RIVAL}: All right, Gramps!\nLeave it all to me!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalTellSisNotToGiveYouMap
en:
{PLAYER}, I hate to say it, but you
won't be necessary for this.\pI know! I'll borrow a TOWN MAP
from my sis!\pI'll tell her not to lend you one,
{PLAYER}! Hahaha!\pDon't bother coming around to
my place after this!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThreeMonsChooseOne
en:
OAK: {RIVAL}?
Let me think…\pOh, that's right, I told you to
come! Just wait!\pHere, {PLAYER}.\pThere are three POKéMON here.\pHaha!\pThe POKéMON are held inside
these POKé BALLS.\pWhen I was young, I was a serious
POKéMON TRAINER.\pBut now, in my old age, I have
only these three left.\pYou can have one.
Go on, choose!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBePatientRival
en: OAK: Be patient, {RIVAL}.\nYou can have one, too!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakWhichOneWillYouChoose
en: OAK: Now, {PLAYER}.\pInside those three POKé BALLS are\nPOKéMON.\pWhich one will you choose for\nyourself?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingCharmander
en: Ah! CHARMANDER is your choice.\nYou should raise it patiently.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you're claiming the\nFIRE POKéMON CHARMANDER?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingSquirtle
en: Hm! SQUIRTLE is your choice.\nIt's one worth raising.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you've decided on the\nWATER POKéMON SQUIRTLE?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingBulbasaur
en: I see! BULBASAUR is your choice.\nIt's very easy to raise.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you want to go with\nthe GRASS POKéMON BULBASAUR?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCanReachNextTownWithMon
en: OAK: If a wild POKéMON appears,\nyour POKéMON can battle it.\pWith it at your side, you should be\nable to reach the next town.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBattleMonForItToGrow
en: OAK: {PLAYER}, raise your young\nPOKéMON by making it battle.\pIt has to battle for it to grow.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHaveSomethingForMe
en:
OAK: Oh, {PLAYER}!
How is my old POKéMON?\pWell, it seems to be growing more
attached to you.\pYou must be talented as a POKéMON
TRAINER.\pWhat's that?
You have something for me?$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCustomBallIOrdered
en: Ah! \nIt's the custom POKé BALL!\pI had it on order.\nThank you!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHaveRequestForYouTwo
en: OAK: Oh, right!\nI have a request for you two.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakPokedexOnDesk
en: On the desk there is my invention,\nthe POKéDEX!\pIt automatically records data on\nPOKéMON you've seen or caught.\pIt's a high-tech encyclopedia!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCatchMonsForDataTakeThese
en:
OAK: You can't get detailed data
on POKéMON by just seeing them.\pYou must catch them to obtain
complete data.\pSo, here are some tools for
catching wild POKéMON.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakExplainCatching
en:
When a wild POKéMON appears,
it's fair game.\pJust throw a POKé BALL at it and
try to catch it!\pThis won't always work, however.\pA healthy POKéMON can escape.
You have to be lucky!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCompleteMonGuideWasMyDream
en:
To make a complete guide on all
the POKéMON in the world…\pThat was my dream!\pBut, I'm too old.
I can't get the job done.\pSo, I want you two to fulfill my
dream for me.\pGet moving, you two.\pThis is a great undertaking in
POKéMON history!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMonsAroundWorldWait
en: POKéMON around the world wait for\nyou, {PLAYER}!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakAddedNothingToPokedex
en:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
How is your POKéDEX shaping up?\p{RIVAL} has already caught some
POKéMON and added to the data.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let's have a look at
your POKéDEX.\p…What's the matter?
You've added no new data at all.\pI'll give you these, so do try a
little harder.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakComeSeeMeSometime
en: OAK: Come see me sometime.\pAfter all, I want to know how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_BlankEncyclopedia
en: It's like an encyclopedia, but the\npages are blank.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ThoseArePokeBalls
en: Those are POKé BALLS.\nThey contain POKéMON!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_PressStartToOpenMenu
en: Press START to open the MENU!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_SaveOptionInMenu
en: The SAVE option is on the MENU.\nUse it regularly.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_AllMonTypesHaveStrongAndWeakPoints
en: All POKéMON types have strong and\nweak points against others.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_EmailMessage
en:
There's an e-mail message here.\p…\pFinally!
The ultimate TRAINERS of the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE are ready to\ltake on all comers!\pBring your best POKéMON and see
how you rate as a TRAINER!\pPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ
INDIGO PLATEAU\pPROF. OAK, please visit us!
…$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_StudyAsOaksAide
en: I study POKéMON as PROF. OAK's\nAIDE.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_DaisyWillGroomMons
en:
Hi, {PLAYER}. I bet you've become
good friends with your POKéMON.\pBy the way, did you know about
DAISY?\pIf you show DAISY your POKéMON,
she can tell how much it likes you.\pOccasionally, she will even groom
a POKéMON for you.\pThis is a secret, so please don't
tell anyone.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsGoingToHaveRadioShow
en: PROF. OAK is going to have his own\nradio show soon.\pThe program will be called PROF.\nOAK's POKéMON SEMINAR.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsAuthorityOnMons
en: PROF. OAK may not look like much,\nbut he's the authority on POKéMON.\pMany POKéMON TRAINERS hold him in\nhigh regard.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakFavorToAskYouPlayer
en: Ah, now this is excellent!\p{PLAYER}, I have another important\nfavor to ask of you.\pI need you to listen closely.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakSightingsOfRareMons
en:
Recently, there have been sightings
of many rare POKéMON species.\pI'm talking about POKéMON that
have never been seen in KANTO.\pI would love to go see things for
myself, but I'm much too old.\pSince I can't do it, {PLAYER}, I'd
like you to go in my place.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalJustLetMeHandleEverything
en:
{RIVAL}: Hey, I heard that!\pGramps, what's with favoring
{PLAYER} over me all the time?\pI went and collected more POKéMON,
and faster, too.\pYou should just let me handle
everything.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNeedYourHelpTooNeedToSeePokedexes
en: OAK: I know, I know.\nOf course I need your help, too.\pNow, I need to see both your\nPOKéDEXES.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNowTheseUnitsCanRecordMoreData
en: … … …  … … …\p… … …  … … …\p…And that's done!\pNow these units can record data on\na lot more POKéMON.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMustReallyWorkToFillPokedex
en:
Now, {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}!\pThis time, you really must work
towards filling your POKéDEXES.\pI urge you to make them the best
and the most complete of all time!\pTruly, this is a monumentally great
undertaking in POKéMON history!$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalIllCompleteThePokedex
en:
{RIVAL}: Gramps, calm down.
Don't get so excited.\pI'll get the POKéDEX completed,
don't you worry about a thing.\pI think I'll try looking around
ONE ISLAND first…\pAnyways, I'm outta here!$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HiBrothersAtLab
en: DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pMy brother, {RIVAL}, is out at\nGrandpa's LAB.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HeardYouBattledRival
en: DAISY: {PLAYER}, I heard you had\na battle against {RIVAL}.\pI wish I'd seen that!$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ErrandForGrandpaThisWillHelp
en: Grandpa asked you to run an\nerrand?\pGee, that's lazy of him.\nHere, this will help you.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
en: You don't have space for this in\nyour BAG.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ExplainTownMap
en: You can use the TOWN MAP to find\nout where you are, or check the\lnames of places.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_PleaseGiveMonsRest
en: DAISY: Just like people, POKéMON\nare living things.\pWhen they get tired, please give\nthem a rest.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsBigMapOfKanto
en: It's a big map of the KANTO region.\nNow this would be useful!$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ShelvesCrammedFullOfBooks
en: The shelves are crammed full of\nbooks on POKéMON.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LikeMeToGroomMon
en:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good timing.\pI'm about to have some tea.
Would you like to join me?\pOh, but look.
Your POKéMON are a little dirty.\pWould you like me to groom one?$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontNeedAnyGrooming
en: You don't need any grooming done?\nOkay, we'll just have tea.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LookingNiceInNoTime
en: DAISY: Okay, I'll get it looking\nnice in no time.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ThereYouGoAllDone
en:
{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…\p{COLOR RED}DAISY: There you go! All done.
{FONT_NORMAL}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…\p{FONT_FEMALE}DAISY: There you go! All done.
See? Doesn't it look nice?\pGiggle…
It's such a cute POKéMON.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CantGroomAnEgg
en: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't\ngroom an EGG.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_MayISeeFirstMon
en: DAISY: Your POKéMON grow to love\nyou if you raise them with love.\pFor example, {PLAYER}, may I see\nyour first POKéMON?$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CouldntLoveYouMore
en: It couldn't possibly love you\nany more than it does now.\pYour POKéMON is happy beyond\nwords.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItLooksVeryHappy
en: It looks very happy.\pI wish {RIVAL} could see this and\nlearn something from it.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsQuiteFriendly
en: It's quite friendly with you.\nKeep being good to it!$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsWarmingUpToYou
en: It's warming up to you.\nTrust must be growing between you.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_NotFamiliarWithYouYet
en: It's not quite familiar with you\nyet.\pPOKéMON are all quite wary when\nyou first get them.$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontLikeWayItGlaresAtYou
en: {PLAYER}, I don't like the way it\nglares at you.\pCould you try being a little nicer\nto it?$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_WhyWouldMonHateYouSoMuch
en: …Um, it's not easy for me to say\nthis, but…\pIs there some reason why your\nPOKéMON would hate you so much?$

label: Text_DreamEaterTeach
en:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.\pI had this weird dream about
a DROWZEE eating my dream.\pAnd…
I learned how to eat dreams…\pOogh, this is too spooky!\pLet me teach it to a POKéMON so
I can forget about it!$

label: Text_DreamEaterWhichMon
en: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nDREAM EATER?$

label: PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon
en: CLEFAIRY came from the moon.\nThat's what the rumor is.\pThey appeared after MOON STONES\nfell on MT. MOON.$

label: PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerHere
en:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.$

label: PewterCity_Text_DidYouCheckOutMuseum
en: Did you check out the MUSEUM?$

label: PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazing
en: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON\namazing?$

label: PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum
en: This is it, the MUSEUM.\pYou have to pay to get in, but it's\nworth it. See you around!$

label: PewterCity_Text_DoYouKnowWhatImDoing
en: Psssst!\nDo you know what I'm doing?$

label: PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildMonsOut
en: I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild\nPOKéMON out of my garden!$

label: PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChallengersFollowMe
en: You're a TRAINER, right?\pBROCK's looking for new\nchallengers. Follow me!$

label: PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock
en: If you have the right stuff,\ngo take on BROCK!$

label: PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP
en: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON that appear in battle,\nhowever briefly, earn EXP Points.$

label: PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieves
en: NOTICE!\pThieves have been stealing POKéMON\nfossils from MT. MOON.\pPlease call the PEWTER POLICE if\nyou have any information.$

label: PewterCity_Text_GymSign
en: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!$

label: PewterCity_Text_DefeatedBrockYouCanHaveTreasure
en: あッれー！\nその　ジムバッジ‥‥\lすげえな　タケシに　かったのかよ！\pかんどう　したから\nおれの　たからもの　やるよ！$

label: PewterCity_Text_BerriesInsideUseCarefully
en: なかには　きのみが　はいってるぜ\pやくに　たつ　きのみも\nはいって　いるから\lだいじに　つかって　くれよ！$

label: PewterCity_Text_MonsWillUseHeldBerriesOnTheirOwn
en: ポケモンに　きのみを\nもたせて　おけば\lたたかっている　ときに\lかってに　つかって　くれるんだ\pキズぐすり　とか　どくけし　より\nてがるで　べんり　だろ？$

label: PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis
en: I'm glad I caught up to you.\nI'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.\pI've been asked to deliver this,\nso here you go.$

label: PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFromAide
en: {PLAYER} received the\nRUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.$

label: PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: Press the B Button to run.\nBut only where there's room to run!$

label: PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab
en: Well, I must be going back to\nthe LAB.\pBye-bye!$

label: PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMom
en: There's a letter attached…\pDear {PLAYER},\pHere is a pair of RUNNING SHOES\nfor my beloved challenger.\pRemember, I'll always cheer for\nyou! Don't ever give up!\pFrom Mom$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro
en:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK.
I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.\pMy rock-hard willpower is evident
even in my POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are all rock hard, and
have true-grit determination.\pThat's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!\pFuhaha! You're going to challenge
me knowing that you'll lose?\pThat's the TRAINER's honor that
compels you to challenge me.\pFine, then!
Show me your best!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDefeat
en:
I took you for granted, and so
I lost.\pAs proof of your victory, I confer
on you this…the official POKéMON\lLEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} received the BOULDERBADGE
from BROCK!{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\p{FONT_MALE}Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes
your POKéMON more powerful.\pIt also enables the use of the
move FLASH outside of battle.\pOf course, a POKéMON must know the
move FLASH to use it.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM39
en:
A TM, Technical Machine, contains a
technique for POKéMON.\pUsing a TM teaches the move it
contains to a POKéMON.\pA TM is good for only one use.\pSo, when you use one, pick the
POKéMON carefully.\pAnyways…
TM39 contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt hurls boulders at the foe and
lowers its SPEED.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle
en:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in
this huge world of ours.\pYou appear to be very gifted as a
POKéMON TRAINER.\pSo let me make a suggestion.\pGo to the GYM in CERULEAN and test
your abilities.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis
en: You don't have room for this.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamIntro
en: Stop right there, kid!\pYou're ten thousand light-years \nfrom facing BROCK!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamPostBattle
en: You're pretty hot.\n…But not as hot as BROCK!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetMeTakeYouToTheTop
en:
Hiya!
Do you want to dream big?\pDo you dare to dream of becoming
the POKéMON champ?\pI'm no TRAINER, but I can advise
you on how to win.\pLet me take you to the top!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TryDifferentPartyOrders
en:
The first POKéMON out in a match is
at the left of the POKéMON LIST.\pBy changing the order of POKéMON,
you may gain an advantage.\pTry different orders to suit your
opponent's party.$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ItsFreeLetsGetHappening
en: It's a free service!\nLet's get happening!$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_YoureChampMaterial
en: Just as I thought!\nYou're POKéMON champ material!$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_TradeMonsAreFinicky
en:
Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's
finicky and hard to handle.\pAn outsider is a POKéMON that you
get in a trade.\pIt grows fast, but it may ignore an
unskilled TRAINER in battle.\pIf only we had some BADGES…$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsLearnTechniquesAsTheyGrow
en: POKéMON learn new techniques as\nthey grow.\pBut some moves must be taught to\nthem by people.$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsEasierCatchIfStatused
en:
A POKéMON becomes easier to 
catch if it has a status problem.\pSleep, poison, burn, or paralysis…
Those are all effective.\pBut catching POKéMON is never
a sure thing!$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_BoughtWeirdFishFromShadyGuy
en: A shady old guy sucked me into\nbuying this weird fish POKéMON!\pIt's totally weak and it cost ¥500!$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_GoodThingsIfRaiseMonsDiligently
en: Good things can happen if you raise\nPOKéMON diligently.\pEven the weak ones can surprise\nyou if you don't give up on them.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChildsTicket
en: Yes, yes.\nIt's ¥50 for a child's ticket.\pWould you like to come in?$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatAmberIs
en: You can't sneak in the back way!\nNice try, kid, but no.\pOh, whatever!\nDo you know what AMBER is?$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsGeneticMatter
en: AMBER contains the genetic matter\nof ancient POKéMON.\pThere's a LAB somewhere trying to\nresurrect POKéMON from AMBER.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossilizedSap
en: AMBER is actually sap, that gooey\nstuff that oozes from trees.\pThe ancient sap fossilized over\ntime to become rock-hard AMBER.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseGoAround
en: あちらへ　おまわりください$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratefulForLongLife
en: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAmberExamined
en:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.\pI think that this chunk of AMBER
contains POKéMON DNA!\pIt would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if POKéMON could be\lresurrected from it.\pBut, my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.\pSo, I have a favor to ask!\pI want you to get this examined at
a POKéMON LAB somewhere.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ReceivedOldAmberFromMan
en: {PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER\nfrom the man.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
en: You don't have space for this.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossilsOnExhibit
en: We have two fossils of rare,\nprehistoric POKéMON on exhibit.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPieceOfAmber
en: There is a beautiful piece of\nAMBER in a clear gold color.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFossil
en: AERODACTYL Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil
en: KABUTOPS Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$

label: Text_SeismicTossTeach
en:
The secrets of space…
The mysteries of earth…\pThere are so many things about
which we know so little.\pBut that should spur us to study
harder, not toss in the towel.\pThe only thing you should toss…\pWell, how about SEISMIC TOSS?
Should I teach that to a POKéMON?$

label: Text_SeismicTossDeclined
en: Is that so?\nI'm sure you'll be back for it.$

label: Text_SeismicTossWhichMon
en: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSEISMIC TOSS?$

label: Text_SeismicTossTaught
en: I hope you won't toss in the towel.\nKeep it up.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WhatsSpecialAboutMoonStone
en: MOON STONE, huh?\pWhat's so special about it?\nLooks like an ordinary rock to me.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BoughtColorTVForMoonLanding
en: July 20, 1969!\pHumankind first set foot on the\nmoon that day.\pI bought a color TV just so I\ncould watch that news.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_RunningSpaceExhibitThisMonth
en: This month, we're running a space\nexhibit.$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AskedDaddyToCatchPikachu
en: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PikachuSoonIPromise
en: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MeteoriteThatFellOnMtMoon
en: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketMtMoonImOnPhone
en: What!?\pTEAM ROCKET is at MT. MOON?\nHuh?\pI'm on the phone!\nScram!$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhenJiggylypuffSingsMonsGetDrowsy
en: Yawn!\pWhen JIGGLYPUFF sings, POKéMON get\ndrowsy…\p…Me, too…\nSnore…$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingMyClefairyForPikachu
en: I really want a PIKACHU, so I'm\ntrading my CLEFAIRY for one.$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingPikachuWithKid
en: I'm trading POKéMON with that kid\nthere.\pI had two PIKACHU, so I figured\nI might as well trade one.$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Intro
en:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_RematchIntro
en:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're the child that OAK's taken
under his wing, aren't you?\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_PostBattle
en: You win!\pI see what the old duff sees in\nyou now.\pI have nothing else to say.\nRun along now, child!$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Intro
en:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_RematchIntro
en:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_PostBattle
en: My job is done.\nGo face your next challenge.$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Intro
en:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI was looking forward to seeing
you, {PLAYER}.\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchIntro
en:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou came back, {PLAYER}!
Hahah, that is so great!\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en:
NO!
That can't be!\lYou beat me at my best!\pAfter all that work to become
the LEAGUE CHAMP?\pMy reign is over already?
It's not fair!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Victory
en:
はーはッ！
かった！　かった！　かった！\p{PLAYER}に　まける　ような
おれさま　では　なーい！\pま！　ポケモンの
てんさい　{RIVAL}さま　あいてに\lここまで　よく　がんばった！\pほめて　つかわす！
はーッ！　はーはッはッ！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattle
en:
Why?
Why did I lose?\pI never made any mistakes raising
my POKéMON…\pDarn it! You're the new POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pAlthough I don't like to admit it…$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCongratulations
en:
OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations!\pYou're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\pYou've grown up so much since you
first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work\lon the POKéDEX.\p{PLAYER}, you have come of age!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakImDisappointedRival
en:
OAK: {RIVAL}…
I'm disappointed in you.\pI came when I heard you'd beaten
the ELITE FOUR.\pBut, when I got here, you had
already lost!\p{RIVAL}, do you understand why
you lost?\pYou have forgotten to treat your
POKéMON with love and trust.\pWithout them, you will never
become a CHAMP again!$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayerComeWithMe
en:
OAK: {PLAYER}.\pYou understand that your victory
was not just your own doing.\pThe bond you share with your
POKéMON is marvelous.\p{PLAYER}!
Come with me!$

label: PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_Text_OakCongratulations
en:
OAK: Er-hem!
Congratulations, {PLAYER}!\pThis floor is the POKéMON HALL OF
FAME.\pPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are
honored for their exploits here.\pTheir POKéMON are also recorded in
the HALL OF FAME.\p{PLAYER}!\pYou have worked hard to become
the new LEAGUE CHAMPION.\pCongratulations, {PLAYER}, you and
your POKéMON are HALL OF FAMERS!$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Intro
en:
Ah! I've heard about you,
{PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_RematchIntro
en:
Ah!
So, you've returned, {PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Defeat
en: That's it!\pI hate to admit it, but you are a\nPOKéMON master!$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_PostBattle
en:
I still can't believe my dragons
lost to you, {PLAYER}.\pYou are now the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\p…Or, you would have been, but
you have one more challenge left.\pThere is one more TRAINER to face!
His name is…\p{RIVAL}!\pHe beat the ELITE FOUR before
you.\pHe is the real POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION.$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Intro
en:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.\pNo one can best me when it comes
to icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_RematchIntro
en:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI, LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR,
have returned!\pYou know how it goes.
No one can best me when it comes\lto icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_PostBattle
en: You're better than I thought.\nGo on ahead.\pYou only got a taste of the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's power.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedIntro
en: Who are you?\nThere shouldn't be anyone here.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedPostBattle
en: A key? I don't know what you're\ntalking about.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonIntro
en: W-w-waah! You startled me!\nI thought you were a ghost.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonPostBattle
en: I was exploring here by myself,\nbut I feel spooked.\pI ought to go soon.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieIntro
en: I can't get out!\nThis old place is one big puzzle.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArniePostBattle
en: The switches here open and close\nalternating sets of doors.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_NewMonDiscoveredInGuyanaJungle
en: Diary: July 5\nGuyana, South America\pA new POKéMON was discovered deep\nin the jungle.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ChristenedDiscoveredMonMew
en: Diary: July 10\nWe christened the newly discovered\lPOKéMON, MEW.$

label: PokemonMansion_Text_PressSecretSwitchJP
en: ひみつの　スイッチが　ある！\pおして　みますか？$

label: PokemonMansion_Text_LetsTryIt
en: おしてみよう！　‥ポチッとな$

label: PokemonMansion_Text_GaveUpOnPressingSwitch
en: おすのは　あきらめた$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonPostBattle
en: I wonder where my partner went.$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonPostBattle
en: So, you're stuck?\nTry jumping off over there!$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_MewGaveBirthToMewtwo
en: Diary: Feb. 6\nMEW gave birth.\pWe named the newborn MEWTWO.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisPostBattle
en: You can find stuff lying around.\nThe residents must've left them.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanIntro
en: This place is ideal for a lab.\nLook at all this space.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanPostBattle
en: I like it here.\nIt's conducive to my studies.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_MewtwoIsFarTooPowerful
en: Diary: Sept. 1\nMEWTWO is far too powerful.\pWe have failed to curb its vicious\ntendencies…$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ErectedInMemoryOfDeadMons
en: POKéMON TOWER was erected in the\nmemory of POKéMON that died.$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsSon
en: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\nson.$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsGirl
en: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\ngirl.$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_CameToPrayForDepartedClefairy
en: I came to pray for my dearly\ndeparted CLEFAIRY.\pSniff!\nI'm awash in tears…$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_SenseSpiritsUpToMischief
en: I am a CHANNELER.\pThere are spirits up to mischief.\nI sense them high in the TOWER.$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalIntro
en: {RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nWhat brings you here?\lIs your POKéMON dead?\pHey! It's alive!\pI can at least make them faint!\nLet's go!$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalDefeat
en: What?\nYou stinker!\pI took it easy on you, too!$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalVictory
en: {RIVAL}“あーあ‥！\nほんとに　くたばっちまったぞ！\lよわいなー！\lもっと　ちゃんと　そだてて　やれよ$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalPostBattle
en:
How's your POKéDEX coming?
I just caught a CUBONE!\pI can't find the bigger MAROWAK.
Where could they be?\pI bet there aren't any left!\pWell, I better get going.
I've got a lot to accomplish,\lunlike you.\pSmell ya later!$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_SilphScopeCouldUnmaskGhosts
en: Even we could not identify the\nwayward ghosts.\pA SILPH SCOPE might be able to\nunmask them.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopePostBattle
en: The ghosts can be identified by\nthe SILPH SCOPE.$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
en: The others above…\nThey must have been possessed.$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelPostBattle
en: We can't determine the identity of\nthe ghosts…$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyPostBattle
en: May the departed POKéMON rest in\npeace…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RestHereInPurifiedSpace
en: Come, child!\nI have purified this space.\lYou can rest here.$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaePostBattle
en: I fell to evil spirits despite my\ntraining in the mountains…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_PurifiedZoneMonsFullyHealed
en: Entered the purified and protected\nzone.\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON were fully\nhealed.$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaPostBattle
en: My hair didn't fall out!\nIt was a malevolent spirit!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_GhostWasCubonesMother
en: The ghost was the restless spirit\nof CUBONE's mother!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_MothersSpiritWasCalmed
en: The mother's spirit was calmed.\pIt departed to the afterlife…$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: What do you want?\nWhy are you here?$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: I'm not going to forget this!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en:
This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: POKéMON are only good for making\nmoney. Why not use them?\pYou stay out of our business!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: You're not getting away with this!$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_MrFujiThankYouFollowMe
en:
MR. FUJI: Heh?
You came to save me?\pThank you. But, I came here of my
own free will.\pI came to calm the spirit of
CUBONE's mother.\pI think MAROWAK's spirit has
finally left us.\pI must thank you for your kind
concern.\pFollow me to my home, POKéMON
HOUSE, at the foot of this tower.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: Who are you?\nHow did you get here?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Blast it… You're dissing TEAM\nROCKET, aren't you?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: You broke into TEAM ROCKET's\noperation? What nerve!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: You're not going to get away with\nthis, brat!$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: SILPH SCOPE? Humph!\nI don't know where it is.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: Okay, I'll talk…\nTake the elevator to see my BOSS.$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: Are you lost, you little mouse?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: Uh-oh, that ruckus somehow opened\nthe door!$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntIntro
en: BOSS said you can see ghosts with\nthe SILPH SCOPE.$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntPostBattle
en: The TEAM ROCKET HQ has four\nunderground floors.\pThink you can reach the BOSS?$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: Stop meddling in TEAM ROCKET's\naffairs or else!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: SILPH SCOPE?\nOh, that machine the BOSS stole.\pIt's here somewhere.$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: We got word from upstairs that you\nwere coming!$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Go ahead and go!\pBut you can't run the elevator\nwithout the LIFT KEY.$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniIntro
en:
So! I must say, I am impressed you
got here.\pTEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from
around the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping
our criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!\pFor your insolence, you will feel a
world of pain!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
en: I see that you raise POKéMON with\nutmost care.\pA child like you would never\nunderstand what I hope to achieve.\pI shall step aside this time!\pI hope we meet again…$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: I know you!\nYou ruined our plans at MT. MOON!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Do you have something against TEAM\nROCKET?$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: How can you not see the beauty of\nour evil?$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: The elevator doesn't work?\nWho has the LIFT KEY?$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Oh, no!\nI dropped the LIFT KEY!$

label: RocketHideout_Elevator_Text_AppearsToNeedAKey
en: It appears to need a key.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyIntro
en: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle
en: Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\pHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat
en: Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\lWhich way is out?$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle
en: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro
en: Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonPostBattle
en: Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahIntro
en: Eek!\pDon't try anything funny in the\ndark!$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahPostBattle
en: I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaIntro
en: I came this far looking for wild\nPOKéMON.$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaPostBattle
en: You looked cute and harmless.\nWas I ever wrong!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaIntro
en: Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\pYou can bend twigs as trail\nmarkers.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyPostBattle
en: I go for power because I hate\nthinking.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperIntro
en: You have a POKéDEX?\nI want one, too.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperPostBattle
en: When you finish your POKéDEX,\ncan I have it?$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveIntro
en: Um… Do you know about POKéMON\ncosplay?$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle
en: POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\pCLEFAIRY is a favorite.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenIntro
en: My POKéMON techniques will leave\nyou crying!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenPostBattle
en: In mountains, you'll often find\nROCK-type POKéMON.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaIntro
en: I don't often come here, but I will\nbattle you.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaPostBattle
en: I like tiny POKéMON.\nBig ones are too scary!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricIntro
en: Hit me with your best shot!$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricPostBattle
en: I'll raise my POKéMON to beat\nyours, kid.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro
en: I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle
en: I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.$

label: Route1_Text_WorkAtPokeMartTakeSample
en:
Hi!
I work at a POKéMON MART.\pIt's part of a convenient chain
selling all sorts of items.\pPlease, visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.\pI know, I'll give you a sample.
Here you go!$

label: Route1_Text_ComeSeeUsIfYouNeedPokeBalls
en: Please come see us if you need\nPOKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.$

label: Route1_Text_PutPotionAway
en: {PLAYER} put the POTION away in\nthe BAG's ITEMS POCKET.$

label: Route1_Text_CanJumpFromLedges
en: See those ledges along the road?\pIt's a bit scary, but you can jump\nfrom them.\pYou can get back to PALLET TOWN\nquicker that way.$

label: Route10_Text_MarkIntro
en: Wow, you came all the way here?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?$

label: Route10_Text_MarkPostBattle
en: I have more rare POKéMON at home!$

label: Route10_Text_HermanIntro
en: Hi, kid!\nWant to see my POKéMON?$

label: Route10_Text_HermanPostBattle
en: I don't like you.\nI don't like anyone better than me!$

label: Route10_Text_HeidiIntro
en: I've been out at a POKéMON GYM\na few times.\p…But I always lose.$

label: Route10_Text_HeidiPostBattle
en: I noticed some POKéMANIACS\nprowling around.\pCan you imagine? Them?\nUp here in the mountains?$

label: Route10_Text_TrentPostBattle
en: I feel bloated on mountain air!$

label: Route10_Text_CarolIntro
en: I'm feeling a bit faint.\nI haven't hiked in some time.$

label: Route10_Text_CarolDefeat
en: I'm too tired.\nI wasn't up for it.$

label: Route10_Text_CarolPostBattle
en: The POKéMON here in the mountains\nare so chunky…\pI wish there were pink POKéMON\nwith a floral pattern!$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryTypeStrongerThanOthers
en: The types of POKéMON match up\ndifferently with each other.\pEvery type is stronger than some\ntypes and weaker than others.$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NuggetUselessSoldFor5000
en: A NUGGET is totally useless.\nSo I sold it for ¥5000.$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardGhostsHauntLavender
en: I heard that ghosts haunt\nLAVENDER TOWN.$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GiveEverstoneIfCaught20Mons
en:
Oh… {PLAYER}!
I've been looking for you!\pIt's me, one of the ever-present
AIDES to PROF. OAK.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on twenty species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward from PROF. OAK.\pHe entrusted me with this
EVERSTONE.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
twenty kinds of POKéMON?$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
en: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainEverstone
en:
Making POKéMON evolve certainly
can add to the POKéDEX.\pHowever, at times, you may not
want a certain POKéMON to evolve.\pIn that case, give the EVERSTONE
to that POKéMON.\pIt will prevent evolution according
to the PROFESSOR.$

label: Route11_Text_HugoPostBattle
en: POKéMON is life!\nAnd to live is to play games!$

label: Route11_Text_JasperPostBattle
en: You can't be a coward in the world\nof POKéMON!$

label: Route11_Text_EddiePostBattle
en: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$

label: Route11_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
en: Spread the word to save energy!$

label: Route11_Text_DillonIntro
en: I just became a TRAINER.\nBut, I think I can win.$

label: Route11_Text_DillonDefeat
en: My POKéMON couldn't win…\nHaven't they grown enough?$

label: Route11_Text_DirkPostBattle
en: You were just lucky, that's all.$

label: Route11_Text_YasuIntro
en: I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning.$

label: Route11_Text_YasuDefeat
en: Darn!\nMy POKéMON need to be stronger!$

label: Route11_Text_YasuPostBattle
en: There's a fat POKéMON that comes\ndown from the mountains.\pI bet it'd be strong if you can\ncatch it.$

label: Route11_Text_BerniePostBattle
en: Well, better get back to work.$

label: Route11_Text_DaveIntro
en: I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now!$

label: Route11_Text_DavePostBattle
en: Tch…\nI better go find stronger ones!$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_BagIsFull
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}の　バッグ\nいっぱい　みたい　だね$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_ManInLavenderRatesNames
en:
Don't you think it's hard to think
up good names for POKéMON?\pEspecially if you've caught a
whole bunch?\pIn LAVENDER TOWN, there's a man
who rates POKéMON nicknames.\pHe can even help you rename your
POKéMON, too.$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_RockTunnelToReachLavender
en: If you're aiming to reach LAVENDER\nTOWN, take ROCK TUNNEL.\pYou can get to ROCK TUNNEL from\nCERULEAN CITY.$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemfinderIfCaught30
en:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
en: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainItemfinder
en:
There are items on the ground that
may be hidden from view.\pUse the ITEMFINDER to detect any
hidden items close to you.\pThe machine is a bit limited.
It can't pinpoint item locations.\pWhat it does is show the direction
where the item is.\pUse it to get your bearings, then
search the suspect area by hand.$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_BigMonAsleepOnRoad
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA big POKéMON is asleep on a road!$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_WhatABreathtakingView
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pWhat a breathtaking view!$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_RockTunnelGoodRouteToLavender
en:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…\pTo get to LAVENDER TOWN from
CERULEAN CITY…\pROCK TUNNEL appears to be a good
route to take.$

label: Route12_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber
en: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.$

label: Text_SnorlaxWokeUp
en: SNORLAX woke up!\pIt attacked in a grumpy rage!$

label: Text_SnorlaxReturnedToMountains
en: SNORLAX calmed down.\nIt gave a huge yawn…\lAnd returned to the mountains.$

label: Text_WantToUsePokeFlute
en: Want to use the POKé FLUTE?$

label: Route12_Text_ChipIntro
en: Be patient.\nFishing is a waiting game.$

label: Route12_Text_ChipPostBattle
en: With a better ROD, I could catch\nbetter POKéMON…$

label: Route12_Text_JustinIntro
en: I'm searching for a MOON STONE.\nHave you found one?$

label: Route12_Text_JustinPostBattle
en: I could have made my POKéMON\nevolve with a MOON STONE.\pI would have won then, I bet.$

label: Route12_Text_LucaIntro
en: Electricity is my specialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.$

label: Route12_Text_LucaPostBattle
en: Water conducts electricity, so you\nshould zap sea POKéMON.$

label: Route12_Text_HankPostBattle
en: I guess you get to be good at\nwhat you like.\pWell, you beat me at POKéMON,\nbut you can't top me at fishing.$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotIntro
en: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\pBut it'd be best if I also had more\nwork.$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotPostBattle
en: It's all right.\nLosing doesn't bug me anymore.$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewIntro
en: What's catching?\pYou never know what you could\ncatch!$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewPostBattle
en: What, MAGIKARP?\pI catch them all the time, sure.\nBut, boy are they wimpy.$

label: Route12_Text_JesIntro
en: JES: If I win, I'm going to\npropose to GIA.$

label: Route12_Text_JesDefeat
en: JES: Oh, please, why couldn't you\nlet us win?$

label: Route12_Text_JesPostBattle
en: JES: Oh, GIA, forgive me,\nmy love!$

label: Route12_Text_JesNotEnoughMons
en: JES: GIA and I, we'll be\ntogether forever.\pWe won't battle unless you have\ntwo POKéMON of your own.$

label: Route12_Text_GiaIntro
en: GIA: Hey, JES…\pIf we win, I'll marry you!$

label: Route12_Text_GiaPostBattle
en: GIA: JES, you silly!\nYou ruined this!$

label: Route12_Text_GiaNotEnoughMons
en: GIA: I can't bear to battle\nwithout my JES!\pDon't you have one more POKéMON?$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoYouLikeToFish
en: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TakeThisAndFish
en: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_ReceivedSuperRod
en: {PLAYER} received a SUPER ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_IfYouCatchBigMagikarpShowMe
en:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend.\pNow, I have a request.\pIf you catch a big MAGIKARP 
with that ROD, I want to see it.\pAs much as I love to fish, I also
love seeing gigantic MAGIKARP.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TryFishingBringMeMagikarp
en:
Hello there, {PLAYER}!
Have you been fishing?\pTry fishing with the SUPER ROD in
any body of water.\pYou'll find different POKéMON in
different places.\pOh, and don't forget to bring me
gigantic MAGIKARP.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhMagikarpAllowMeToSee
en: Oh? {PLAYER}?\nWhy, if it isn't a MAGIKARP!\pAllow me to see it, quick!$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_WhoaXInchesTakeThis
en:
… … …Whoa!
{STR_VAR_2} inches!\pYou have a rare appreciation for
the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!\pYou must take this.
I insist!$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_LookForwardToGreaterRecords
en: I'll look forward to seeing greater\nrecords from you!$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HuhXInchesSameSizeAsLast
en: Huh?\n{STR_VAR_2} inches?\pThis is the same size as the one\nI saw before.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HmmXInchesDoesntMeasureUp
en: Hmm…\nThis one is {STR_VAR_2} inches long.\pIt doesn't measure up to the\n{STR_VAR_3}-inch one you brought before.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoesntLookLikeMagikarp
en: Uh… That doesn't look much like\na MAGIKARP.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_NoRoomForGift
en: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it.$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_MostGiganticMagikarpXInches
en: The most gigantic MAGIKARP\nI have ever witnessed…\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_BlankChartOfSomeSort
en: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_LookoutSpotUpstairs
en: There's a lookout spot upstairs.\nThe view is magnificent.$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDontNeedAnymoreMale
en: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDontNeedAnymoreFemale
en: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainTM27
en: TM27 is a move called RETURN…\pIf you treat your POKéMON good,\nit will return your love by working\lits hardest in battle.$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis
en: You don't have room for this.$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TheresManFishing
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a man fishing!$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsPokemonTower
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's POKéMON TOWER!$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianIntro
en: My bird POKéMON want to battle\nwith you!$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianPostBattle
en: My POKéMON look happy even though\nthey lost.$

label: Route13_Text_SusieIntro
en: I'm told I'm good for a kid.$

label: Route13_Text_SusiePostBattle
en: I want to become a good TRAINER.\nI'll train hard, just watch.$

label: Route13_Text_ValeriePostBattle
en: You got those BADGES from GYM\nLEADERS. I know!$

label: Route13_Text_GwenIntro
en: My cute POKéMON wish to make your\nacquaintance.$

label: Route13_Text_GwenPostBattle
