en: You have to make POKéMON battle\nto toughen them up.$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaIntro
en: I found CARBOS in a cave once\nwhile I was spelunking.$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaDefeat
en: Oh, too bad!\nI just messed up!$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaPostBattle
en: CARBOS boosted the SPEED of my\nPOKéMON.$

label: Route13_Text_PerryIntro
en: I'm not going to lose.\nNot when the wind's blowing my way!$

label: Route13_Text_PerryPostBattle
en: I'm beat.\nI guess I'll FLY home.$

label: Route13_Text_LolaIntro
en: Sure, I'll play with you, sweetie.$

label: Route13_Text_LolaPostBattle
en: I wonder which is stronger, male or\nfemale POKéMON?$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaIntro
en: Do you want to battle some\nPOKéMON with me?$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaPostBattle
en: I don't know anything about\nPOKéMON actually.\pThe ones I use… I picked them\nfor their looks!$

label: Route13_Text_RobertIntro
en: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.$

label: Route13_Text_RobertPostBattle
en: I wish I could fly like PIDGEY and\nPIDGEOTTO…$

label: Route13_Text_LookToLeftOfThatPost
en: TRAINER TIPS\pLook, look!\nLook to the left of that post!$

label: Route13_Text_SelectToSwitchItems
en: TRAINER TIPS\pUse SELECT to switch items in the\nITEMS window.$

label: Route14_Text_CarterIntro
en: You need to use TMs to teach good\nmoves to POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_CarterPostBattle
en: You have some HMs, right? POKéMON\ncan't forget those moves easily.$

label: Route14_Text_MitchIntro
en: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle.$

label: Route14_Text_MitchPostBattle
en: My bird POKéMON need to learn\nbetter moves.$

label: Route14_Text_BeckIntro
en: They have TMs on sale at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE.\pTMs aren't really rare, but not\nmany people have HMs.$

label: Route14_Text_BeckPostBattle
en: Try teaching POKéMON a move that's\nthe same type as it.\pThat apparently boosts the power\nof the move.$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonIntro
en: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky!$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonPostBattle
en: Bird POKéMON are my one true love.\nI don't want to raise anything else.$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldIntro
en: Have you heard the legend of the\nwinged mirages?$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldPostBattle
en: Well, the winged mirages are the\nlegendary bird POKéMON.\pThere are three of them: ARTICUNO,\nZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.$

label: Route14_Text_BennyIntro
en: I'm not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!$

label: Route14_Text_BennyPostBattle
en: Winning, losing… It's insignificant\nunder this huge sky.$

label: Route14_Text_LukasIntro
en: C'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!$

label: Route14_Text_LukasPostBattle
en: What, what, what?\nWhat do you want still?$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacIntro
en: I need to burn some time.\nShut up and battle.$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacPostBattle
en: Raising POKéMON is a drag, man.$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldIntro
en: We ride out here because of the\nwide-open spaces.$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldPostBattle
en: It's cool you made your POKéMON so\nstrong.\pMight is right!\nAnd you know it!$

label: Route14_Text_MalikPostBattle
en: You know who'd win, you and me\none-on-one!$

label: Route14_Text_KiriIntro
en: KIRI: JAN, let's try really,\nreally hard together.$

label: Route14_Text_KiriPostBattle
en: KIRI: Did we lose because of me?$

label: Route14_Text_KiriNotEnoughMons
en: KIRI: We can battle if you have\ntwo POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_JanIntro
en: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nWe have to try hard!$

label: Route14_Text_JanPostBattle
en: JAN: KIRI, don't cry!\nWe'll just try harder next time.$

label: Route14_Text_JanNotEnoughMons
en: JAN: You want to battle?\nYou don't have enough POKéMON.$

label: Route15_Text_KindraIntro
en: I just got some POKéMON in trades.\nCan I try them out on you?$

label: Route15_Text_KindraPostBattle
en: You can't change the nickname of\nany POKéMON you get in a trade.\pOnly the Original TRAINER can get\nthe nickname changed.$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyIntro
en: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it a go!$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyPostBattle
en: I'm afraid of BIKERS. They look so\nugly and mean!$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinIntro
en: When I whistle, I can summon bird\nPOKéMON.$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinPostBattle
en: Maybe I'm not cut out for battles.\nI'm not the right type, I guess.$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterIntro
en: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nYou're good, aren't you?$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterPostBattle
en: This is so obvious, you should know\nthis, but…\pMoves like EARTHQUAKE and FISSURE\nhave no effect on bird POKéMON.$

label: Route15_Text_GraceIntro
en: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!$

label: Route15_Text_GracePostBattle
en: I forgive you.\nI can take it.\lI'm a big girl now.$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaIntro
en: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaDefeat
en: POKéMON isn't about winning or\nlosing for me.$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaPostBattle
en: I love having my POKéMON greet me\nwhen I get home.\pIt's so reassuring.$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestIntro
en: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI just got these off some loser!$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestPostBattle
en: Life's too short.\nIt's cool to live as an outlaw.\lTEAM ROCKET RULES!$

label: Route15_Text_AlexIntro
en: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!$

label: Route15_Text_AlexPostBattle
en: I was just joking about the money.\nDon't take me all serious.$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaPostBattle
en: I trade POKéMON with my friends\nall the time.$

label: Route15_Text_YazminIntro
en: Want to play with my POKéMON?$

label: Route15_Text_YazminPostBattle
en: I'll go train with weaker people.$

label: Route15_Text_MyaIntro
en: MYA: You're perfect.\nHelp me train my little brother?$

label: Route15_Text_MyaDefeat
en: MYA: RON, you have to focus!\nConcentrate on what you're doing!$

label: Route15_Text_MyaPostBattle
en: MYA: Okay, we'll turn it up.\nI'll add to our training menu!$

label: Route15_Text_MyaNotEnoughMons
en: MYA: Do you want to challenge us?\nYou'll need two POKéMON, though.$

label: Route15_Text_RonIntro
en: RON: My sister gets scary when we\nlose.$

label: Route15_Text_RonDefeat
en: RON: Oh, no, no…\nSis, I'm sorry!$

label: Route15_Text_RonPostBattle
en: RON: Oh, bleah…\nI wish I had a nice sister…$

label: Route15_Text_RonNotEnoughMons
en: RON: Did you want to battle with\nmy sister and me?\pYou need two POKéMON, then.$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_1F_Text_OaksAideCameByHere
en: Are you the kid who's working on\na POKéDEX?\pPROF. OAK's AIDE came by here.$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemIfCaughtEnough
en:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
en: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: EXP. SHARE is an item to be held\nby a POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON will receive a share\nof the EXP. Points without having\lto battle.$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_LargeShiningBird
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA large, shining bird is flying\ntoward the sea.$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_SmallIslandOnHorizon
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt looks like a small island on\nthe horizon!$

label: Route16_Text_LaoPostBattle
en: We like just hanging here.\nWhat's it to you?$

label: Route16_Text_KojiPostBattle
en: Forget it, who needs your BIKE!$

label: Route16_Text_LukeIntro
en: Come out and play, little mouse!$

label: Route16_Text_LukePostBattle
en: I hate losing!\nGet out of my face!$

label: Route16_Text_HideoPostBattle
en: We'll always be hanging around here\neven if you don't like it.\pYou can detour to VERMILION from\nFUCHSIA going along the coast.$

label: Route16_Text_CamronIntro
en: I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI need a punching bag!$

label: Route16_Text_CamronPostBattle
en: If I'm going to have POKéMON, they\nmay as well be ferocious.\pI'd use them to leave my enemies\nin tatters.$

label: Route16_Text_RubenIntro
en: Hey, there!\nLet's have ourselves a good time!$

label: Route16_Text_RubenPostBattle
en: I get my kicks by harassing people\nwith my stinking POKéMON.\pThey're great for startling people.\nAnd, they bite, too.$

label: Route16_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber
en: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.$

label: Route16_Text_JedIntro
en: JED: Our love knows no bounds.\nWe're in love and we show it!$

label: Route16_Text_JedDefeat
en: JED: Oh, no!\nMy love has seen me as a loser!$

label: Route16_Text_JedPostBattle
en: JED: Listen, LEA.\nYou need to focus less on me.$

label: Route16_Text_JedNotEnoughMons
en: JED: You have just one POKéMON?\nIs there no love in your heart?$

label: Route16_Text_LeaIntro
en: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.$

label: Route16_Text_LeaDefeat
en: LEA: Ohh! But JED looks cool\neven in a loss!$

label: Route16_Text_LeaPostBattle
en: LEA: Ehehe, I'm sorry.\nJED is so cool.$

label: Route16_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons
en: LEA: Oh, you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you?\pDoesn't it feel lonely for you or\nyour POKéMON?$

label: Route16_House_Text_FoundMySecretRetreat
en: Oh, dear.\nYou've found my secret retreat.\pPlease don't tell anyone I'm here.\nI'll make it up to you with this!$

label: Route16_House_Text_ExplainHM02
en: HM02 is FLY.\nIt's a wonderfully convenient move.\pPlease, put it to good use.$

label: Route16_House_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForThis
en: You don't have any room for this.$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_NoPedestriansOnCyclingRoad
en: No pedestrians are allowed on\nCYCLING ROAD!$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoadIsDownhillCourse
en: CYCLING ROAD is a downhill course\nby the sea. It's a great ride.$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_OnBikeRideWithGirlfriend
en: I'm on a relaxing ride on my new\nbike with my girlfriend.$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_RidingTogetherOnNewBikes
en: We're going riding together on our\nnew bikes.$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsCeladonDeptStore
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's the CELADON DEPT. STORE!$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_LongPathOverWater
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a long path over water far\naway.$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GiveAmuletCoinIfCaught40
en:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on 40 species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with an
AMULET COIN for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
40 kinds of POKéMON?$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
en: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedAmuletCoinFromAide
en: {PLAYER} received the AMULET COIN\nfrom the AIDE.$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainAmuletCoin
en: An AMULET COIN is an item to be\nheld by a POKéMON.\pIf the POKéMON appears in a winning\nbattle, you will earn more money.$

label: Route17_Text_RaulIntro
en: There's no getting rich quick in\nbattling kids.$

label: Route17_Text_RaulPostBattle
en: You can find good stuff lying\naround on CYCLING ROAD.\pThere's good money in picking them\nup and selling them.$

label: Route17_Text_IsaiahIntro
en: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!$

label: Route17_Text_BillyIntro
en: We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!$

label: Route17_Text_NikolasPostBattle
en: I got my VOLTORB at the abandoned\nPOWER PLANT.$

label: Route17_Text_ZeekIntro
en: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nwon't evolve. Why?$

label: Route17_Text_ZeekPostBattle
en: Maybe some POKéMON need element\nSTONES to evolve.$

label: Route17_Text_JamalPostBattle
en: I'm sure I lost weight there!$

label: Route17_Text_CoreyPostBattle
en: Be ready to fight for your beliefs!$

label: Route17_Text_JaxonPostBattle
en: The slope makes it hard to steer.$

label: Route17_Text_WilliamPostBattle
en: I need to catch a few z's!$

label: Route17_Text_WatchOutForDiscardedItems
en: It's a notice.\pWatch out for discarded items.$

label: Route17_Text_SameSpeciesGrowDifferentRates
en: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON are unique.\pEven POKéMON of the same species\nand level grow at different rates.$

label: Route17_Text_PressBToStayInPlace
en: TRAINER TIPS\pPress the B Button to stay in place\nwhile on a slope.$

label: Route17_Text_DontThrowGameThrowBalls
en: It's a notice!\pDon't throw the game, throw POKé\nBALLS instead!$

label: Route18_Text_WiltonIntro
en: I always check every grassy area\nfor new POKéMON.$

label: Route18_Text_WiltonPostBattle
en: I wish I had a BIKE!$

label: Route18_Text_RamiroIntro
en: Kurukkoo!\nHow do you like my birdcall?$

label: Route18_Text_RamiroPostBattle
en: I collect sea POKéMON on weekends\nbecause the sea is so close.$

label: Route18_Text_JacobIntro
en: This is my turf!\nGet out of here!$

label: Route18_Text_JacobPostBattle
en: This is my fave area for catching\nPOKéMON.$

label: Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_NeedBicycleForCyclingRoad
en: You need a BICYCLE to go out on\nCYCLING ROAD!$

label: Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoadAllUphillFromHere
en: CYCLING ROAD is all uphill from\nhere.$

label: Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PalletTownInWest
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pPALLET TOWN is in the west.$

label: Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PeopleSwimming
en: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere are people swimming.$

label: Route19_Text_RichardIntro
en: I have to exercise and warm up\nbefore going out for a swim.$

label: Route19_Text_RichardPostBattle
en: Thanks, kid!\nI'm ready for a swim.$

label: Route19_Text_ReeceIntro
en: Wait! Slow down!\nYou'll have a heart attack!$

label: Route19_Text_ReecePostBattle
en: Watch out for TENTACOOL.\nThey sting so painfully.$

label: Route19_Text_MatthewPostBattle
en: I can beat even marine POKéMON\nat swimming.$

label: Route19_Text_DouglasPostBattle
en: I see a couple of islands over\nyonder!$

label: Route19_Text_DavidIntro
en: I tried diving for POKéMON, but it\nwas a no-go.$

label: Route19_Text_DavidPostBattle
en: I guess you have to fish for sea\nPOKéMON.$

label: Route19_Text_TonyIntro
en: I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.$

label: Route19_Text_TonyPostBattle
en: I'm looking at the sea to forget\nthe bad thing that happened!$

label: Route19_Text_AnyaIntro
en: Oh, I just love your ride!\nCan I have it if I win?$

label: Route19_Text_AnyaPostBattle
en: It's still a long way to go to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS…\pI want to go back to FUCHSIA…$

label: Route19_Text_AlicePostBattle
en: My boyfriend wanted to swim to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS.$

label: Route19_Text_AxlePostBattle
en: M-my legs! They cramped up!\nGlub, glub…$

label: Route19_Text_ConnieIntro
en: I swam here with my friends…\nI'm tired…$

label: Route19_Text_ConniePostBattle
en: If I were to ride a POKéMON on\nthe sea, I'd like a LAPRAS.\pLAPRAS is so big, I bet it\nwould keep me dry on water.$

label: Route19_Text_LiaIntro
en: LIA: I'm looking after my brother.\nHe just became a TRAINER.$

label: Route19_Text_LiaDefeat
en: LIA: That's no way to treat my\nlittle brother!$

label: Route19_Text_LiaPostBattle
en: LIA: Do you have a younger\nbrother?\pI hope you're teaching him all\nsorts of things.$

label: Route19_Text_LiaNotEnoughMons
en: LIA: I want to battle together\nwith my little brother.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?$

label: Route19_Text_LucIntro
en: LUC: My big sis taught me how\nto swim and train POKéMON.$

label: Route19_Text_LucDefeat
en: LUC: Oh, wow!\nSomeone tougher than my big sis!$

label: Route19_Text_LucPostBattle
en: LUC: My big sis is strong and nice.\nI think she's awesome!$

label: Route19_Text_LucNotEnoughMons
en: LUC: I don't want to if I can't\nbattle you with my big sis.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?$

label: Route20_Text_BarryIntro
en: The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.$

label: Route20_Text_BarryPostBattle
en: I wish I could ride my POKéMON.\nI bet you're not tired.$

label: Route20_Text_ShirleyIntro
en: SEAFOAM is a quiet getaway.\nI'm vacationing here.$

label: Route20_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
en: There's a huge cavern underneath\nthis island.$

label: Route20_Text_TiffanyIntro
en: I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.$

label: Route20_Text_IrenePostBattle
en: SEAFOAM used to be a single island\nin the distant past.$

label: Route20_Text_DeanPostBattle
en: I should've been buffing up my\nPOKéMON, not me!$

label: Route20_Text_DarrinIntro
en: Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nCan't you swim?$

label: Route20_Text_DarrinPostBattle
en: Riding a POKéMON sure looks fun!$

label: Route20_Text_RogerIntro
en: I rode my bird POKéMON here.$

label: Route20_Text_RogerDefeat
en: Oh, no!\nNow what am I to do?$

label: Route20_Text_RogerPostBattle
en: My birds are exhausted.\nThey can't FLY me back!$

label: Route20_Text_NoraIntro
en: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.$

label: Route20_Text_NoraDefeat
en: Oh, no!\nMy pearls were in them!$

label: Route20_Text_NoraPostBattle
en: Will my pearls grow bigger inside\nCLOYSTER?$

label: Route20_Text_MissyIntro
en: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, I tell you.$

label: Route20_Text_MissyPostBattle
en: POKéMON have taken over an\nabandoned mansion on CINNABAR.\pThey call it the POKéMON MANSION\nnow.$

label: Route20_Text_MelissaIntro
en: CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.$

label: Route20_Text_MelissaPostBattle
en: CINNABAR is a volcanic island.\pI heard it rose out of the sea\nwhen a volcano erupted.$

label: Route20_Text_MistyTrainsHere
en: Strong TRAINERS and WATER POKéMON\nare common sights in these parts.\pThey say that MISTY of the\nCERULEAN GYM trains here.$

label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldIntro
en: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?$

label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldPostBattle
en: I can't catch anything good.\nNot one good POKéMON to be had!$

label: Route21_North_Text_WadeIntro
en: I got a big haul!\nWanna go for it?$

label: Route21_North_Text_WadeDefeat
en: Heheh, MAGIKARP just don't make\nthe grade, do they?$

label: Route21_North_Text_WadePostBattle
en: I seem to only catch MAGIKARP!$

label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerIntro
en: The sea cleanses my body and soul!$

label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerPostBattle
en: The sea is great and all, but I\nlike the mountains, too.$

label: Route21_North_Text_CueBallIntro
en: おれだって　たまには\nおよぎに　くるぜ！$

label: Route21_North_Text_CueBallPostBattle
en: うきやすそう　だと？\nうるせー　おおきな　おせわだッ！$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackIntro
en: I caught my POKéMON at sea.$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeIntro
en: Right now, I'm in a triathlon meet.$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromePostBattle
en: I'm beat! But, I still have the\nbike race and marathon left!$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandIntro
en: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeIntro
en: Hey, don't scare away the fish!$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeDefeat
en: Sorry! I'm just so frustrated from\nnot catching anything.$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudePostBattle
en: Sheesh, I haven't caught a thing.\nCould this place actually be a\lgiant pool or something?$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanIntro
en: Keep me company till I get a hit.$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanPostBattle
en: Oh wait!\nI got a bite! Yeah!$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilIntro
en: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nIAN, can't you do it alone?$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilDefeat
en: LIL: Oh, see?\nWe lost. Happy now?$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilPostBattle
en: LIL: I'm tired.\nCan't we go home already?$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilNotEnoughMons
en: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nI can't be bothered to do it alone.\lBring two POKéMON, won't you?$

label: Route21_North_Text_IanIntro
en: IAN: My sis doesn't get enough\nexercise, so I made her come.$

label: Route21_North_Text_IanPostBattle
en: IAN: Come on, Sis!\pYou're not going to lose weight\nlike this!$

label: Route21_North_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
en: IAN: We want a two-on-two battle.\nSo can you bring two POKéMON?$

label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalIntro
en:
{RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!\pYou're off to the POKéMON LEAGUE?
Forget about it!\pYou probably don't have any
BADGES, do you?\pThe guard won't let you through
without them.\pBy the way, did your POKéMON get
any stronger?$

label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalPostBattle
en:
I heard the POKéMON LEAGUE is
crawling with tough TRAINERS.\pI have to figure out how to get
past them.\pYou should quit dawdling and get a
move on!$

label: Route22_Text_RivalShouldCatchSomeMons
en: {RIVAL}“なんだ？\nポケモン　2ひきも\lもってるの　なぜか　だって？\pおまえも\nつかまえれば　いい　じゃん！$

label: Route22_Text_LateRivalIntro
en:
{RIVAL}: What? {PLAYER}!
What a surprise to see you here!\pSo you're going to the POKéMON
LEAGUE?\pYou collected all the BADGES, too?
That's cool!\pThen I'll whip you, {PLAYER}, as a
warm-up for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pCome on!$

label: Route22_Text_LateRivalPostBattle
en: That loosened me up.\nI'm ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\p{PLAYER}, you need more practice.\pBut hey, you know that!\nI'm out of here. Smell ya!$

label: Route22_Text_LateRivalVictory
en: {RIVAL}“ひゃははッ　{PLAYER}ー！\nそれで　がんばってるのかよ！\lおれの　さいのうに　くらべりゃ\l{PLAYER}は　まだまだ　だな！\pもっと　れんしゅう　こいよ！\nあははーッ！$

label: Route24_Text_JustEarnedFabulousPrize
en: Congratulations! You beat our\nfive contest TRAINERS!\pYou just earned a fabulous prize!$

label: Route24_Text_ReceivedNuggetFromMysteryTrainer
en: {PLAYER} received a NUGGET\nfrom the mystery TRAINER!$

label: Route24_Text_JoinTeamRocket
en:
By the way, how would you like to
join TEAM ROCKET?\pWe're a group of professional
criminals specializing in POKéMON!\pWant to join?\pAre you sure?\pCome on, join us!\pI'm telling you to join!\p…Okay, you need convincing!\pI'll make you an offer you can't
refuse!$

label: Route24_Text_YoudBecomeTopRocketLeader
en: With your ability, you'd become\na top leader in TEAM ROCKET.\pCome on, think of the opportunity!\nDon't let this chance go to waste.$

label: Route24_Text_ShaneIntro
en: I saw your feat from the grass!$

label: Route24_Text_ShanePostBattle
en: I hid because the people on the\nbridge frightened me.$

label: Route24_Text_EthanPostBattle
en: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

label: Route24_Text_ReliPostBattle
en: I did my best, so I've no regrets!$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyPostBattle
en: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

label: Route24_Text_AliPostBattle
en: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

label: Route24_Text_CaleIntro
en: People call this the NUGGET\nBRIDGE!\pBeat us five TRAINERS and win\na fabulous prize!\pThink you got what it takes?$

label: Route24_Text_CalePostBattle
en: I did my best. I have no regrets!$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyPostBattle
en: All POKéMON have weaknesses.\nEven the strongest ones.\pThat's why it's best to raise\nPOKéMON of different types.$

label: Route25_Text_DanIntro
en: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.$

label: Route25_Text_DanPostBattle
en: On the S.S. ANNE, I saw TRAINERS\nfrom around the world.$

label: Route25_Text_FlintIntro
en: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!$

label: Route25_Text_FlintPostBattle
en: Oh, well.\nMy girlfriend will cheer me up.$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyPostBattle
en: I wish my boyfriend was as good\nas you.$

label: Route25_Text_ChadIntro
en: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you!$

label: Route25_Text_ChadPostBattle
en: If your POKéMON gets confused,\nswitch it out.\pThat's a good tactic.$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyIntro
en: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyPostBattle
en: You came from MT. MOON?\nMay I have a CLEFAIRY?$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinIntro
en: I just got down from MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinPostBattle
en: Drat!\nA ZUBAT bit me back in that cave.$

label: Route25_Text_NobIntro
en: I'm off to see a POKéMANIAC's\ncollection at the cape.$

label: Route25_Text_NobDefeat
en: You done got me, and real good,\ntoo!$

label: Route25_Text_NobPostBattle
en: The POKéMANIAC sure lives up to\nhis name.\pHis collection includes many rare\nspecies of POKéMON.$

label: Route25_Text_WayneIntro
en: You're going to see BILL?\nFirst, we battle!$

label: Route25_Text_WaynePostBattle
en: The trail below is a shortcut to\nCERULEAN CITY.$

label: Route25_Text_MistyHighHopesAboutThisPlace
en: This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.$

label: Route25_Text_AreYouHereAlone
en: Hello, are you here alone?\pIf you're out at CERULEAN's cape…\nWell, it should be as a couple.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutPal
en:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, pal.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutLady
en:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, lady.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_RunCellSeparationOnPC
en: Wait till I get inside the\nTELEPORTER.\pWhen I do, go to my PC and run\nthe Cell Separation System.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseChief
en:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, chief?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseBeautiful
en:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, beautiful?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksBudTakeThis
en:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, bud! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksLadyTakeThis
en:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, lady! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SSAnnePartyYouGoInstead
en:
That cruise ship S.S. ANNE is in
VERMILION CITY.\pI hear there are lots of TRAINERS
on board, too.\pThey invited me to their party, but
I can't stand fancy do's.\pWhy don't you go instead of me?
Go on and have a good time.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_CheckOutRareMonsOnPC
en: BILL: Feel like checking out some\nof my rare POKéMON on my PC?\pGo on, check out my PC.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_TeleporterIsDisplayed
en: TELEPORTER is displayed on the PC\nmonitor.$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SeeWhichMon
en: Which POKéMON do you want to see?$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GiveHM05IfSeen10Mons
en:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on ten species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with
HM05 for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
ten kinds of POKéMON?$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GreatHereYouGo
en: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ExplainHM05
en: HM05 contains the hidden move\nFLASH.\pFLASH lights up even the darkest\nof caves and dungeons.$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_CanGetThroughRockTunnel
en: Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you\ncan get through ROCK TUNNEL.$

label: Route2_House_Text_FaintedMonsCanUseFieldMoves
en: A fainted POKéMON just has no\nenergy left to battle.\pIt can still use moves like CUT\noutside of battle.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_ManyMonsOnlyInForests
en: Many POKéMON live only in forests \nand caves.\pYou need to be persistent and look\neverywhere to get different kinds.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCutSkinnyTrees
en: Have you noticed the skinny trees\non the roadside?\pThey can be cut down by a special\nPOKéMON move, I hear.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCancelEvolution
en:
Do you know the evolution-cancel
technique?\pWhen a POKéMON is evolving, you
can stop the process.\pIt's a technique for raising
POKéMON the way they are.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_ForestIsMaze
en: Are you going to VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nIt's a natural maze in there.\lBe careful you don't get lost.$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_RattataHasWickedBite
en: RATTATA may be small, but don't\nunderestimate its wicked bite.\pHave you caught one already?$

label: Route3_Text_TunnelFromCeruleanTiring
en: Whew… I better take a rest…\nGroan…\pThat tunnel from CERULEAN takes a\nlot out of you!$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonIntro
en: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonPostBattle
en: There are other kinds of POKéMON\nthan the ones you find in forests.$

label: Route3_Text_BenIntro
en: Hi!\nI like shorts!\pThey're delightfully comfy and\neasy to wear!$

label: Route3_Text_BenPostBattle
en: Are you using a POKéMON CENTER's\nPC for storing your POKéMON?\pEach BOX can hold up to\n30 POKéMON.$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceIntro
en: Excuse me!\nYou looked at me, didn't you?$

label: Route3_Text_JanicePostBattle
en: You shouldn't be staring if you\ndon't want to battle!$

label: Route3_Text_GregIntro
en: Are you a TRAINER?\nLet's get with it right away!$

label: Route3_Text_GregDefeat
en: If I had new POKéMON, I would've\nwon!$

label: Route3_Text_GregPostBattle
en: If a POKéMON BOX on the PC gets\nfull, just switch to another BOX.$

label: Route3_Text_SallyIntro
en: That look you gave me…\nIt's so intriguing!$

label: Route3_Text_SallyPostBattle
en: You can avoid battles by not\nletting TRAINERS see you.$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinIntro
en: Hey! You're not wearing shorts!\nWhat's wrong with you?$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinPostBattle
en: I always wear shorts, even in\nwinter. That's my policy.$

label: Route3_Text_JamesIntro
en: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI just caught.$

label: Route3_Text_JamesPostBattle
en: Trained POKéMON are stronger than\nthe wild ones.$

label: Route3_Text_RobinPostBattle
en: ROUTE 4 is at the foot of\nMT. MOON.$

label: Route4_Text_TrippedOverGeodude
en: Ouch! I tripped over a rocky\nPOKéMON, GEODUDE!$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyIntro
en: I came to MT. MOON in search of\nmushroom POKéMON.$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyDefeat
en: After all I did to catch them!$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyPostBattle
en: There might not be any more\nmushrooms here.\pI think I got them all.$

label: Text_MegaPunchTeach
en: A punch of roaring ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen the chips are down,\nMEGA PUNCH is the ultimate attack!\lYou agree, yes?\pNow!\nLet me teach it to your POKéMON!$

label: Text_MegaPunchDeclined
en: You'll be back when you understand\nthe worth of MEGA PUNCH.$

label: Text_MegaPunchTaught
en: Now, we are comrades in the way of\npunching!\pYou should go before you're seen\nby the misguided fool who trains\lonly his silly kicking over there.$

label: Text_MegaKickTeach
en: A kick of brutal ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen you get right down to it,\nMEGA KICK is the ultimate attack!\lDon't you agree?\pOkay!\nI'll teach it to your POKéMON!$

label: Text_MegaKickDeclined
en: You'll come crawling back when you\nrealize the value of MEGA KICK.$

label: Text_MegaKickWhichMon
en: All right!\nWhich POKéMON wants to learn it?$

label: Text_MegaKickTaught
en: Now, we are soul mates in the way\nof kicking!\pYou should run before you're seen\nby the deluded nitwit who trains\lonly simple punching over there.$

label: Route4_Text_PeopleLikeAndRespectBrock
en:
Oh, wow, that's the BOULDERBADGE!
You got it from BROCK, didn't you?\pBROCK is cool. He's not just tough.
People like and respect him.\pI want to become a GYM LEADER
like him.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanHaveSixMonsWithYou
en: Okay, set six POKé BALLS in my\nbelt…\pYeah, that'll do it. At most, you\ncan have six POKéMON with you.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketAttacksCerulean
en: TEAM ROCKET attacks CERULEAN\ncitizens…\pNot a day goes by without TEAM\nROCKET being in the news.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LaddieBuyMagikarpForJust500
en: MAN: Hello there, laddie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SweetieBuyMagikarpForJust500
en: MAN: Hello there, sweetie pie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PaidOutrageouslyForMagikarp
en: {PLAYER} paid an outrageous ¥500\nand bought the MAGIKARP…$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnlyDoingThisAsFavorToYou
en: No? You say no? I'm only doing this\nas a favor to you!$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NoRoomForMorePokemon
en: There's no more room for any more\nPOKéMON, it looks like.$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullNeedMoreMoney
en: You'll need more money than that!$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IDontGiveRefunds
en: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds.\nYou knew what you were getting!$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ShouldStoreMonsUsingPC
en: Sometimes, you'll have too many\nPOKéMON with you to add any more.\pIn that case, you should just\nstore some using any PC.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToRaiseMon
en: I run the DAY-CARE service.\pWould you like me to raise one of\nyour POKéMON?$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_LookAfterMonForAWhile
en: Fine, I'll look after your\n{STR_VAR_1} for a while.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeSeeMeInAWhile
en: Come see me in a while.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonNeedsToSpendMoreTime
en: You're back already?\pYour {STR_VAR_1} needs to spend\nsome more time with me.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OweMeXForMonsReturn
en: You owe me ¥{STR_VAR_2} for the return\nof this POKéMON.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OnlyHaveOneMonWithYou
en: Oh? You only have one POKéMON\nwith you.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBattleWith
en: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonHasGrownByXLevels
en: Your {STR_VAR_1} has grown a lot.\nYes, quite a lot, I'd say.\pLet me see…\nBy level, it's grown by {STR_VAR_2}.\pAren't I great?$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouveGotNoRoomForIt
en: You can't take this POKéMON back\nif you've got no room for it.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_CantAcceptMonWithHM
en: わるいけど　ひでんのわざを　もった\nポケモンは　あずかれないなぁ$

label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardDuty
en: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.$

label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTasty
en: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…$

label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
en: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$

label: Route6_Text_RickyIntro
en: Who's there?\nQuit listening in on us!$

label: Route6_Text_NancyIntro
en: Excuse me!\nThis is a private conversation!$

label: Route6_Text_KeigoIntro
en: There aren't many bugs out here.$

label: Route6_Text_KeigoPostBattle
en: I like bugs, so I'm going back to\nVIRIDIAN FOREST.$

label: Route6_Text_JeffIntro
en: Huh?\nYou want to talk to me?$

label: Route6_Text_JeffDefeat
en: This stinks…\nI couldn't beat your challenge…$

label: Route6_Text_JeffPostBattle
en: I should bring more POKéMON with\nme. I'll feel safer that way.$

label: Route6_Text_IsabellePostBattle
en: I want to get stronger.\nWhat's your secret?$

label: Route6_Text_ElijahIntro
en: I've never seen you around.\nAre you good?$

label: Route6_Text_ElijahPostBattle
en: Are my POKéMON weak?\nOr, am I just bad?\lWhich do you think?$

label: Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardDuty
en: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.$

label: Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTasty
en: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…$

label: Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
en: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$

label: Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardDuty
en: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.$

label: Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTasty
en: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…$

label: Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
en: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$

label: Route8_Text_AidanIntro
en: You look good at POKéMON, but how\nis your chemistry grade?$

label: Route8_Text_AidanPostBattle
en: I am better at school than this!$

label: Route8_Text_GlennIntro
en: You should be informed.\nYou need strategy to win at this!$

label: Route8_Text_PaigeIntro
en: I like NIDORAN, so I collect them!$

label: Route8_Text_PaigePostBattle
en: When POKéMON grow up, they get\nugly! They shouldn't evolve.$

label: Route8_Text_LeslieIntro
en: School is fun, but so are POKéMON.$

label: Route8_Text_LeslieDefeat
en: You made it clear to me that\nI should stick with school.$

label: Route8_Text_LesliePostBattle
en: I was planning on getting some\nfresh air for a change, but…\pWe're stuck here because of the\ngates at SAFFRON.$

label: Route8_Text_AndreaIntro
en: MEOWTH is so cute, meow, meow,\nmeow!$

label: Route8_Text_AndreaPostBattle
en: I think PIDGEY and RATTATA are\ncute, too!$

label: Route8_Text_MeganIntro
en: We must look silly standing here\nlike this.$

label: Route8_Text_MeganDefeat
en: Look what you did to my poor, cute\nPOKéMON!$

label: Route8_Text_MeganPostBattle
en: SAFFRON's gatekeeper won't let us\ngo through.\pI know he's doing his job, but I\nthink he's mean.$

label: Route8_Text_RichPostBattle
en: Playing games and POKéMON are like\neating peanuts! I just can't stop!$

label: Route8_Text_JuliaIntro
en: What's a cute, round, and fluffy\nPOKéMON?$

label: Route8_Text_JuliaDefeat
en: Stop!\pDon't be so mean to my CLEFAIRY!$

label: Route8_Text_JuliaPostBattle
en: I read that CLEFAIRY evolves when\nit's exposed to a MOON STONE.\pI read that in a POKéMON JOURNAL.\nI wonder if it's true?$

label: Route8_Text_EliIntro
en: ELI: Twin power is fantastic.\nDid you know?$

label: Route8_Text_EliDefeat
en: ELI: But…\nWe used our twin power…$

label: Route8_Text_EliPostBattle
en: ELI: I caught my POKéMON with\nANNE!$

label: Route8_Text_EliNotEnoughMons
en: ELI: We can't battle if you don't\nhave two POKéMON.$

label: Route8_Text_AnneIntro
en: ANNE: We'll shock you with our twin\npower!$

label: Route8_Text_AnneNotEnoughMons
en: ANNE: Hi, hi! Let's battle!\nBut bring two POKéMON.$

label: Route8_Text_RicardoPostBattle
en: I got grass caught up in my\nspokes, man.$

label: Route8_Text_JarenIntro
en: Clear the way, or I'll run you\ndown!$

label: Route8_Text_JarenPostBattle
en: Don't think you're all special and\nall just because of this.$

label: Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardDuty
en: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.$

label: Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTasty
en: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…$

label: Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
en: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$

label: Route9_Text_AliciaIntro
en: You have POKéMON with you!\nYou're mine!$

label: Route9_Text_AliciaPostBattle
en: The tunnel coming up is pitch-black\ninside.\pYou'll need FLASH to get through\nthere.$

label: Route9_Text_ChrisIntro
en: Who's that walking there with those\ngood-looking POKéMON?$

label: Route9_Text_DrewIntro
en: I'm taking the ROCK TUNNEL to\ngo to LAVENDER…$

label: Route9_Text_DrewPostBattle
en: Are you off to ROCK TUNNEL, too?$

label: Route9_Text_CaitlinPostBattle
en: You're obviously talented.\nGood luck to you!$

label: Route9_Text_JeremyDefeat
en: Keep it coming, eh!\pOh wait.\nI'm out of POKéMON!$

label: Route9_Text_JeremyPostBattle
en: You sure had guts standing up to\nme there, eh?$

label: Route9_Text_BrentIntro
en: I got up early every day to raise\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!$

label: Route9_Text_BrentDefeat
en: WHAT?\pWhat a total waste of time!$

label: Route9_Text_BrentPostBattle
en: I have to collect more than bugs\nto get stronger…$

label: Route9_Text_ConnerPostBattle
en: If you don't like BUG POKéMON,\nyou bug me!$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_PressStartToCheckTime
en: TRAINER TIPS\pPress START to check\nremaining time.$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_WhereDidErikGo
en: SARA: Where did my boyfriend,\nERIK, go?$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_CatchingMonsAsGifts
en: I'm catching POKéMON to take home\nas gifts.$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_TimeDeclinesOnlyWhileYouWalk
en: TRAINER TIPS\pThe remaining time declines only\nwhile you walk.$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_HowManyDidYouCatch
en: How many did you catch?\nI'm bushed from the effort!$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_CaughtChanseyAllWorthwhile
en: I caught a CHANSEY!\pThat makes this all worthwhile.$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_TiredFromAllTheFun
en: Whew!\nI'm tired from all the fun!$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_SecretHouseStillAhead
en: TRAINER TIPS\pThe SECRET HOUSE is still ahead.$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_ZigzagThroughTallGrass
en: TRAINER TIPS\pPOKéMON hide in tall grass.\pZigzag through grassy areas to\nflush them out.$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_WinFreeHMFindSecretHouse
en: TRAINER TIPS\pWin a free HM for finding the\nSECRET HOUSE.$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_KeepAnyItemFoundOnSafari
en: You can keep any item you find in\nthe SAFARI ZONE.\pBut, you'll run out of time if you\ntry for all of them at once.$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_PrizeInDeepestPartOfSafariZone
en: Go to the deepest part of the\nSAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_MyEeveeEvolvedIntoFlareon
en: My EEVEE evolved into FLAREON.\pBut, a friend's EEVEE turned into a\nVAPOREON. I wonder why?$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_CongratsYouveWon
en:
Ah! Finally!\pYou're the first person to reach
the SECRET HOUSE!\pAlthough I made a campaign
for our grand opening,\pI was getting worried that no one
would win our campaign prize.\pCongratulations!
You have won!$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_ExplainSurf
en:
HM03 is SURF.\pPOKéMON will be able to ferry you
across water using it.\pAnd, this HM isn't disposable, so
you can use it over and over.\pYou're super lucky for winning this
fabulous prize!$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_DontHaveRoomForPrize
en: You don't have room for this\nfabulous prize!$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_PleaseFindWardensLostTeeth
en: REQUEST NOTICE\pPlease find the SAFARI WARDEN's\nlost GOLD TEETH.\lThey're around here somewhere.\pReward offered!\nContact: WARDEN$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_SearchForSecretHouse
en: TRAINER TIPS\pZone Exploration Campaign!\nThe Search for the SECRET HOUSE!$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_KogaPatrolsSafariEverySoOften
en:
The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_RocksMakeMonRunButEasierCatch
en: Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might\nmake them run, but they'll be\leasier to catch.$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_BaitMakesMonStickAround
en: Using BAIT will make POKéMON more\nlikely to stick around if they get\lbusy eating.$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_HikedLotsDidntSeeMonIWanted
en: I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any\nPOKéMON I wanted.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_BossTakeTownForTeamRocket
en: BOSS said he'll take this town\nin the name of TEAM ROCKET!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_DontGetDefiantOrIllHurtYou
en: Don't get defiant!\nOr I'll have to hurt you!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CriminalLifeMakesMeFeelAlive
en: My life as a criminal makes me feel\nso alive!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WeCanExploitMonsAroundWorld
en: With SILPH under control, we can\nexploit POKéMON around the world!\pWe'll get stinking rich, yeahah!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_YouBeatTeamRocket
en: You beat TEAM ROCKET all alone?\nThat's amazing!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SafeToGoOutAgain
en: Yeah! TEAM ROCKET is gone!\nIt's safe to go out again!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_PeopleComingBackToSaffron
en: People fled from here in droves\nwhen those ROCKETS came.\pThey should be flocking back to\nSAFFRON now.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FlewHereOnPidgeot
en: I flew here on my PIDGEOT when\nI read about SILPH.\pIt's already over?\nI missed the media action…$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SawRocketBossEscaping
en: I saw the ROCKET BOSS escaping\nSILPH's building.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_ImASecurityGuard
en: I'm a security guard.\pSuspicious kids I don't allow in!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CitySign
en: SAFFRON CITY\nShining, Golden Land of Commerce$

label: SaffronCity_Text_GymSign
en: SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\lThe Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FullHealCuresStatus
en: TRAINER TIPS\pFULL HEAL cures all ailments like\nburns, paralysis, poisoning,\lfreezing, and sleep.\pIt costs a bit more, but it's more\nconvenient than buying other items.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_GreatBallImprovedCatchRate
en: TRAINER TIPS\pThe new GREAT BALL offers improved\ncatching rates.\pTry it on those hard-to-catch\nPOKéMON.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SilphsLatestProduct
en: SILPH's latest product!\nRelease to be determined…$

label: SaffronCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign
en: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pMany TRAINERS have scribbled their\nnames on this sign.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_HowCanClubNotRecognizeLance
en:
This FAN CLUB…
No one here has a clue!\pHow could they not recognize
the brilliance that is LANCE?\pHe stands for justice!
He's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_DaughterIsSelfCentered
en: My daughter is so self-centered.\nShe has but a few friends.$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_DaughterLikesToMimicPeople
en: My daughter likes to mimic people.\nIt's rather vexing.\pHer mimicry has earned her the\nnickname COPYCAT around here.$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MimickingFavoriteHobbyMale
en:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Do you like POKéMON?\p{PLAYER}: Uh, no, I just asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Huh?
You're strange!\pCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?
But, that's my favorite hobby!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MimickingFavoriteHobbyFemale
en:
{PLAYER}: Hi.
You must like POKéMON.\p{PLAYER}: No, not me.
I asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?
You're weird!\l \lCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?\lBut that's my favorite hobby!$

label: Text_MimicTeach
en:
Oh wow!
A POKé DOLL!\pFor me?
Thank you!\pYou know what?
I can teach the move MIMIC.$

label: Text_MimicWhichMon
en: I really love MIMIC!\nWho's going to learn it?$

label: Text_MimicTaughtMale
en:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for earlier!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it that fun to mimic my
every move?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!$

label: Text_MimicTaughtFemale
en:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for what you did for us.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it really that fun to
copy what I say and do?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_TooMuchInBag
en: にもつが　いっぱいね！$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MimickingFavoriteHobbyMaleJP
en:
{PLAYER}“やあ！　こんにちは！
きみ　ポケモン　すきかい？\p{PLAYER}“ぼく　じゃなくって
きみに　きいてるんだ　けど\p{PLAYER}“‥‥　えー　なんだよ！
ヘンな　やつ　だなあ！\pモノマネむすめ“‥‥　なに？
ひとの　マネ　すんなって？\pだって　あたし　
ものまね　しゅみ　なんだ　もん！”$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MimickingFavoriteHobbyFemaleJP
en:
{PLAYER}“こんにちは！
ポケモン　すきなのね？\p{PLAYER}“わたし　じゃなくって
あなたに　きいてるんだ　けど\p{PLAYER}“‥　えー　なんなの！
おかしなこ　ねー！\pモノマネむすめ“‥　なに？
ひとの　マネ　すんなって？\pだって　あたし
ものまね　しゅみ　なんだ　もん！$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_Doduo
en: DODUO: Giiih!\pPRETTY MIRROR LOOK AT ME,\nSEE HOW PRETTY I CAN BE?$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_RareMonOnlyDoll
en: This is a rare POKéMON!\nHuh? It's only a doll!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MarioWearingABucket
en: A game with MARIO wearing a bucket\non his head!$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MySecrets
en: …\pMy Secrets!\pSkill: Mimicry!\nHobby: Collecting dolls!\lFavorite POKéMON: CLEFAIRY!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MasterKoichiIntro
en: Grunt!\pI am the KARATE MASTER!\nI am the LEADER here!\pYou wish to challenge us?\nExpect no mercy!\pFwaaa!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ChoosePrizedFightingMon
en: Indeed, I have lost!\pBut, I beseech you, do not take\nour emblem as your trophy!\pIn return, I will give you a prized\nFIGHTING POKéMON!\pChoose whichever one you like!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_StayAndTrainWithUs
en: Grunt!\nStay and train at karate with us!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikePostBattle
en: You wait 'til you see our MASTER!\nI'm a small fry compared to him!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiPostBattle
en: Our MASTER is a pro fighter.\nBe prepared to lose!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronIntro
en: Hiyah!\nI have no fear for anything tough!\pI shatter boulders for training\nevery day!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronPostBattle
en: The only thing that frightens us is\npsychic power!$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
en: The prime fighters across the land\ntrain here.$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ReceivedMonFromKarateMaster2
en: {PLAYER}は　カラテ　だいおう　から\n{STR_VAR_1}を　もらった！$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro
en:
I had a vision of your arrival.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat
en:
This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle
en: Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTakeThis
en:
The MARSHBADGE makes POKéMON up
to Lv. 70 obey you.\pStronger POKéMON will become wild,
ignoring your orders in battle.\pJust don't raise your POKéMON too
much to avoid that problem.\pWait, please take this TM with you.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM04
en: TM04 is CALM MIND.\pIt makes the POKéMON concentrate\nto raise both SP. ATK and SP. DEF.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_BagFullOfOtherItems
en: Your BAG is full of other items.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaIntro
en: SABRINA is far younger than I,\nbut she has earned my respect.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaPostBattle
en: In a battle of equals, the one\nwith the stronger will wins.\pIf you wish to beat SABRINA, focus\nand will yourself to victory.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanIntro
en: Does our unseen power scare you?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanPostBattle
en: PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts\nand bugs!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyIntro
en: POKéMON take on the appearance of\ntheir TRAINERS.\pYour POKéMON must be tough, then!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyPostBattle
en: I have much to learn still…\pI must master PSYCHIC and teach it\nto my POKéMON…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronIntro
en: You understand, don't you?\pThat power alone isn't enough to\nwin in the world of POKéMON?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronPostBattle
en: SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaIntro
en: You and I, our POKéMON shall\nbattle!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaPostBattle
en: I knew that this was going to take\nplace.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronIntro
en: SABRINA is young, but she's also\nour highly skilled LEADER.\pYou won't reach her easily!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronPostBattle
en:
There used to be two POKéMON GYMS
in SAFFRON.\pThe FIGHTING DOJO next door lost
its GYM status, though.\pWe simply creamed them when we
decided to have just one GYM.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
en: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM is famous for\ntraining psychics.\pYou want to see SABRINA, don't\nyou? I can tell!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
en: That's right! I used telepathy to\nread your mind!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
en:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pSABRINA's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
en: Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_DontLookAtMyLetter
en: …Thank you for writing.\nI hope to see you soon!\p…Hey!\nDon't look at my letter!$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_GettingCopycatPokeDoll
en: The COPYCAT is cute!\nI'm getting her a POKé DOLL.$

label: SaffronCity_House_Text_ExplainPPUp
en: I was given a PP UP as a gift.\pIt's used to increase the PP of\na POKéMON's move.\pI should use it on a powerful move\nwith only a few PP.$

label: SaffronCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelMoreEffectiveThanSuper
en: MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON\nfrom appearing.\pMAX REPEL stays effective longer\nthan SUPER REPEL.$

label: SaffronCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsCostly
en: REVIVE is costly, but it revives\nfainted POKéMON!$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouWantedThis
en: …Wait! Don't say a word!\pYou wanted this!$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_ExplainTM29
en: You already know, don't you?\nTM29 is PSYCHIC.\pIt's an attack that may also lower\nthe target's special stats.$

label: SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouveNoRoom
en: Where do you plan to put this?\nYou've no room.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GrowthRatesDifferBySpecies
en: POKéMON growth rates differ from\nspecies to species.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SilphCoVictimOfFame
en: SILPH CO. is widely known to all.\pIt's a victim of its own fame - it\nattracted TEAM ROCKET.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatIfEliteFourCameBeatRockets
en: Sigh…\nWouldn't this be great?\pIf the ELITE FOUR came and\nstomped TEAM ROCKET?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketTookOff
en: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nWe can go out safely again!\lThat's great!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePlayerWereYourFansNow
en:
Are you maybe…
… …\pYou are!
You are {PLAYER}!\pWe were just talking about you!\pWe were talking about how an
incredibly good TRAINER appeared.\pAnd that someone is you!
You're so cool!\pSo, we decided that we'll become
your FAN CLUB!\pWe all hope you'll keep battling
and show us how cool you are.\pThat way, maybe other people will
become fans just like me.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AlwaysCheerForYou
en: I'll always be cheering for you!\pGo, {PLAYER}, go!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_IllAlwaysBelieveInYou
en: I'll always believe in you,\n{PLAYER}.\pPlease show the others what you're\nlike when you battle seriously.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WasYourFanNotAnymore
en:
I'm sorry.
I was your fan before.\pBut now, you seem to have lost
the drive you had before.\pLately, I think {STR_VAR_1} has been
a lot cooler.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryonesYourFanButICantBe
en:
Oh!
{PLAYER}!\pEveryone's been all excited about
you recently.\pI can understand why.
I know that you're strong.\pBut, do you know what?\pOnce I became {STR_VAR_1}'s fan,
I can't just stop being a fan.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainersCoolWhenBattling
en: I think TRAINERS are so cool when\nthey're battling.\pDon't you think so, too?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CanYouAutographShorts
en:
Oh! It's {PLAYER}!
Too cool!\pOh!
Oh, yeah!\pCan you autograph something?
How about my shorts?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CountingOnYou
en:
However hot it's been…\pAnd however cold it may get…\pI've always believed in, and worn,
shorts!\pI'm counting on you to keep
winning!\pI believe in you just as much as
I believe in shorts!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksMyHero
en:
BROCK's my hero!
He's a man among men!\pHeheh, I got my mom to do
something for me.\pI got her to embroider “BROCK”
on my shorts!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksFanToBitterEnd
en: …  …\p…  …\nI'm BROCK's fan!\pEven if I were his only fan,\nI swear it on my rock-hard will,\land on my shorts!\pI'll be his fan to the bitter end!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksLastWordOnCool
en: BROCK's the last word on cool,\nend of story!\pNow there's a guy who I want to\nbe like!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HadPleasureOfWatchingYouBattle
en:
{PLAYER}, I've had the pleasure of
watching you battle.\pIt brings back sweet memories of
my own long-lost youth.\pMay you continue to find success.
You have a fan in me!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverSeenTrainerOfYourMagnificence
en:
I have journeyed far and wide
across the lands.\pBut never have I seen a TRAINER
of your magnificence.\pTake courage in your abilities
and keep battling on!\pMake that a promise to me,
my young idol!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HmmAndYouAre
en: Hmm…\nAnd you are?\pWere you hoping to sign up for\na membership in our FAN CLUB?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouveStillAWaysToGo
en:
Ah, so you are the much-
talked-about {PLAYER}.\pYou certainly do have the look of
a winner.\pBut for me to accept you as
a true POKéMON great…\p… …\pYou've still a ways to go!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoullBeTalkedAboutIfYouKeepWinning
en:
All of us gathered here are fans
of POKéMON TRAINERS.\pThe way they look in battle…
They are the picture of coolness.\pPerhaps you will be talked about
here, too, if you keep winning.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeLikeYouOneDay
en: It's {PLAYER}!\nIt's {PLAYER}!\pI want to be like {PLAYER} one day!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneButMeStoppedBeingYourFan
en:
Everyone stopped being {PLAYER}'s
fan…\pBut that means I can have {PLAYER}
all to myself!\pYay! Go for it!
My one and only {PLAYER}!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeLikeSabrina
en: Do you know what?\nI want to be like SABRINA!\pI want to be a psychic girl just\nlike her!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WontStopBeingSabrinasFan
en:
Even if I'm the only one, I won't
stop being SABRINA's fan.\pMy dream is to be like SABRINA,
cute, but cool.\pI want to be a psychic girl just
like her!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_CanIBecomeCoolTrainerOneDay
en: I wonder if I can become a cool\nTRAINER one day?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TheWayYouBattleIsCool
en:
Oh, man, oh, man!
Cool! Too cool!\p…Huh?
No, not you.\pJust the way you battle.
That's cool.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImOnlyOneLeftOfYourFans
en: Yo, {PLAYER}!\pLooks like I'm the only one left\nout of your fans.\pBut, you know, I like being an only\nfan… It's less stressful.\pKeep up and at it!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_LoveWayTrainerTalks
en: {STR_VAR_1}'s cool, huh?\nI love the way he talks.\pI'd really relish a chance to meet\nhim in person once.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImLoneTrainerFan
en:
Huh, can you believe it?
Everyone turned into your fans.\pSo after all we've been through,
I'm the lone {STR_VAR_1} fan?\pEh, being the one and only
{STR_VAR_1} fan's my style, anyway.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AdoreWayYouBattle
en:
Oh, my goodness!
Is it really you, {PLAYER}?\pI have to tell you, I adore the
way you battle.\pI hope you'll keep at it.
I'll be your number one fan!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImYourNumberOneFan
en:
Oh, my goodness!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pIt's so disappointing… I realized
I'm your number-one-and-only fan!\pWell, it can't be helped!
Let me cheer you on, at least!\pHurray, hurray, {PLAYER}!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerHasBeenOnFire
en: Recently, {STR_VAR_1} has been on\nfire.\pThe way he battles… It's just \nthe way that I like it!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneTalksAboutYou
en:
Oh, hello!
If it isn't {PLAYER}!\pLately, all everyone talks about
is you.\pI'm feeling lonesome because I
prefer {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouReallyAreAmazing
en: Amazing!\n{PLAYER}, you really are amazing!\pInstead of just watching, maybe\nI should become a TRAINER, too.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImYourOnlyFan
en: I'm your only fan…\nSigh… This is lonely…\pCan't you try harder and make the\nothers take notice of you?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WhyCantOthersSeeMastersDignity
en: Master {STR_VAR_1} is so dignified…\nHe is so my type.\pWhy can't the others see the\ndignity he simply oozes?$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BelieveInMasterWithAllMyHeart
en:
I believe in Master {STR_VAR_1}
with all my heart.\pEven if I am the only one to
believe in him.\pI won't ever feel lonesome, though.\pNot if I keep thinking about Master
{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourBattleStyleIsEducational
en: Hiyah!\pYour battling style is most\neducational.\pI hope that you will keep plugging\naway at success, hiyah!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WontStopBeingYourFan
en:
Instead of just watching others
battle, battle yourself!\p…My DOJO's MASTER chewed me out
like that…\pBut I won't let that stop me from
being your fan!\pI can't stop being your fan!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyMasterHasMyRespect
en:
Hiyah! There is but one TRAINER
who has my respect.\pAnd that is none other than my
MASTER at the FIGHTING DOJO.\pYou should become a fan of my
MASTER like me! Hiyah!$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverBeFanOfAnyoneButMaster
en:
Hiyah! I respect my MASTER at the
FIGHTING DOJO.\pI will never become a fan of
anyone other than my MASTER!\pI will even sneak out of the DOJO
to spread word of his greatness.\pHiyah!$

label: Text_RockSlideTeach
en:
When you're up on a rocky mountain
like this, rockslides are a threat.\pCan you imagine?
Boulders tumbling down on you?\pThat'd be, like, waaaaaaaaaaah!
Total terror!\pYou don't seem to be scared.
Want to try using ROCK SLIDE?$

label: Text_RockSlideDeclined
en: Oh, so you are scared after all.$

label: Text_RockSlideWhichMon
en: Which POKéMON should I teach\nROCK SLIDE?$

label: Text_RockSlideTaught
en: It might be scary to use it in this\ntunnel…$

label: SeafoamIslands_B4F_Text_BouldersMightChangeWaterFlow
en: Hint: Boulders might change the\nflow of water.$

label: Text_SwordsDanceTeach
en: Not many people come out here.\pIf I train here, I'm convinced that\nI'll get stronger and stronger.\pYep, stronger and stronger…\pHow would you like to learn a move\nlike that? It's SWORDS DANCE.$

label: Text_SwordsDanceWhichMon
en: All right, pick which POKéMON\nI should teach it to.$

label: Text_SwordsDanceTaught
en: If only we could keep getting\nstronger and stronger, eh?$

label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandsMadeInSevenDays
en:
These islands are called the SEVII
ISLANDS because there are seven.\p…Or at least that's what the young
people believe.\pThe truth is, these islands are so
named because they are said to\lhave been made in seven days.$

label: SevenIsland_Text_IslandVirtuallyUntouched
en: This island has been left virtually\nuntouched in its natural state.\pIt could be a little difficult to\nhike around because of that.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OnlyEnjoymentWatchingBattles
en:
I may not look like much now,
but when I was younger…\pI flew everywhere, challenging
TRAINERS wherever I found them.\pNow, my only source of enjoyment
is reminiscing about the past while\lwatching battles.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SlightBreezeAroundBox
en: There is a slight breeze blowing\naround the box.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
en:
Ah!
Welcome, my friend!\pLet me tell you something. There's
a hidden room in the basement.\pA TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is
waiting there now.\pTell me, you did come to challenge
{STR_VAR_1}, am I right?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OhYouWontBattle
en:
Oh…
You won't battle…\pI see, I see.
… …\pWell, perhaps if you change your
mind, do come back.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_LimitThreeMonsPerSide
en:
Ah!
You will battle for me?\pIt was worth my time moving the
box aside, then.\p… …
But there is one slight problem.\pThis hidden room is not built very
sturdy.\pCan I get you to limit it to
battles of three POKéMON per side?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
en: Fine! Before your battle, would\nyou like to save your game?$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room2_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
en: The match ended up a draw.$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DrawWasIt
en: A draw, was it?\pHowever, let me say that it was\na worthy spectacle.\pI'd say it was a wonderful battle\nwith a real sense of depth!$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_AstoundingBattle
en:
Bravo!\pBravo, indeed!
What an astounding battle!\pIt was so astounding, why, it keeps
filling my eyes with tears!\pThe thrust and parry of expertly
used techniques!\pThe clash of power upon power!\pYes!
It was sheer magnificence!$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_FeelYourDisappointment
en:
Too bad!
I feel your disappointment.\pHowever, that disappointment is
what will make you better.\pUse it, learn from it, and make it
motivate you to seek greatness.\pForget not this disappointment
and redouble your training!$

label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_MonHavePersonalitiesOfTheirOwn
en: POKéMON have personalities of their\nown, just like people.\pMy PIKACHU has a HASTY nature,\nso it grew to be a speedy POKéMON.$

label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_PreparationsCompleteForRuins
en: Okay, preparations are complete\nfor me to explore the RUINS.$

label: SevenIsland_Mart_Text_NeedToFishOnSevenIsland
en: I need to fish on SEVEN ISLAND.\pThat will complete my fishing tour\nof the SEVII ISLANDS.\pI'd better stock up on some\nPOKé BALLS first, though.$

label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EventsDependingOnConnections
en: On this island, different events\noccur depending on connections.\pWhat are those connections?\pThey are for you to discover on\nyour own.$

label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DidYouRideSeagallopHere
en:
Did you ride a SEAGALLOP ferry
to get here?\pThere are at least ten of those
high-speed ships.\pI don't know where they all go,
though.$

label: SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CheckOutTrainerTower
en: If you're confident, you should\ncheck out TRAINER TOWER.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyPostBattle
en: The way I am now, I may have to\nhold off on TRAINER TOWER…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanIntro
en: It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanPostBattle
en: You see them every so often,\nTRAINERS with awesome POKéMON\lwho have no idea what to do.\pBefore training POKéMON, TRAINERS\nthemselves need to grow up.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonIntro
en: I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonDefeat
en: Whoa! You're tough!\nHow about protecting me?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonPostBattle
en: From far out among the stars, our\nplanet is just a drop of water.\pBut we want to protect that drop\nof water for everyone.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynIntro
en: Those shoes you have are pretty\nsnazzy.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynDefeat
en: You're hot stuff in spite of your\ncute looks.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynPostBattle
en: Your mom bought those snazzy\nRUNNING SHOES for you?\pShe must adore you.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyIntro
en: You look strong.\nLet me battle you, please!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyDefeat
en: I knew it!\nYou're as tough as I thought!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyPostBattle
en: The way you battle has given me\na lot of useful data.\pThanks so much!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleIntro
en: I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI don't want to lose to anyone!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleDefeat
en: Thank you. I feel like I've been\nset free by losing to you.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichellePostBattle
en: For some reason, I get furious\nover the slightest thing.\pI'll calm myself by breathing\ndeeply.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexIntro
en: LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe could win!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexDefeat
en: LEX: I seem to have been too\ncareless…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexPostBattle
en: LEX: I think it was a good\nexperience for NYA.\pYou have my gratitude.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexNotEnoughMons
en: LEX: May I ask you to battle the\nboth of us at the same time?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaIntro
en: NYA: I'll do my best so I won't\ndrag down my mentor, LEX!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaDefeat
en: NYA: Oh, no…\nI'm so sorry, I…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaPostBattle
en: NYA: I think I'm going to need\nmuch more seasoning and tutoring\lunder LEX…\p…So, LEX, please, may I stay with\nyou like this?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaNotEnoughMons
en: NYA: I'm sorry, but may we battle\nin two-on-two style?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_BrunoTrainedWithBrawly
en:
Training by oneself is certainly
not a bad thing.\pBut it's also not bad to aim for
the top with a partner.\pEven BRUNO…
He trained with a fellow by the\lname of BRAWLY before.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahPostBattle
en: What's that?\nI don't act the way I look?\pHeh, that's a part of my strategy!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonIntro
en: Howdy!\nAre you a member of my fan club?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonDefeat
en: Oh, so you're not a fan…\pWell, I can change that.\nLet me sing for you!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonPostBattle
en: Lalalah…\nMy POKéMON, I send them out,\lall the girls scream and shout!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasIntro
en: This island is too spread out…\nIt's not easy patrolling the place.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasPostBattle
en: TRAINERS like you from cities,\nthey sure are tough.\pYou'll be headed for the TOWER,\nwon't you?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineDefeat
en: You don't seem to be a problem\nTRAINER.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelinePostBattle
en: If you treat your POKéMON with\nkindness, they'll understand.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveIntro
en: EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveDefeat
en: EVE: Me and JON, we lost.\nEhehe.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EvePostBattle
en: EVE: I'm going to work harder with\nJON.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveNotEnoughMons
en: EVE: I want to team up with JON\nwhen I battle you.\pCome back with two POKéMON, okay?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonIntro
en: JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonDefeat
en: JON: When I'm with EVE,\nit doesn't feel like I've lost!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonPostBattle
en: JON: When I'm with EVE, I feel\ngiddy whether I win or lose.\pIt's magical!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonNotEnoughMons
en: JON: If it's with EVE, I'll be\nhappy to battle with you.\pSo, I'd like to make it a\ntwo-on-two battle, if I may.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_RouteSign
en: SEVAULT CANYON ENTRANCE\pTRAINERS are asked to refrain from\ndamaging plants in the CANYON.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_ChanseyDanceJoinIn
en: Dance, dance!\nCHANSEY Dance!\pYou join in, too!\nDance, dance!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_TanobyKey_Text_MysteriousRumbleFarAway
en: A mysterious rumble echoed\nsomewhere far away.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonIntro
en: Do you know anything about this\nstone chamber?$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonDefeat
en: That was uncalled for.\nYou didn't have to be so rough.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonPostBattle
en: The TANOBY RUINS date back at\nleast 1,500 years.\pBut it's a baffling mystery as to\nwhy it was built in the first place.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminIntro
en: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminDefeat
en: I'm not much good in battle.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
en: I hear there are other ruins like\nthe one here.\pMight they be the resting places\nof other mystic POKéMON?$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaIntro
en: CLIFFORD is teaching me how to\npaint.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaDefeat
en: We might get in trouble for being\nnoisy here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaPostBattle
en: I said that I wanted to paint an\nold building.\pSo CLIFFORD brought me here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordIntro
en: Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordPostBattle
en: Ah, so you are studying POKéMON\non your own…\pYes, you certainly are quite the\nextraordinary person, indeed.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioPostBattle
en: In your future, I sense that you\nwill meet many others.\pI think you will be linked to each\nother by a strange power.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteIntro
en: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodettePostBattle
en: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.\pCould it be that they're waiting\nfor you?$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTowerSign
en: TRAINER TOWER ENTRANCE\nRise to the Challenge, TRAINERS!$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_LooksLikeTrainerTowerIsClosed
en: トレーナータワーには\nいまは　はいれない　みたい‥$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTowerIsOpenLetsGoIn
en: トレーナータワーが　あいてる！\nさっそく　はいってみよう！$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntIntro
en: Welcome to 10F!\nSo good of you to join me!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntPostBattle
en: Nice try, but the boardroom is up\none more floor.$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisPostBattle
en: Are you satisfied with beating me?\nThen go on home!$

label: SilphCo_10F_Text_KeepMeCryingASecret
en: About me crying…\nPlease keep it a secret.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearBoy
en:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearGirl
en:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear girl!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ObtainedMasterBallFromPresident
en: {PLAYER} obtained a MASTER BALL\nfrom the PRESIDENT!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThatsOurSecretPrototype
en:
PRESIDENT: You can't buy that
anywhere.\pIt's our secret prototype MASTER
BALL.\pIt will catch any POKéMON without
fail!\pYou should be quiet about using it,
though.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForThis
en: You have no room for this.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForRescuingUs
en: SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing\nall of us.\pWe, from the PRESIDENT down,\nare indebted to you.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniIntro
en:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
So we meet again!\pThe PRESIDENT and I are discussing
a vital business proposition.\pKeep your nose out of grown-up
matters…\pOr, experience a world of pain!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
en: Blast it all!\nYou ruined our plans for SILPH!\pBut, TEAM ROCKET will never fall!\p{PLAYER}! Never forget that all\nPOKéMON exist for TEAM ROCKET!\pI must go, but I shall return!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: So, you want to see my BOSS?$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: Halt! Do you have an appointment\nwith my BOSS?$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Watch your step…\nMy BOSS likes his POKéMON tough!$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_MonitorHasMonsOnIt
en: The monitor has POKéMON on it!$

label: SilphCo_1F_Text_WelcomePresidentInBoardroom
en: Welcome.\pThe PRESIDENT is in the boardroom\non 11F.$

label: SilphCo_1F_Text_DestroyedWontBeFixedForWhile
en: めちゃめちゃに　こわされてる\nとうぶん　なおりそうに　ない‥$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorDefeat
en: How did you know\nI was a ROCKET?$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorPostBattle
en: I work for both SILPH and TEAM\nROCKET.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryPostBattle
en: Can you solve the maze in here?\nIt's not easy, I tell you!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: No kids are allowed in here!$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Diamond-shaped tiles are teleport\nblocks.\pThey're transporters for this\nhigh-tech building.$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Hey, kid!\nWhat are you wandering here for?$

label: SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: SILPH CO. will be associated with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

label: Text_ThunderWaveTeach
en:
Eeek!
No! Stop! Help!\pOh, you're not with TEAM ROCKET.
I'm sorry, I thought…\pWill you forgive me if I teach
you the THUNDER WAVE technique?$

label: Text_ThunderWaveWhichMon
en: Which POKéMON should I teach\nTHUNDER WAVE?$

label: Text_ThunderWaveTaught
en:
THUNDER WAVE causes paralysis in
the target POKéMON.\pA paralyzed POKéMON may be unable
to move in battle.\pIt's an ELECTRIC-type move, so it
won't work on some POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_WhatAmIToDo
en: I work for SILPH CO.\nWhat am I to do?$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntPostBattle
en: A hint? You can open doors with\na CARD KEY!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JoseIntro
en: I support TEAM ROCKET more than\nI support SILPH CO.!$

label: SilphCo_3F_Text_JosePostBattle
en: Humph…\pTEAM ROCKET said that if I helped\nthem, they'd let me study POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: TEAM ROCKET has taken control\nof SILPH CO.!$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Fwahahaha!\nMy BOSS has been after this place!$
