label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyIntro
en: My POKéMON is my loyal servant.$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyPostBattle
en: The doors are electronically\nlocked.\pIt takes a CARD KEY to open the\ndoors here.$

label: SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: I better tell the BOSS on 11F!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketsInUproarAboutIntruder
en: TEAM ROCKET is in an uproar over\nsome intruder.\pThat's you, right?$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_YoureOurHeroThankYou
en: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nYou're our hero! Thank you!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: I heard a kid was wandering\naround.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: It's not smart to pick a fight with\nTEAM ROCKET!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauIntro
en: We study POKé BALL technology on\nthis floor.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauPostBattle
en: We worked on the ultimate POKé\nBALL which would catch anything.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonPostBattle
en: You're only on 5F.\nIt's a long way to my BOSS!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Which reminds me.\pKOFFING evolves into WEEZING!$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_PorygonFirstVRMon
en: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pPOKéMON LAB created PORYGON,\nthe first virtual-reality POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_Over350TechniquesConfirmed
en: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pOver 350 POKéMON techniques have\nbeen confirmed.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveWhenTraded
en: It's a POKéMON REPORT!\pSome POKéMON have been confirmed\nto evolve when they are traded.$

label: SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketBossLookingForStrongMons
en:
Those thugs that took over our
building…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for
strong POKéMON.\pI hope our PRESIDENT managed to
avoid trouble…$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTookOverBuilding
en: The ROCKETS came and took over\nthe building!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_BetterGetBackToWork
en: Well, better get back to work.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_HelpMePlease
en: Oh dear, oh dear.\nHelp me, please!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_ThatManIsSuchACoward
en: That man next to me…\nHe's such a coward!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_NeedsMeToLookAfterHim
en: He's so helpless, he needed\nsomeone like me to look after him.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTryingToConquerWorld
en: TEAM ROCKET is trying to conquer\nthe world with POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsRanAwayBecauseOfYou
en: TEAM ROCKET ran away, and it's all\nbecause of you!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TargetedSilphForOurMonProducts
en: They must have targeted SILPH for\nour POKéMON products.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_ComeWorkForSilphWhenYoureOlder
en: Come work for SILPH when you\nget older.$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: No matter!\nMy brothers will avenge me!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorIntro
en: That rotten PRESIDENT!\pServes him right for shipping me\noff to the TIKSI BRANCH!\pThat's why TEAM ROCKET came after\nus, I'm sure of it!$

label: SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: If you stand for justice, you\nbetray us bad guys!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_HaveMonForSavingUs
en: Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET!\nYou came to save us?\lWhy, thank you!\pI want you to have this POKéMON\nfor saving us.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ObtainedLaprasFromEmployee
en: {PLAYER} obtained a LAPRAS from\nthe SILPH employee!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ExplainLapras
en:
It's a LAPRAS.
It's a very intelligent POKéMON.\pWe kept it in our lab, but it will
be much better off with you.\pI think you will be a good TRAINER
for LAPRAS!\pIt's a good swimmer.
It'll give you a lift across water!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketBossWentToBoardroom
en: TEAM ROCKET's BOSS went to the\nboardroom!\pIs our PRESIDENT okay?\nI'm worried.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_OhNo
en: あ‥　もう　もてないぞ$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_SavedAtLast
en: たすかったよ　ありがと！$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketsAfterMasterBall
en: TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER\nBALL, which catches any POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_CanceledMasterBallProject
en: We canceled the MASTER BALL\nproject because of TEAM ROCKET.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_BadIfTeamRocketTookOver
en: It would be bad if TEAM ROCKET\ntook over SILPH or our POKéMON.$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_WowYouChasedOffTeamRocket
en: Wow!\pYou chased off TEAM ROCKET all by\nyourself?$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_ReallyDangerousHere
en: You!\nIt's really dangerous here!\pYou came to save me?\nYou can't!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: You won't find my BOSS by just\nscurrying around!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaIntro
en: Heheh!\pYou mistook me for a SILPH worker?$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaPostBattle
en: Despite your age, you are a\nskilled TRAINER!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Doesn't matter.\nMy brothers will repay the favor!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: A child intruder?\nThat must be you!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Go on home before my BOSS gets\nticked off!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalIntro
en:
{RIVAL}: Hahaha! I thought you'd
turn up if I waited here!\pI guess TEAM ROCKET slowed you
down! Not that I care!\pI saw you in SAFFRON, so I decided
to see if you got better!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalDefeat
en: Oh, man!\nSo, you are ready for BOSS\lROCKET!$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalVictory
en: {RIVAL}“おまえなあ‥\pこんな　うでまえじゃ\nまだまだ‥\lいちにんまえ　とは　いえないぜ$

label: SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalPostBattle
en:
Well, {PLAYER}!
I'm moving on up and ahead!\pBy checking my POKéDEX, I'm
starting to see what's strong and\lhow they evolve!\pAm I a genius or what?\pI'm going to the POKéMON LEAGUE to
boot out the ELITE FOUR.\pI'll become the world's most
powerful TRAINER!\p{PLAYER}, well, good luck to you!
Don't sweat it!\lSmell ya!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_WonderIfSilphIsFinished
en: I wonder if SILPH is finished…$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: That's as far as you'll go!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: If you don't turn back…\nI'll call for backup!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerPostBattle
en: So, what do you think of SILPH\nBUILDING's maze?$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: I'll leave you up to my brothers.$

label: SilphCo_8F_Text_ToRocketBossMonsAreTools
en:
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly
cruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to
be used.\pWhat will happen if that tyrant
takes over our company…$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_YouShouldTakeQuickNap
en: You look tired.\nYou should take a quick nap.$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: Your POKéMON seem to adore you,\nkid!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: If I had started as a TRAINER at\nyour age…$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_EdIntro
en: Your POKéMON have weak points!\nI can nail them!$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_EdPostBattle
en: Exploiting weak spots does work.\nThink about type advantages.$

label: SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!$

label: SixIsland_Text_IslandSign
en: SIX ISLAND\nFortune Island of Aged Wisdom$

label: SixIsland_Text_ThatWayToWaterPathRuinValley
en: Keep going this way and you'll get\nto the WATER PATH.\pStay on that and you'll get to\nthe RUIN VALLEY.$

label: SixIsland_Text_SkyAtNightIsFantastic
en: When you're this far away from the\ncity, the sky at night is fantastic.$

label: SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_IWasRightInTailingYou
en: Fufu… Fufufufu…\nI guessed right.\pI was right in tailing you!$

label: SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_SellToTeamRocketTellPassword
en:
I knew that there was a SAPPHIRE
here, so it belongs to me!\pI'll sell it to TEAM ROCKET for
serious money.\p…D-don't glare at me like that!\pIf you want it back, why don't you
go get it after I sell it?\pI'll even tell you one of the
passwords to TEAM ROCKET's\lWAREHOUSE.\pThe WAREHOUSE password I know is
“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\pI'm done.
Don't think badly of me!$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynIntro
en: …Huh?\pI was envisioning my house, but\nthis is where I TELEPORT?$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynPostBattle
en: I am so scatterbrained!\pI need to focus so I can TELEPORT\nproperly to my house!$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_RightRouteSign
en: GREEN PATH\nThink Green, Keep Nature Clean!$

label: SixIsland_House_Text_GoodPlaceForNatureAndHistory
en: There's nothing that young people'd\nfind exciting here on this island.\pBut, this is a good place in terms\nof nature and history.\pRelax and enjoy your stay.$

label: SixIsland_Mart_Text_AgathaOldestEverEliteFourMember
en: Play with POKéMON lots and live\na long life!\pTake AGATHA, for example.\pShe set a record for being the\noldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.\pShe spurs me to do bigger things.$

label: SixIsland_Mart_Text_ShouldBuyMailAndWriteLetter
en: I should buy some MAIL and write\nhim a letter…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketIntro
en: There're no rare POKéMON around\nthese parts! Not a one!\pThat burns me up, man.\nI'll take it out on you!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketPostBattle
en: So listen, you haven't seen any\nrare POKéMON, have you?$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorIntro
en: I'm having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorPostBattle
en: I can't very well go home without\ncatching something, though.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoIntro
en: Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLE PORT\nin one go.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoPostBattle
en: I'm only at the halfway point…\nI'm beat…$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleIntro
en: It's not so easy sending POKéMON\nout while swimming, you know?$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleDefeat
en: I didn't lose to you at swimming.\nThis doesn't bother me.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicolePostBattle
en: Are you headed for the island up\npast here?\pI didn't see anything interesting\nthere.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaIntro
en: AVA: Let's have a two-on-two\nmarine battle!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaDefeat
en: AVA: Oh, you're amazing!\nEven better, you're on your own!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaPostBattle
en: AVA: You know, I do prefer the\nsea over any pool.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaNotEnoughMons
en: AVA: You're challenging us to\na battle?\pYou'll need at least two POKéMON\nif you want to do that.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebIntro
en: GEB: Big Sister, help!\nPlease battle with me!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebDefeat
en: GEB: Wow, Big Sister, this person's\nreally good!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebPostBattle
en: GEB: I'm hanging onto my sister\nbecause I can't touch the bottom.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebNotEnoughMons
en: GEB: Please battle against me and\nmy sister!\p…Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyIntro
en: I'm curious, how do you raise your\nPOKéMON?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyDefeat
en: You raise your POKéMON with a\nwhole lot of love!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyPostBattle
en: In the same way your mother raised\nyou full of love, you should raise\lyour POKéMON.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonIntro
en: I'm working to preserve the natural\necology of POKéMON here.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonDefeat
en: Oh, for someone so young, you are\ntremendous!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonPostBattle
en: I'm not saying that you shouldn't\ncatch POKéMON.\pI just want people to raise their\nPOKéMON responsibly.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretIntro
en: I caught a BUG POKéMON that lives\nonly around here!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretPostBattle
en: There's a girl near the BUSH who\nmeasures HERACROSS for TRAINERS.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahIntro
en: You know, it just doesn't feel right\nif I don't use BUG POKéMON.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahDefeat
en: It's okay, losing is a fun part of\nPOKéMON's appeal, too.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahPostBattle
en: By the way, “appeal” is a weird\nword, if you think about it.\pLike, is it like an orange peel?\nOr like a ringing bell?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceIntro
en: Yeah, yeah, yeah!\nLook at all the BUG POKéMON!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceDefeat
en: I got beat while I was still busy\ncelebrating!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VancePostBattle
en: I'm going to bring my little brother\nhere next time.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashIntro
en: Look, look! There are funny\npatterns on the ground.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashPostBattle
en: The funny patterns on the ground…\pThey look like the patterns on my\ngrandpa's clothes.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellIntro
en: I bet you think I'm just some guy,\ndon't you, eh?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellDefeat
en: I bet you think I'm weak,\ndon't you, eh?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellPostBattle
en: Ayup, you townies come around all\nso dandy with a hat that flashy…\pHow about giving me that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaIntro
en: Take a deep breath.\nIsn't the air delicious?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaDefeat
en: If you'd like, I can teach you how\nto breathe properly.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaPostBattle
en: First, exhale.\nBlow everything out.\pWhen you can't exhale anymore,\ninhale the clean air!\pIsn't it refreshing?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaIntro
en: I love BUG POKéMON.\nThat's why I'm here all the time.\pAm I the only girl like that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaDefeat
en: I lost, but I'm still laughing.\nAm I the only girl like that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaPostBattle
en: I'm going to keep on collecting\nBUG POKéMON.\pAm I the only girl like that?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyIntro
en: This is a good spot.\nI'll pitch my tent here.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyPostBattle
en: I'm going to observe the night sky\nhere.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyIntro
en: Oh, yuck!\nI think a bug stung me!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyDefeat
en: It wasn't a bug.\nI cut my shin on some grass.$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyPostBattle
en: A little cut like that…\nA little spit's enough to cure it!$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonIntro
en: Have you noticed something odd\nabout these parts?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonDefeat
en: Have you taken a good look around\nyour feet?$

label: SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonPostBattle
en: There are places here in PATTERN\nBUSH where grass won't grow.\pWhat could be the cause of such\na phenomenon?$

label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomethingHiddenOnThisIsland
en: For ten years, I've searched for\nRUINS.\pNo, make that twenty years.\pI get this feeling that there's\nsomething hidden on this island.$

label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveByTradingWithHeldItem
en:
You know of POKéMON that evolve
only upon trading, yes?\pBut did you know that there are
still others?\pSome POKéMON evolve only when
traded while holding specific items.$

label: SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RivalImpossibleToGetAllMonsAroundHere
en:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!
How's your POKéDEX filling up?\pIt looks like it's impossible to get
all the POKéMON by hanging around\ljust these parts.\pMaybe there are POKéMON we don't
know about somewhere far away…\p… … …  … … …  … … …\pWell, if I can't do it, there's no
way for you to get it done.\pI'm not going to get all desperate
over this.\pI'll keep collecting POKéMON at my
own pace while I train them.\pThat's what I'll do.
So there's no point staying here.\lI may as well leave for home.\pThat's that, then!
Smell ya later!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CantFigureOutHowToGetInside
en: I can't figure out how I'm supposed\nto get inside.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_IFoundThisPlace
en: Let me tell you, I found this\nplace.\pDon't look so envious, will you?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CheckDoorMoreThoroughly
en: The door doesn't budge at all.\nCheck it more thoroughly?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_SeveralDotsOnTheDoor
en: On closer inspection, there are\nseveral dots on the door…$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyIntro
en: There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyPostBattle
en: I suggest to you that you, too,\ngive a thought to the secrets and\lmysteries of our world once a day.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterIntro
en: I'm curious, what compelled you to\ncome here?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterDefeat
en: It's been so long since I battled,\nmy instincts are off.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterPostBattle
en: There are several ruins on the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\pThe majority of them date back\na long way.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryIntro
en: It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pI suspect it has something to do\nwith the ruins here.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryPostBattle
en: Those ruins over there…\pI haven't had any luck in finding\nhow I can get inside.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylIntro
en: A battle with you, so high up!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylDefeat
en: Oh, the heartbreak of losing so\neasily to you!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorIntro
en: I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorDefeat
en: You don't need to be so pushy.\nI'll be happy to tell you.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorPostBattle
en: The door to the ruins…\nIt has these strange patterns\lengraved on the outside.\pI don't know what they mean,\nthough.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseIntro
en: I let a pleasant breeze lead me\nall the way here.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseDefeat
en: Giggle… You're so cute when you're\ndetermined.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RosePostBattle
en: I want to go to the woods over\nthere, but…\pThere are lots of BUG POKéMON.\nThey scare me a little.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardIntro
en: I'm practicing in secret so no one\ncan see me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardPostBattle
en: As a performer, I don't want people\nto know about the effort I put in.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirIntro
en: What, you're suggesting that you're\nsick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirPostBattle
en: I couldn't lift the stigma of being\na SWIMMER…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseIntro
en: My boyfriend's always busy, so I\ncome swimming by myself.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseDefeat
en: Awww, I knew this would happen!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DenisePostBattle
en: When I can't be with my boyfriend,\nI spend time with the POKéMON he\lgave me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlIntro
en: Tell me, where are the mountains\naround these parts?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlDefeat
en: I lost my way while I was busy\nbattling!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlPostBattle
en: Aren't there any mountains around\nthese parts?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuIntro
en: MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuPostBattle
en: MIU: It makes me all sad inside\nwhen we lose…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
en: MIU: MIA and I are TWINS.\nWe want to battle together.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaIntro
en: MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaDefeat
en: MIA: You're mean!\nYou're bad for winning!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
en: MIA: Oh, you only have one\nPOKéMON?\pDon't you feel lonesome?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_LoveItNeedItHeracross
en: Hera, hera, HERACROSS!\nBig and shiny, it's the bug boss!\lLove it, need it, HERACROSS!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_MayIMeasureHeracross
en: Eeeeek!\nThat's a HERACROSS!\pPlease, please, may I measure how\nbig it is?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInchesDeserveReward
en: Eeeek, it's {STR_VAR_2} inches!\nI've never seen anything like this!\lYou deserve a reward!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_WantToSeeBiggerOne
en: I want to see a much, much bigger\nHERACROSS than that one.\pOh, how I adore them, big\nHERACROSS!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInchesSameAsBefore
en: Huh? This {STR_VAR_2}-inch measurement…\nOh, boo! It's the same as before.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInchesYInchesWasBiggest
en: Oh, it's just {STR_VAR_2} inches.\nThe HERACROSS before was bigger.\pIt was {STR_VAR_3} inches, the biggest\nHERACROSS you've brought me.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ThisWontDo
en: Oh, no! This won't do!\pHERACROSS looks much more macho\nand cool, and has a lovely horn!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_YourBagIsFull
en: Your BAG is full.\nMy reward won't fit.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BiggestHeracrossIsXInches
en: The biggest HERACROSS that I have\never seen measured so far is:\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BlankChartOfSomeSort
en: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_House2_Text_MyNeighborMeasuredMe
en: My height is 67.0 inches on the\nbutton.\pI know it is this precisely because\nmy neighbor measured me.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_LeStrongSilentType
en:
Bonjour!
I am le waiter on this ship!\pI will be happy to serve you
anything you please!\p… … …
Ah! Le strong silent type!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_PassengersAreRestless
en: The passengers are restless from\nthis long voyage.\pYou might be challenged by the\nmore bored ones!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room1_Text_ImAGlobalPoliceAgent
en: Ssh…!\nI'm a GLOBAL POLICE agent.\pI'm on the trail of TEAM ROCKET.\nThey're up to nothing good!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerPostBattle
en: Listen, listen!\nLet me be your friend, okay?\pThen we can trade POKéMON and\ndo stuff.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnIntro
en: I collected these POKéMON\nfrom all around the world!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnDefeat
en: Oh, no!\nI went around the world for these!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnPostBattle
en: You hurt my poor POKéMON!\pI demand that you heal them at a\nPOKéMON CENTER!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_CruisingAroundWorld
en: We are cruising around the world,\nmy children and I.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_CruiseIsElegantAndCozy
en: A world cruise is so elegant yet\ncozy!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_AlwaysTravelWithWigglytuff
en: I always travel with WIGGLYTUFF.\nI never leave home without it.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaiterCherryPiePlease
en: Waiter, I would like a cherry pie,\nplease!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaitressCherryPiePlease
en: Waitress, I would like a cherry\npie, please!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro
en: You insolent pup!\nHow dare you barge in!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurDefeat
en: Humph! You rude child!\nYou have no sense of courtesy!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurPostBattle
en: I wish to be left alone!\nGet out!$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_TakeAShortRest
en: You look tired. Would you like to\ntake a short rest?$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_GladEveryoneIsRefreshed
en: I'm glad to see that everyone is\nlooking refreshed and chipper.$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyBrother
en: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little brother…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMySister
en: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little sister…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasIntro
en: I am but a solitary traveler…\pMy sole companions and friends are\nPOKéMON I caught on my journeys…$

label: SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasPostBattle
en: You should be nice to friends!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_ThisShipIsLuxuryLiner
en: This ship, she is a luxury liner for\nTRAINERS of the world!\pAt every port, we hold parties with\ninvited TRAINERS.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalIntro
en:
{RIVAL}: Bonjour!
{PLAYER}!\pImagine seeing you here!
{PLAYER}, were you really invited?\pSo how's your POKéDEX coming?\pI already caught 40 kinds, pal.
Different kinds are everywhere.\pCrawl around in grassy areas, and
look hard for them.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalVictory
en: {PLAYER}‥！\nふなよい　してるのか！\pもっと　からだ\nきたえた　ほうが　いいぜ！$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalPostBattle
en:
{RIVAL}: I heard there was a CUT
master on board.\pBut he was just a seasick old man!\pCUT itself is really useful.
Yup, it'll be handy.\pYou should go see him, too.
Smell ya!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room1_Text_SleepingMonLookedLikeThis
en: I've journeyed far and wide, but in\nall my travels I've never seen\lany POKéMON sleep like this one!\pIt was something like this!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksIntro
en: Competing against the young keeps\nme youthful.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat
en: Good match!\nAh, I feel young again!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle
en: Fifteen years ago, I would\nhave won!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleIntro
en: Check out what I fished up!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle
en: Party?\pThe cruise ship's party should be\nover by now.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SeenMonsFerryPeople
en: Ah, yes, I have seen some POKéMON\nferry people across the water!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SomeTreesCanBeCutDown
en:
Small trees can be chopped down
using the move CUT.\pBut remember this!
CUT is an HM technique.\pOnce learned, it is not so easily
discarded.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarIntro
en: Which do you find more worthy,\na strong or a rare POKéMON?$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarPostBattle
en: Personally, I prefer strong and\nrare POKéMON.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnIntro
en: I don't believe I saw you at the\nparty?$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnPostBattle
en: Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON!\nOh, how I envy you for them!$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_HaveYouGoneToSafariZone
en: Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE\nin FUCHSIA CITY?\pThere are many kinds of rare\nPOKéMON.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_WeThinkSafariZoneIsAwesome
en: Me and my daddy think the SAFARI\nZONE is awesome!\lI wish we could go there again.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_CaptainIsAwfullySick
en: The CAPTAIN said he's awfully sick.\nHe was all pale.$

label: SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_ManyPeopleGetSeasick
en: I hear many people get seasick.$

label: SSAnne_3F_Corridor_Text_CaptainTeachesCutToMons
en: Our CAPTAIN is a sword master.\nHe's awesome at using CUT.\pThey say he even teaches CUT\nto POKéMON!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro
en: Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle
en: When we're out at sea, jellyfish\nPOKéMON sometimes drift by.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro
en: Hello, stranger!\pI can't tell if you're from the seas\nor mountains, but stop and chat.\pAll my POKéMON are from the sea.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyDefeat
en: Darn!\nI let that one get away!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle
en: I was going to make you my\nassistant, too!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro
en: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle
en: We caught all our POKéMON while\nwe were out at sea.$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanIntro
en: I like feisty kids like you!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanPostBattle
en: Sea POKéMON live in deep water.\nYou'll need a ROD to fish them up!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro
en: You know what they say about\nsailors and battling!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardPostBattle
en: Hahaha!\nWant to be a sailor, mate?$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro
en: Come on, then!\nMy sailor's pride is at stake!$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle
en: Did you see the FISHING GURU in\nVERMILION CITY?$

label: SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_MachokeHasStrengthToMoveRocks
en: My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!\pHe has enough STRENGTH to move\nbig rocks!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThankYouHaveHMForCut
en:
CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you!
I'm feeling much better now.\pYou want to see my hidden CUT
technique?\pI could show you my prized CUT
technique if I weren't so ill…\pI know! You can have this!
This HIDDEN MACHINE!\pTeach CUT to your POKéMON, and
you can see it CUT anytime!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ExplainCut
en: Using CUT, you can chop down\nsmall trees.\pWhy not try it with the trees\naround VERMILION CITY?$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_SSAnneWillSetSailSoon
en: CAPTAIN: …Whew!\pNow that I'm not sick anymore,\nI guess it's time.\pThe S.S. ANNE will set sail soon!\pFarewell, until our return to\nVERMILION CITY!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForThis
en: Oh, no!\nYou have no room for this!$

label: SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_HowToConquerSeasickness
en: How to Conquer Seasickness…\nThe CAPTAIN's reading this!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_ShipDepartingSoon
en: The party's over.\nThe ship will be departing soon.$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_FeelSeasick
en: Urf… I feel ill…\pI got seasick, so I stepped out to\nget some air…$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondIntro
en: Hey, matey!\pLet's do a little jig!$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondPostBattle
en: How many kinds of POKéMON do you\nthink there are in this big world?$

label: SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorPostBattle
en: My pa said there are 100 kinds of\nPOKéMON. I think there are more.$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_BusyOutOfTheWay
en: You, mon petit!\nWe're busy here!\lOut of the way!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SawOddBerryInTrash
en: I saw an odd BERRY in the trash.\nI wonder what that was?$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SoBusyImDizzy
en: I'm so busy I'm getting dizzy!\nYou have to give me room here!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_HearAboutSnorlaxItsAGlutton
en: Did you hear about SNORLAX?\nIt's a glutton.\pNo other POKéMON eats and sleeps\nthe way SNORLAX can and does!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_OnlyGetToPeelOnions
en: Snivel… Sniff…\pI only get to peel onions…\nSnivel…$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_IAmLeChefMainCourseIs
en: Er-hem!\nIndeed I am le CHEF!\pLe main course is$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SalmonDuSalad
en: Salmon du Salad!\pLes guests may gripe it's fish\nagain, however!$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_EelsAuBarbecue
en: Eels au Barbecue!\pLes guests will mutiny, I fear.$

label: SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PrimeBeefsteak
en: Prime Beefsteak!\pBut, have I enough fillets du\nbeef?$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_IslandSign
en: THREE ISLAND\nKin Island of Family Bonding$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_IslandBelongsToUs
en: Hyahoo!\pFrom this day on, this island\nbelongs to us!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_GoBackToKanto
en: We don't need you people bringing\nyour noise and trouble here!\pWe're asking you to go back to\nKANTO!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_BossIsOnHisWay
en: Hey, go cry somewhere else.\nOur boss is on his way.\pWhen he gets here, we'll give you\na k-rad motorbike show you won't\lsoon forget!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_GetOffIslandNow
en: W-what!? Not on your life!\nGet off the island now!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_AreYouBossGoBackToKanto
en: Are you the boss?\nGo back to KANTO right now!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_JustGotHerePal
en: Hah?\pI just got here, pal.\pWhat's with the hostile attitude?\nIt's mighty cold of you!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_FollowersRaisingHavoc
en: Your gang of followers have been\nraising havoc on their bikes.\pDo you have any idea how much\ntrouble they've caused us on the\lisland?$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_OughtToBeThankingUs
en:
No, man, I don't get it at all.\pLook at this place.
What do you do for entertainment?\pYou ought to be thanking us for
livening up this sleepy village.\pBut hey, if you insist, you can try
making us leave.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_YouCowardsToughInPack
en: Grr… You cowards…\nSo tough in a pack…$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WannaMakeSomethingOfYourStaring
en: You, what are you staring at?\nDon't you know it's not polite?\pYou wanna make something of it\nor what?$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_ThatsSmart
en: That's smart.\nKeep your nose out of this.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1Intro
en: Heh, I like your guts.\nYou'll be losing money to me, but…$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2Intro
en: Aren't you from KANTO?\nYou should be on our side!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2PostBattle
en: What's the matter with you,\ngetting all hot like that?\pTotally uncool, man!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3Intro
en: We invited the boss out here,\nbut you had to mess it up!\pYou embarrassed us, man!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3PostBattle
en: Boss, I'm telling you, you've gotta\ndo something about this kid!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonIntro
en:
I've been watching you, and I'd say
you've done enough.\pWhat are you, their friend or
something?\pThen I guess you'll be battling me
in their place.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonDefeat
en: All right, enough!\nWe'll leave like you wanted!\pWe'll be happy to see the last of\nthis boring island!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
en: Humph! Yeah, go right on hanging\naround with these hayseeds!$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_ThankYouOhYourMonGotHurt
en: Thank you! Those goons were\nnothing but bad trouble.\pOh, look, your POKéMON got hurt\non my account.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_YouveGotImpressiveMons
en: You've got seriously impressive\nPOKéMON with you.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_LostelleWentOffTowardsBondBridge
en:
It'd be fantastic if someone as
strong as you lived here.\pI hope you'll at least stay here
a while.\p…I beg your pardon?
You're looking for LOSTELLE?\pLOSTELLE went off towards BOND
BRIDGE a while ago.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WouldntWantToSeeBikersHereAgain
en: THREE ISLAND is actually the most\npopulous of the islands here.\pStill, it could be less sleepy.\pBut I wouldn't want to see goons\nlike those BIKERS here again.$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_WhenDodouEvolvesGoingToPlayGame
en: I'm going to train my DODUO in the\nBERRY FOREST.\pWhen it evolves, I'm going to play\na game on TWO ISLAND.$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HelpScaryPokemon
en:
LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff…
Oh! Please, help!\pA scary POKéMON appeared there
a little while ago.\pIt kept scaring.
It made LOSTELLE scared.\pI'm too scared to move!
But I want to go home…$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HereItComesAgain
en: Oh! Here it comes again!\nNo! Go away! It's scaring me!\pWaaaaaaah!\nI want my daddy!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_ThankYouHaveThis
en: Ohh! That was so scary!\nThank you!\pLOSTELLE came to pick some\nBERRIES.\pYou can have this!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_LetsGoHome
en: What's your name?\pLOSTELLE's scared, so can I go\nwith you to my daddy's house?\pOkay!\nLet's go home!$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BerryPouchIsFull
en: Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nI guess you don't want this.$

label: ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_WelcomeToBerryForest
en: Welcome to the BERRY FOREST\pBe friendly and share BERRIES with\nothers and POKéMON.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiIntro
en: The salty tang of the sea…\nIt tickles my heart.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiPostBattle
en: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty\nPOKéMON's body odor…$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletIntro
en: Where are you off to in such\na hurry?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletPostBattle
en: If you keep going this way, you'll\neventually reach BERRY FOREST.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraIntro
en: My mommy said that I can't swim\nwithout my float ring.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraPostBattle
en: This year, I'm going to finally\nlearn how to swim!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisPostBattle
en: Did I just win?\nOr did I lose?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaIntro
en: Oh, no, don't come here!\nPlease, stay away from me!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaDefeat
en: Okay, you've won!\nNow will you please go away?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaPostBattle
en: A POKéMON bit through my \nswimsuit.\pI can't get out of the water!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyIntro
en: JOY: We'll teach you what our\nfavorite POKéMON is!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyPostBattle
en: JOY: Wasn't that fun?\nI hope we can battle again!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
en: JOY: I really want to battle with\nMEG.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegIntro
en: MEG: We'll show you our favorite\nPOKéMON.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
en: MEG: I want to battle together\nwith JOY.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BondBridgeSign
en: BOND BRIDGE\nPlease be quiet when crossing.\pBERRY FOREST AHEAD$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ProspectingForGold
en:
Hey, there!
How's it going?\pWhat am I doing here, you ask?
Why, I'm prospecting for gold!\pWhen I strike it rich, I'm buying
a house in KANTO.$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_StruckGoldThisIsForYou
en:
Hey, there! How's it going?
Did you hear? I've struck gold!\pYou remembered that I was
prospecting, didn't you?\pYou can't begin to imagine just
how happy I am.\pSo, I'll show you!
This is for you!$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ThatsANugget
en: That's a NUGGET!\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!$

label: ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_WhoopsBagCrammedFull
en: Whoops, your BAG is crammed full!\nI'll give this to you later.$

label: ThreeIsland_House1_Text_YoureAlwaysSoCool
en: LOSTELLE: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nYou're always so cool!\pI'll make lunch for you, too, one\nday, {PLAYER}.$

label: ThreeIsland_House1_Text_RareRocksGemsDisplayed
en: Rare rocks and gems are displayed.$

label: ThreeIsland_House2_Text_CantMakeThisSpoonBend
en:
Urrrrrrrrgggghhhh…
Kwaaaaah!\p…It's useless! I can't make this
spoon bend with my mind.\pMaybe I really don't have any
psychic powers.$

label: ThreeIsland_House2_Text_IAdmireSabrina
en:
You know about a girl GYM LEADER
in SAFFRON CITY?\pShe uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,
right?\pI admire her, I really do.\pI've heard that she's one cool
customer and beautiful, too.$

label: ThreeIsland_House3_Text_WantedToLiveSomewhereQuiet
en: I bought this house because I\nwanted to live somewhere quiet.\pToday, I think I'll go out fishing.$

label: ThreeIsland_House4_Text_GhostsInBerryForest
en: You must never, ever go out to\nthe BERRY FOREST alone.\pWhy?\nThere are ghosts there.$

label: ThreeIsland_House4_Text_PapaKeepsLyingToMe
en: Papa keeps lying to me, and won't\nlet me go out and play!$

label: ThreeIsland_House5_Text_ImNotLostelle
en:
Me?
I'm not LOSTELLE.\pShe's probably gone to the
BERRY FOREST, I think.\pShe picks BERRIES there for making
lunch.$

label: ThreeIsland_House5_Text_IllGoPlayWithLostelle
en: I think I'll go play with LOSTELLE\ntoday.$

label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_TrueThatCeldadonDeptStoreBigger
en: Is it true?\pCELADON DEPT. STORE is several\ntimes bigger than this shop?$

label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_PeopleHealWithBerriesFromForest
en: I sometimes buy medicine here.\pBut a lot of people heal POKéMON\nwith BERRIES from BERRY FOREST.\pAfter all, BERRIES are free and\nthey never run out.$

label: ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_BikersWereAboutToTrashMart
en: Those BIKERS were about to trash\nthis POKéMON MART.\pAm I glad they decided to leave!$

label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCNetworkCanLinkWithKanto
en: Hey, did you hear the news?\pThe PC network here can now link\nwith PCs in KANTO.\pI don't know how that came about,\nbut it's fantastic!$

label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ImpossibleToSurfBetweenIslands
en: It's impossible to SURF between the\nislands around these parts.\pThe tides are too fast and\ntreacherous.$

label: ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBerriesInBerryForest
en: Let's crush BERRIES!\n…That'd be wasting BERRIES?\pYou can always find some BERRIES\non the ground in BERRY FOREST.$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_WereKantoRiderFederation
en: We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION!\nVroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!\pMy bike's wimpy, so I have to\nmake exhaust noises myself!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ForkOverMoney
en: Hey, hey, lady!\nFork over some spending money!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_IllCallThePolice
en: Aiyeeh!\pWh-who are you?!\nI… I'll call the police!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ThankGoodnessBikersGone
en: Those BIKERS…\nAre they gone?\pOh, thank goodness!\nThey certainly had me terrified!$

label: ThreeIsland_Port_Text_EverythingTurnedOutForBest
en: Those BIKERS ran off, and\nLOSTELLE was found safe.\pEverything turned out for the best!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WelcomeToTrainerTower
en: Hello!\pWelcome to TRAINER TOWER where\nTRAINERS gather from all over!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpToFloorNum
en: TRAINERS from all over the world\ngather here to battle.\pLet me see…\pRight now, there are TRAINERS only\nup to Floor {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpEighthFloor
en: TRAINERS are awaiting your\nchallenge up to the eighth floor.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
en: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StartClockGetSetGo
en: Okay, I'll get the clock started,\nso give it everything you have.\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TooBadComeBackTryAgain
en: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_GiveItYourBest
en: I hope you give it your best.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_MoveCounterHereWhenTrainersSwitch
en: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ImOwnerBattledPerfectly
en: Hello…\pI am the owner of this TOWER…\pHow the sky soars above this\nrooftop…\pThe caress of the winds up here…\pIt's all so perfect…\pThe way you battled…\nIt, too, was perfection…$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_DoneItInRecordTime
en:
Oh!
Stupendous!\pIt's marvelous how you've come up
here so quickly.\pThe fact is, you've done it in
record time…\pI'll have your record posted at
the reception counter.$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_TookSweetTimeGettingHere
en: You seem to have taken your sweet\ntime getting here…$

label: TrainerTower_Roof_Text_IdLikeToSeeBetterTime
en: What I would like to see is a\nbetter time out of you…\pI'm counting on you.\pUntil then, farewell…$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_NeedTwoMonsForDouble
en: This is a two-on-two battle.\pYou may not battle unless you have\nat least two POKéMON.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_ExplainTrainerTower
en:
Here at TRAINER TOWER, there is an
event called TIME ATTACK.\pYou will be timed on how quickly
you can get from the reception\lcounter to the OWNER on the roof.\pThe best times will be recorded on
the Time Board.\pTry competing with friends to see
who can beat it the fastest.\pYou will not earn any EXP. Points
or money by beating TRAINERS here.$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WonderWhatKindsOfTrainers
en: I'm here to see how good I am.\pI wonder what kinds of TRAINERS\nare waiting for me?\pIt's nerve-racking!$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StairsTougherThanAnyBattle
en: Gasp, gasp…\nGasp…\pNever mind battling! These stairs…\nThey're tougher than any battle…$

label: TwoIsland_Text_DangerFastCurrent
en: DANGER! FAST CURRENT!\nFishing and surfing prohibited!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_WelcomeToShopMerchandiseLimited
en: Oh!\nHello, welcome to my shop!\pWe've only opened up recently.\pOur merchandise is limited, but I\nhope we can serve your needs.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_AddedMerchandiseForLostelle
en:
I can't tell you how grateful I am
for your rescue of LOSTELLE.\pThanks to your feat, the people of
THREE ISLAND have changed their\lattitudes about KANTO people.\pAnd, I'm from KANTO, you see.\pThe people of THREE ISLAND
helped me add to my merchandise.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
en: Hi! I'm giving it my best here.\nI hope you do too, {PLAYER}.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_BringingItemsFromDistantLands
en:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
Welcome!\pI've started bringing in items from
distant lands.\pI've got some rare items in, too.
Please have a look!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_FellowMovedFromCeladonCity
en:
That fellow there, he moved here
from CELADON CITY.\pHe started up a shop with his
younger brother.\pYou have to wonder if he knew what
he was getting into.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_ShopkeepersBrotherWorksGameCorner
en: The shopkeeper's brother took\na job at the GAME CORNER.\pHe's trying to pull together money\nso they can buy more merchandise.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_BrunoCameToIslandWhileBack
en:
Listen, listen.
Did you know?\pA famous TRAINER came to the
ISLAND a little while back.\pHe's one of the ELITE FOUR.
His name is BRUNO.\pHe went away disappointed when he
found out that they were all sold\lout of Rage Candybars.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_BuyRareItemsHere
en: The discerning TRAINER knows to\nbuy rare items here!$

label: TwoIsland_Text_OldWomanLivesOutOnCape
en: There's an old woman who lives in\na cottage out on the cape.\pShe gives the eye to POKéMON.\nIt's a bit unnerving.$

label: TwoIsland_Text_HaveYouTriedJumpingGame
en:
Boing! Boing!
Have you tried the jumping game?\pThe POKéMON you can enter…
Boing!\pSome go boing!\pAnd some go boooooooing!\pDid you know that?
Boing!$

label: Text_UltimateMoveThatMon
en:
I perfected the ultimate move of
its type…\pBut will no one take it for
future use?\p…Hm? Hmmm!\pY-you…
Th-that {STR_VAR_1}…$

label: Text_AllowMeToTeachMonUltimateMove
en:
Oh! This is the one!
This is the POKéMON!\pThis {STR_VAR_1} is worthy of
learning my ultimate move!\pWill you allow it?\pWill you allow your {STR_VAR_1} to
learn my {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: Text_YouRejectIt
en: Gaah! You reject it?\nNo, I won't be dissuaded!$

label: Text_LetMeConferUltimateMove
en: You will allow it?\pThen, let me confer my ultimate\n{STR_VAR_2} on your {STR_VAR_1}.\pGgggrah-awooo!$

label: Text_TaughtMove
en: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI didn't think I could teach that\nmove while I still lived…$

label: Text_MakeBestUseOfMove
en: I implore you to make the best\nuse of that move and gain power!$

label: Text_PassedOnEverythingIKnow
en: Gasp, gasp, gasp…\pI have no regrets now.\nI've passed on everything I know.\pNow I can live out my life knowing\nmy work is done.$

label: Text_FeelRejuvenated
en: After I passed on my knowledge to\nyou, I felt so much relief.\pIn fact, I feel rejuvenated,\nas if I were younger again!$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMushroom
en:
I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.\pI know every single move that
POKéMON learn growing up.\pI'm also a mushroom maniac.\pBring me two TINYMUSHROOMS,
or one BIG MUSHROOM.\pIf you do that for me, I'll teach
a move to one POKéMON.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove
en: Sniff, sniff…\nHm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!\pDo you want me to teach a move\nto a POKéMON of yours?$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_NoMoveICanTeachThatMon
en: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have a\nmove I can teach that POKéMON.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_IllNeedMushroomOrTwo
en: Then, I'll need a MUSHROOM or two.\nWhat are you going to give me?$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverOneBigMushroom
en: {PLAYER} handed over one\nBIG MUSHROOM in exchange.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoToLearnMove
en: If your POKéMON need to learn a\nmove, I need a MUSHROOM or two.$

label: TwoIsland_House_Text_CantTeachAnEgg
en: Hunh? There isn't a single move\nthat I can teach an EGG.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_WhereHasLostelleGottenTo
en: Now, where's LOSTELLE gotten to\ntoday?\pShe always brings me lunch every\nday right about now…$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseHelpFindLostelle
en:
Hm? You, there!
Are you a friend of LOSTELLE's?\pHave you seen LOSTELLE around?
I don't know where she might be.\lShe should've been here long ago.\pLOSTELLE's a cutie - she got my
looks - so what if someone…\pWhat if something's happened to
my LOSTELLE?!\pPlease, help me find her!
Please go search THREE ISLAND!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IsThisOnlyThreeIsland
en:
Hah? What is this GAME CORNER?
How much sadder can this get?\pThose clowns…\pThey said they'd be waiting on the
island, so where are they?\pHey, you! Is this the only THREE
ISLAND around here?$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsTwoIslandMoveIt
en: Try waking up before you crawl out\nof bed, you punk.\pThis is TWO ISLAND!\pMove it! Get your filthy motorbike\nout of my place!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_TheseIslandsAreConfusing
en: Huh…\nOh, oh, gotcha.\pTch…\nThese islands are confusing…$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PunkScuffedUpMyFloor
en: Would you look at that?\nThat punk scuffed up my floor.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseGoToThreeIsland
en:
Hey, but listen! I'm begging you,
you have to go to THREE ISLAND.\pIf anything were to happen to my
LOSTELLE…\pMy place is the house with the red
roof on THREE ISLAND.\pShe may just show up late here,
so I can't run off anywhere.\pThat's why I have to get you to do
me this big favor.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotRunningAnyGamesToday
en: I'm sorry.\nWe're not running any games today.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_GetGamesGoingSoon
en: We'll get the games going soon\nfor you!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_YouRescuedLostelle
en: So you rescued LOSTELLE?\nHow can I thank you?\pLOSTELLE, darling, forgive me!\pDaddy didn't know you were scared\nand in trouble!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_LostelleItsOkayDaddy
en: LOSTELLE: It's okay, Daddy.\nI got to be friends with {PLAYER}!$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsForMe
en:
Oh, what's that?
You're saying that this is for me?\pHow did you know that I love rare
rocks and gems?\pYou sure know how to make a guy
happy.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_OhThisIsFromBill
en: Oh, I see, this is from BILL!\nYou have to thank him for me!\pYou know, you've been fantastic.\nI want you to have this.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ReceivedMoonStoneFromLostellesDaddy
en: {PLAYER} received a MOON STONE\nfrom LOSTELLE's daddy.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotGoingToFitInBag
en: Your BAG's not going to fit another\nthing…$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IllGetGameCornerRunning
en: All right, I'll get the GAME CORNER\nrunning right away.\pYou have to come visit with a\nfriend.$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseShowMeYouBeingCool
en: Listen, listen!\pPlease show me you being cool\nagain!$

label: TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaveYouVisitedGameCorner
en: Have you visited the GAME CORNER\nalready?\pIt's no good to go alone.\nYou have to take a friend along.$

label: TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OldLadyLivesOutOnCape
en:
Not many people live on
TWO ISLAND.\pThere is this old lady who lives
out on the cape.\pShe's been there since I don't know
when.$

label: UndergroundPath_EastEntrance_Text_DoYouGoToCeladonDeptStore
en: The DEPARTMENT STORE in CELADON\nhas a great selection.\pDo you go there very often?$

label: UndergroundPath_SouthEntrance_Text_PeopleLoseThingsInTheDarkness
en: People often lose things in the\ndarkness of the UNDERGROUND PATH.$

label: UndergroundPath_WestEntrance_Text_SleepyMonNearCeladon
en: I heard a sleepy POKéMON appeared\nout near CELADON CITY, too.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_GrimerMultipliesInSludge
en: We're careful about pollution here.\pWe've heard GRIMER multiplies in\ntoxic sludge.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DidYouSeeSSAnneInHarbor
en: Did you see the S.S. ANNE moored\nin the harbor?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneHasDepartedForYear
en: So, the S.S. ANNE has departed?\pShe'll be back in VERMILION about\nthis time next year.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BuildingOnThisLand
en: I'm putting up a building on this\nplot of land. I own it all.\pMy POKéMON is tamping the land\nto lay the foundation.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_MachopStompingLandFlat
en: A MACHOP is stomping the land flat.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneVisitsOnceAYear
en: The S.S. ANNE is a famous luxury\ncruise ship.\pIt visits VERMILION once a year.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_CitySign
en: VERMILION CITY\nThe Port of Exquisite Sunsets$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SnorlaxBlockingRoute12
en: NOTICE!\pROUTE 12 may be blocked off by a\nsleeping POKéMON.\pDetour through ROCK TUNNEL to\nLAVENDER TOWN.\pVERMILION POLICE$

label: VermilionCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
en: POKéMON FAN CLUB\nAll POKéMON fans welcome!$

label: VermilionCity_Text_GymSign
en: VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\lThe Lightning American!$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DoYouHaveATicket
en: Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!\pExcuse me, do you have a ticket?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_FlashedSSTicket
en: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} flashed the S.S. TICKET!\p{FONT_MALE}Great!\nWelcome to the S.S. ANNE!$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DontHaveNeededSSTicket
en: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} doesn't have the needed\nS.S. TICKET.\p{FONT_MALE}Sorry!\pYou need a ticket to get aboard.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopTriPass
en: Ah, you have a TRI-PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop7Departing
en: Okay, everything's in order.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 7 will be\ndeparting immediately.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopRainbowPass
en: Ah, you have a RAINBOW PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_OhMysticTicketTakeYouToNavelRock
en: Oh! That's a MYSTICTICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nNAVEL ROCK anytime.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_OhAuroraTicketTakeYouToBirthIsland
en: Oh! That's an AURORATICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nBIRTH ISLAND anytime.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopFerry
en: Would you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop10Departing
en: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 10 will be\ndeparting immediately.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop12Departing
en: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 12 will be\ndeparting immediately.$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Route2AideHasPackageForYou
en:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
How are you doing?\pIt's me, one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pDid you meet the other AIDE?\pHe had a package from PROF. OAK
for you, {PLAYER}.\pHe said he'd look for you around
ROUTE 2, {PLAYER}.\pIf you're in the ROUTE 2 area,
please look for him.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeIntro
en:
Hey, kid! What do you think you're
doing here?\pYou won't live long in combat!
Not with your puny power!\pI tell you, kid, electric POKéMON
saved me during the war!\pThey zapped my enemies into
paralysis!\pThe same as I'll do to you!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgePostBattle
en: A little word of advice, kid!\pElectricity is sure powerful!\pBut, it's useless against GROUND-\ntype POKéMON!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainThunderBadgeTakeThis
en:
The THUNDERBADGE cranks up your
POKéMON's SPEED!\pIt also lets your POKéMON FLY
lightning-quick anytime, kid!\pYou're special, kid!
Take this!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM34
en: TM34 contains SHOCK WAVE!\pTeach it to an ELECTRIC POKéMON!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_MakeRoomInYourBag
en: Yo, kid, make room in your BAG!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDefeat
en: Now that's a shocker!\pYou're the real deal, kid!\pFine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerIntro
en: When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\pHe was a hard taskmaster.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerPostBattle
en: It's not easy opening that door.\pLT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyIntro
en: I'm a lightweight, but I'm good\nwith electricity!\pThat's why I joined this GYM.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyPostBattle
en: Okay, I'll talk!\pLT. SURGE said he hid door\nswitches inside something.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneIntro
en: This is no place for kids!\nNot even if you're good!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwaynePostBattle
en:
LT. SURGE installed the traps in
the GYM himself.\pHe set up double locks everywhere.
Let me give you a hint.\pWhen you open the first lock, the
second lock is right next to it.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
en:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLT. SURGE has a nickname.\pPeople refer to him as the
Lightning American!\pHe's an expert on electric
POKéMON.\pBIRD/WATER-type POKéMON match
poorly against the ELECTRIC type.\pBeware of paralysis, too.\pLT. SURGE is very cautious.\pHe's locked himself in, so it won't
be easy getting to him.$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
en: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SwitchUnderTrashFirstLockOpened
en: Hey! There's a switch under the\ntrash! Turn it on!\pThe first electric lock opened!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_AnotherSwitchInTrash
en: ガサゴソ‥！\nおっと！　ゴミばこの　そこに\lまた　スイッチが　あった！\lおして　みよう！　‥　ポチッとな$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SecondLockOpened
en: The second electric lock opened!\nThe motorized door opened!$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_OnlyTrashLocksWereReset
en: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.\pHey!\nThe electric locks were reset!$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_ImFishingGuruDoYouLikeToFish
en: I'm the FISHING GURU!\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_TakeThisAndFish
en: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_ReceivedOldRodFromFishingGuru
en: {PLAYER} received an OLD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU.$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_FishingIsAWayOfLife
en: Fishing is a way of life!\nIt is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out\nand land the big one, my friend.$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_HowAreTheFishBiting
en: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_NoRoomForNiceGift
en: Oh, no!\pI had a nice gift for you, but you\nhave no room for it!$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_DoYouHaveMonWantToTradeForMyMon
en: Hi!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThisIsNoMon
en: …This is no {STR_VAR_1}.\pIf you get one, please trade it\nto me!$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_HowIsMyOldMon
en: How is my old {STR_VAR_2}?\pMy {STR_VAR_1} is doing great!$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_PidgeyFlyLetterToSaffron
en: I'm getting my PIDGEY to fly a\nletter to SAFFRON in the north.$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_DearPippiLetter
en: Dear PIPPI,\nI hope to see you soon.\pI heard SAFFRON has problems with\nTEAM ROCKET.\pVERMILION appears to be safe.$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_SendMyPidgeyToUnionRoom
en: I want to exchange MAIL with all\nsorts of people.\pI send my PIDGEY to a UNION ROOM\nto exchange MAIL for me.$

label: VermilionCity_Mart_Text_TeamRocketAreWickedPeople
en:
There are wicked people who will
use POKéMON for criminal acts.\pTEAM ROCKET traffics in rare
POKéMON, for example.\pThey also abandon POKéMON that
they consider unpopular or useless.\pThat's the sort of horrid people
they are, TEAM ROCKET.$

label: VermilionCity_Mart_Text_MonsGoodOrBadDependingOnTrainer
en: I think POKéMON can be good or\nbad. It depends on the TRAINER.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainerMonsStrongerThanWild
en: Even if they are the same level,\nPOKéMON can have very different\lstats and abilities.\pA POKéMON raised by a TRAINER is\nstronger than one in the wild.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PoisonedMonFaintedWhileWalking
en: My POKéMON was poisoned!\nIt fainted while we were walking!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AllMonWeakToSpecificTypes
en:
It is true that a higher-level
POKéMON will be more powerful…\pBut, all POKéMON will have weak
points against specific types.\pSo, there appears to be no
universally strong POKéMON.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UrgeToBattleSomeoneAgain
en:
The urge to battle with someone
you've tangled with before…\pHave you ever had that urge?
I'm sure you have.\pI wanted to battle certain people
again over and over, too.\pSo, I've been giving these away.
Please, take one!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UseDeviceForRematches
en: Use that device and you'll find\nTRAINERS looking for a rematch.\pYou have to charge its battery to\nuse it, though.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainVSSeeker
en:
How do you use the VS SEEKER?
There's nothing to it.\pUse it like beep-beep-beep, and
TRAINERS around you will notice.\pIf any TRAINER wants a rematch,
it will let you know immediately.\pCharge its battery and use it
while you're on a road.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdmirePikachusTail
en: Won't you admire my PIKACHU's\nadorable tail?$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PikachuTwiceAsCute
en: Humph!\pMy PIKACHU is twice as cute as\nthat one!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdoreMySeel
en: I just adore my SEEL!\nIt's so lovable!\pIt squeals, “Kyuuuh,” when I\nhug it!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SeelFarMoreAttractive
en: Oh, dear!\pMy SEEL is far more attractive.\nBy double, I would say.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidYouComeToHearAboutMyMons
en:
I chair the POKéMON Fan Club!\pI raise more than a hundred
POKéMON!\pI'm very fussy when it comes to
POKéMON! I surely am!\pSo…\pDid you come visit to hear about
my POKéMON?$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmansStory
en:
Good!
Then listen up!\pMy favorite RAPIDASH…\pIt's…cute…lovely…smart… 
plus…amazing…you think so?…\loh yes…it's…stunning…\lkindly…love it!\pHug it…when…sleeping…warm
and cuddly…spectacular…\lravishing…\l…Oops! Look at the time!\lI kept you too long!\pThanks for hearing me out!
I want you to have this!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ReceivedBikeVoucherFromChairman
en: {PLAYER} received a BIKE VOUCHER\nfrom the CHAIRMAN.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBikeVoucher
en:
Take that BIKE VOUCHER to the
BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY.\pExchange that for a BICYCLE
free of charge!\pDon't worry, my favorite FEAROW
will FLY me anywhere I need to go.\pSo, I have no need for a BICYCLE.\pI hope you like cycling!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ComeBackToHearStory
en: Oh. Come back when you want to\nhear my story!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidntComeToSeeAboutMonsAgain
en: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pDid you come see me about my\nPOKéMON again?\pNo?\nToo bad!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmanVeryVocalAboutPokemon
en: Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal about\nPOKéMON.$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ListenPolitelyToOtherTrainers
en: Let's all listen politely to other\nTRAINERS!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SomeoneBragsBragBack
en: If someone brags, brag right back!$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmanReallyAdoresHisMons
en: Our CHAIRMAN really does adore his\nPOKéMON.\pBut the person who is most liked by\nPOKéMON is DAISY, I think.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiIntro
en: I wonder if you are good enough\nfor me?$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiPostBattle
en: I never wanted to lose to anybody,\nespecially to a younger kid…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoIntro
en: I can see you're good.\nLet me see exactly how good!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoPostBattle
en: Tch!\nI concede, you are better than I!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonIntro
en: If you can get through here,\nyou can go meet the ELITE FOUR.$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonPostBattle
en: I can beat you when it comes to\nknowledge about POKéMON!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeIntro
en: This here is VICTORY ROAD.\nIt's the final test for TRAINERS!$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukePostBattle
en: If you get stuck, try moving some\nboulders around.$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonIntro
en: Ah, so you wish to challenge the\nELITE FOUR?$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentPostBattle
en: You earned the right to be on\nVICTORY ROAD…$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryPostBattle
en: Many TRAINERS give up their\nchallenge here and go home.$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
en:
You should be proud of yourself,
having battled your way through\lVICTORY ROAD so courageously.\pIn recognition of your feat,
I'll teach you DOUBLE-EDGE.\pWould you like me to teach that
technique?$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
en: Keep that drive going for the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE!\pTake a run at them and knock 'em\nout!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeIntro
en: I heard rumors of a child prodigy.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgePostBattle
en: So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI\nof TEAM ROCKET?$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaPostBattle
en: By fighting tough battles, you get\nstronger.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineIntro
en: I'll show you just how good you\nare. Not!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
en: You showed me just how good\nI was…$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyIntro
en: Only the chosen can pass here!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyPostBattle
en: All TRAINERS here are headed to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDon't let down your guard.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayIntro
en: RAY: Together, the two of us are\ndestined for greatness!$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayPostBattle
en: RAY: You've beaten us.\nGreatness remains elusive…$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayNotEnoughMons
en: RAY: Together, the two of us are\nstriving for the pinnacle.\pWe need you to bring two POKéMON\ninto battle with us.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraIntro
en: TYRA: We're trying to become\nchampions together.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraPostBattle
en: TYRA: You've taught me that power\ncan be infinite in shape and form.$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
en: TYRA: You can't battle with us if\nyou have only one POKéMON.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CanCarryMonsAnywhere
en: Those POKé BALLS at your waist!\nYou have POKéMON, don't you?\pIt's great that you can carry and\nuse POKéMON anytime, anywhere.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GymClosedWonderWhoLeaderIs
en: This POKéMON GYM is always closed.\pI wonder who the LEADER is?$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WantToKnowAboutCaterpillarMons
en: You want to know about the two\nkinds of caterpillar POKéMON?$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ExplainCaterpieWeedle
en: CATERPIE has no poison,\nbut WEEDLE does.\pWatch that your POKéMON aren't\nstabbed by WEEDLE's POISON STING.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GrandpaHasntHadCoffeeYet
en: Oh, Grandpa!\nDon't be so mean!\pI'm so sorry.\nHe hasn't had his coffee yet.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GoShoppingInPewterOccasionally
en: I go shopping in PEWTER CITY\noccasionally.\pI have to take the winding trail in\nVIRIDIAN FOREST when I go.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ThisIsPrivateProperty
en: I absolutely forbid you from\ngoing through here!\pThis is private property!$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ShowYouHowToCatchMons
en:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pHm?
What is that red box you have?\pAh, so you're working on your
POKéDEX.\pThen let me give you a word of
advice.\pWhenever you catch a POKéMON,
the POKéDEX automatically updates\lits data.\p…You don't know how to catch
a POKéMON?\pI suppose I had better show you
then!$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ThatWasEducationalTakeThis
en: There! Now tell me, that was\neducational, was it not?\pAnd here, take this, too.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WatchThatToLearnBasics
en: If there's something you don't\nunderstand, watch that.\pIt will teach you about the basics\nof being a POKéMON TRAINER.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WeakenMonsFirstToCatch
en:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, are you filling your
POKéDEX?\pAt first, focus on weakening the
POKéMON before trying to catch it.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_HowsTeachyTVHelping
en:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, is my old TEACHY TV
helping you?$

label: ViridianCity_Text_MyGrandsonOnTheShow
en: Wahaha!\nIt's my grandson on the show!\pSince he's the one doing the\nteaching, you're bound to learn.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_TooBusyForTeachyTV
en: Hm… You're too busy to not even\nhave the time for TEACHY TV…\pTime is money, and neither should\nbe ill spent…$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CatchMonsForEasierBattles
en: TRAINER TIPS\pCatch POKéMON and expand your\ncollection.\pThe more you have, the easier it\nis to battle.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_MovesLimitedByPP
en: TRAINER TIPS\pThe battle moves of POKéMON are\nlimited by their POWER POINTS, PP.\pTo replenish PP, rest your tired\nPOKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniIntro
en:
Fwahahaha!
Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore
TEAM ROCKET to its former glory.\pBut, you have found me again.
So be it.\lThis time, I'm not holding back!\pOnce more, you shall face
GIOVANNI, the greatest TRAINER!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniDefeat
en: Ha!\nThat was a truly intense fight.\lYou have won!\pAs proof, here is the EARTHBADGE!\n{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
en:
Having lost in this fashion, 
I can't face my followers.\lI have betrayed their trust.\pAs of today, TEAM ROCKET is
finished forever!\pAs for myself, I shall dedicate
my life to training again.\pLet us meet again someday!
Farewell!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainEarthBadgeTakeThis
en:
The EARTHBADGE makes POKéMON of
any level obey without question.\pIt is evidence of your mastery as
a POKéMON TRAINER.\pWith it, you can challenge the
POKéMON LEAGUE.\pAlso, take this TM.\pConsider it a gift for your POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM26
en: TM26 contains EARTHQUAKE.\pIt is a powerful attack that causes\na massive tremor.\pI made it when I ran the GYM here,\nfar too long ago… $

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YouDoNotHaveSpace
en: You do not have space for this!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiIntro
en: Heh!\nYou must be running out of steam\lby now!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiPostBattle
en: You'll need power to keep up with\nour GYM LEADER.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiIntro
en: Rrrroar!\nI'm working myself into a rage!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonIntro
en: POKéMON and I, we make wonderful\nmusic together!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonPostBattle
en: Do you know the identity of our\nGYM LEADER?$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoIntro
en: Karate is the ultimate form of\nmartial arts!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoPostBattle
en: If my POKéMON were as good at\nkarate as I…$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenIntro
en: The truly talented win with style.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenPostBattle
en: The LEADER will scold me for\nlosing this way…$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiIntro
en: I'm the KARATE KING!\nYour fate rests with me!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiPostBattle
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE?\nYou? Don't get cocky!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeIntro
en: Your POKéMON will cower at the\ncrack of my whip!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelIntro
en: VIRIDIAN GYM was closed for a\nlong time.\pBut now, our LEADER is back!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelPostBattle
en: You can go on to the POKéMON\nLEAGUE only by defeating our GYM\lLEADER!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
en:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pEven I don't know the VIRIDIAN
LEADER's identity.\pBut one thing's certain.
This will be the toughest of all\lthe GYM LEADERS.\pAlso, I heard that the TRAINERS
here like GROUND-type POKéMON.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
en: Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?$

label: ViridianCity_House_Text_NicknamingIsFun
en: Coming up with nicknames is fun,\nbut it's not so easy to do.\pClever names are nice, but simple\nnames are easier to remember.$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_TakeThisToProfOak
en: You know PROF. OAK, right?\pHis order came in.\nCan I get you to take it to him?$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ReceivedOaksParcelFromClerk
en: {PLAYER} received OAK'S PARCEL\nfrom the POKéMON MART clerk.$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_SayHiToOakForMe
en: Okay, thanks! Please say hi to\nPROF. OAK for me, too.$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ShopDoesGoodBusinessInAntidotes
en: This shop does good business in\nANTIDOTES, I've heard.$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_GotToBuySomePotions
en: I've got to buy some POTIONS.\pYou never know when your POKéMON\nwill need quick healing.$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FeelFreeToUsePC
en: Please feel free to use that PC in\nthe corner.\pThe receptionist told me so.\nIt's so kind of her!$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeCenterInEveryTown
en: There's a POKéMON CENTER in every\ntown ahead.\pThey charge no money, so don't\nbe shy about healing POKéMON.$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeCentersHealMons
en: POKéMON CENTERS heal your tired,\nhurt, or fainted POKéMON.\pThey make all POKéMON completely\nhealthy.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_TryingToMemorizeNotes
en: Whew! I'm trying to memorize all my\nnotes.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadBlackboardCarefully
en: Okay!\pBe sure to read what's on the\nblackboard carefully!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFirstPage
en:
Let's check out the notebook.\pFirst page…\pPOKé BALLS are used to catch
POKéMON.\pUp to six POKéMON can be carried
in your party.\pPeople who raise and battle
with POKéMON are called TRAINERS.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookSecondPage
en: Second page…\pA healthy POKéMON may be hard to\ncatch, so weaken it first.\pPoison, burn, or cause another\nstatus problem to weaken it.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookThirdPage
en:
Third page…\pPOKéMON TRAINERS seek others to
engage in POKéMON battles.\pTo TRAINERS, the taste of victory
is sweet, indeed.\pBattles are constantly waged at
POKéMON GYMS everywhere.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFourthPage
en:
Fourth page…\pThe ultimate goal for all POKéMON
TRAINERS is simple.\pIt is to defeat the top eight
POKéMON GYM LEADERS.\pDo so to earn the right to face…\pThe ELITE FOUR of the POKéMON
LEAGUE!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_HeyDontLookAtMyNotes
en: GIRL: Hey!\nDon't look at my notes!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_BlackboardListsStatusProblems
en: The blackboard lists POKéMON\nSTATUS problems during battles.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadWhichTopic
en: Which topic do you want to read?$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainSleep
en:
A POKéMON can't attack if it's
asleep.\pPOKéMON will stay asleep even
after battles.\pUse AWAKENING to awaken one
from sleep.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainBurn
en: A burn reduces ATTACK power.\nIt also causes ongoing HP loss.\pA burn remains after a battle.\nUse BURN HEAL to cure a burn.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainPoison
en: When poisoned, a POKéMON's health\nsteadily drops.\pPoison lingers after battles.\nUse an ANTIDOTE to cure poison!$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainFreeze
en:
A frozen POKéMON becomes
helplessly immobile.\pIt stays frozen even after the
battle ends.\pUse ICE HEAL to thaw out the
suffering POKéMON.$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainParalysis
en: Paralysis reduces SPEED and may\nprevent the POKéMON from moving.\pParalysis remains after battles.\nUse PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_FriendsItchingToBattle
en: I came here with some friends to\ncatch us some BUG POKéMON!\pThey're all itching to get into\nsome POKéMON battles!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickIntro
en: Hey! You have POKéMON!\nCome on!\lLet's battle 'em!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickPostBattle
en: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.\nAnother time, okay?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougIntro
en: Yo!\nYou can't jam out if you're a\lPOKéMON TRAINER!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougPostBattle
en: That totally stinks! I'm going to\ncatch some stronger ones!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyIntro
en: Hey, wait up!\nWhat's the hurry? Why the rush?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyPostBattle
en: Sometimes, you can find stuff on\nthe ground.\pI'm looking for the stuff I\ndropped. Can you help me?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyIntro
en: I might be little, but I won't like\nit if you go easy on me!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
en: I lost some of my allowance…$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieIntro
en: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharliePostBattle
en: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nThey're a lot of fun!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RanOutOfPokeBalls
en: I was throwing POKé BALLS to\ncatch POKéMON, and I ran out.\pThat's why you can never have too\nmany POKé BALLS.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AvoidGrassyAreasWhenWeak
en: TRAINER TIPS\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you\nwant to avoid battles, stay away\lfrom grassy areas!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_UseAntidoteForPoison
en: For poison, use ANTIDOTE!\nGet it at POKéMON MARTS!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ContactOakViaPCToRatePokedex
en: TRAINER TIPS\pContact PROF. OAK via a PC to\nget your POKéDEX evaluated!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CantCatchOwnedMons
en: TRAINER TIPS\pYou can't catch a POKéMON that\nbelongs to someone else.\pThrow POKé BALLS only at wild\nPOKéMON to catch them!$

label: ViridianForest_Text_WeakenMonsBeforeCapture
en: TRAINER TIPS\pWeaken POKéMON before attempting\ncapture!\pWhen healthy, they may escape!$

label: CableClub_Text_WelcomeWhichCableClubService
en: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE\nCLUB.\pWhich of our services do you wish\nto use?$

label: CableClub_Text_WhichService
en: Which of our services do you wish\nto use?$

label: CableClub_Text_TradeMonsUsingLinkCable
en: Trade POKéMON with another player\nusing a GBA Game Link cable.$

label: CableClub_Text_BattleUsingLinkCable
en: You may battle another TRAINER\nusing a GBA Game Link cable.$

label: CableClub_Text_NeedTwoMonsForDoubleBattle
en: For a DOUBLE BATTLE, you must\nhave at least two POKéMON.$

label: CableClub_Text_NeedTwoMonsToTrade
en: For trading, you must have at\nleast two POKéMON with you.$

label: CableClub_Text_CantTradeEnigmaBerry
en: A POKéMON holding the {STR_VAR_1}\nBERRY can't be traded.$

label: CableClub_Text_WhenAllPlayersReadyAConfirmBCancel
en: When all players are ready…\nA Button: Confirm\lB Button: Cancel$

label: CableClub_Text_StartLinkWithXPlayersAConfirmBCancel
en: Start link with {STR_VAR_1} players.\nA Button: Confirm\lB Button: Cancel$

label: CableClub_Text_OkayToSaveProgress
en: はじめる　まえに　レポートを\nかきますが　よろしいですか？$

label: CableClub_Text_DirectYouToYourRoom
en: I'll direct you to your room now.$

label: CableClub_Text_SomeoneIsNotReadyToLink
en: Someone is not ready to link.\pPlease come back after everyone\nhas made preparations.$

label: CableClub_Text_LinkErrorPleaseReset
