en: Sorry, we have a link error…\nPlease reset and try again.$

label: CableClub_Text_PlayersMadeDifferentSelections
en: The link partners appear to have\nmade different selections.$

label: CableClub_Text_CantSingleBattleWithXPlayers
en: The SINGLE BATTLE Mode can't be\nplayed by {STR_VAR_1} players.$

label: CableClub_Text_CantDoubleBattleWithXPlayers
en: The DOUBLE BATTLE Mode can't be\nplayed by {STR_VAR_1} players.$

label: CableClub_Text_NeedFourPlayers
en: There must be four players to play\nthis Battle Mode.$

label: CableClub_Text_PleaseConfirmNumberAndRestart
en: Please confirm the number of\nplayers and start again.$

label: Text_TerminateLinkIfYouLeaveRoom
en: The link will be terminated if you\nleave the room. Is that okay?$

label: Text_TerminateLinkConfirmation
en: Terminating link…\nYou will be escorted out of\lthe room. Please wait.$

label: Text_TrainerTooBusyToNotice
en: This TRAINER is too busy to\nnotice…$

label: Text_LookedAtPlayersTrainerCard
en: Score! Got to look at {STR_VAR_1}'s\nTRAINER CARD!$

label: Text_LookedAtPlayersTrainerCardColored
en: Score! Got to look at {STR_VAR_1}'s\nTRAINER CARD!\pIt's a {STR_VAR_2} card!$

label: Text_TakeSeatStartBattle
en: Please take your seat and start\nyour battle.$

label: Text_TakeSeatStartTrade
en: Please take your seat and start\nyour trade.$

label: RecordCorner_Text_ThanksForComing
en: ごりよう　ありがとう　ございました$

label: CableClub_Text_TrainerCardDataOverwritten
en: The TRAINER CARD data will\nbe overwritten.$

label: CableClub_Text_HopeToSeeYouAgain
en: I hope to see you again!$

label: CableClub_Text_NotSetUpForFarAwayRegion
en: I'm awfully sorry.\pWe're not set up to conduct trades\nwith TRAINERS far away in another\lregion yet…$

label: CableClub_Text_OtherTrainerNotReady
en: The other TRAINER is not ready.$

label: CableClub_Text_YouHaveAMonThatCantBeTaken
en: You have at least one POKéMON\nthat can't be taken.$

label: CableClub_Text_AdapterNotConnected
en: The Wireless Adapter is not\nconnected properly.$

label: CableClub_Text_ParticipantsStepUpToCounter
en: Participants are asked to step up\nto the reception counter.$

label: CableClub_Text_PleaseWait
en: しょうしょう　おまちください$

label: CableClub_Text_YouMayTradeHere
en: You may trade your POKéMON here\nwith another TRAINER.$

label: CableClub_Text_YouMayBattleHere
en: You may battle with your friends\nhere.$

label: CableClub_Text_CanMakeBerryPowder
en: Two to five TRAINERS can make\nBERRY POWDER together.$

label: CableClub_Text_CanMixRecords
en: ワイヤレス　クラブでの\nあそびかたを　せつめいします$

label: CableClub_Text_WhichBattleMode
en: どちらの　しょうぶに　しますか？$

label: CableClub_Text_ReturnsToPreviousStep
en: ひとつ　まえに　もどります$

label: CableClub_Text_NeedBerryForBerryCrush
en: To use the BERRY CRUSH service,\nyou must have at least one BERRY.$

label: CableClub_Text_NeedTwoMonsForUnionRoom
en: To enter the UNION ROOM, you must\nhave at least two POKéMON.$

label: CableClub_Text_NoEnigmaBerryInUnionRoom
en: No POKéMON holding the {STR_VAR_1}\nBERRY may enter the UNION ROOM.$

label: CableClub_Text_UnionRoomAdapterNotConnected
en: This is the POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB\nUNION ROOM.\pUnfortunately, your Wireless\nAdapter is not connected properly.\pPlease do come again.$

label: Text_PlayerIsPlayingRightNowGoForIt
en: It appears as if {STR_VAR_1} is playing\nright now.\lGo for it!$

label: Text_DescribeWhichGame
en: I can explain game rules to you,\nif you'd like.\pWhich game should I describe?$

label: Text_PokemonJumpInfo
en:
“POKéMON JUMP”\pMake your POKéMON skip the
VINE WHIP rope with the A Button.\pOnly mini POKéMON around 28 inches
or less may participate.\pPOKéMON that only swim, burrow, or
fly are not good at jumping.\pAs a result, those POKéMON may not
participate.\pGood things happen if everyone
jumps in time.$

label: Text_DodrioBerryPickingInfo
en:
“DODRIO BERRY-PICKING”\pCommand DODRIO's three heads to
catch falling BERRIES.\pPress right, up, or left on the
{PLUS} Control Pad to move the heads.\pTo play this game, you must have
a DODRIO.$

label: Text_TalkToManToPlay
en: If you want to play a game,\nplease tell the man beside me.$

label: Text_WelcomeCanYouWait
en: Hi, welcome!\nYou can play games over the\lWireless Communication System.\pCan you wait just a little bit?$

label: Text_AdapterNotConnectedMinigame
en: The Wireless Adapter isn't\nconnected.\pCome back when it's hooked up!$

label: Text_PlayWhichGame
en: All right, which game did you want\nto play?$

label: Text_EnterWhichPokemon
en: Which POKéMON would you like to\nenter?$

label: Text_AllGoodToGo
en: Okay, you're all good to go.\nDon't let the others beat you!$

label: Text_LeavingDoComeAgain
en: きょうは　けえるのか？\nまたこいよ！$

label: EventScript_ExplainPokemonJumpRequirements
en: It doesn't look like you have any\nPOKéMON that you can enter…\pWould you like me to explain what\nkinds of POKéMON can enter?$

label: Text_ShortJumpingPokemonAllowed
en:
“POKéMON JUMP” is open to POKéMON
around 28 inches or less.\pWhat you can't enter are those
POKéMON that can't jump.\pYou know, like POKéMON that only
swim, burrow, or fly.\pThat's all you need to know.$

label: Text_OnlyDodrioAllowed
en: “DODRIO BERRY-PICKING”…\nWell, the name says it all.\pYou have to have a DODRIO to play\nthis game.$

label: Text_RetryFromStartPlease
en: もういちど　はじめから\nやりなおして　みて　くれ$

label: CableClub_Text_WelcomeWhichDirectCornerRoom
en:
Welcome to the POKéMON WIRELESS
CLUB DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may interact directly with
your friends here.\pWhich room would you like to
enter?$

label: CableClub_Text_TradePokemon
en: Would you like to trade POKéMON?$

label: CableClub_Text_PlayWhichBattleMode
en: Which Battle Mode would you like\nto play?$

label: CableClub_Text_UseBerryCrush
en: Would you like to use the\nBERRY CRUSH System?$

label: CableClub_Text_ExplainBattleModes
en:
There are three Battle Modes.\pSINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.\pDOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with two or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER will send out two
POKéMON in battle at a time.\pMULTI BATTLE is for four TRAINERS

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni2
en: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly\ncruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to\nbe used.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni3
en: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore\nTEAM ROCKET to its former glory.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni4
en: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni5
en: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,\nare you?\pNo, that can't be right.\nGIOVANNI's kid has red hair.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_ProfOak
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: PROF. OAK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Why do POKéMON compete and battle
so hard for you?\pThey do so because they can see
the love and trust you have\ltowards POKéMON.\pNever forget that.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Daisy
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: DAISY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}While I was comfortably enjoying
my tea breaks, you've grown very\lskilled and powerful.\pI hope you'll remain a good rival
to my little brother.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Brock
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BROCK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}In this big world of ours, there
must be many tough TRAINERS.\pLet's both keep training and
making ourselves stronger!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Misty
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MISTY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm going to keep training here at
this GYM.\pWhen I get better, I'd love to hit
the road and travel.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_LtSurge
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LT. SURGE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, kid!
You electrified me in our battle!\pI didn't know that there were
gutsy TRAINERS like you.\pIt made me change my mind about
you!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Erika
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: ERIKA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am so glad that there are strong
TRAINERS like you.\pThat awareness alone inspires and
motivates me to try harder.\pPlease visit me again.
Zzz…$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Koga
en: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: KOGA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You and I, we must both set our\nsights higher and work towards\lmeeting our challenges.\pNow, I must go train my daughter.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Sabrina
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: SABRINA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The love you have towards your
POKéMON…\pIt was a power that was never
bested by my psychic power.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Blaine
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BLAINE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My fire POKéMON!
They'll become even more powerful!\pAnd now, a quiz. How many kinds of
FIRE-type POKéMON are there?$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Lorelei
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LORELEI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I needed to thank you for your
help.\pBut that has nothing to do with our
battles.\pYou'd better watch out next time!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Bruno
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BRUNO
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The super power of your POKéMON
and you I've experienced myself.\pNext time, maybe I should show you
how to train yourself.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Agatha
en: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: AGATHA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}When you grow older, don't you\ndare go soft like that coot OAK!\pBe like me and keep battling on!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Lance
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LANCE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm considering going back to my
hometown.\pI want to retrain my DRAGON-type
POKéMON and strengthen them.\pI'd like to invite you to my
hometown one day.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Bill
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BILL
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, there! CELIO had nothing but
praise for you.\pHearing that makes me happy.\pWhen you catch some rare POKéMON,
come show me, okay? Promise!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_MrFuji
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MR. FUJI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Instead of hoping for the happiness
of just your POKéMON…\p…Can I get you to wish for the
happiness of all POKéMON?$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Giovanni
en:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: GIOVANNI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}There is nothing that I wish to say
to you.\pI will concentrate solely on
bettering myself, and none other.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBrock
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PEWTER GYM\nLEADER BROCK!\pBROCK rarely laughs, but is said to\nbe unable to stop if he starts.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMisty
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CERULEAN GYM\nLEADER MISTY!\pMISTY is said to worship LORELEI\nof the ELITE FOUR.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLtSurge
en:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: VERMILION GYM
LEADER LT. SURGE!\pLT. SURGE is rumored to have been
a pilot while home in America.\pHe used the electricity generated
by POKéMON to power his plane.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureErika
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CELADON GYM\nLEADER ERIKA!\pRumor has it that if you peek into\nCELADON GYM, you can often\lsee ERIKA snoozing.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureKoga
en:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: FUCHSIA GYM
LEADER KOGA!\pKOGA is said to have a thorough
knowledge of medicine.\pHe even concocts medicine to nurse
his POKéMON to health.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureSabrina
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: SAFFRON GYM\nLEADER SABRINA!\pPeople say that SABRINA can\ncommunicate with her POKéMON\lduring battle without speaking.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBlaine
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CINNABAR GYM\nLEADER BLAINE!\pBLAINE is said to remove his dark\nshades only when he is thinking up\lnew quiz questions.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLorelei
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LORELEI!\pKnown for her logical, calculated,\nand cool battling style, LORELEI\lhas a surprising secret!$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBruno
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's BRUNO!\pBRUNO apparently joined the ELITE\nFOUR out of his burning ambition to\lbattle the best TRAINERS.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureAgatha
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's AGATHA!\pIn her youth, AGATHA and PROF.\nOAK were rivals who vied for\lsupremacy as TRAINERS.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLance
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LANCE!\pLANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureProfOak
en: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PROF. OAK,\nthe POKéMON Researcher!\pPROF. OAK reportedly lives with his\ngrandchildren DAISY and {RIVAL}.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureDaisyOak
en:
This is a POKéMON JOURNAL from
years ago…\pPOKéMON JOURNAL
CONTEST Special!\pThe Spring POKéMON CONTEST's
Grand Champion is DAISY OAK of\lPALLET TOWN!$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMrFuji
en:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:
MR. FUJI of POKéMON HOUSE!\pEditor: The shy MR. FUJI turned
down our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored
and respected in LAVENDER TOWN.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerPlayingForFirstTime
en: You become the main character,\nexploring the world of POKéMON.\lBy talking to people and solving\lmysteries, new paths will open to you.\lStrive for the goal together with your\lwonderful POKéMON.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatShouldIBeDoing
en: When you come across another person,\ngo up to them and press the A Button.\lThat will get them to talk and interact\lwith your character. You may also\lexamine various items and objects in\lthe same way. Talk to people and check\lthings often to obtain information.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerCantGetOutOfRoom
en: On the stairs or the exits of a\nbuilding is a red mat. Move your\lcharacter to stand on top of the\lred mat. Press the {PLUS} Control Pad \ltoward the stairs or the exit to\ladvance.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerCantFindPersonIWant
en: This isn't something you should worry\nabout too much.\lTalk to other people, check signs,\lcheck things, and so on.\lSometimes, you may need to just move\lto a new town or place.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerTalkedToEveryoneNowWhat
en: Try moving on to a new road, town, or\nplace.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerSomeoneBlockingMyWay
en: There could be something in the town\nor inside a building that is the cause.\lTry talking to the people in the area\lagain. If there is a problem that they\lneed solved, you may have to help.\lAfterwards, try talking to the person\lblocking your way again.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerICantGoOn
en: Try talking to people by going up to\nthem and pressing the A Button.\lAlso, try checking things like odd trees\land strange rocks with the A Button.\lPress the {PLUS} Control Pad and try going\lto places that look impassable, too.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerOutOfThingsToDo
en: Try going to places where you \nhaven't visited yet.\lAlso, check everything that looks\lsuspicious by pressing the A Button.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatHappenedToItemIGot
en: Any item that you are given by another\ncharacter goes in your BAG.\lThe item is automatically sorted and\lplaced in one of three pockets.\lFor instructions on the BAG's use,\lplease refer to the HELP System's\l“How do I do this?” heading.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreMyAdventureBasics
en: If POKéMON are hurt in battle,\ntake them to a POKéMON CENTER and\lhave them healed by the staff.\lGet in the habit of saving your\lgame and recording your progress.\lStock up on healing items at\lPOKéMON MARTS before traveling far.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerHowAreRoadsForestsDifferent
en: Forests are basically the same as\nroads but they can be like mazes.\lAll forests have a way out, so don't\lgive up if you get lost.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerHowAreCavesDifferent
en: Caves are dark and dangerous. Wild\nPOKéMON can appear anywhere in them.\lIf there is an emergency, rush to a\lPOKéMON CENTER or use items.\lNew towns await discovery beyond some\lcaves, so don't give up.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerHowDoIProgress
en: The object of the game is to train\nyour POKéMON and move forward.\lYou must collect info and solve\lproblems. For example, what do you\lneed to get around an obstacle?\lWhat would get that impeding\lperson out of the way?$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhenCanIUseItem
en: There are several kinds of items.\nSome can be used only on the field.\lSome are only for use during battle.\lSome can be used anytime.\lTry using an item - if it can't be used,\lyou will be alerted.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsABattle
en: In a battle, POKéMON try to reduce\none another's vitality, expressed as\lHP. If a POKéMON's HP falls to zero,\lit faints, and the other POKéMON\lwins. By winning a battle, POKéMON\learn EXP. Points, which help them\llevel up (grow stronger).$

label: Help_Text_AnswerHowDoIPrepareForBattle
en: First, fully heal the POKéMON in your\nparty (the POKéMON with you) at any\lPOKéMON CENTER.\lYou should also buy healing items for\lemergencies at a POKéMON MART.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsAMonsVitality
en: A POKéMON's vitality is expressed in HP.\nIf a POKéMON is hurt in battle, HP is\lsubtracted. If its HP drops to zero,\lthe POKéMON faints.\lHeal hurt or fainted POKéMON at a\lPOKéMON CENTER or by using items.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerMyMonsAreHurt
en: A POKéMON CENTER is like an inn for\nPOKéMON. It will fully heal POKéMON of\lany status problems and fully restore\ltheir HP using a special machine.\lThis service is free, so get in the\lhabit of healing your POKéMON often.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsStatusProblem
en: A status problem refers to an ailment\nthat is inflicted on a POKéMON by its\lfoe's attack. These include burns,\lparalysis, poisoning, sleep, and\lfreezing. These can be healed by\lvisiting a POKéMON CENTER or using\lthe appropriate item.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatHappensIfAllMyMonsFaint
en: If all the POKéMON in your party\n(all the POKéMON with you) faint, you\llose some MONEY, and you are\lreturned home or to a POKéMON\lCENTER. To reduce that chance, visit\lPOKéMON CENTERS often. Also, get\lin the habit of saving often.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerCantCatchMons
en: If a wild POKéMON escapes from a POKé\nBALL, it's obviously still feisty.\lTry reducing its HP some more, and\ltry to weaken it with paralysis or sleep\lbefore trying to catch it.\lIf the POKé BALL rocks for a while,\lthe quarry is close to being caught!$

label: Help_Text_AnswerRanOutOfPotions
en: There are shops, known as POKéMON\nMARTS, that sell items.\lYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\lroads, in forests, or in caves.\lStock up on needed items while you are\lvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerCanIBuyPokeBalls
en: You may buy POKé BALLS at any\nPOKéMON MART in any town.\lYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\lroads, in forests, or in caves.\lStock up on POKé BALLS while you are\lvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsATrainer
en: A TRAINER is a person who raises\nPOKéMON through battling.\lTRAINERS will challenge you \lwherever they are - it could be on\la road, in forests, caves, anywhere.\lIf your eyes meet, you have to accept\ltheir challenge. So be careful!$

label: Help_Text_AnswerHowDoIWinAgainstTrainer
en: To beat a TRAINER in battle, use\nPOKéMON that have type advantages\lover the foe's POKéMON. You may also\luse highly trained POKéMON with\loverwhelming power. Outnumbering the\lfoe's POKéMON is another obvious\ltactic.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhereDoMonsAppear
en: Wild POKéMON will appear in tall grass,\non roads, and in forests. They will\lappear anywhere in dark caves.\lThere are no wild POKéMON or TRAINERS\lin towns, so they are safe places.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreMoves
en: POKéMON may learn up to four different\ntechniques, or moves. There is a great\lvariety of moves including attacks and\lthose with special effects. The kinds\lof moves that can be learned vary\lfor each POKéMON. Some moves\lcan be learned from machines.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreHiddenMoves
en: HIDDEN moves are those that are\nespecially important for your\ladventure. To use such a move outside\lof battle, open the “POKéMON” MENU\land make the POKéMON that knows the\lmove use it. A fainted POKéMON may use\la HIDDEN move outside of battle.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatMovesShouldIUse
en: Select “FIGHT,” and the MENU of moves\nwill appear. Consider the type\lmatchups, and use the most effective\lmoves. You can check the effects of\lmoves by opening “POKéMON,”\lpicking a POKéMON, opening “SUMMARY,”\lthen opening “POKéMON SKILLS.”$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWantToAddMoreMoves
en: The most a POKéMON can learn is four\nmoves. They are learned as the\lPOKéMON levels up. It can also be\ltaught a move using a TM (Technical\lMachine) or HM (Hidden Machine).\lThere are also people who teach moves.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWantToMakeMonStronger
en: The key to making your POKéMON\nstrong is to battle and win often.\lThe EXP. (Experience) Points earned\lby winning battles accumulate to\llevel up POKéMON that participated in\lthem. Battle wild POKéMON often to\llevel up your party.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerFoeMonsTooStrong
en: If your foes are too strong, try\nleveling up your POKéMON some more.\lGo back the way you came and battle\lwild POKéMON to level up your party.\lYou may also battle TRAINERS whom you\lhave not battled before.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatDoIDoInCave
en: Unlike roads and forests, wild POKéMON\ncan appear anywhere in caves.\lIf your POKéMON are hurt in a cave,\lrush to a POKéMON CENTER or use items\lto heal them right away. It is very\ldangerous to force your luck in caves.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerNothingIWantToKnow
en: Trust your own knowledge and power.\nBelieve in yourself and find your way!$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsPokemonCenter
en: A POKéMON CENTER is identified by its\nred roof and a “P.C” sign. Every\lPOKéMON CENTER offers such services as\lfully healing POKéMON and free PC use,\lmaking it essential for your travels.\lOn the upper floor are facilities for\llinking with friends and others.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsPokemonMart
en: A POKéMON MART is identified by its\nblue roof and a “MART” sign.\lItems can be bought and sold at any\lPOKéMON MART. Some MARTS carry items\lthat are available only in their towns.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWantToEndGame
en: You can safely end your game by\nselecting “SAVE” on the MENU.\lOnce you have saved, the game can be\lsafely turned off. When the game is\lturned back on, you can resume from\lwhere you last saved.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatsAMon
en: POKéMON are living beings about which\nmany mysteries still remain. You may\lsee them in grass, the sea, and caves.\lThey appear to obey the wishes of the\lTRAINERS that caught them.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsThatPersonLike
en: Use the FAME CHECKER among the\nKEY ITEMS in your BAG.\lIt may give you a hint, so try it out.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatDoesHiddenMoveDo
en: A HIDDEN move is taught to a POKéMON\nusing an HM (Hidden Machine).\lA HIDDEN move is important for helping\lyour adventure. For example, one is\lused to light up dark caves. Another\lcuts down small trees. There is one\lfor traveling on water, and so on.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatDoIDoInSafari
en: Try to catch wild POKéMON by throwing\nthe special SAFARI BALLS.\lYou may keep any item you find, too.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreSafariRules
en: Your SAFARI GAME ends once you have\ntraveled a certain distance or thrown\lall your SAFARI BALLS.\lOpen the MENU to check the remaining\lnumber of steps and SAFARI BALLS.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWantToEndSafari
en: If you would like to cut your SAFARI\nGAME short, open the MENU and select\l“RETIRE” at the top of the list.$

label: Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsAGym
en: POKéMON GYMS are operated by the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE and are training\lfacilities for TRAINERS. They are all\lacross the land in cities and towns.\lEach one is headed by a LEADER, who\lis a very skilled TRAINER. Beat the\lLEADER to collect a BADGE.$

label: Help_Text_UsingMoveOutsideOfBattle
en: Using a move outside of battle$

label: Help_Text_HowToUsePokedex
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéDEX” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Choose POKéMON using commands such
   as “POKéMON LIST,”
   “HABITATS OF POKéMON,” and
   “SEARCH.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select a POKéMON to obtain detailed
   information.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUsePokemon
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéMON” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Choose a POKéMON in your party.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “SUMMARY,” “SWITCH,”
   or “ITEM.”$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseSummary
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “SUMMARY.”
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the information:
   “POKéMON INFO”
   “POKéMON SKILLS”
   “KNOWN MOVES”$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseSwitch
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Choose the POKéMON you want to
   switch around.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “SWITCH.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select the POKéMON to switch with
   the first one.
The POKéMON at the left of the screen
will be the first one out in a battle.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseItem
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select whether you want to “GIVE”
   an item to the POKéMON to hold,
   or “TAKE” an item it is holding.
A POKéMON can hold no more than one
item!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseBag
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “BAG” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the data headings:
   “ITEMS”
   “KEY ITEMS”
   “POKé BALLS”
   Press up or down to select an item.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseAnItem
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select the “ITEMS” POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select an item.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to use the selected
   item.
Some items may not be used depending
on the place and/or situation.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseKeyItem
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select a key item.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to use the selected
   key item.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUsePokeBall
en:
{CIRCLE_1} While battling a wild POKéMON,
   select the BAG's “POKé BALLS”
   POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select a POKé BALL.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to throw the selected
   POKé BALL.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUsePlayer
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Your TRAINER CARD is displayed face
   up with basic information. Press the
   A Button to turn the CARD over.
{CIRCLE_3} A variety of data can be found on
   the reverse side of the CARD.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseSave
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “SAVE” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “YES” and your progress is
   recorded in the save file.
Once the game is saved, you may turn
off the game. Your game can be resumed
from where you saved.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseOption
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “OPTION” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select an optional item, then
   press left or right to alter the
   settings.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “CANCEL” or press the
   B Button after making changes.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUsePotion
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad and select “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select “POTION” in the “ITEMS”
   POCKET.
{CIRCLE_4} Select “USE.”
{CIRCLE_5} Select the POKéMON to be healed.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseTownMap
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad and select “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} Press left or right to open the
   “KEY ITEMS” POCKET, then press
   up or down to select “TOWN MAP.” 
{CIRCLE_4} Select “USE” to open the TOWN MAP.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseTM
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the
   “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” the TM CASE.
{CIRCLE_4} Select and “USE” a TM.
{CIRCLE_5} Select a POKéMON that can learn the
   move in the TM.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseHM
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the
   “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” the TM CASE.
{CIRCLE_4} Select and “USE” an HM.
{CIRCLE_5} Select a POKéMON that can learn it.
HMs are hard to remove, so be careful!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseMoveOutsideOfBattle
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “POKéMON.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select a POKéMON that knows an
   HM move. The usable HM move(s)
   will be shown in blue. Select and
   use the desired move to destroy an
   obstacle, fly, surf, etc.$

label: Help_Text_HowToRideBicycle
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU. Open the
   “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the “BAG”
   and select the “BICYCLE.”
{CIRCLE_2} The BICYCLE can be ridden by
   selecting “USE.” You may also
   “REGISTER” it for instant use by
   pressing SELECT.$

label: Help_Text_HowToEnterName
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Move the cursor to the letter you
   want with the {PLUS} Control Pad, then
   press the A Button to enter it.
{CIRCLE_2} Press the B Button to back up.
{CIRCLE_3} Press SELECT to switch between
   uppercase and lowercase letters.
{CIRCLE_4} Press the A Button on “OK.”$

label: Help_Text_HowToUsePC
en: {CIRCLE_1} Go to any POKéMON CENTER, go up\n   to the PC, then press the A Button.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseBillsPC
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{STR_VAR_1}'S PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select from one of the top three
   MENU items to access the POKéMON
   Storage System.
If you catch a POKéMON when you have
six in your party, the POKéMON is sent
automatically to a BOX in the System!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseWithdraw
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in the open BOX
   with the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “WITHDRAW” to remove the
   POKéMON from the BOX and add it to
   your party.
You may not withdraw a POKéMON if you
already have six POKéMON with you!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseDeposit
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in your party with
   the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “DEPOSIT.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select the BOX, then press the
   A Button to store the POKéMON.
If you have only one POKéMON with you,
it may not be stored!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseMove
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in the open BOX.
{CIRCLE_2} Pick up the POKéMON by selecting
   “MOVE” and move it anywhere with
   the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_3} Move the POKéMON to the BOX name
   and press left or right to move it
   to another BOX.$

label: Help_Text_HowToMoveItems
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Faintly shown POKéMON can be made
   to hold an item by selecting it and
   pressing the A Button.
{CIRCLE_2} Clearly shown POKéMON can be made
   to give the item they are holding to
   another POKéMON, or return the item
   to the BAG with the A Button.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUsePlayersPC
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}'s PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select either “ITEM STORAGE” or
   “MAILBOX.”
You may store things in your own PC
if your BAG is full. You may also
withdraw items stored in your PC.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseWithdrawItem
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item to be withdrawn.
{CIRCLE_3} The item can be withdrawn and
   placed in the BAG's ITEMS POCKET.
   It may also be directly given to a
   POKéMON to hold.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseDepositItem
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item in the BAG to be
   deposited using the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_3} If there is more than one 
   item to be deposited, enter the
   quantity with the {PLUS} Control Pad,
   then press the A Button.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseMailbox
en:
When MAIL is taken from a POKéMON,
it is moved to the MAILBOX. If it has
no MAIL, the MAILBOX can't be used.
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}'S PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “MAILBOX” to read MAIL or
   make a POKéMON hold MAIL.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseProfOaksPC
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “PROF. OAK'S PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} PROF. OAK will evaluate your
   POKéDEX.
His evaluations should give you hints
for catching more POKéMON!$

label: Help_Text_HowToOpenMenu
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Press START.
{CIRCLE_2} The MENU will open on the right.
{CIRCLE_3} Depending on the situation, the MENU
   may feature different headings.
The MENU will not open in certain
situations such as when talking, doing
something, battling, etc.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseFight
en: {CIRCLE_1} Select “FIGHT.”\n{CIRCLE_2} Select one of the moves shown,\nand that move will be used!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUsePokemon2
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéMON.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the POKéMON in your party
   that you want to use.
{CIRCLE_3} If you have two or more POKéMON
   with you, they may be switched by
   selecting “SHIFT.” Check POKéMON
   data by selecting “SUMMARY.”$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseShift
en:
This command switches the POKéMON in
battle with another one in your party.
{CIRCLE_1} Select the POKéMON to be sent out.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “SHIFT.”
{CIRCLE_3} The selected POKéMON will switch
   places with the POKéMON in battle!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseSummary2
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “SUMMARY.”
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the information:
   “POKéMON INFO”
   “POKéMON SKILLS”
   “KNOWN MOVES”$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseBag2
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the data headings:
   “ITEMS”
   “KEY ITEMS”
   “POKé BALLS”
   Press up or down to select an item.$

label: Help_Text_HowToReadPokedex
en:
{CIRCLE_1} POKéMON that you have caught are
   identified by a POKé BALL mark on
   the POKéDEX list.
{CIRCLE_2} A caught POKéMON will provide a
   large amount of data.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “AREA” to display the TOWN
   MAP with the POKéMON's habitat(s).$

label: Help_Text_HowToReadPokedex
en: {CIRCLE_3} Select “NEXT DATA” to display the\n   TOWN MAP with its habitat(s).$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseHomePC
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Go up to the PC at home, then press
   the A Button.
{CIRCLE_2} The PC will turn on.
{CIRCLE_3} Select either “ITEM STORAGE” or
   “MAILBOX.”$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseItemStorage
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM” to withdraw
   an item stored on your PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM” to put 
   an item from your BAG into your PC.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseWithdrawItem2
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item to be withdrawn.
{CIRCLE_3} The item can be withdrawn and
   placed in the BAG's ITEMS POCKET.
   It may also be directly given to a
   POKéMON to hold.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseDepositItem2
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item in the BAG to be
   deposited using the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_3} If there is nothing in the BAG, this
   command can't be used!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseMailbox2
en:
When MAIL is taken from a POKéMON,
it is moved to the MAILBOX. If it has
no MAIL, the MAILBOX can't be used.
{CIRCLE_1} Select MAIL by name to read it or
   make a POKéMON hold it.$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseRun
en:
You may not “RUN” from a TRAINER
battle!
{CIRCLE_1} You may “RUN” from a wild POKéMON.
{CIRCLE_2} Your chance of escape is improved
   if your POKéMON in battle is fast.$

label: Help_Text_HowToRegisterKeyItem
en:
You may “REGISTER” a key item for
instant use by pressing SELECT!
{CIRCLE_1} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Select the key item, then select
   “REGISTER.”$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseBall
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select to throw the special POKé
   BALL used only in the SAFARI ZONE.
When wild POKéMON appear, throw lots
of SAFARI BALLS to catch them!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseBait
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select to throw the special food
   used only in the SAFARI ZONE.
It is POKéMON food rolled up into
a ball for easy eating. When BAIT is
thrown, the wild POKéMON may get
attracted by it, and may not flee!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseRock
en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select to throw a rock lying on
   the ground in the SAFARI ZONE.
Throwing a rock at a POKéMON may 
make it run away, but it becomes easier
to catch!$

label: Help_Text_HowToUseHallOfFame
en: {CIRCLE_1} Select “HALL OF FAME” on the PC.\n{CIRCLE_2} The POKéMON that have entered the\n   HALL OF FAME can be examined.$

label: Help_Text_DefineHP
en: HP indicates a POKéMON's vitality.\nIf a POKéMON's HP drops to zero, it\lfaints and is unable to battle.\lSo, the key in battle is to try to\lreduce the foe's HP to zero.\lIf your POKéMON are hurt, restore their\lHP at a POKéMON CENTER or use items.$

label: Help_Text_DefineEXP
en: EXP. Points stands for “Experience\nPoints.” POKéMON gain EXP. Points by\lparticipating in winning battles.\lWhen a POKéMON accumulates sufficient\lEXP. Points, it levels up. The EXP. Bar\lindicates accumulated EXP. Points.\lIt returns to zero upon leveling up.$

label: Help_Text_DefineMoves
en: POKéMON may learn up to four different\nmoves. There are many kinds of moves\lincluding attacks and those with\lspecial effects. The kinds of moves\lthat can be learned vary for each\lPOKéMON. Some moves can be learned\lfrom items.$

label: Help_Text_DefineAttack
en: ATTACK indicates the power of an\noffensive move. The higher this stat,\lthe more powerful the move.\lIt is applied for the following move\ltypes: NORMAL, POISON, GROUND,\lFLYING, BUG, FIGHTING, ROCK, GHOST,\land STEEL.$

label: Help_Text_DefineDefense
en: DEFENSE indicates the resistance a\nPOKéMON has against physical attacks.\lThe higher this stat, the less damage\lsustained from a foe's physical hit.$

label: Help_Text_DefineSpAtk
en: SP. ATK (Special Attack) indicates the\npower of a special attack move.\lThe higher this stat, the more powerful\lthe special attack move.\lIt is applied for the following move\ltypes: FIRE, WATER, ELECTRIC, GRASS,\lICE, PSYCHIC, DRAGON, and DARK.$

label: Help_Text_DefineSpDef
en: SP. DEF (Special Defense) indicates\nthe resistance a POKéMON has against\lspecial attacks.\lThe higher this stat, the less damage\lsustained from a foe's special attack.$

label: Help_Text_DefineSpeed
en: SPEED indicates the agility of a\nPOKéMON. If this stat exceeds the foe's\lin battle, the POKéMON can make a move\lbefore its slower opponent.$

label: Help_Text_DefineLevel
en: Lv. (Level) indicates the growth and\nstrength of a POKéMON.\lIn general, when a POKéMON levels up,\lits stats such as HP, ATTACK, and\lDEFENSE rise, making it stronger.\lPOKéMON may learn a new move upon\lleveling up.$

label: Help_Text_DefineType
en: POKéMON and moves are classified by\ntype. Every type has advantageous and\ldisadvantageous matchups against\lother types. For example, like a rock-\lpaper-scissors game, the WATER type is\lstrong against the FIRE type and weak\lagainst the GRASS type.$

label: Help_Text_DefineOT
en: OT stands for “Original TRAINER,”\nthe first TRAINER to have caught the\lselected POKéMON.\lEven if the POKéMON is traded, the OT\lname will remain unchanged.$

label: Help_Text_DefineItem
en: All POKéMON can be made to hold one\nitem each. Some items will be used by\lthe POKéMON automatically in certain\lsituations. To make a POKéMON hold an\litem, select the item from the BAG and\l“GIVE” it to the POKéMON.$

label: Help_Text_DefineAbility
en: All POKéMON have a special ABILITY.\nThere are many different kinds of these\labilities, some used in battle, some\lelsewhere. The abilities differ from\lspecies to species. Some species may\lhave more than one kind of ability.$

label: Help_Text_DefineMoney
en: Whenever you win a battle against a\nTRAINER, you are given prize money.\lSave up your prize money so you can\lenjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!$

label: Help_Text_DefineMoveType
en: Moves are also classified by types.\nIf a POKéMON of a certain type uses\la move of the same type, the move's\lpower is boosted. If the move's type\lhas a matchup advantage against the\ltarget, its effectiveness is also\lboosted.$

label: Help_Text_DefineNature
en: All POKéMON have a personality,\nor “NATURE.” The POKéMON's\lnature appears to affect how the\lPOKéMON will grow upon leveling up.$

label: Help_Text_DefineIDNo
en: The ID No. is a special number assigned\nspecifically to you as a TRAINER.\lTogether with the OT name, the ID No.\lis used to precisely identify the\lOriginal TRAINER.\lThe ID No. does not change even if the\lPOKéMON is traded.$

label: Help_Text_DefinePP
en: PP stands for “Power Points.”\nIt indicates the number of times a\lcertain move can be used in battle.\lLike HP, PP can be restored by visiting\la POKéMON CENTER or using certain\litems.$

label: Help_Text_DefinePower
en: POWER indicates the strength of an\nattack. The higher this number, the\lgreater the damage that can be\linflicted on the foe!$

label: Help_Text_DefineAccuracy
en: ACCURACY indicates the probability of\nthe move hitting the foe.\lThe higher this number, the more likely\lthe move will strike the target.$

label: Help_Text_DefineFNT
en: FNT stands for “fainted.”\nA POKéMON faints if its HP is reduced\lto zero. It becomes incapable of taking\lpart in battle.\lRestore a fainted POKéMON at a POKéMON\lCENTER, or use an item.$

label: Help_Text_DefineItems
en: Ordinary items bought at any POKéMON\nMART are placed in the ITEMS POCKET.\lItems may be used, given to a POKéMON\lto hold, or tossed out as garbage.$

label: Help_Text_DefineKeyItems
en: Important items that you find or \nreceive from people are placed in the\lKEY ITEMS POCKET.\lKey items may be used, or registered\lfor use instantly with SELECT. Once\lregistered, the item can be used\lwithout opening the MENU and BAG.$

label: Help_Text_DefinePokeBalls
en: POKé BALLS, which are used for\ncatching wild POKéMON, are placed in\lthe POKé BALLS POCKET.\lPOKé BALLS may be bought at POKéMON\lMARTS. They may be used, given to a\lPOKéMON to hold, or tossed out as\lgarbage.$

label: Help_Text_DefinePokedex
en: This indicates the number of species of\nPOKéMON you have caught and/or\levolved to fill the POKéDEX.\lTry hard to catch all sorts of\lPOKéMON!$

label: Help_Text_DefinePlayTime
en: This is the total amount of time that\nyou have played this game.$

label: Help_Text_DefineBadges
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE BADGES that you\nhave won are registered and shown.\lEarn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS\lin various cities and towns.$

label: Help_Text_DefineTextSpeed
en: You can adjust how quickly the text is\ndisplayed. Choose one: SLOW, MID,\lor FAST.$

label: Help_Text_DefineBattleScene
en: You can choose to turn the battle\nanimation ON or OFF.$

label: Help_Text_DefineBattleStyle
en: You can choose whether or not a\nTRAINER can switch a POKéMON after\lit has made its foe faint.\lSet to “SHIFT” if you would like the\lchance to switch a POKéMON after it\lhas made its foe faint.$

label: Help_Text_DefineSound
en: You can choose between MONO and\nSTEREO sound output.$

label: Help_Text_DefineFrame
en: You may choose the design of the frame\naround certain menus. Try them out and\lsee what you like.$

label: Help_Text_DefineCancel2
en: The settings will be changed to the\nselections shown in red, and you will\lreturn to the MENU.$

label: Help_Text_DefineTM
en: A TM (Technical Machine) is a device\nused to teach a move to a POKéMON.\lThere are many different kinds.\lMoves can be taught only to those\lPOKéMON capable of using them.\lA TM breaks after a single use.$

label: Help_Text_DefineHM
en: An HM (Hidden Machine) is a device used\nto teach a HIDDEN move to a POKéMON.\lA HIDDEN move can be taught only to\lthose POKéMON capable of using it.\lUnlike a TM, an HM can be used over\land over. A HIDDEN move can be tough\lfor a POKéMON to forget.$

label: Help_Text_DefineHMMove
en: HIDDEN moves are those that are\nespecially important for your\ladventure. To use such a move outside\lof battle, open the “POKéMON” MENU\land make the POKéMON that knows the\lmove use it. A fainted POKéMON may use\la HIDDEN move outside of battle.$

label: Help_Text_DefineEvolution
en: Among POKéMON, there are some that\nundergo major changes (evolution) upon\lgrowing to certain levels. Evolution\lcauses a POKéMON to alter form, change\lits name, and perhaps change the moves\lit may learn. Some POKéMON evolve\ldue to reasons other than leveling up.$

label: Help_Text_DefineStatusProblem
en: Status problems include:\nSleep: Can't use moves.\lPoison: Causes steady HP loss.\lParalysis: May prevent moves.\lBurn: HP loss and lowers ATTACK.\lFreeze: Can't use moves.\lThese can be healed with items, etc.$

label: Help_Text_DefinePokemon
en: POKéMON is a name given to describe\nwondrous creatures that inhabit all\lcorners of this world.\lPeople raise POKéMON to be their pets,\luse them for battling, and so on.$

label: Help_Text_DefineIDNo2
en: The ID No. is a special number assigned\nspecifically to you as a TRAINER.\lTogether with the OT name, the ID No.\lis used to precisely identify the\lOriginal TRAINER.\lThe ID No. does not change even if the\lPOKéMON is traded.$

label: Help_Text_DefineMoney2
en: Whenever you win a battle against a\nTRAINER, you are given prize money.\lSave up your prize money so you can\lenjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!$

label: Help_Text_DefineBadges2
en: This indicates the number of POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES that you have won.\lEarn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS\lin various cities and towns.$

label: Help_Text_DescTheHelpSystem
en: The help messages change depending on\nhow much you have progressed in the\lgame. They are designed to support you\lwhen you need them. If there is\lanything that you don't understand,\lplease look up the HELP System!$

label: Help_Text_DescTheGame
en: You become the main character to\nexplore the world of POKéMON!\lBy talking to people and solving\lmysteries, new paths will open to you.\lStrive for the goal together with your\lwonderful POKéMON!$

label: Help_Text_DescWirelessAdapter
en:
This game communicates over a wireless
link using the Wireless Adapter.\pGo wireless anywhere, anytime, and
with anybody!\pTry playing with the Wireless Adapter
always attached!$

label: Help_Text_DescGameFundamentals1

label: gOakSpeech_Text_WelcomeToTheWorld
en: Hello, there!\nGlad to meet you!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is OAK.\pPeople affectionately refer to me\nas the POKéMON PROFESSOR.\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_IsInhabitedFarAndWide
en: …is inhabited far and wide by\ncreatures called POKéMON.\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_IStudyPokemon
en: For some people, POKéMON are pets.\nOthers use them for battling.\pAs for myself…\pI study POKéMON as a profession.\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_TellMeALittleAboutYourself
en: But first, tell me a little about\nyourself.\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_YourNameWhatIsIt
en: Let's begin with your name.\nWhat is it?\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_WhatWasHisName
en: This is my grandson.\pHe's been your rival since you both\nwere babies.\p…Erm, what was his name now?$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_YourRivalsNameWhatWasIt
en: Your rival's name, what was it now?$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_RememberRivalsName
en: That's right! I remember now!\nHis name is {RIVAL}!\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_LetsGo
en: {PLAYER}!\pYour very own POKéMON legend is\nabout to unfold!\pA world of dreams and adventures\nwith POKéMON awaits! Let's go!$

label: Text_PutCoinsAwayInCoinCase
en: {PLAYER} put the COINS away in\nthe COIN CASE.$

label: Text_CoinCaseIsFull
en: Too bad!\nThe COIN CASE is full…$

label: Text_NothingToPutThemIn
en: Too bad!\nThere's nothing to put them in…$

label: Text_NoRoomForAnotherDecor
en: Too bad! There's no room left for\nanother {STR_VAR_2}…$

label: Text_MonSentToBoxInSomeonesPC
en: {STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nSomeone's PC.\pIt was placed in \nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: Text_MonSentToBoxInBillsPC
en: {STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nBILL'S PC.\pIt was placed in \nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: Text_MonSentToBoxSomeonesBoxFull
en: BOX “{STR_VAR_3}” on\nSomeone's PC was full.\p{STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: Text_MonSentToBoxBillsBoxFull
en: BOX “{STR_VAR_3}” on\nBILL'S PC was full.\p{STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: Text_MonSentToBoxInPC
en: ポケモンを　もちきれないので\nパソコンの　ボックス“{STR_VAR_1}”　に\l{STR_VAR_2}を　てんそうした！$

label: Text_NoMoreRoomForPokemon
en: There's no more room for POKéMON!\pThe POKéMON BOXES are full and\ncan't accept any more!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_HowIsPokedexComingAlong
en: OAK: Good to see you!\nHow is your POKéDEX coming along?\pHere, let me take a look.$

label: PokedexRating_Text_SeenXOwnedY
en: The amount of progress you've made\non your POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.\p{FONT_NORMAL}PROF. OAK's rating:$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan10
en: You still have lots to do.\pGo into every patch of grass you\nsee and look for POKéMON!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan20
en: It looks as if you're getting on\nthe right track!\pI've given one of my AIDES a FLASH\nHM. Make sure you go get it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan30
en: Your POKéDEX could use a bit more\nvolume still!\pTry to catch other species of\nPOKéMON!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan40
en: Good, it's apparent that you're\ntrying hard!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan50
en: Your POKéDEX is coming along quite\nwell!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nAMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan60
en: Ah, you've finally topped 50\nspecies!\pI've given one of my AIDES an EXP.\nSHARE. Be sure to go get it!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan70
en: Hoho! This is turning into quite the\nrespectable POKéDEX!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan80
en: Very good!\pI think you'll collect even more\nPOKéMON by going fishing!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan90
en: Wonderful! Let me guess… You\nlike to collect things, don't you?$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan100
en: I'm impressed!\nIt must have been difficult to do!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan110
en: You've finally hit 100 species!\nI can't believe how good you are!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan120
en: You even have the evolved forms\nof POKéMON! Super!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan130
en: Excellent! Trade with friends to\nget some more!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan140
en: Outstanding!\nYou've become a real pro at this!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan150
en: I have nothing left to say!\nYou're the POKéMON PROFESSOR now!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_NationalDexSeenXOwnedY
en: And your NATIONAL POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LookForwardToFilledNationalDex
en: I'll be looking forward to seeing\nyou fill the NATIONAL POKéDEX!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_YouveCompletedDex
en: Finally…\pYou've finally completed the\nPOKéDEX!\pIt's magnificent!\nTruly, this is a fantastic feat!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_ThankYouMadeDreamReality
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nSincerely, thank you!\lYou've made my dream a reality!$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LoveSeeingYourPokedex
en: OAK: Ah, welcome!\pTell me, how is your POKéDEX\ncoming along?\pWahaha!\pActually, I know how it is, but I\nlove seeing it anyway!\pLet's see…$

label: Pokedude_Text_SpeedierBattlerGoesFirst
en: POKé DUDE: The speedier of the\nbattlers gets to attack first.$

label: Pokedude_Text_MyRattataFasterThanPidgey
en: It looks like my RATTATA was\nfaster than the PIDGEY.$

label: Pokedude_Text_BattlersTakeTurnsAttacking
en: The battlers take turns attacking\nand reducing each other's HP.$

label: Pokedude_Text_MyRattataWonGetsEXP
en:
My RATTATA reduced the foe's HP
to zero, so it wins!\pThe POKéMON that took part in the
battle get EXP. Points.\pWhen a POKéMON collects enough
EXP. Points, it levels up.\pLeveling up makes your POKéMON
stronger than before.$

label: Pokedude_Text_UhOhRattataPoisoned
en: POKé DUDE: Uh-oh…\nMy RATTATA has been poisoned…\pIf a POKéMON is poisoned, it loses\nHP steadily.$

label: Pokedude_Text_HealStatusRightAway
en: If a POKéMON develops a status\nproblem, heal it right away.$

label: Pokedude_Text_UsingItemTakesTurn
en: Using an item on a POKéMON uses\nup one turn, though.\pNow, it's the opponent's turn!$

label: Pokedude_Text_WaterNotVeryEffectiveAgainstGrass
en:
POKé DUDE: The move BUBBLE is
a WATER-type attack.\pThe targeted ODDISH is a
GRASS/POISON-type POKéMON.\pThe WATER-type attack is absorbed
by the GRASS-type POKéMON…\pAs a result, the move becomes not
very effective, and inflicts only\lhalf the usual damage.$

label: Pokedude_Text_GrassEffectiveAgainstWater
en: Uh-oh, this is not good!\pThe ABSORB attack you just saw\nis a GRASS-type move.\pPOLIWAG is a WATER-type POKéMON.\pSo, ABSORB becomes super\neffective, doubling the damage.$

label: Pokedude_Text_LetsTryShiftingMons
en: It's not going to be easy to win\nwith this matchup…\pLet's try shifting POKéMON!$

label: Pokedude_Text_ShiftingUsesTurn
en: Shifting POKéMON in and out uses\nup one turn.\pNow, it's the opponent's turn.$

label: Pokedude_Text_ButterfreeDoubleResistsGrass
en:
BUTTERFREE is a BUG/FLYING-type
POKéMON.\pAgainst this POKéMON, a GRASS-
type attack…\p…inflicts only half the usual
damage on a BUG-type POKéMON…\p…And, it also causes only half the
damage on a FLYING-type POKéMON.\pTherefore, BUTTERFREE, being a
BUG/FLYING POKéMON, only takes\lone quarter of the usual damage.$

label: Pokedude_Text_ButterfreeGoodAgainstOddish
en:
ODDISH is a GRASS/POISON-type
POKéMON.\pA FLYING- or PSYCHIC-type attack
is super effective against it.\pOne of those types of attacks will
inflict double the usual damage.\pOkay, here we go!$

label: Pokedude_Text_WeakenMonBeforeCatching
en: POKé DUDE: When you're trying to\ncatch a POKéMON, don't throw any\lPOKé BALLS right away.\pFirst, you need to weaken it by\nreducing its HP.$

label: Pokedude_Text_BestIfTargetStatused
en: Okay, that should be good enough.\pBut, if it's possible, it would be\nbest if the target has a status\lproblem.\pFor instance, it would be easier\nto catch if it were asleep or\lparalyzed.$

label: Pokedude_Text_CantDoubleUpOnStatus
en:
This will make the POKéMON a lot
easier to catch!\pOh, yes. If you paralyze a
POKéMON, you can't make it fall\lasleep on top of paralysis.\pIn other words, you can't double
up status problems, okay?$

label: Pokedude_Text_LetMeThrowBall
en: Okay!\nLet me throw my POKé BALL!$

label: Pokedude_Text_PickBestKindOfBall
en: Before you throw a POKé BALL,\nconsider the condition and the\ltype of POKéMON, and pick the kind\lof BALL that would work best.$

label: Text_FillOutQuestionnaire
en: There is a questionnaire.\nWould you like to fill it out?$

label: Text_QuestionnaireThankYou
en: Thank you for taking the time to\nfill out our questionnaire.\pYour feedback will be used for\nfuture reference.$

Oh, hello!
You know those words?\pThat means you must know about
the MYSTERY GIFT.\pFrom now on, you should be
receiving MYSTERY GIFTS!$

あ！　おきゃくさん
ポロックケースを　おもちで　ないですね？\pサファリゾーンは　ポロックを　つかうと
より　おたのしみ　いただけますので\pぜひ　ポロックケースを

en: この　さきに　いきたい　けど\nじてんしゃ　もって　くるの　わすれた‥‥\pおくに　めずらしい　ポケモンが\nいそうな　きが　するのに！$

en: ここで　めずらしい　ポケモンを\nたくさん　つかまえて\lともだちと　こうかん　するんだ！$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
en: ポロックおきばに　おいた　ポロックが\nいつのまにか　なくなっていた‥‥\pしらない　うちに\nポケモンが　たべちゃったのかな？$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
en: サファリゾーンの　おとくな　じょうほう！\pであった　ポケモンに\nポロックを　なげると　にげにくく　なります！$

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_RestHouseSign
en: あるき　つかれたら　ちょっと　ひといき！\n‘みんなの　きゅうけいじょ'$

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
en: おれ　ポロック　もってないけど\nポケモン　たくさん　つかまえたよ\pちかづいて　ボールを　なげる　だけで\nけっこう　つかまえられる　もんだよ！$

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
en: ポロックを　つかうと　いつもより\nちょっぴり　にげにくく　なるみたい\pだから　にげにくい　ポケモンに　つかっても\nあんまり　いみが　ないかもね$

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
en: ポロックおきばに　ポロック　おいて\nポケモンを　つかまえると\pおなじ　ような　せいかくの　ポケモンが\nあつまる　きが　するなあ$

Your POKéMON have been healed
to perfect health.\pIf your POKéMON's energy, HP,

field, you should buy some POTIONS\lat the POKéMON MART.\pWe hope you excel!$

label: Text_MomExplainHPGetPotions
en:
MOM: Oh, good! You and your
POKéMON are looking great.\pI just heard from PROF. OAK.\pHe said that POKéMON's energy is
measured in HP.\pIf your POKéMON lose their HP,
you can restore them at any\lPOKéMON CENTER.\pIf you're going to travel far away,
the smart TRAINER stocks up on\lPOTIONS at the POKéMON MART.\pMake me proud, honey!\pTake care!$

label: gText_ForPetesSake

OAK: Oh, for Pete's sake…
So pushy, as always.\p{B_PLAYER_NAME}.\pYou've never had a POKéMON battle
before, have you?\pA POKéMON battle is when TRAINERS
pit their POKéMON against each\lother.\p$

label: gText_TheTrainerThat

label: gText_TryBattling
en: But rather than talking about it,\nyou'll learn more from experience.\pTry battling and see for yourself.\p$

label: gText_WinEarnsPrizeMoney

label: gText_HowDissapointing
en:
OAK: Hm…
How disappointing…\pIf you win, you earn prize money,
and your POKéMON grow.\pBut if you lose, {B_PLAYER_NAME}, you end
up paying prize money…\pHowever, since you had no warning
this time, I'll pay for you.\pBut things won't be this way once
you step outside these doors.\pThat's why you must strengthen your
POKéMON by battling wild POKéMON.\p$

label: gMoveDescription_Pound

long tail or a
foreleg, etc.$

critical-hit ratio.$

five times.$

The foe is hit with

five times.$

The foe is slugged

power.$

The foe is punched

label: gMoveDescription_Nightmare
en:
A sleeping foe is
shown a nightmare
that inflicts some
damage every turn.$

label: gMoveDescription_FlameWheel
en:
The user makes a
fiery charge at the
foe. It may cause
a burn.$

label: gMoveDescription_Snore
en:
An attack that can
be used only while
asleep. It may
cause flinching.$

label: gMoveDescription_Curse
en:
A move that works
differently for the
GHOST-type and all
the other types.$

label: gMoveDescription_Flail
en:
A desperate attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has.$

label: gMoveDescription_Conversion2
en:
The user changes
type to make itself
resistant to the
last attack it took.$

label: gMoveDescription_Aeroblast
en:
A vortex of air is
shot at the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.$

label: gMoveDescription_CottonSpore
en:
Cotton-like spores
cling to the foe,
sharply reducing
its SPEED stat.$

label: gMoveDescription_Reversal
en:
An all-out attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has.$

label: gMoveDescription_Spite
en:
A move that cuts
2 to 5 PP from the
move last used by
the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_PowderSnow
en:
Blasts the foe with
a snowy gust.
It may cause
freezing.$

label: gMoveDescription_Protect
en:
Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession.$

label: gMoveDescription_MachPunch
en:
A punch thrown at
blinding speed.
It is certain to
strike first.$

label: gMoveDescription_ScaryFace
en:
Frightens the foe
with a scary face
to sharply reduce
its SPEED.$

label: gMoveDescription_FaintAttack
en:
The user draws up
close to the foe
disarmingly, then
hits without fail.$

label: gMoveDescription_SweetKiss
en:
The user kisses
the foe with sweet
cuteness that
causes confusion.$

label: gMoveDescription_BellyDrum
en:
The user maximizes
its ATTACK stat at
the cost of half
its full HP.$

label: gMoveDescription_SludgeBomb
en:
Filthy sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may poison the
target.$

label: gMoveDescription_MudSlap
en:
Mud is hurled in
the foe's face to
inflict damage and
lower its accuracy.$

label: gMoveDescription_Octazooka
en:
Ink is blasted in
the foe's face or
eyes to damage and
lower accuracy.$

label: gMoveDescription_Spikes
en:
A trap of spikes is
laid around the
foe's party to hurt
foes switching in.$

label: gMoveDescription_ZapCannon
en:
An electric blast is
fired like a cannon
to inflict damage
and paralyze.$

label: gMoveDescription_Foresight
en:
Completely negates
the foe's efforts to
heighten its ability
to evade.$

label: gMoveDescription_DestinyBond
en:
If the user faints,
the foe delivering
the final hit also
faints.$

label: gMoveDescription_PerishSong
en:
Any battler that
hears this faints
in three turns
unless it switches.$

label: gMoveDescription_IcyWind
en:
A chilling wind is
used to attack.
It also lowers the
SPEED stat.$

label: gMoveDescription_Detect
en:
Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession.$

label: gMoveDescription_BoneRush
en:
The user strikes
the foe with a bone
in hand two to five
times.$

label: gMoveDescription_LockOn
en:
The user locks on
to the foe, making
the next move sure
to hit.$

label: gMoveDescription_Outrage
en:
The user thrashes
about for two to
three turns, then
becomes confused.$

label: gMoveDescription_Sandstorm
en:
A 5-turn sandstorm
that damages all
types except ROCK,
GROUND, and STEEL.$

label: gMoveDescription_GigaDrain
en:
A harsh attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP.$

label: gMoveDescription_Endure
en:
The user endures
any hit with 1 HP
left. It may fail if
used in succession.$

label: gMoveDescription_Charm
en:
The foe is charmed
by the user's cute
appeals, sharply
cutting its ATTACK.$

label: gMoveDescription_Rollout
en:
A 5-turn rolling
attack that becomes
stronger each time
it hits.$

label: gMoveDescription_FalseSwipe
en:
A restrained attack
that always leaves
the foe with at
least 1 HP.$

label: gMoveDescription_Swagger
en:
A move that makes
the foe confused,
but also sharply
raises its ATTACK.$

label: gMoveDescription_MilkDrink
en:
Heals the user by
up to half its full
HP. It can be used
to heal an ally.$

label: gMoveDescription_Spark
en:
An electrically
charged tackle that
may also paralyze
the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_FuryCutter
en:
An attack that
grows stronger on
each successive
hit.$

label: gMoveDescription_SteelWing
en:
The foe is hit with
wings of steel.
It may also raise
the user's DEFENSE.$

label: gMoveDescription_MeanLook
en:
The foe is fixed
with a mean look
that prevents it
from escaping.$

label: gMoveDescription_Attract
en:
If it is the other
gender, the foe is
made infatuated and
unlikely to attack.$

label: gMoveDescription_SleepTalk
en:
While asleep, the
user randomly uses
one of the moves it
knows.$

label: gMoveDescription_HealBell
en:
A soothing bell
chimes to heal the
status problems of
all allies.$

label: gMoveDescription_Return
en:
This attack move
grows more powerful
the more the user
likes its TRAINER.$

label: gMoveDescription_Present
en:
The foe is given a
booby-trapped gift.
It restores HP
sometimes, however.$

label: gMoveDescription_Frustration
en:
This attack move
grows more powerful
the less the user
likes its TRAINER.$

label: gMoveDescription_Safeguard
en:
It protects the
user's party from
all status problems
for five turns.$

label: gMoveDescription_PainSplit
en:
The user adds its
HP to the foe's HP,
then equally shares
the total HP.$

label: gMoveDescription_SacredFire
en:
A mystical and
powerful fire
attack that may
inflict a burn.$

label: gMoveDescription_Magnitude
en:
A ground-shaking
attack against all
standing POKéMON.
Its power varies.$

label: gMoveDescription_DynamicPunch
en:
The foe is punched
with the user's full
power. It confuses
the foe if it hits.$

label: gMoveDescription_Megahorn
en:
A brutal ramming
attack delivered
with a tough and
impressive horn.$

label: gMoveDescription_DragonBreath
en:
The foe is hit with
an incredible blast
of breath that may
also paralyze.$

label: gMoveDescription_BatonPass
en:
The user switches
out, passing along
any stat changes
to the new battler.$

label: gMoveDescription_Encore
en:
Makes the foe use
the move it last
used repeatedly for
two to six turns.$

label: gMoveDescription_Pursuit
en:
An attack move that
works especially
well on a foe that
is switching out.$

label: gMoveDescription_RapidSpin
en:
An attack that
frees the user from
BIND, WRAP, LEECH
SEED, and SPIKES.$

label: gMoveDescription_SweetScent
en:
Allures the foe to
reduce evasiveness.
It also attracts
wild POKéMON.$

label: gMoveDescription_IronTail
en:
An attack with a
steel-hard tail.
It may lower the
foe's DEFENSE stat.$

label: gMoveDescription_MetalClaw
en:
The foe is attacked
with steel claws.
It may also raise
the user's ATTACK.$

label: gMoveDescription_VitalThrow
en:
Makes the user
attack after the
foe. In return,
it will not miss.$

label: gMoveDescription_MorningSun
en:
Restores the user's
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather.$

label: gMoveDescription_Synthesis
en:
Restores the user's
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather.$

label: gMoveDescription_Moonlight
en:
Restores the user's
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather.$

label: gMoveDescription_HiddenPower
en:
An attack that
varies in type and
intensity depending
on the user.$

label: gMoveDescription_CrossChop
en:
The foe is hit with
double chops.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.$

label: gMoveDescription_Twister
en:
A vicious twister
attacks the foe.
It may make the
foe flinch.$

label: gMoveDescription_RainDance
en:
A heavy rain falls
for five turns,
powering up WATER-
type moves.$

label: gMoveDescription_SunnyDay
en:
The sun blazes for
five turns, powering
up FIRE-type
moves.$

label: gMoveDescription_Crunch
en:
The foe is crunched
with sharp fangs.
It may lower the
foe's SP. DEF.$

label: gMoveDescription_MirrorCoat
en:
A retaliation move
that pays back the
foe's special attack
double.$

label: gMoveDescription_PsychUp
en:
The user hypnotizes
itself into copying
any stat change
made by the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_ExtremeSpeed
en:
A blindingly speedy
charge attack that
always goes before
any other.$

label: gMoveDescription_AncientPower
en:
An ancient power is
used to attack. It
may also raise all
the user's stats.$

label: gMoveDescription_ShadowBall
en:
A shadowy blob is
hurled at the foe.
May also lower the
foe's SP. DEF.$

label: gMoveDescription_FutureSight
en:
Two turns after
this move is used,
the foe is attacked
psychically.$

label: gMoveDescription_RockSmash
en:
An attack that may
also cut DEFENSE.
It can also smash
cracked boulders.$

label: gMoveDescription_Whirlpool
en:
The foe is trapped
in a fast, vicious
whirlpool for two
to five turns.$

label: gMoveDescription_BeatUp
en:
All party POKéMON
join in the attack.
The more allies,
the more damage.$

label: gMoveDescription_FakeOut
en:
An attack that hits
first and causes
flinching. Usable
only on 1st turn.$

label: gMoveDescription_Uproar
en:
The user attacks in
an uproar that
prevents sleep for
two to five turns.$

label: gMoveDescription_Stockpile
en:
The user charges
up power for use
later. It can be
used three times.$

label: gMoveDescription_SpitUp
en:
The power built
using STOCKPILE is
released at once
for attack.$

label: gMoveDescription_Swallow
en:
The energy it built
using STOCKPILE is
absorbed to restore
HP.$

label: gMoveDescription_HeatWave
en:
The user exhales a
heated breath to
attack. It may also
inflict a burn.$

label: gMoveDescription_Hail
en:
A hailstorm lasting
five turns damages
all POKéMON except
the ICE-type.$

label: gMoveDescription_Torment
en:
It enrages the foe,
making it incapable
of using the same
move successively.$

label: gMoveDescription_Flatter
en:
Flattery is used to
confuse the foe,
but its SP. ATK
also rises.$

label: gMoveDescription_WillOWisp
en:
A sinister, bluish
white flame is shot
at the foe to
inflict a burn.$

label: gMoveDescription_Memento
en:
The user faints,
but sharply lowers
the foe's ATTACK
and SP. ATK.$

label: gMoveDescription_Facade
en:
An attack that is
boosted if user is
burned, poisoned,
or paralyzed.$

label: gMoveDescription_FocusPunch
en:
An attack that is
executed last.
The user flinches
if hit beforehand.$

label: gMoveDescription_SmellingSalt
en:
Doubly effective on
a paralyzed foe,
but it also cures
the foe's paralysis.$

label: gMoveDescription_FollowMe
en:
The user draws
attention to itself,
making foes attack
only the user.$

label: gMoveDescription_NaturePower
en:
An attack that
changes type
depending on the
user's location.$

label: gMoveDescription_Charge
en:
The user charges
power to boost the
ELECTRIC move it
uses next.$

label: gMoveDescription_Taunt
en:
The foe is taunted
into a rage that
allows it to use
only attack moves.$

label: gMoveDescription_HelpingHand
en:
A move that boosts
the power of the
ally's attack in a
battle.$

label: gMoveDescription_Trick
en:
A move that tricks
the foe into
trading held items
with the user.$

label: gMoveDescription_RolePlay
en:
The user mimics the
foe completely and
copies the foe's
ability.$

label: gMoveDescription_Wish
en:
A self-healing move
that restores half
the full HP on the
next turn.$

label: gMoveDescription_Assist
en:
The user randomly
picks and uses a
move of an allied
POKéMON.$

label: gMoveDescription_Ingrain
en:
The user lays roots
that restore HP on
every turn.
It can't switch out.$

label: gMoveDescription_Superpower
en:
A powerful attack,
but it also lowers
the user's ATTACK
and DEFENSE stats.$

label: gMoveDescription_MagicCoat
en:
Reflects back the
foe's LEECH SEED
and any status-
damaging move.$

label: gMoveDescription_Recycle
en:
A move that
recycles a used
item for use once
more.$

label: gMoveDescription_Revenge
en:
An attack move that
gains in intensity if
the target has hurt
the user.$

label: gMoveDescription_BrickBreak
en:
An attack that also
breaks any barrier
like LIGHT SCREEN
and REFLECT.$

label: gMoveDescription_Yawn
en:
A huge yawn lulls
the foe into falling
asleep on the next
turn.$

label: gMoveDescription_KnockOff
en:
Knocks down the
foe's held item to
prevent its use
during the battle.$

label: gMoveDescription_Endeavor
en:
Gains power the
fewer HP the user
has compared with
the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_Eruption
en:
The higher the
user's HP, the more
powerful this
attack becomes.$

label: gMoveDescription_SkillSwap
en:
The user employs
its psychic power
to swap abilities
with the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_Imprison
en:
Prevents foes from
using any move
that is also known
by the user.$

label: gMoveDescription_Refresh
en:
A self-healing move
that cures the user
of a poisoning,
burn, or paralysis.$

label: gMoveDescription_Grudge
en:
If the user faints,
this move deletes
the PP of the move
that finished it.$

label: gMoveDescription_Snatch
en:
Steals the effects
of the foe's
healing or status-
changing move.$

label: gMoveDescription_SecretPower
en:
An attack that may
have an additional
effect that varies
with the terrain.$

label: gMoveDescription_Dive
en:
The user dives
underwater on the
first turn and
strikes next turn.$

label: gMoveDescription_ArmThrust
en:
A quick flurry of
straight-arm
punches that hit
two to five times.$

label: gMoveDescription_Camouflage
en:
Alters the user's
type depending on
the location's
terrain.$

label: gMoveDescription_TailGlow
en:
The user flashes a
light that sharply
raises its SP. ATK
stat.$

label: gMoveDescription_LusterPurge
en:
A burst of light
injures the foe. It
may also lower the
foe's SP. DEF.$

label: gMoveDescription_MistBall
en:
A flurry of down
hits the foe. It
may also lower the
foe's SP. ATK.$

label: gMoveDescription_FeatherDance
en:
The foe is covered
with a mass of down
that sharply cuts
the ATTACK stat.$

label: gMoveDescription_TeeterDance
en:
A wobbly dance
that confuses all
the POKéMON in
battle.$

label: gMoveDescription_BlazeKick
en:
A fiery kick with a
high critical-hit
ratio. It may also
burn the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_MudSport
en:
Weakens ELECTRIC-
type attacks while
the user is in the
battle.$

label: gMoveDescription_IceBall
en:
A 5-turn rolling
attack that becomes
stronger each time
it rolls.$

label: gMoveDescription_NeedleArm
en:
An attack using
thorny arms.
It may make the
foe flinch.$

label: gMoveDescription_SlackOff
en:
The user slacks off
and restores its HP
by half its full
HP.$

label: gMoveDescription_HyperVoice
en:
The user lets loose
a horribly loud
shout with the
power to damage.$

label: gMoveDescription_PoisonFang
en:
The foe is bitten
with toxic fangs.
It may also badly
poison the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_CrushClaw
en:
The foe is attacked
with sharp claws.
It may also lower
the foe's DEFENSE.$

label: gMoveDescription_BlastBurn
en:
The foe is hit with
a huge explosion.
The user can't move
on the next turn.$

label: gMoveDescription_HydroCannon
en:
The foe is hit with
a watery cannon.
The user can't move
on the next turn.$

label: gMoveDescription_MeteorMash
en:
The foe is hit with
a hard, fast punch.
It may also raise
the user's ATTACK.$

label: gMoveDescription_Astonish
en:
An attack using a
startling shout.
It also may make
the foe flinch.$

label: gMoveDescription_WeatherBall
en:
An attack that
varies in power and
type depending on
the weather.$

label: gMoveDescription_Aromatherapy
en:
A soothing scent is
released to heal
all status problems
in the user's party.$

label: gMoveDescription_FakeTears
en:
The user feigns
crying to sharply
lower the foe's
SP. DEF stat.$

label: gMoveDescription_AirCutter
en:
The foe is hit with
razor-like wind.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.$

label: gMoveDescription_Overheat
en:
An intense attack
that also sharply
reduces the user's
SP. ATK stat.$

label: gMoveDescription_OdorSleuth
en:
Completely negates
the foe's efforts to
heighten its ability
to evade.$

label: gMoveDescription_RockTomb
en:
Boulders are hurled
at the foe. It also
lowers the foe's
SPEED if it hits.$

label: gMoveDescription_SilverWind
en:
The foe is attacked
with a silver dust.
It may raise all
the user's stats.$

label: gMoveDescription_MetalSound
en:
A horrible metallic
screech is used to
sharply lower the
foe's SP. DEF.$

label: gMoveDescription_GrassWhistle
en:
A pleasant melody
is played to lull
the foe into a deep
sleep.$

label: gMoveDescription_Tickle
en:
The foe is made to
laugh, reducing its
ATTACK and DEFENSE
stats.$

label: gMoveDescription_CosmicPower
en:
The user absorbs a
mystic power to
raise its DEFENSE
and SP. DEF.$

label: gMoveDescription_WaterSpout
en:
The higher the
user's HP, the more
powerful this
attack becomes.$

label: gMoveDescription_SignalBeam
en:
The foe is hit with
a flashing beam
that may also
cause confusion.$

label: gMoveDescription_ShadowPunch
en:
The user throws a
punch from the
shadows. It cannot
be evaded.$

label: gMoveDescription_Extrasensory
en:
The user attacks
with an odd power
that may make the
foe flinch.$

label: gMoveDescription_SkyUppercut
en:
The user attacks
with an uppercut
thrown skywards
with force.$

label: gMoveDescription_SandTomb
en:
The foe is trapped
inside a painful
sandstorm for two
to five turns.$

label: gMoveDescription_SheerCold
en:
The foe is attacked
with ultimate cold
that causes fainting
if it hits.$

label: gMoveDescription_MuddyWater
en:
The user attacks
with muddy water.
It may also lower
the foe's accuracy.$

label: gMoveDescription_BulletSeed
en:
The user shoots
seeds at the foe.
Two to five seeds
are shot at once.$

label: gMoveDescription_AerialAce
en:
An extremely fast
attack against one
target. It can't be
evaded.$

label: gMoveDescription_IcicleSpear
en:
Sharp icicles are
fired at the foe.
It strikes two to
five times.$

label: gMoveDescription_IronDefense
en:
The user hardens
its body's surface
to sharply raise its
DEFENSE stat.$

label: gMoveDescription_Block
en:
The user blocks the
foe's way with arms
spread wide to
prevent escape.$

label: gMoveDescription_Howl
en:
The user howls to
raise its spirit and
boost its ATTACK
stat.$

label: gMoveDescription_DragonClaw
en:
Sharp, huge claws
hook and slash the
foe quickly and
with great power.$

label: gMoveDescription_FrenzyPlant
en:
The foe is hit with
an enormous branch.
The user can't move
on the next turn.$

label: gMoveDescription_BulkUp
en:
The user bulks up
its body to boost
both its ATTACK and
DEFENSE stats.$

label: gMoveDescription_Bounce
en:
The user bounces
on the foe on the
2nd turn. It may
paralyze the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_MudShot
en:
The user attacks by
hurling mud.
It also reduces the
foe's SPEED.$

label: gMoveDescription_PoisonTail
en:
An attack with a
high critical-hit
ratio. It may also
poison the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_Covet
en:
A cutely executed
attack that also
steals the foe's
hold item.$

label: gMoveDescription_VoltTackle
en:
The user throws an
electrified tackle.
It hurts the user
a little.$

label: gMoveDescription_MagicalLeaf
en:
The foe is attacked
with a strange leaf
that cannot be
evaded.$

label: gMoveDescription_WaterSport
en:
Weakens FIRE-type
attacks while the
user is in the
battle.$

label: gMoveDescription_CalmMind
en:
The user focuses
its mind to raise
the SP. ATK and
SP. DEF stats.$

label: gMoveDescription_LeafBlade
en:
The foe is slashed
with a sharp leaf.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.$

label: gMoveDescription_DragonDance
en:
A mystic, powerful
dance that boosts
the user's ATTACK
and SPEED stats.$

label: gMoveDescription_RockBlast
en:
The user hurls two
to five hard rocks
at the foe to
attack.$

label: gMoveDescription_ShockWave
en:
A rapid jolt of
electricity strikes
the foe. It can't
be evaded.$

label: gMoveDescription_WaterPulse
en:
An attack with a
pulsing blast of
water. It may also
confuse the foe.$

label: gMoveDescription_DoomDesire
en:
A move that attacks
the foe with a
blast of light two
turns after use.$

label: gMoveDescription_PsychoBoost
en:
An intense attack
that also sharply
reduces the user's
SP. ATK stat.$
