label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_ViridianForest
en:
A deep and sprawling forest that
extends around VIRIDIAN CITY.
A natural maze, many people
become lost inside.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_MtMoon
en:
A mystical mountain that is known
for its frequent meteor falls.
The shards of stars that fall
here are known as MOON STONES.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_DiglettsCave
en:
A seemingly plain tunnel that was
dug by wild DIGLETT.
It is famous for connecting
ROUTES 2 and 11.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_VictoryRoad
en:
A tunnel situated on ROUTE 23.
It earned its name because it
must be traveled by all TRAINERS
aiming for the top.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_PokemonMansion
en:
A decrepit, burned-down mansion
on CINNABAR ISLAND.
It got its name because a famous
POKéMON researcher lived there.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_SafariZone
en:
An amusement park outside FUCHSIA
CITY where many rare POKéMON can
be observed in the wild.
Catch them in a popular game!$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_RockTunnel
en:
A naturally formed underground
tunnel. Because it has not been
developed, it is inky dark inside.
A light is needed to get through.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_SeafoamIslands
en:
A pair of islands that is situated
on ROUTE 20.
The two islands are shaped the
same, as if they were twins.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_PokemonTower
en:
A tower that houses the graves of
countless POKéMON.
Many people visit it daily to pay
their respects to the fallen.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_CeruleanCave
en:
A mysterious cave that is filled
with terribly tough POKéMON.
It is so dangerous, the POKéMON
LEAGUE is in charge of it.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_PowerPlant
en:
A power plant that was abandoned
years ago, though some of the
machines still work. It is infested
with electric POKéMON.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_MtEmber
en:
Supposedly an inactive volcano.
However, there are persistent
reports that the peak blazes
with fire at night.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_BerryForest
en:
A forest on a small islet off the
coast of THREE ISLAND. BERRIES
grow wildly in profusion, quickly
replenishing those that fall off.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_IcefallCave
en:
A cave which is covered by water
and ice on FOUR ISLAND.
It seems like the end of the cave
is connected to the ocean.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_LostCave
en:
A bewildering cave off the coast
of RESORT GORGEOUS.
Some curious thrill seekers have
never emerged from it.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_TanobyRuins
en:
An ancient ruin that is rumored to
be home to a peculiar POKéMON.
However, so far, the POKéMON
remains an unconfirmed rumor.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_AlteringCave
en:
This island has been known by this
name since the distant past.
No one today knows where it got
this name, however.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_PatternBush
en:
A lush and bush-like area. 
In it are patterns where no grass
grows. Some study it in the belief
that a secret is concealed.$

label: gText_RegionMap_AreaDesc_DottedHole
en:
A mysterious, just-discovered
ruin from an ancient time.
It got its name from the six dots
on its door.$

label: gDummyPokedexText
en: This is a newly discovered POKéMON. It is\ncurrently under investigation. No detailed\ninformation is available at this time.$

label: gBulbasaurPokedexText
en: There is a plant seed on its back right\nfrom the day this POKéMON is born.\nThe seed slowly grows larger.$

label: gIvysaurPokedexText
en: There is a plant bulb on its back.\nWhen it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said\nto blossom into a large flower.$

label: gVenusaurPokedexText
en: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower.\nThe fragrance becalms those engaged in\na battle.$

label: gCharmanderPokedexText
en: From the time it is born, a flame burns\nat the tip of its tail. Its life would end\nif the flame were to go out.$

label: gCharmeleonPokedexText
en: It lashes about with its tail to knock\ndown its foe. It then tears up the fallen\nopponent with sharp claws.$

label: gCharizardPokedexText
en: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to\nan altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out\nfire at very high temperatures.$

label: gSquirtlePokedexText
en: When it retracts its long neck into its\nshell, it squirts out water with vigorous\nforce.$

label: gWartortlePokedexText
en: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet.\nIts fur-covered tail is a symbol of its\nlongevity.$

label: gBlastoisePokedexText
en: It crushes its foe under its heavy body\nto cause fainting. In a pinch, it will\nwithdraw inside its shell.$

label: gCaterpiePokedexText
en: It is covered with a green skin. When it\ngrows, it sheds the skin, covers itself\nwith silk, and becomes a cocoon.$

label: gMetapodPokedexText
en: Even though it is encased in a sturdy\nshell, the body inside is tender.\nIt can't withstand a harsh attack.$

label: gButterfreePokedexText
en: The wings are protected by rain-repellent\ndust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly\nabout even in rain.$

label: gWeedlePokedexText
en: Often found in forests and grasslands.\nIt has a sharp, toxic barb of around two\ninches on top of its head.$

label: gKakunaPokedexText
en: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage\nwhile making its body. It is almost\ncompletely unable to move on its own.$

label: gBeedrillPokedexText
en: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent\nspeeds, all the while stabbing with the\ntoxic stinger on its rear.$

label: gPidgeyPokedexText
en: Does not like to fight. It hides in\ntall grass and so on, foraging for food\nsuch as small bugs.$

label: gPidgeottoPokedexText
en: The claws on its feet are well developed.\nIt can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE\nto its nest over 60 miles away.$

label: gPidgeotPokedexText
en: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to\nintimidate enemies. It races through the\nskies at Mach-2 speed.$

label: gRattataPokedexText
en: Its fangs are long and very sharp.\nThey grow continuously, so it gnaws on\nhard things to whittle them down.$

label: gRaticatePokedexText
en: Its rear feet have three toes each.\nThey are webbed, enabling it to swim\nacross rivers.$

label: gSpearowPokedexText
en: It busily flits around here and there.\nEven if it is frail, it can be a tough\nfoe that uses MIRROR MOVE.$

label: gFearowPokedexText
en: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it\naloft in the sky. It can remain flying a\nwhole day without landing.$

label: gEkansPokedexText
en: A very common sight in grassland, etc.\nIt flicks its tongue in and out to sense\ndanger in its surroundings.$

label: gArbokPokedexText
en: The pattern on its belly appears to be a\nfrightening face. Weak foes will flee just\nat the sight of the pattern.$

label: gPikachuPokedexText
en: It has small electric sacs on both its\ncheeks. If threatened, it looses electric\ncharges from the sacs.$

label: gRaichuPokedexText
en: Its electric charges can reach even\n100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause\neven an Indian elephant to faint.$

label: gSandshrewPokedexText
en: It burrows and lives underground.\nIf threatened, it curls itself up into a\nball for protection.$

label: gSandslashPokedexText
en: It is adept at attacking with the spines\non its back and its sharp claws while\nquickly scurrying about.$

label: gNidoranFPokedexText
en: Though small, it must be treated with\ncaution because of its powerfully toxic\nbarbs. The female has smaller horns.$

label: gNidorinaPokedexText
en: The female has a gentle temperament.\nIt emits ultrasonic cries that have the\npower to befuddle foes.$

label: gNidoqueenPokedexText
en: The body is covered by stiff, needle-\nlike scales. If it becomes excited,\nthe needles bristle outwards.$

label: gNidoranMPokedexText
en: Its large ears are flapped like wings\nwhen it is listening to distant sounds.\nIt extends toxic barbs when angered.$

label: gNidorinoPokedexText
en: It is easily angered. By swinging its well-\ndeveloped horn wildly, it can even punch\nthrough diamond.$

label: gNidokingPokedexText
en: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide\nand its extended horn. Be careful with\nthe horn as it contains venom.$

label: gClefairyPokedexText
en: Its adorable appearance makes it popular\nas a pet. However, it is rare and\ndifficult to find.$

label: gClefablePokedexText
en: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can\neasily hear a pin being dropped nearly\n1,100 yards away.$

label: gVulpixPokedexText
en: While young, it has six gorgeous tails.\nWhen it grows, several new tails are\nsprouted.$

label: gNinetalesPokedexText
en: It has nine long tails and fur that \ngleams gold. It is said to live for \n1,000 years.$

label: gJigglypuffPokedexText
en: It captivates foes with its huge, round\neyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing\na soothing melody.$

label: gWigglytuffPokedexText
en: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and\nsupple. The exquisitely pleasant fur\nconveys an image of luxury.$

label: gZubatPokedexText
en: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on\nits ultrasonic cries for echo location to\nflit about in darkness.$

label: gGolbatPokedexText
en: It clamps down on its prey with needle-\nsharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of\nblood in one gulp.$

label: gOddishPokedexText
en: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.”\nAt night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000\nfeet on its two roots.$

label: gGloomPokedexText
en: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor.\nThe horrid stench can cause fainting at a\ndistance of 1.25 miles.$

label: gVileplumePokedexText
en: Its petals are the largest in the world.\nIt fiendishly scatters allergy-causing\npollen from its petals.$

label: gParasPokedexText
en: Growing out of the bug's back are\nmushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms\ngrow with the bug host.$

label: gParasectPokedexText
en: It scatters toxic spores from the\nmushroom cap. In China, the spores are\nused as herbal medicine.$

label: gVenonatPokedexText
en: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be\nactive in darkness. The eyes can also\nshoot powerful beams.$

label: gVenomothPokedexText
en: The wings are covered with dustlike\nscales. Every time it flaps its wings, it\nlooses highly toxic dust.$

label: gDiglettPokedexText
en: It burrows through the ground at a\nshallow depth. It leaves raised earth in\nits wake, making it easy to spot.$

label: gDugtrioPokedexText
en: In battle, it digs through the ground and\nstrikes the unsuspecting foe from an\nunexpected direction.$

label: gMeowthPokedexText
en: All it does is sleep during the daytime.\nAt night, it patrols its territory with its\neyes aglow.$

label: gPersianPokedexText
en: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it\nraises its tail straight up. It is a signal\nthat it is about to pounce and bite.$

label: gPsyduckPokedexText
en: It is constantly wracked by a headache.\nWhen the headache turns intense, it begins\nusing mysterious powers.$

label: gGolduckPokedexText
en: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make\nit an adept swimmer. It can be seen\nswimming elegantly in lakes, etc.$

label: gMankeyPokedexText
en: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious\nin temperament. When angered, it flies into\nan uncontrollable frenzy.$

label: gPrimeapePokedexText
en: It is always outrageously furious. If it\ngives chase, it will tenaciously track the\ntarget no matter how far.$

label: gGrowlithePokedexText
en: Very friendly and faithful to people.\nIt will try to repel enemies by barking\nand biting.$

label: gArcaninePokedexText
en: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese\nlegends. It is said to race at an\nunbelievable speed.$

label: gPoliwagPokedexText
en: Its slick black skin is thin and damp.\nA part of its internal organs can be seen\nthrough the skin as a spiral pattern.$

label: gPoliwhirlPokedexText
en: Its two legs are well developed.\nEven though it can live on the ground,\nit prefers living in water.$

label: gPoliwrathPokedexText
en: An adept swimmer, it knows the front\ncrawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster\nthan the best human swimmers.$

label: gAbraPokedexText
en: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a\nvariety of extrasensory powers even\nwhile asleep.$

label: gKadabraPokedexText
en: It happened one morning - a boy with\nextrasensory powers awoke in bed\ntransformed into KADABRA.$

label: gAlakazamPokedexText
en: It does not like physical attacks very \nmuch. Instead, it freely uses extra-\nsensory powers to defeat foes.$

label: gMachopPokedexText
en: Its whole body is composed of muscles.\nEven though it's the size of a human\nchild, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.$

label: gMachokePokedexText
en: Its formidable body never gets tired.\nIt helps people by doing work such as\nthe moving of heavy goods.$

label: gMachampPokedexText
en: Its four ruggedly developed arms can\nlaunch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just\ntwo seconds.$

label: gBellsproutPokedexText
en: Its bud looks like a human face. Because\nof the bud, it is rumored to be a type of\nlegendary mandrake plant.$

label: gWeepinbellPokedexText
en: The leafy parts act as cutters for\nslashing foes. It spits a fluid that\ndissolves everything.$

label: gVictreebelPokedexText
en: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike\naroma. The helpless prey is melted with\na dissolving fluid.$

label: gTentacoolPokedexText
en: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals.\nFrom them, it shoots mysterious\nbeams of light.$

label: gTentacruelPokedexText
en: It has 80 tentacles that move about\nfreely. They can sting, causing poisoning\nand sharp, stabbing pain.$

label: gGeodudePokedexText
en: Its round form makes it easy to pick up.\nSome people have used them to hurl\nat each other in a snowball fight.$

label: gGravelerPokedexText
en: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails.\nGRAVELER may come rolling down the path\nwithout slowing.$

label: gGolemPokedexText
en: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as\nrugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin\nonce a year to grow larger.$

label: gPonytaPokedexText
en: Its body is light, and its legs are\nincredibly powerful. It can clear\nAyers Rock in one leap.$

label: gRapidashPokedexText
en: It can gallop at a top speed of 150\nmiles per hour. It can race as fast as a\nbullet train while ablaze.$

label: gSlowpokePokedexText
en: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but\nno one knows what it is thinking about.\nIt is good at fishing with its tail.$

label: gSlowbroPokedexText
en: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea,\nits tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That\nmade it evolve into SLOWBRO.$

label: gMagnemitePokedexText
en: It moves while constantly hovering.\nIt discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on\nfrom the units at its sides.$

label: gMagnetonPokedexText
en: A linked cluster formed of several\nMAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful\nmagnetic waves at high voltage.$

label: gFarfetchdPokedexText
en: It always walks about with a plant stalk\nclamped in its beak. The stalk is used for\nbuilding its nest.$

label: gDoduoPokedexText
en: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered\nas a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace\nof over 60 miles per hour.$

label: gDodrioPokedexText
en: An odd species that is rarely found.\nThe three heads respectively represent\njoy, sadness, and anger.$

label: gSeelPokedexText
en: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is\nthick and tough. It is active in bitter\ncold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.$

label: gDewgongPokedexText
en: Its body is covered with a pure white\nfur. The colder the weather, the more\nactive it becomes.$

label: gGrimerPokedexText
en: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon\ntransformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding\non filthy things.$

label: gMukPokedexText
en: It is usually undetectable because it\nblends in with the ground. Touching it can\ncause terrible poisoning.$

label: gShellderPokedexText
en: It is encased in a shell that is harder\nthan diamond. Inside, however, it is\nsurprisingly tender.$

label: gCloysterPokedexText
en: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be\nshattered, even with a bomb. The shell\nopens only when it is attacking.$

label: gGastlyPokedexText
en: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can\ntopple an Indian elephant by enveloping\nthe prey in two seconds.$

label: gHaunterPokedexText
en: If you get the feeling of being watched\nin darkness when nobody is around,\nHAUNTER is there.$

label: gGengarPokedexText
en: It is said to emerge from darkness to\nsteal the lives of those who become lost\nin mountains.$

label: gOnixPokedexText
en: It usually lives underground. It searches\nfor food while boring its way through the\nground at 50 miles per hour.$

label: gDrowzeePokedexText
en: A descendent of the legendary animal\nbaku, which is said to eat dreams. It is\nskilled at hypnotism.$

label: gHypnoPokedexText
en: It carries a pendulum-like device. There\nonce was an incident in which it took \naway a child it hypnotized.$

label: gKrabbyPokedexText
en: It can be found near the sea. The large\npincers grow back if they are torn out of\ntheir sockets.$

label: gKinglerPokedexText
en: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-\nhorsepower strength. However, being so\nbig, it is unwieldy to move.$

label: gVoltorbPokedexText
en: A life-form whose identity is unknown.\nIt is said to SCREECH or suddenly\nSELFDESTRUCT.$

label: gElectrodePokedexText
en: It explodes in response to even minor\nstimuli. It is feared, with the nickname\nof “The Bomb Ball.”$

label: gExeggcutePokedexText
en: Even though it appears to be eggs of\nsome sort, it was discovered to be a life-\nform more like plant seeds.$

label: gExeggutorPokedexText
en: It is called “The Walking Tropical\nRainforest.” Each of the nuts has\na face and a will of its own.$

label: gCubonePokedexText
en: It wears the skull of its dead mother on\nits head. When it becomes lonesome, it is\nsaid to cry loudly.$

label: gMarowakPokedexText
en: It is small and was originally very weak.\nIts temperament turned ferocious when it\nbegan using bones.$

label: gHitmonleePokedexText
en: The legs freely contract and stretch.\nThe stretchy legs allow it to hit a\ndistant foe with a rising kick.$

label: gHitmonchanPokedexText
en: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this\nPOKéMON. It throws punches that are\nfaster than a bullet train.$

label: gLickitungPokedexText
en: Its tongue is twice the length of its\nbody. It can be moved like an arm for\ngrabbing food and attacking.$

label: gKoffingPokedexText
en: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by\nhorribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is\nnearby.$

label: gWeezingPokedexText
en: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result\nin two small KOFFING twins becoming\nconjoined as a WEEZING.$

label: gRhyhornPokedexText
en: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON\ncan shatter even a skyscraper with its\ncharging TACKLES.$

label: gRhydonPokedexText
en: It begins walking on its hind legs after\nevolution. It can punch holes through\nboulders with its horn.$

label: gChanseyPokedexText
en: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are\napparently rich in nutrients and extremely\ndelicious.$

label: gTangelaPokedexText
en: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON's\nidentity in a tangled mass. It entangles\nanything that gets close.$

label: gKangaskhanPokedexText
en: The female raises its offspring in a pouch\non its belly. It is skilled at attacking\nusing COMET PUNCH.$

label: gHorseaPokedexText
en: It maintains balance using its tail, which\nis wound up like a coil. It may spray ink\nfrom its mouth.$

label: gSeadraPokedexText
en: Its body bristles with sharp spikes.\nCarelessly trying to touch it could cause\nfainting from the spikes.$

label: gGoldeenPokedexText
en: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly\ndeveloped like muscles. It can swim at a\nspeed of five knots.$

label: gSeakingPokedexText
en: The horn on its head is sharp like a\ndrill. It bores a hole in a boulder to\nmake its nest.$

label: gStaryuPokedexText
en: It appears in large numbers by seashores.\nAt night, its central core flashes with a\nred light.$

label: gStarmiePokedexText
en: This POKéMON has a geometric body.\nBecause of its body, the locals suspect\nthat it is an alien creature.$

label: gMrmimePokedexText
en: It is adept at conning people. It is said\nto be able to create walls out of thin\nair by miming.$

label: gScytherPokedexText
en: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly\nsharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its\nwings to fly.$

label: gJynxPokedexText
en: It speaks using a language that sounds\nhuman. Research is under way to determine\nwhat is being said.$

label: gElectabuzzPokedexText
en: It loves to feed on strong electricity.\nIt occasionally appears around large\npower plants and so on.$

label: gMagmarPokedexText
en: Found near the mouth of a volcano.\nThis fire-breather's body temperature is\nnearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.$

label: gPinsirPokedexText
en: Its two long pincer horns are powerful.\nOnce they grip an enemy, they won't\nrelease until the foe is torn.$

label: gTaurosPokedexText
en: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips\nits body repeatedly with its three\nlong tails.$

label: gMagikarpPokedexText
en: It is virtually worthless in terms of both\npower and speed. It is the most weak and\npathetic POKéMON in the world.$

label: gGyaradosPokedexText
en: It has an extremely aggressive nature.\nThe HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth\ntotally incinerates all targets.$

label: gLaprasPokedexText
en: Its high intelligence enables it to\nunderstand human speech. It likes to ferry\npeople on its back.$

label: gDittoPokedexText
en: It can freely recombine its own cellular\nstructure to transform into other life-\nforms.$

label: gEeveePokedexText
en: An extremely rare POKéMON that may\nevolve in a number of different ways\ndepending on stimuli.$

label: gVaporeonPokedexText
en: Its body's cellular structure is similar to\nthe molecular composition of water.\nIt can melt invisibly in water.$

label: gJolteonPokedexText
en: If it is angered or startled, the fur all\nover its body bristles like sharp needles\nthat pierce foes.$

label: gFlareonPokedexText
en: It has a flame bag inside its body. After\ninhaling deeply, it blows out flames of\nnearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.$

label: gPorygonPokedexText
en: Using the most advanced technologies,\nscientists finally succeeded in making the\nfirst artificial POKéMON.$

label: gOmanytePokedexText
en: A prehistoric POKéMON that lived in the\nprimordial sea, it swims by twisting its\n10 tentacles about.$

label: gOmastarPokedexText
en: Its tentacles are highly developed as if\nthey are hands and feet. As soon as it\nensnares prey, it bites.$

label: gKabutoPokedexText
en: This POKéMON was regenerated from the\nfossil of an ancient creature. It protects\nitself with a hard shell.$

label: gKabutopsPokedexText
en: It swims freely through water. It catches\nprey with its scythe-like arms and drains\nthe victim's fluids.$

label: gAerodactylPokedexText
en: It was regenerated from a dinosaur's\ngenetic matter that was found in amber.\nIt flies with high-pitched cries.$

label: gSnorlaxPokedexText
en: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880\npounds of food every day. When it is done\neating, it goes promptly to sleep.$

label: gArticunoPokedexText
en: One of the legendary bird POKéMON.\nWith its long tail trailing behind, its\nflying form is magnificent.$

label: gZapdosPokedexText
en: One of the legendary bird POKéMON.\nWhile it is flying, it makes crackling and\nsnapping sounds.$

label: gMoltresPokedexText
en: One of the legendary bird POKéMON.\nThose seeing it are overwhelmed by its\norange wings that seem to be on fire.$

label: gDratiniPokedexText
en: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in\nlength. It grows larger by repeatedly\nshedding skin.$

label: gDragonairPokedexText
en: It is said to live in seas and lakes.\nEven though it has no wings, it has been\nseen flying occasionally.$

label: gDragonitePokedexText
en: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky\nphysique. It circles the globe in just\n16 hours.$

label: gMewtwoPokedexText
en: A POKéMON whose genetic code was\nrepeatedly recombined for research.\nIt turned vicious as a result.$

label: gMewPokedexText
en: A POKéMON of South America that was\nthought to have been extinct. It is very\nintelligent and learns any move.$

label: gBayleefPokedexText
en: A spicy aroma emanates from around its\nneck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to\nrestore health.$

label: gMeganiumPokedexText
en: MEGANIUM's breath has the power to revive\ndead grass and plants. It can make them\nhealthy again.$

label: gCyndaquilPokedexText
en: It usually stays hunched over. If it is\nangry or surprised, it shoots flames out\nof its back.$

label: gQuilavaPokedexText
en: This POKéMON is fully covered by\nnonflammable fur. It can withstand any\nkind of fire attack.$

label: gTyphlosionPokedexText
en: It has a secret, devastating move. It\nrubs its blazing fur together to cause\nhuge explosions.$

label: gTotodilePokedexText
en: It is small but rough and tough. It won't\nhesitate to take a bite out of anything\nthat moves.$

label: gCroconawPokedexText
en: It opens its huge jaws wide when\nattacking. If it loses any fangs while\nbiting, they grow back in.$

label: gFeraligatrPokedexText
en: It is hard for it to support its own\nweight out of water, so it gets down on\nall fours. But it moves fast.$

label: gSentretPokedexText
en: It stands on its tail so it can see a long\nway. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly\nto warn its kind.$

label: gFurretPokedexText
en: There is no telling where its tail begins.\nDespite its short legs, it is quick at\nhunting RATTATA.$

label: gHoothootPokedexText
en: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever\nhappens, it keeps rhythm by precisely\ntilting its head in time.$

label: gNoctowlPokedexText
en: When it needs to think, it rotates its head\n180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual\npower.$

label: gLedybaPokedexText
en: When the weather turns cold, numerous\nLEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster\nand keep each other warm.$

label: gLedianPokedexText
en: The star patterns on its back grow larger\nor smaller depending on the number of\nstars in the night sky.$

label: gSpinarakPokedexText
en: It spins a web using fine--but durable--\nthread. It then waits patiently for prey\nto be trapped.$

label: gAriadosPokedexText
en: A single strand of a special string is\nendlessly spun out of its rear. The string\nleads back to its nest.$

label: gCrobatPokedexText
en: The development of wings on its legs\nenables it to fly fast but also makes it\ntough to stop and rest.$

label: gChinchouPokedexText
en: On the dark ocean floor, its only means\nof communication is its constantly\nflashing lights.$

label: gLanturnPokedexText
en: It blinds prey with an intense burst of\nlight, then swallows the immobilized prey\nin a single gulp.$

label: gPichuPokedexText
en: Despite its small size, it can zap even\nadult humans. However, if it does so, it\nalso surprises itself.$

label: gCleffaPokedexText
en: When numerous meteors illuminate the\nnight sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely\nincrease.$

label: gIgglybuffPokedexText
en: Its extremely flexible and elastic body\nmakes it bounce continuously--anytime,\nanywhere.$

label: gTogepiPokedexText
en: A proverb claims that happiness will come\nto anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI\nstand up.$

label: gTogeticPokedexText
en: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind\npeople. It can float in midair without\nmoving its wings.$

label: gNatuPokedexText
en: It usually forages for food on the ground\nbut may, on rare occasions, hop onto\nbranches to peck at shoots.$

label: gXatuPokedexText
en: In South America, it is said that its right\neye sees the future and its left eye\nviews the past.$

label: gMareepPokedexText
en: Its fleece grows continually. In the\nsummer, the fleece is fully shed, but it\ngrows back in a week.$

label: gFlaaffyPokedexText
en: Its fluffy fleece easily stores\nelectricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it\nfrom being electrocuted.$

label: gAmpharosPokedexText
en: The bright light on its tail can be seen\nfar away. It has been treasured since\nancient times as a beacon.$

label: gBellossomPokedexText
en: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances,\nits petals rub together and make a\npleasant ringing sound.$

label: gMarillPokedexText
en: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that\nkeeps it from drowning, even in a vicious\ncurrent.$

label: gAzumarillPokedexText
en: When it plays in water, it rolls up its\nelongated ears to prevent their insides\nfrom getting wet.$

label: gSudowoodoPokedexText
en: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid\nattack. It hates water, so it will\ndisappear if it starts raining.$

label: gPolitoedPokedexText
en: Whenever three or more of these get\ntogether, they sing in a loud voice that\nsounds like bellowing.$

label: gHoppipPokedexText
en: Its body is so light, it must grip the\nground firmly with its feet to keep from\nbeing blown away.$

label: gSkiploomPokedexText
en: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight.\nIt also floats in the air to get closer to\nthe sun.$

label: gJumpluffPokedexText
en: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads\nits cotton-like spores all over the world \nto make more offspring.$

label: gAipomPokedexText
en: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping\nfrom branch to branch, it deftly uses its\ntail for balance.$

label: gSunkernPokedexText
en: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from\nunder the leaves of plants. It is said\nthat it eats nothing else.$

label: gSunfloraPokedexText
en: In the daytime, it rushes about in a\nhectic manner, but it comes to a complete\nstop when the sun sets.$

label: gYanmaPokedexText
en: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees.\nIt looks in all directions to seek out\ninsects as its prey.$

label: gWooperPokedexText
en: When it walks around on the ground,\nit coats its body with a slimy, poisonous\nfilm.$

label: gQuagsirePokedexText
en: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude,\nit often bumps its head on boulders and\nboat hulls as it swims.$

label: gEspeonPokedexText
en: By reading air currents, it can predict\nthings such as the weather or its foe's\nnext move.$

label: gUmbreonPokedexText
en: When darkness falls, the rings on its body\nbegin to glow, striking fear in the hearts\nof anyone nearby.$

label: gMurkrowPokedexText
en: It is said that when chased, it lures its\nattacker onto dark mountain trails where\nthe foe will get lost.$

label: gSlowkingPokedexText
en: When its head was bitten, toxins entered\nSLOWPOKE's head and unlocked an\nextraordinary power.$

label: gMisdreavusPokedexText
en: It loves to bite and yank people's hair\nfrom behind without warning, just to see\ntheir shocked reactions.$

label: gUnownPokedexText
en: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on\nwalls. Its shape appears to have some\nmeaning.$

label: gWobbuffetPokedexText
en: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it\nlives quietly in the darkness. It is never\nfirst to attack.$

label: gGirafarigPokedexText
en: Its tail, which also contains a small\nbrain, may bite on its own if it notices an\nalluring smell.$

label: gPinecoPokedexText
en: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey\nto come near. It does not move about\nmuch on its own.$

label: gForretressPokedexText
en: It remains immovably rooted to its tree.\nIt scatters pieces of its hard shell to\ndrive its enemies away.$

label: gDunsparcePokedexText
en: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with\nits tail. It can hover just slightly using\nits wings.$

label: gGligarPokedexText
en: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots\nits prey, it spreads its wings and glides\ndown to attack.$

label: gSteelixPokedexText
en: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over\n100 years, its composition changes to\nbecome diamond-like.$

label: gSnubbullPokedexText
en: It has an active, playful nature. Many\nwomen like to frolic with it because of\nits affectionate ways.$

label: gGranbullPokedexText
en: Because its fangs are too heavy, it\nalways keeps its head tilted down.\nHowever, its BITE is powerful.$

label: gQwilfishPokedexText
en: The small spikes covering its body\ndeveloped from scales. They inject a\ntoxin that causes fainting.$

label: gScizorPokedexText
en: Its wings are not used for flying.\nThey are flapped at high speed to adjust\nits body temperature.$

label: gShucklePokedexText
en: It stores BERRIES inside its shell.\nTo avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks\nand remains completely still.$

label: gHeracrossPokedexText
en: Usually docile, but if disturbed while\nsipping honey, it chases off the intruder\nwith its horn.$

label: gSneaselPokedexText
en: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from\ntheir nests and feasts on the eggs that\nare left behind.$

label: gTeddiursaPokedexText
en: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime,\nits habit is to hoard food in many hidden\nlocations.$

label: gUrsaringPokedexText
en: With its ability to distinguish any smell,\nit unfailingly finds all food buried deep\nunderground.$

label: gSlugmaPokedexText
en: A common sight in volcanic areas, it\nslowly slithers around in a constant\nsearch for warm places.$

label: gMagcargoPokedexText
en: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts\nintense flames that circulate throughout\nits body.$

label: gSwinubPokedexText
en: If it smells something enticing, it dashes\noff headlong to find the source of the\naroma.$

label: gPiloswinePokedexText
en: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on\nits back stand up straight. It is very\nsensitive to sound.$

label: gCorsolaPokedexText
en: In a south sea nation, the people live in\ncommunities that are built on groups of\nthese POKéMON.$

label: gRemoraidPokedexText
en: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it\nclings to a MANTINE's underside to\nscavenge for leftovers.$

label: gOctilleryPokedexText
en: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes.\nIf it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a\nfellow OCTILLERY.$

label: gDelibirdPokedexText
en: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs.\nIt spends all day carrying food to its\nawaiting chicks.$

label: gMantinePokedexText
en: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly\nout of the water and over the waves if it\nbuilds up enough speed.$

label: gSkarmoryPokedexText
en: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings\nof its chicks grow hard from scratches by\nthorns.$

label: gHoundourPokedexText
en: To corner prey, they check each other's\nlocation using barks that only they can\nunderstand.$

label: gHoundoomPokedexText
en: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other\nPOKéMON get the shivers and head straight\nback to their nests.$

label: gKingdraPokedexText
en: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to\nbuild its energy. It is said to cause\ntornadoes as it wakes.$

label: gPhanpyPokedexText
en: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its\nsnout. However, it is so strong, it may\nsend you flying.$

label: gDonphanPokedexText
en: The longer and bigger its tusks, the\nhigher its rank in its herd. The tusks take\na long time to grow.$

label: gPorygon2PokedexText
en: Further research enhanced its abilities.\nSometimes, it may exhibit motions that\nwere not programmed.$

label: gStantlerPokedexText
en: Those who stare at its antlers will\ngradually lose control of their senses\nand be unable to stand.$

label: gSmearglePokedexText
en: Once it becomes an adult, it has a\ntendency to let its comrades plant\nfootprints on its back.$

label: gTyroguePokedexText
en: Even though it is small, it can't be\nignored because it will slug any handy\ntarget without warning.$

label: gHitmontopPokedexText
en: It launches kicks while spinning. If it\nspins at high speed, it may bore its way\ninto the ground.$

label: gSmoochumPokedexText
en: It always rocks its head slowly backwards\nand forwards as if it is trying to kiss\nsomeone.$

label: gElekidPokedexText
en: Even in the most vicious storm, this\nPOKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles\nin the sky.$

label: gMagbyPokedexText
en: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body\nheat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit,\nso don't underestimate it.$

label: gMiltankPokedexText
en: If it has just had a baby, the milk it\nproduces contains much more nutrition than\nusual.$

label: gBlisseyPokedexText
en: It has a very compassionate nature. If it\nsees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the\nsufferer back to health.$

label: gRaikouPokedexText
en: This POKéMON races across the\nland while barking a cry that sounds\nlike crashing thunder.$

label: gEnteiPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that races across the land.\nIt is said that one is born every time a\nnew volcano appears.$

label: gSuicunePokedexText
en: This POKéMON races across the land.\nIt is said that north winds will somehow\nblow whenever it appears.$

label: gLarvitarPokedexText
en: It is born deep underground. It can't\nemerge until it has entirely consumed the\nsoil around it.$

label: gPupitarPokedexText
en: Even sealed in its shell, it can move\nfreely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding\ndestructive power.$

label: gLugiaPokedexText
en: It is said to be the guardian of the seas.\nIt is rumored to have been seen on the\nnight of a storm.$

label: gHoOhPokedexText
en: A legend says that its body glows in\nseven colors. A rainbow is said to form\nbehind it when it flies.$

label: gCelebiPokedexText
en: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest,\nit is said to leave behind an egg it\nbrought from the future.$

label: gTreeckoPokedexText
en: It quickly scales even vertical walls.\nIt senses humidity with its tail to predict\nthe next day's weather.$

label: gGrovylePokedexText
en: Its strongly developed thigh muscles\ngive it astounding agility and jumping\nperformance.$

label: gSceptilePokedexText
en: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp\nas swords. It agilely leaps about the\nbranches of trees to strike.$

label: gTorchicPokedexText
en: It has a flame sac inside its belly that\nperpetually burns. It feels warm if it is\nhugged.$

label: gCombuskenPokedexText
en: It boosts its concentration by emitting\nharsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding\ndestructive power.$

label: gBlazikenPokedexText
en: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames\nfrom its wrists. Its powerful legs let it\njump clear over buildings.$

label: gMudkipPokedexText
en: Its large tail fin propels it through\nwater with powerful acceleration. It is\nstrong in spite of its size.$

label: gMarshtompPokedexText
en: It is at its best when on muddy ground\nwith poor footing. It quickly overwhelms\nfoes struggling in mud.$

label: gSwampertPokedexText
en: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing,\nthey can batter down its foe. It makes its\nnest on beautiful beaches.$

label: gPoochyenaPokedexText
en: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute\nsense of smell lets it chase a chosen\nprey without ever losing track.$

label: gMightyenaPokedexText
en: It will always obey the commands of a\nskilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from\nits living in packs in ancient times.$

label: gZigzagoonPokedexText
en: A POKéMON with abundant curiosity.\nIt shows an interest in everything, so it\nalways zigs and zags.$

label: gLinoonePokedexText
en: When running in a straight line, it can top\n60 miles per hour. However, it has a\ntough time with curved roads.$

label: gWurmplePokedexText
en: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests.\nWhen attacked, it resists by pointing its\nvenomous spikes at the foe.$

label: gSilcoonPokedexText
en: It conserves its energy by moving as\nlittle as possible. It awaits evolution\nwhile drinking only a little rainwater.$

label: gBeautiflyPokedexText
en: Despite its appearance, it has an\naggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing\nwith its long, thin mouth.$

label: gCascoonPokedexText
en: Its body, which is made of soft silk,\nhardens over time. When cracks appear,\nevolution is near.$

label: gDustoxPokedexText
en: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it\nsenses danger. They tend to gather in the\nglow of streetlamps at night.$

label: gLotadPokedexText
en: It searches about for clean water. If it\ndoes not drink water for too long, the\nleaf on its head wilts.$

label: gLombrePokedexText
en: It lives at the water's edge where it is\nsunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass\nby day and becomes active at night.$

label: gLudicoloPokedexText
en: The rhythm of bright, festive music\nactivates LUDICOLO's cells, making it more\npowerful.$

label: gSeedotPokedexText
en: If it remains still, it becomes impossible\nto distinguish from real nuts. It delights\nin surprising foraging PIDGEY.$

label: gNuzleafPokedexText
en: They live in holes bored in large trees.\nThe sound of NUZLEAF's grass flute fills\nlisteners with dread.$

label: gShiftryPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest\nguardian. It can read the foe's mind and\ntake preemptive action.$

label: gTaillowPokedexText
en: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to\nother lands in search of warmth, flying\nover 180 miles a day.$

label: gSwellowPokedexText
en: If its two tail feathers are standing at\nattention, it is proof of good health.\nIt soars elegantly in the sky.$

label: gWingullPokedexText
en: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were\na glider. In the winter, it hides food\naround its nest.$

label: gPelipperPokedexText
en: It is a flying transporter that carries\nsmall POKéMON in its beak. It bobs on the\nwaves to rest its wings.$

label: gRaltsPokedexText
en: It is highly attuned to the emotions of\npeople and POKéMON. It hides if it senses\nhostility.$

label: gKirliaPokedexText
en: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives\nit energy for its psychokinetic power.\nIt spins and dances when happy.$

label: gGardevoirPokedexText
en: It has the power to predict the future.\nIts power peaks when it is protecting its\nTRAINER.$

label: gSurskitPokedexText
en: They usually live on ponds, but after an\nevening shower, they may appear on\npuddles in towns.$

label: gMasquerainPokedexText
en: The antennae have distinctive patterns\nthat look like eyes. When it rains, they\ngrow heavy, making flight impossible.$

label: gShroomishPokedexText
en: It prefers damp places. By day it remains\nstill in the forest shade. It releases\ntoxic powder from its head.$

label: gBreloomPokedexText
en: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic\nspores. It knocks out foes with quick,\nvirtually invisible punches.$

label: gSlakothPokedexText
en: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making\ndrowsy those that see it is one of\nits abilities.$

label: gVigorothPokedexText
en: It is always hungry because it won't stop\nrampaging. Even while it is eating, it\ncan't keep still.$

label: gSlakingPokedexText
en: It is the world's most slothful POKéMON.\nHowever, it can exert horrifying power by\nreleasing pent-up energy all at once.$

label: gNincadaPokedexText
en: Because it lived almost entirely\nunderground, it is nearly blind.\nIt uses its antennae instead.$

label: gNinjaskPokedexText
en: This POKéMON is so quick, it is said to\nbe able to avoid any attack. It loves to\nfeed on tree sap.$

label: gShedinjaPokedexText
en: A most peculiar POKéMON that somehow\nappears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA\nevolves.$

label: gWhismurPokedexText
en: It usually murmurs, but starts crying\nloudly if it senses danger. It stops when\nits ear covers are shut.$

label: gLoudredPokedexText
en: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it\ngenerates ultrasonic waves that can blow\napart a house.$

label: gExploudPokedexText
en: It emits a variety of sounds from the \nholes all over its body. Its loud cries\ncan be heard from over six miles away.$

label: gMakuhitaPokedexText
en: It grows stronger by enduring harsh\ntraining. It is a gutsy POKéMON that can\nwithstand any attack.$

label: gHariyamaPokedexText
en: It stomps on the ground to build power.\nIt can send a 10-ton truck flying with a\nstraight-arm punch.$

label: gAzurillPokedexText
en: It battles by flinging around its tail,\nwhich is bigger than its body. The\ntail is a flotation device in water.$

label: gNosepassPokedexText
en: Its magnetic nose consistently faces\nnorth. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get\ntheir bearings.$

label: gSkittyPokedexText
en: It is said to be difficult to earn its\ntrust. However, it is extremely popular\nfor its cute looks and behavior.$

label: gDelcattyPokedexText
en: The favorite of trend-conscious\nfemale TRAINERS, they are used in\ncompetition for their style and fur.$

label: gSableyePokedexText
en: It feeds on gemstone crystals.\nIn darkness, its eyes sparkle with the\nglitter of jewels.$

label: gMawilePokedexText
en: It uses its docile-looking face to lull\nfoes into complacency, then bites with its\nhuge, relentless jaws.$

label: gAronPokedexText
en: It eats iron to build its steel body.\nIt is a pest that descends from mountains\nto eat bridges and train tracks.$

label: gLaironPokedexText
en: It habitually shows off its strength with\nthe size of sparks it creates by ramming\nits steel body into boulders.$

label: gAggronPokedexText
en: It claims a large mountain as its sole\nterritory. It mercilessly thrashes those\nthat violate its space.$

label: gMedititePokedexText
en: It never skips its daily yoga training.\nIt heightens its inner strength through\nmeditation.$

label: gMedichamPokedexText
en: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-\nlike steps, then launches a devastating\nblow in the same motion.$

label: gElectrikePokedexText
en: It stores static electricity in its fur\nfor discharging. It gives off sparks if a\nstorm approaches.$

label: gManectricPokedexText
en: It rarely appears before people.\nIt is said to nest where lightning has\nfallen.$

label: gPluslePokedexText
en: It cheers on partners while scattering\nsparks from its body. It climbs telephone\npoles to absorb electricity.$

label: gMinunPokedexText
en: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter\nunder the eaves of houses in rain. It uses\npom-poms made of sparks for cheering.$

label: gVolbeatPokedexText
en: It lives around clean ponds. At night,\nits rear lights up. It converses with\nothers by flashing its light.$

label: gIllumisePokedexText
en: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night\nskies. There are scientists that study the\npatterns it creates.$

label: gRoseliaPokedexText
en: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance.\nThe stronger its aroma, the healthier\nthe ROSELIA is.$

label: gGulpinPokedexText
en: There is nothing its stomach can't digest.\nWhile it is digesting, vile, overpowering\ngases are expelled.$

label: gSwalotPokedexText
en: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp.\nIt secretes a horribly toxic fluid from\nthe pores on its body.$

label: gCarvanhaPokedexText
en: It lives in massive rivers that course\nthrough jungles. It swarms prey that\nenter its territory.$

label: gSharpedoPokedexText
en: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that\ncrunch through iron. It swims by jetting\nwater from its rear.$

label: gWailmerPokedexText
en: When it sucks in a large volume of\nseawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy\nball. It eats a ton of food daily.$

label: gWailordPokedexText
en: It is among the largest of all POKéMON.\nIt herds prey in a pack then swallows the\nmassed prey in one gulp.$

label: gNumelPokedexText
en: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit\ncourses through its body. When it grows\ncold, the magma hardens and slows it.$

label: gCameruptPokedexText
en: If angered, the humps on its back erupt\nin a shower of molten lava. It lives in\nthe craters of volcanoes.$

label: gTorkoalPokedexText
en: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is\nattacked, it belches thick, black smoke\nand flees.$

label: gSpoinkPokedexText
en: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing\nabout. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL\non its head.$

label: gGrumpigPokedexText
en: It can gain control over foes by doing\nodd dance steps. The black pearls on its\nforehead are precious gems.$

label: gSpindaPokedexText
en: No two SPINDA are said to have identical\npatterns. It confuses foes with its\nstumbling motions.$

label: gTrapinchPokedexText
en: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a\nsloping pit trap in sand where it\npatiently awaits prey.$

label: gVibravaPokedexText
en: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently\nflapping its wings. After making its prey\nfaint, it melts the prey with acid.$

label: gFlygonPokedexText
en: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand\nwith its wings. Red covers shield its eyes\nfrom sand.$

label: gCacneaPokedexText
en: It prefers harsh environments such as\ndeserts. It can survive for 30 days on\nwater stored in its body.$

label: gCacturnePokedexText
en: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at\nnight when it hunts for prey exhausted\nfrom the desert's heat.$

label: gSwabluPokedexText
en: It constantly grooms its cotton-like\nwings. It takes a shower to clean\nitself if it becomes dirty.$

label: gAltariaPokedexText
en: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling\ndeep among mountains far from people,\nit is ALTARIA's humming.$

label: gZangoosePokedexText
en: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur\nbristles and it assumes its battle pose.\nIts sharp claws are its best weapon.$

label: gSeviperPokedexText
en: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard\nrocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes\nunwary prey with venomous fangs.$

label: gLunatonePokedexText
en: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar\ncycle. It brims with power when exposed\nto the light of the full moon.$

label: gSolrockPokedexText
en: It absorbs solar energy during the day.\nAlways expressionless, it can sense what\nits foe is thinking.$

label: gBarboachPokedexText
en: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two\nlong whiskers. A slimy film protects its\nbody.$

label: gWhiscashPokedexText
en: It makes its nest at the bottom of \nswamps. It will eat anything - if it is\nalive, WHISCASH will eat it.$

label: gCorphishPokedexText
en: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy\ncreature that will quickly proliferate,\neven in polluted streams.$

label: gCrawdauntPokedexText
en: A rough customer that wildly flails its\ngiant claws. It is said to be extremely\nhard to raise.$

label: gBaltoyPokedexText
en: It was discovered in ancient ruins.\nWhile moving, it constantly spins. It\nstands on one foot even when asleep.$

label: gClaydolPokedexText
en: It appears to have been born from clay\ndolls made by ancient people. It uses\ntelekinesis to float and move.$

label: gLileepPokedexText
en: It became extinct roughly 100 million\nyears ago. It was regenerated from a\nfossil using advanced techniques.$

label: gCradilyPokedexText
en: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles.\nIt then melts the prey with a strong acid\nbefore feeding.$

label: gAnorithPokedexText
en: It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor.\nIt uses its extending claws to catch prey\nhiding among rocks on the seafloor.$

label: gArmaldoPokedexText
en: Protected by a hard shell, its body is\nvery sturdy. It skewers prey with its\nclaws to feed.$

label: gFeebasPokedexText
en: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance,\nit is ignored by researchers. It lives in\nponds choked with weeds.$

label: gMiloticPokedexText
en: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful.\nThose that see it are said to forget their\ncombative spirits.$

label: gCastformPokedexText
en: It has the ability to change its form into\nthe sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, \ndepending on the weather.$

label: gKecleonPokedexText
en: It changes body color to blend in with\nits surroundings. It also changes color if\nit is happy or sad.$

label: gShuppetPokedexText
en: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and\nmalice. Its upright horn catches the\nemotions of people.$

label: gBanettePokedexText
en: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet\ninto a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth,\nits cursed energy escapes.$

label: gDuskullPokedexText
en: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks\nup to prey. It has the ability to slip\nthrough thick walls.$

label: gDusclopsPokedexText
en: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens\nits mouth, it sucks everything in as if it\nwere a black hole.$

label: gTropiusPokedexText
en: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of\nfruit around its neck is delicious.\nThe fruit grows twice a year.$

label: gChimechoPokedexText
en: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly\nuses its long tail to pluck nuts and\nberries, which it loves to eat.$

label: gAbsolPokedexText
en: It appears when it senses an impending\nnatural disaster. As a result, it was\nmistaken as a doom-bringer.$

label: gWynautPokedexText
en: It tends to move in a pack with others.\nThey cluster in a tight group to sleep in\na cave.$

label: gSnoruntPokedexText
en: It is said that a home visited by a\nSNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand\ncold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.$

label: gGlaliePokedexText
en: It has a body of ice that won't melt,\neven with fire. It can instantly freeze\nmoisture in the atmosphere.$

label: gSphealPokedexText
en: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The\nfur keeps it from feeling cold while\nit is rolling on ice.$

label: gSealeoPokedexText
en: It touches new things with its nose to\ntest for smell and feel. It plays by\nspinning SPHEAL on its nose.$

label: gWalreinPokedexText
en: It swims through icy seas while shattering\nice floes with its large tusks. It is\nprotected by its thick blubber.$

label: gClamperlPokedexText
en: It is protected by a sturdy shell.\nOnce in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent\npearl.$

label: gHuntailPokedexText
en: It lives deep in the sea where no light\never filters down. It lights up its small\nfishlike tail to attract prey.$

label: gGorebyssPokedexText
en: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant.\nWith its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed\nthat grows between rocks.$

label: gRelicanthPokedexText
en: It has remained unchanged for 100\nmillion years. It was discovered\nduring a deep-sea exploration.$

label: gLuvdiscPokedexText
en: During the spawning season, countless\nLUVDISC congregate at coral reefs,\nturning the waters pink.$

label: gBagonPokedexText
en: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders.\nIt longingly hopes for wings to grow so it\ncan fly.$

label: gShelgonPokedexText
en: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce\noff. The armor is too tough, however,\nmaking it heavy and somewhat sluggish.$

label: gSalamencePokedexText
en: It becomes uncontrollable if it is\nenraged. It destroys everything with\nshredding claws and fire.$

label: gBeldumPokedexText
en: It uses magnetic waves to converse with\nits kind. All the cells in its body are\nmagnetic.$

label: gMetangPokedexText
en: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body\nis so tough, even a crash with a jet\nplane won't leave a scratch.$

label: gMetagrossPokedexText
en: It is formed by two METANG fusing.\nIts four brains are said to be superior\nto a supercomputer.$

label: gRegirockPokedexText
en: It is entirely composed of rocks with no\nsign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery\neven to modern scientists.$

label: gRegicePokedexText
en: Research revealed that its body is made\nof the same kind of ice that is found at\nthe South Pole.$

label: gRegisteelPokedexText
en: It is sturdier than any kind of metal.\nIt hardened due to pressure underground\nover tens of thousands of years.$

label: gLatiasPokedexText
en: It can telepathically communicate with\npeople. It changes its appearance using\nits down that refracts light.$

label: gLatiosPokedexText
en: It has a docile temperament and dislikes\nfighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can\nfly faster than a jet plane.$

label: gKyogrePokedexText
en: This POKéMON is said to have\nexpanded the sea by bringing heavy rains.\nIt has the power to control water.$

label: gGroudonPokedexText
en: This legendary POKéMON is said to\nrepresent the land. It went to sleep after\ndueling KYOGRE.$

label: gRayquazaPokedexText
en: It has lived for hundreds of millions of\nyears in the ozone layer. Its flying form\nlooks like a meteor.$

label: gJirachiPokedexText
en: It is said to make any wish come true.\nIt is awake for only seven days out of\na thousand years.$

label: gDeoxysPokedexText
en: This DEOXYS has transformed into its\naggressive guise. It can fool enemies by\naltering its appearance.$

label: gDummyPokedexText
en: This is a newly discovered POKéMON. It is\ncurrently under investigation. No detailed\ninformation is available at this time.$

label: gBulbasaurPokedexText
en: A strange seed was planted on its back at\nbirth. The plant sprouts and grows with\nthis POKéMON.$

label: gIvysaurPokedexText
en: When the bulb on its back grows large, it\nappears to lose the ability to stand on\nits hind legs.$

label: gVenusaurPokedexText
en: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing\nsolar energy. It stays on the move to\nseek sunlight.$

label: gCharmanderPokedexText
en: It has a preference for hot things.\nWhen it rains, steam is said to spout from\nthe tip of its tail.$

label: gCharmeleonPokedexText
en: When it swings its burning tail, it\nelevates the air temperature to \nunbearably high levels.$

label: gCharizardPokedexText
en: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt\nboulders. It may cause forest fires by\nblowing flames.$

label: gSquirtlePokedexText
en: After birth, its back swells and hardens\ninto a shell. It powerfully sprays foam \nfrom its mouth.$

label: gWartortlePokedexText
en: It often hides in water to stalk unwary\nprey. For fast swimming, it moves its\nears to maintain balance.$

label: gBlastoisePokedexText
en: The pressurized water jets on this brutal\nPOKéMON's shell are used for high-\nspeed tackles.$

label: gCaterpiePokedexText
en: Its short feet are tipped with suction\npads that enable it to tirelessly climb\nslopes and walls.$

label: gMetapodPokedexText
en: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack\nwhile its shell is soft, exposing its weak\nand tender body.$

label: gButterfreePokedexText
en: In battle, it flaps its wings at great\nspeed to release highly toxic dust into\nthe air.$

label: gWeedlePokedexText
en: Often found in forests, eating leaves.\nIt has a sharp stinger on its head that\ninjects poison.$

label: gKakunaPokedexText
en: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON\ncan only harden its shell to protect\nitself when it is in danger.$

label: gBeedrillPokedexText
en: It flies at high speed and attacks using \nthe large venomous stingers on its\nforelegs and tail.$

label: gPidgeyPokedexText
en: A common sight in forests and woods.\nIt flaps its wings at ground level to kick\nup blinding sand.$

label: gPidgeottoPokedexText
en: Very protective of its sprawling\nterritorial area, this POKéMON will\nfiercely peck at any intruder.$

label: gPidgeotPokedexText
en: When hunting, it skims the surface of\nwater at high speed to pick off unwary\nprey such as MAGIKARP.$

label: gRattataPokedexText
en: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and\nvery quick, it is a common sight in many\nplaces.$

label: gRaticatePokedexText
en: It uses its whiskers to maintain its\nbalance. It apparently slows down if\nthey are cut off.$

label: gSpearowPokedexText
en: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap\nits short wings at high speed to stay\nairborne.$

label: gFearowPokedexText
en: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can\nkeep aloft without ever having to land\nfor rest.$

label: gEkansPokedexText
en: Moving silently and stealthily, it eats\nthe eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY\nand SPEAROW, whole.$

label: gArbokPokedexText
en: It is rumored that the ferocious warning\nmarkings on its belly differ from area to\narea.$

label: gPikachuPokedexText
en: When several of these POKéMON gather,\ntheir electricity can build and cause\nlightning storms.$

label: gRaichuPokedexText
en: Its long tail serves as a ground to\nprotect itself from its own high-voltage\npower.$

label: gSandshrewPokedexText
en: Burrows deep underground in arid locations\nfar from water. It only emerges to hunt\nfor prey.$

label: gSandslashPokedexText
en: Curls up into a spiny ball when\nthreatened. It can roll while curled up\nto attack or escape.$

label: gNidoranFPokedexText
en: Although small, its venomous barbs render\nthis POKéMON dangerous. The female has\nsmaller horns.$

label: gNidorinaPokedexText
en: The female's horns develop slowly.\nPrefers physical attacks such as clawing\nand biting.$

label: gNidoqueenPokedexText
en: Its hard scales provide strong protection.\nIt uses its hefty bulk to execute\npowerful moves.$

label: gNidoranMPokedexText
en: It stiffens its ears to sense danger.\nThe larger its horns, the more \npowerful its secreted venom.$

label: gNidorinoPokedexText
en: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to\nattack. The horn on its head secretes a\npowerful venom.$

label: gNidokingPokedexText
en: It uses its powerful tail in battle to\nsmash, constrict, then break the prey's\nbones.$

label: gClefairyPokedexText
en: With its magical and cute appeal, it has \nmany admirers. It is rare and found only\nin certain areas.$

label: gClefablePokedexText
en: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen,\nit will run and hide the moment it senses\npeople.$

label: gVulpixPokedexText
en: When it is born, it has just one snow-\nwhite tail. The tail splits from its tip as\nit grows older.$

label: gNinetalesPokedexText
en: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing\none of its many tails could result in a\n1,000-year curse.$

label: gJigglypuffPokedexText
en: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a\nmysteriously soothing melody that lulls\nits enemies to sleep.$

label: gWigglytuffPokedexText
en: The body is soft and rubbery. When\nangered, it will suck in air and inflate\nitself to an enormous size.$

label: gZubatPokedexText
en: It forms colonies in perpetually dark \nplaces and uses ultrasonic waves to  \nidentify and approach targets.$

label: gGolbatPokedexText
en: Once it bites, it will not stop draining\nenergy from the victim even if it gets too\nheavy to fly.$

label: gOddishPokedexText
en: During the day, it keeps its face buried\nin the ground. At night, it wanders around\nsowing its seeds.$

label: gGloomPokedexText
en: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't\ndrool. It is a nectar that is used to\nattract prey.$

label: gVileplumePokedexText
en: The larger its petals, the more toxic\npollen it contains. Its big head is heavy\nand hard to hold up.$

label: gParasPokedexText
en: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms\non its back grow by drawing nutrients from\nthe bug host.$

label: gParasectPokedexText
en: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite\nmushroom has taken over the host bug.\nPrefers damp places. $

label: gVenonatPokedexText
en: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where\nit eats bugs. It is attracted by light\nat night.$

label: gVenomothPokedexText
en: The dustlike scales covering its wings\nare color-coded to indicate the kinds of\npoison it has.$

label: gDiglettPokedexText
en: Lives about one yard underground where it\nfeeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears\naboveground.$

label: gDugtrioPokedexText
en: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers\nhuge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles\nunderground.$

label: gMeowthPokedexText
en: Adores round objects. It wanders the\nstreets on a nightly basis to look for\ndropped loose change.$

label: gPersianPokedexText
en: Although its fur has many admirers, it is\ntough to raise as a pet because of its\nfickle meanness.$

label: gPsyduckPokedexText
en: While lulling its enemies with its vacant\nlook, this wily POKéMON will use\npsychokinetic powers.$

label: gGolduckPokedexText
en: Often seen swimming elegantly by\nlakeshores. It is often mistaken for the\nJapanese monster Kappa.$

label: gMankeyPokedexText
en: Extremely quick to anger. It could be\ndocile one moment, then thrashing away \nthe next instant.$

label: gPrimeapePokedexText
en: Always furious and tenacious to boot.\nIt will not abandon chasing its quarry\nuntil it catches up.$

label: gGrowlithePokedexText
en: It is very protective of its territory.\nIt will bark and bite to repel intruders\nfrom its space.$

label: gArcaninePokedexText
en: A POKéMON that has long been admired\nfor its beauty. It runs agilely as if\non wings.$

label: gPoliwagPokedexText
en: Its newly grown legs prevent it from\nwalking well. It appears to prefer\nswimming over walking.$

label: gPoliwhirlPokedexText
en: It can live in or out of water. When out\nof water, it constantly sweats to keep its\nbody slimy.$

label: gPoliwrathPokedexText
en: A swimmer adept at both the front crawl\nand breaststroke. Easily overtakes the\nbest human swimmers.$

label: gAbraPokedexText
en: Using its ability to read minds, it will\nsense impending danger and TELEPORT to\nsafety.$

label: gKadabraPokedexText
en: It emits special alpha waves from its\nbody that induce headaches just by being\nclose.$

label: gAlakazamPokedexText
en: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer.\nIts IQ (intelligence quotient) is said to\nbe around 5,000.$

label: gMachopPokedexText
en: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in\nall styles of martial arts to become even\nstronger.$

label: gMachokePokedexText
en: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must\nwear a power-save belt to be able to\nregulate its motions.$

label: gMachampPokedexText
en: Its superpowerful punches are said to\nknock the victim flying clear over the\nhorizon.$

label: gBellsproutPokedexText
en: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats\nbugs. It appears to use its root feet to\nreplenish moisture.$

label: gWeepinbellPokedexText
en: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize\nthe enemy and then finishes it with a\nspray of ACID.$

label: gVictreebelPokedexText
en: Said to live in huge colonies deep in\njungles, although no one has ever\nreturned from there.$

label: gTentacoolPokedexText
en: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook\nthem by accident are often punished by\ntheir stingers.$

label: gTentacruelPokedexText
en: The tentacles are normally kept short.\nOn hunts, they are extended to ensnare\nand immobilize prey.$

label: gGeodudePokedexText
en: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking\nthem for boulders, people often step or\ntrip on them.$

label: gGravelerPokedexText
en: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over\nany obstacle without slowing or changing\nits direction.$

label: gGolemPokedexText
en: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard.\nIt can easily withstand dynamite blasts\nwithout taking damage.$

label: gPonytaPokedexText
en: Its hooves are ten times harder than\ndiamond. It can trample anything\ncompletely flat in little time.$

label: gRapidashPokedexText
en: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase\nanything that moves fast in the hopes of\nracing it.$

label: gSlowpokePokedexText
en: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five\nseconds for it to feel pain when under\nattack.$

label: gSlowbroPokedexText
en: The SHELLDER that latches onto\nSLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the\nhost's leftover scraps.$

label: gMagnemitePokedexText
en: Uses antigravity to stay suspended.\nAppears without warning and uses THUNDER\nWAVE and similar moves.$

label: gMagnetonPokedexText
en: Formed by several MAGNEMITE linked\ntogether. They frequently appear when\nsunspots flare up.$

label: gFarfetchdPokedexText
en: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon.\nThe stalk is used like a sword to cut all\nsorts of things.$

label: gDoduoPokedexText
en: A bird that makes up for its poor flying\nwith its fast foot speed. Leaves giant\nfootprints.$

label: gDodrioPokedexText
en: Uses its three brains to execute complex\nplans. While two heads sleep, one head is\nsaid to stay awake.$

label: gSeelPokedexText
en: The protruding horn on its head is very\nhard. It is used for bashing through thick\nicebergs.$

label: gDewgongPokedexText
en: It stores thermal energy in the body.\nIt swims at a steady eight knots even in\nintensely cold waters.$

label: gGrimerPokedexText
en: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by\nsucking up polluted sludge that is pumped\nout of factories.$

label: gMukPokedexText
en: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile\nsludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints\ncontain poison.$

label: gShellderPokedexText
en: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack.\nIt is vulnerable only when its shell is\nopen.$

label: gCloysterPokedexText
en: When attacked, it launches its horns in\nquick volleys. Its innards have never been\nseen.$

label: gGastlyPokedexText
en: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON\ncloaks the target and puts it to sleep\nwithout notice.$

label: gHaunterPokedexText
en: Because of its ability to slip through\nblock walls, it is said to be from another\ndimension.$

label: gGengarPokedexText
en: On the night of a full moon, if shadows\nmove on their own and laugh, it must be\nGENGAR's doing.$

label: gOnixPokedexText
en: As it grows, the stone portions of its\nbody harden to become similar to\nblack-colored diamonds.$

label: gDrowzeePokedexText
en: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their\ndreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating\nonly bad dreams.$

label: gHypnoPokedexText
en: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will\nuse a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS\nand CONFUSION.$

label: gKrabbyPokedexText
en: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons,\nthey are used for balance when walking\nsideways.$

label: gKinglerPokedexText
en: The large pincer has 10,000-horsepower\ncrushing force. However, its huge size\nmakes it unwieldy to use.$

label: gVoltorbPokedexText
en: Usually found in power plants. Easily\nmistaken for a POKé BALL, it has\nzapped many people.$

label: gElectrodePokedexText
en: It stores electric energy under very high\npressure. It often explodes with little or\nno provocation.$

label: gExeggcutePokedexText
en: It is often mistaken for eggs. When\ndisturbed, they quickly gather and attack\nin swarms.$

label: gExeggutorPokedexText
en: It is said that on rare occasions, one\nof its heads will drop off and continue on\nas an EXEGGCUTE.$

label: gCubonePokedexText
en: Because it never removes its skull helmet,\nno one has ever seen this POKéMON's real\nface.$

label: gMarowakPokedexText
en: The bone it holds is its key weapon.\nIt throws the bone skillfully like a\nboomerang to KO targets.$

label: gHitmonleePokedexText
en: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen\nprogressively. It runs smoothly with\nextra-long, loping strides.$

label: gHitmonchanPokedexText
en: While apparently doing nothing, it fires\npunches in lightning-fast volleys that are\nimpossible to see.$

label: gLickitungPokedexText
en: Its tongue can be extended like a\nchameleon's. It leaves a tingling\nsensation when it licks enemies.$

label: gKoffingPokedexText
en: Because it stores several kinds of toxic\ngases in its body, it is prone to\nexploding without warning.$

label: gWeezingPokedexText
en: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two\nKOFFING can fuse into a WEEZING over\nmany years.$

label: gRhyhornPokedexText
en: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder\nthan human bones. Its TACKLE can knock a\nsemitrailer flying.$

label: gRhydonPokedexText
en: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is\ncapable of living in molten lava of 3,600\ndegrees Fahrenheit.$

label: gChanseyPokedexText
en: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said\nto bring happiness to those who manage to\ncatch one.$

label: gTangelaPokedexText
en: The whole body is swathed with wide vines\nthat are similar to seaweed. The vines\nsway as it walks.$

label: gKangaskhanPokedexText
en: The infant rarely ventures out of its\nmother's protective pouch until it is\nthree years old.$

label: gHorseaPokedexText
en: Known to shoot down flying bugs with\nprecision blasts of ink from the surface\nof the water.$

label: gSeadraPokedexText
en: It is capable of swimming backwards by\nrapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins\nand stout tail.$

label: gGoldeenPokedexText
en: Its tail fin billows like an elegant\nballroom dress, giving it the nickname of\n“The Water Queen.”$

label: gSeakingPokedexText
en: In the autumn spawning season, they can\nbe seen swimming powerfully up rivers and\ncreeks.$

label: gStaryuPokedexText
en: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly\nregenerate any appendage it loses in\nbattle.$

label: gStarmiePokedexText
en: Its central core glows with the seven\ncolors of the rainbow. Some people value\nthe core as a gem.$

label: gMrmimePokedexText
en: If interrupted while it is miming, it will\nsuddenly DOUBLESLAP the offender with its\nbroad hands.$

label: gScytherPokedexText
en: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can\ncreate the illusion that there is more\nthan one of itself.$

label: gJynxPokedexText
en: It seductively wiggles its hips as it\nwalks. It can cause people to dance in\nunison with it.$

label: gElectabuzzPokedexText
en: Normally found near power plants, they\ncan wander away and cause major\nblackouts in cities.$

label: gMagmarPokedexText
en: Its body always burns with an orange glow\nthat enables it to hide perfectly amidst\nflames.$

label: gPinsirPokedexText
en: If it fails to crush the foe in its\npincers, it will swing around and toss\nthe opponent.$

label: gTaurosPokedexText
en: When it targets an enemy, it charges\nfuriously while whipping its body with its\nlong tails.$

label: gMagikarpPokedexText
en: In the distant past, it was somewhat\nstronger than the horribly weak\ndescendants that exist today.$

label: gGyaradosPokedexText
en: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious,\nit is capable of destroying entire cities\nin a rage.$

label: gLaprasPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that has been overhunted\nalmost to extinction. It can ferry people\non its back.$

label: gDittoPokedexText
en: Capable of copying an opponent's genetic\ncode to instantly transform itself into a\nduplicate of the enemy.$

label: gEeveePokedexText
en: Its genetic code is irregular. It may\nmutate if it is exposed to radiation from\nelement STONES.$

label: gVaporeonPokedexText
en: Lives close to water. Its long tail is\nridged with a fin which is often mistaken\nfor a mermaid's.$

label: gJolteonPokedexText
en: It accumulates negative ions in the\natmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt\nlightning bolts.$

label: gFlareonPokedexText
en: When storing thermal energy in its body,\nits temperature can soar to over 1,600\ndegrees Fahrenheit.$

label: gPorygonPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that consists entirely of\nprogramming code. It is capable of moving\nfreely in cyberspace.$

label: gOmanytePokedexText
en: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it\ncan be genetically regenerated from\nfossils.$

label: gOmastarPokedexText
en: Despite having strong fangs and tentacles,\nit went extinct when its heavy shell made\nit unable to catch prey.$

label: gKabutoPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that was regenerated from a\nfossil found in what was once the ocean\nfloor long ago.$

label: gKabutopsPokedexText
en: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming.\nIt slashes prey with its claws and drains\ntheir fluids.$

label: gAerodactylPokedexText
en: A ferocious, prehistoric POKéMON that\ngoes for the enemy's throat with its\nserrated, sawlike fangs.$

label: gSnorlaxPokedexText
en: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its\nrotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily\nmore slothful.$

label: gArticunoPokedexText
en: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to\nappear to doomed people who are lost in\nicy mountains.$

label: gZapdosPokedexText
en: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to\nappear from clouds while dropping\nenormous lightning bolts.$

label: gMoltresPokedexText
en: It is said to be the legendary bird\nPOKéMON of fire. Every flap of its wings\ncreates a dazzling flare of flames.$

label: gDratiniPokedexText
en: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until\nrecently, when a small colony was found\nliving underwater.$

label: gDragonairPokedexText
en: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle\naura. It is said to have the ability to\nchange the weather.$

label: gDragonitePokedexText
en: Only a very few people ever see this\nPOKéMON. Its intelligence is said to\nmatch that of humans.$

label: gMewtwoPokedexText
en: It was created by a scientist after years\nof horrific gene-splicing and DNA-\nengineering experiments.$

label: gMewPokedexText
en: So rare that it is still said to be a\nmirage by many experts. Only a few people\nhave seen it worldwide.$

label: gChikoritaPokedexText
en: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf\non its head. It is docile and loves to\nsoak up the sun's rays.$

label: gBayleefPokedexText
en: The scent of spices comes from around\nits neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you\nwant to fight.$

label: gMeganiumPokedexText
en: The aroma that rises from its petals\ncontains a substance that calms aggressive\nfeelings.$

label: gCyndaquilPokedexText
en: It is timid and always curls itself up in\na ball. If attacked, it flares up its back\nfor protection.$

label: gQuilavaPokedexText
en: Be careful if it turns its back during\nbattle. It means that it will attack with\nthe fire on its back.$

label: gTyphlosionPokedexText
en: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that\nanything that touches it will instantly go\nup in flames.$

label: gTotodilePokedexText
en: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and\ncapable of crushing anything. Even its\nTRAINER must be careful.$

label: gCroconawPokedexText
en: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back\nin its place. There are always 48 fangs\nlining its mouth.$

label: gFeraligatrPokedexText
en: When it bites with its massive and\npowerful jaws, it shakes its head and\nsavagely tears up its victim.$

label: gSentretPokedexText
en: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself\nup using its tail to get a better view of\nits surroundings.$

label: gFurretPokedexText
en: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny\nbody. The nest is impossible for other\nPOKéMON to enter.$

label: gHoothootPokedexText
en: It always stands on one foot. It changes\nfeet so fast, the movement can rarely be\nseen.$

label: gNoctowlPokedexText
en: Its eyes are specially adapted. They\nconcentrate even faint light and enable it\nto see in the dark.$

label: gLedybaPokedexText
en: It is very timid. It will be afraid to\nmove if it is alone. But it will be active\nif it is in a group.$

label: gLedianPokedexText
en: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it\nflutters about, scattering a glowing\npowder.$

label: gSpinarakPokedexText
en: It lies still in the same pose for days\nin its web, waiting for its unsuspecting\nprey to wander close.$

label: gAriadosPokedexText
en: It spins string not only from its rear but\nalso from its mouth. It is hard to tell\nwhich end is which.$

label: gCrobatPokedexText
en: It flies so silently through the dark on\nits four wings that it may not be noticed\neven when nearby.$

label: gChinchouPokedexText
en: It shoots positive and negative\nelectricity between the tips of its two\nantennae and zaps its enemies.$

label: gLanturnPokedexText
en: The light it emits is so bright that it can\nilluminate the sea's surface from a depth\nof over three miles.$

label: gPichuPokedexText
en: It is not yet skilled at storing\nelectricity. It may send out a jolt if\namused or startled.$

label: gCleffaPokedexText
en: Because of its unusual, starlike\nsilhouette, people believe that it came\nhere on a meteor.$

label: gIgglybuffPokedexText
en: It has a very soft body. If it starts to\nroll, it will bounce all over and be\nimpossible to stop.$

label: gTogepiPokedexText
en: The shell seems to be filled with joy.\nIt is said that it will share good luck\nwhen treated kindly.$

label: gTogeticPokedexText
en: They say that it will appear before\nkindhearted, caring people and shower\nthem with happiness.$

label: gNatuPokedexText
en: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown,\nit has to hop to get around. It is always\nstaring at something.$

label: gXatuPokedexText
en: They say that it stays still and quiet\nbecause it is seeing both the past and\nfuture at the same time.$

label: gMareepPokedexText
en: If static electricity builds in its body,\nits fleece doubles in volume. Touching\nit will shock you.$

label: gFlaaffyPokedexText
