en: As a result of storing too much\nelectricity, it developed patches where\neven downy wool won't grow.$

label: gAmpharosPokedexText
en: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be\nseen from far away. It acts as a beacon\nfor lost people.$

label: gBellossomPokedexText
en: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to\ndance. They say that the dance is a\nritual to summon the sun.$

label: gMarillPokedexText
en: The tip of its tail, which contains oil\nthat is lighter than water, lets it swim\nwithout drowning.$

label: gAzumarillPokedexText
en: By keeping still and listening intently, it\ncan even tell what is in wild, fast-moving\nrivers.$

label: gSudowoodoPokedexText
en: Although it always pretends to be a tree,\nits composition appears to be closer to a\nrock than a plant.$

label: gPolitoedPokedexText
en: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its\nechoing cry, they respond by gathering\nfrom far and wide.$

label: gHoppipPokedexText
en: To keep from being blown away by the\nwind, they gather in clusters. They do\nenjoy gentle breezes, though.$

label: gSkiploomPokedexText
en: The bloom on top of its head opens and\ncloses as the temperature fluctuates up\nand down.$

label: gJumpluffPokedexText
en: Once it catches the wind, it deftly\ncontrols its cotton-puff spores to float,\neven around the world.$

label: gAipomPokedexText
en: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it\nto grab a tree branch and hold itself up\nin the air.$

label: gSunkernPokedexText
en: It may drop out of the sky suddenly.\nIf attacked by a SPEAROW, it will\nviolently shake its leaves.$

label: gSunfloraPokedexText
en: It converts sunlight into energy. In the\ndarkness after sunset, it closes its petals\nand becomes still.$

label: gYanmaPokedexText
en: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can\ngenerate shock waves that will shatter\nwindows in the area.$

label: gWooperPokedexText
en: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will\nleave the water to search for food when\nit gets cold outside.$

label: gQuagsirePokedexText
en: This carefree POKéMON has an easygoing\nnature. While swimming, it always bumps\ninto boat hulls.$

label: gEspeonPokedexText
en: It uses the fine hair that covers its body\nto sense air currents and predict its\nenemy's actions.$

label: gUmbreonPokedexText
en: When agitated, this POKéMON protects\nitself by spraying poisonous sweat from its\npores.$

label: gMurkrowPokedexText
en: Feared and loathed by many, it is\nbelieved to bring misfortune to all those\nwho see it at night.$

label: gSlowkingPokedexText
en: It has incredible intellect and intuition.\nWhatever the situation, it remains calm\nand collected.$

label: gMisdreavusPokedexText
en: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as\nscreaming and wailing to startle people at\nnight. $

label: gUnownPokedexText
en: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on\nancient tablets. It is said that the two\nare somehow related.$

label: gWobbuffetPokedexText
en: It hates light and shock. If attacked,\nit inflates its body to pump up its\ncounterstrike.$

label: gGirafarigPokedexText
en: Its tail has a small brain of its own.\nBeware! If you get close, it may react\nto your scent and bite.$

label: gPinecoPokedexText
en: It likes to make its shell thicker by\nadding layers of tree bark. The extra\nweight doesn't bother it.$

label: gForretressPokedexText
en: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-\nhard shell. What lurks inside the armor is\na total mystery.$

label: gDunsparcePokedexText
en: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes\nbackward by furiously boring into the\nground with its tail.$

label: gGligarPokedexText
en: It flies straight at its target's face,\nthen clamps down on the startled\nvictim to inject poison.$

label: gSteelixPokedexText
en: Its body has been compressed deep under\nthe ground. As a result, it is even harder\nthan diamond.$

label: gSnubbullPokedexText
en: Although it looks frightening, it is\nactually kind and affectionate. It is very\npopular among women.$

label: gGranbullPokedexText
en: It is actually timid and easily spooked.\nIf attacked, it flails about to fend off\nits attacker.$

label: gQwilfishPokedexText
en: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate\nits body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of \nwater all at once.$

label: gScizorPokedexText
en: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to\nscare its foes. This makes it look like it\nhas three heads.$

label: gShucklePokedexText
en: The BERRIES it stores in its vaselike\nshell decompose and become a gooey\nliquid.$

label: gHeracrossPokedexText
en: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized\nhorn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts\nand throws them.$

label: gSneaselPokedexText
en: Its paws conceal sharp claws.\nIf attacked, it suddenly extends the\nclaws and startles its enemy.$

label: gTeddiursaPokedexText
en: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows.\nIt always licks its paws because they are\nsoaked with honey.$

label: gUrsaringPokedexText
en: Although it is a good climber, it prefers\nto snap stout trees with its forelegs and\neat fallen BERRIES.$

label: gSlugmaPokedexText
en: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving\nbecause if it stopped, its magma body\nwould cool and harden.$

label: gMagcargoPokedexText
en: The shell on its back is just skin that\nhas cooled and hardened. It breaks easily\nwith a slight touch.$

label: gSwinubPokedexText
en: It rubs its snout on the ground to find\nand dig up food. It sometimes discovers\nhot springs.$

label: gPiloswinePokedexText
en: Because the long hair all over its body\nobscures its sight, it just keeps charging\nrepeatedly.$

label: gCorsolaPokedexText
en: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip\nof its head is prized as a treasure for\nits beauty.$

label: gRemoraidPokedexText
en: It has superb accuracy. The water it\nshoots out can strike even moving prey\nfrom more than 100 yards.$

label: gOctilleryPokedexText
en: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped\ntentacles, then smashes them with its\nrock-hard head.$

label: gDelibirdPokedexText
en: It carries food all day long. There are\ntales about lost people who were saved\nby the food it had.$

label: gMantinePokedexText
en: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care\nif REMORAID attach to it to scavenge\nfor its leftovers.$

label: gSkarmoryPokedexText
en: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but its bones\nare hollow and light, allowing it to fly\nfreely in the sky.$

label: gHoundourPokedexText
en: It uses different kinds of cries for\ncommunicating with others of its kind and\nfor pursuing prey.$

label: gHoundoomPokedexText
en: If you are burned by the flames it shoots\nfrom its mouth, the pain will never go\naway.$

label: gKingdraPokedexText
en: It is said that it usually hides in\nunderwater caves. It can create\nwhirlpools by yawning.$

label: gPhanpyPokedexText
en: It swings its long snout around playfully,\nbut because it is so strong, this can be\ndangerous.$

label: gDonphanPokedexText
en: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged\nhide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to\nknock down a house.$

label: gPorygon2PokedexText
en: This upgraded version of PORYGON is\ndesigned for space exploration. However,\nit can't even fly.$

label: gStantlerPokedexText
en: Its curved antlers subtly change the flow\nof air to create a strange space where\nreality is distorted.$

label: gSmearglePokedexText
en: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its\ntail. It paints the fluid everywhere to\nmark its territory.$

label: gTyroguePokedexText
en: It is always bursting with energy. To make\nitself stronger, it keeps on fighting even\nif it loses.$

label: gHitmontopPokedexText
en: If you become enchanted by its smooth,\nelegant, dance-like kicks, you may get\ndrilled hard.$

label: gSmoochumPokedexText
en: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on\nits body. It always uses its lips first to\nexamine things.$

label: gElekidPokedexText
en: It rotates its arms to generate\nelectricity, but it tires easily, so it\ncharges up only a little bit.$

label: gMagbyPokedexText
en: Each and every time it inhales and\nexhales, hot embers dribble out of its\nmouth and nostrils.$

label: gMiltankPokedexText
en: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making\nit the ultimate beverage for the sick or\nweary.$

label: gBlisseyPokedexText
en: Anyone who takes even one bite of\nBLISSEY's egg becomes unfailingly caring\nand pleasant to everyone.$

label: gRaikouPokedexText
en: The rain clouds it carries let it fire\nthunderbolts at will. They say that it\ndescended with lightning.$

label: gEnteiPokedexText
en: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to\nrestrain its extreme power, it races\nheadlong around the land.$

label: gSuicunePokedexText
en: Said to be the reincarnation of north\nwinds, it can instantly purify filthy,\nmurky water.$

label: gLarvitarPokedexText
en: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a\nlarge mountain, it will fall asleep so it\ncan grow.$

label: gPupitarPokedexText
en: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it\nis also very strong. Its THRASHING can\ntopple a mountain.$

label: gTyranitarPokedexText
en: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of\nattack, so it is very eager to make\nchallenges against enemies.$

label: gLugiaPokedexText
en: It is said that it quietly spends its time\ndeep at the bottom of the sea because\nits powers are too strong.$

label: gHoOhPokedexText
en: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the\nworld's skies continuously on its\nmagnificent seven-colored wings.$

label: gCelebiPokedexText
en: This POKéMON wanders across time.\nGrass and trees flourish in the forests in\nwhich it has appeared.$

label: gTreeckoPokedexText
en: It quickly scales even vertical walls.\nIt senses humidity with its tail to predict\nthe next day's weather.$

label: gGrovylePokedexText
en: Its strongly developed thigh muscles\ngive it astounding agility and jumping\nperformance.$

label: gSceptilePokedexText
en: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp\nas swords. It agilely leaps about the\nbranches of trees to strike.$

label: gTorchicPokedexText
en: It has a flame sac inside its belly that\nperpetually burns. It feels warm if it is\nhugged.$

label: gCombuskenPokedexText
en: It boosts its concentration by emitting\nharsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding\ndestructive power.$

label: gBlazikenPokedexText
en: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames\nfrom its wrists. Its powerful legs let it\njump clear over buildings.$

label: gMudkipPokedexText
en: Its large tail fin propels it through\nwater with powerful acceleration. It is\nstrong in spite of its size.$

label: gMarshtompPokedexText
en: It is at its best when on muddy ground\nwith poor footing. It quickly overwhelms\nfoes struggling in mud.$

label: gSwampertPokedexText
en: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing,\nthey can batter down its foe. It makes its\nnest on beautiful beaches.$

label: gPoochyenaPokedexText
en: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute\nsense of smell lets it chase a chosen\nprey without ever losing track.$

label: gMightyenaPokedexText
en: It will always obey the commands of a\nskilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from\nits living in packs in ancient times.$

label: gZigzagoonPokedexText
en: A POKéMON with abundant curiosity.\nIt shows an interest in everything, so it\nalways zigs and zags.$

label: gLinoonePokedexText
en: When running in a straight line, it can top\n60 miles per hour. However, it has a\ntough time with curved roads.$

label: gWurmplePokedexText
en: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests.\nWhen attacked, it resists by pointing its\nvenomous spikes at the foe.$

label: gSilcoonPokedexText
en: It conserves its energy by moving as\nlittle as possible. It awaits evolution\nwhile drinking only a little rainwater.$

label: gBeautiflyPokedexText
en: Despite its appearance, it has an\naggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing\nwith its long, thin mouth.$

label: gCascoonPokedexText
en: Its body, which is made of soft silk,\nhardens over time. When cracks appear,\nevolution is near.$

label: gDustoxPokedexText
en: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it\nsenses danger. They tend to gather in the\nglow of streetlamps at night.$

label: gLotadPokedexText
en: It searches about for clean water. If it\ndoes not drink water for too long, the\nleaf on its head wilts.$

label: gLombrePokedexText
en: It lives at the water's edge where it is\nsunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass\nby day and becomes active at night.$

label: gLudicoloPokedexText
en: The rhythm of bright, festive music\nactivates LUDICOLO's cells, making it more\npowerful.$

label: gSeedotPokedexText
en: If it remains still, it becomes impossible\nto distinguish from real nuts. It delights\nin surprising foraging PIDGEY.$

label: gNuzleafPokedexText
en: They live in holes bored in large trees.\nThe sound of NUZLEAF's grass flute fills\nlisteners with dread.$

label: gShiftryPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest\nguardian. It can read the foe's mind and\ntake preemptive action.$

label: gTaillowPokedexText
en: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to\nother lands in search of warmth, flying\nover 180 miles a day.$

label: gSwellowPokedexText
en: If its two tail feathers are standing at\nattention, it is proof of good health.\nIt soars elegantly in the sky.$

label: gWingullPokedexText
en: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were\na glider. In the winter, it hides food\naround its nest.$

label: gPelipperPokedexText
en: It is a flying transporter that carries\nsmall POKéMON in its beak. It bobs on the\nwaves to rest its wings.$

label: gRaltsPokedexText
en: It is highly attuned to the emotions of\npeople and POKéMON. It hides if it senses\nhostility.$

label: gKirliaPokedexText
en: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives\nit energy for its psychokinetic power.\nIt spins and dances when happy.$

label: gGardevoirPokedexText
en: It has the power to predict the future.\nIts power peaks when it is protecting its\nTRAINER.$

label: gSurskitPokedexText
en: They usually live on ponds, but after an\nevening shower, they may appear on\npuddles in towns.$

label: gMasquerainPokedexText
en: The antennae have distinctive patterns\nthat look like eyes. When it rains, they\ngrow heavy, making flight impossible.$

label: gShroomishPokedexText
en: It prefers damp places. By day it remains\nstill in the forest shade. It releases\ntoxic powder from its head.$

label: gBreloomPokedexText
en: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic\nspores. It knocks out foes with quick,\nvirtually invisible punches.$

label: gSlakothPokedexText
en: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making\ndrowsy those that see it is one of\nits abilities.$

label: gVigorothPokedexText
en: It is always hungry because it won't stop\nrampaging. Even while it is eating, it\ncan't keep still.$

label: gSlakingPokedexText
en: It is the world's most slothful POKéMON.\nHowever, it can exert horrifying power by\nreleasing pent-up energy all at once.$

label: gNincadaPokedexText
en: Because it lived almost entirely\nunderground, it is nearly blind.\nIt uses its antennae instead.$

label: gNinjaskPokedexText
en: This POKéMON is so quick, it is said to\nbe able to avoid any attack. It loves to\nfeed on tree sap.$

label: gShedinjaPokedexText
en: A most peculiar POKéMON that somehow\nappears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA\nevolves.$

label: gWhismurPokedexText
en: It usually murmurs, but starts crying\nloudly if it senses danger. It stops when\nits ear covers are shut.$

label: gLoudredPokedexText
en: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it\ngenerates ultrasonic waves that can blow\napart a house.$

label: gExploudPokedexText
en: It emits a variety of sounds from the \nholes all over its body. Its loud cries\ncan be heard from over six miles away.$

label: gMakuhitaPokedexText
en: It grows stronger by enduring harsh\ntraining. It is a gutsy POKéMON that can\nwithstand any attack.$

label: gHariyamaPokedexText
en: It stomps on the ground to build power.\nIt can send a 10-ton truck flying with a\nstraight-arm punch.$

label: gAzurillPokedexText
en: It battles by flinging around its tail,\nwhich is bigger than its body. The\ntail is a flotation device in water.$

label: gNosepassPokedexText
en: Its magnetic nose consistently faces\nnorth. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get\ntheir bearings.$

label: gSkittyPokedexText
en: It is said to be difficult to earn its\ntrust. However, it is extremely popular\nfor its cute looks and behavior.$

label: gDelcattyPokedexText
en: The favorite of trend-conscious\nfemale TRAINERS, they are used in\ncompetition for their style and fur.$

label: gSableyePokedexText
en: It feeds on gemstone crystals.\nIn darkness, its eyes sparkle with the\nglitter of jewels.$

label: gMawilePokedexText
en: It uses its docile-looking face to lull\nfoes into complacency, then bites with its\nhuge, relentless jaws.$

label: gAronPokedexText
en: It eats iron to build its steel body.\nIt is a pest that descends from mountains\nto eat bridges and train tracks.$

label: gLaironPokedexText
en: It habitually shows off its strength with\nthe size of sparks it creates by ramming\nits steel body into boulders.$

label: gAggronPokedexText
en: It claims a large mountain as its sole\nterritory. It mercilessly thrashes those\nthat violate its space.$

label: gMedititePokedexText
en: It never skips its daily yoga training.\nIt heightens its inner strength through\nmeditation.$

label: gMedichamPokedexText
en: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-\nlike steps, then launches a devastating\nblow in the same motion.$

label: gElectrikePokedexText
en: It stores static electricity in its fur\nfor discharging. It gives off sparks if a\nstorm approaches.$

label: gManectricPokedexText
en: It rarely appears before people.\nIt is said to nest where lightning has\nfallen.$

label: gPluslePokedexText
en: It cheers on partners while scattering\nsparks from its body. It climbs telephone\npoles to absorb electricity.$

label: gMinunPokedexText
en: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter\nunder the eaves of houses in rain. It uses\npom-poms made of sparks for cheering.$

label: gVolbeatPokedexText
en: It lives around clean ponds. At night,\nits rear lights up. It converses with\nothers by flashing its light.$

label: gIllumisePokedexText
en: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night\nskies. There are scientists that study the\npatterns it creates.$

label: gRoseliaPokedexText
en: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance.\nThe stronger its aroma, the healthier\nthe ROSELIA is.$

label: gGulpinPokedexText
en: There is nothing its stomach can't digest.\nWhile it is digesting, vile, overpowering\ngases are expelled.$

label: gSwalotPokedexText
en: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp.\nIt secretes a horribly toxic fluid from\nthe pores on its body.$

label: gCarvanhaPokedexText
en: It lives in massive rivers that course\nthrough jungles. It swarms prey that\nenter its territory.$

label: gSharpedoPokedexText
en: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that\ncrunch through iron. It swims by jetting\nwater from its rear.$

label: gWailmerPokedexText
en: When it sucks in a large volume of\nseawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy\nball. It eats a ton of food daily.$

label: gWailordPokedexText
en: It is among the largest of all POKéMON.\nIt herds prey in a pack then swallows the\nmassed prey in one gulp.$

label: gNumelPokedexText
en: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit\ncourses through its body. When it grows\ncold, the magma hardens and slows it.$

label: gCameruptPokedexText
en: If angered, the humps on its back erupt\nin a shower of molten lava. It lives in\nthe craters of volcanoes.$

label: gTorkoalPokedexText
en: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is\nattacked, it belches thick, black smoke\nand flees.$

label: gSpoinkPokedexText
en: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing\nabout. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL\non its head.$

label: gGrumpigPokedexText
en: It can gain control over foes by doing\nodd dance steps. The black pearls on its\nforehead are precious gems.$

label: gSpindaPokedexText
en: No two SPINDA are said to have identical\npatterns. It confuses foes with its\nstumbling motions.$

label: gTrapinchPokedexText
en: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a\nsloping pit trap in sand where it\npatiently awaits prey.$

label: gVibravaPokedexText
en: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently\nflapping its wings. After making its prey\nfaint, it melts the prey with acid.$

label: gFlygonPokedexText
en: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand\nwith its wings. Red covers shield its eyes\nfrom sand.$

label: gCacneaPokedexText
en: It prefers harsh environments such as\ndeserts. It can survive for 30 days on\nwater stored in its body.$

label: gCacturnePokedexText
en: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at\nnight when it hunts for prey exhausted\nfrom the desert's heat.$

label: gSwabluPokedexText
en: It constantly grooms its cotton-like\nwings. It takes a shower to clean\nitself if it becomes dirty.$

label: gAltariaPokedexText
en: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling\ndeep among mountains far from people,\nit is ALTARIA's humming.$

label: gZangoosePokedexText
en: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur\nbristles and it assumes its battle pose.\nIts sharp claws are its best weapon.$

label: gSeviperPokedexText
en: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard\nrocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes\nunwary prey with venomous fangs.$

label: gLunatonePokedexText
en: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar\ncycle. It brims with power when exposed\nto the light of the full moon.$

label: gSolrockPokedexText
en: It absorbs solar energy during the day.\nAlways expressionless, it can sense what\nits foe is thinking.$

label: gBarboachPokedexText
en: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two\nlong whiskers. A slimy film protects its\nbody.$

label: gWhiscashPokedexText
en: It makes its nest at the bottom of \nswamps. It will eat anything - if it is\nalive, WHISCASH will eat it.$

label: gCorphishPokedexText
en: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy\ncreature that will quickly proliferate,\neven in polluted streams.$

label: gCrawdauntPokedexText
en: A rough customer that wildly flails its\ngiant claws. It is said to be extremely\nhard to raise.$

label: gBaltoyPokedexText
en: It was discovered in ancient ruins.\nWhile moving, it constantly spins. It\nstands on one foot even when asleep.$

label: gClaydolPokedexText
en: It appears to have been born from clay\ndolls made by ancient people. It uses\ntelekinesis to float and move.$

label: gLileepPokedexText
en: It became extinct roughly 100 million\nyears ago. It was regenerated from a\nfossil using advanced techniques.$

label: gCradilyPokedexText
en: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles.\nIt then melts the prey with a strong acid\nbefore feeding.$

label: gAnorithPokedexText
en: It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor.\nIt uses its extending claws to catch prey\nhiding among rocks on the seafloor.$

label: gArmaldoPokedexText
en: Protected by a hard shell, its body is\nvery sturdy. It skewers prey with its\nclaws to feed.$

label: gFeebasPokedexText
en: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance,\nit is ignored by researchers. It lives in\nponds choked with weeds.$

label: gMiloticPokedexText
en: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful.\nThose that see it are said to forget their\ncombative spirits.$

label: gCastformPokedexText
en: It has the ability to change its form into\nthe sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, \ndepending on the weather.$

label: gKecleonPokedexText
en: It changes body color to blend in with\nits surroundings. It also changes color if\nit is happy or sad.$

label: gShuppetPokedexText
en: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and\nmalice. Its upright horn catches the\nemotions of people.$

label: gBanettePokedexText
en: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet\ninto a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth,\nits cursed energy escapes.$

label: gDuskullPokedexText
en: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks\nup to prey. It has the ability to slip\nthrough thick walls.$

label: gDusclopsPokedexText
en: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens\nits mouth, it sucks everything in as if it\nwere a black hole.$

label: gTropiusPokedexText
en: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of\nfruit around its neck is delicious.\nThe fruit grows twice a year.$

label: gChimechoPokedexText
en: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly\nuses its long tail to pluck nuts and\nberries, which it loves to eat.$

label: gAbsolPokedexText
en: It appears when it senses an impending\nnatural disaster. As a result, it was\nmistaken as a doom-bringer.$

label: gWynautPokedexText
en: It tends to move in a pack with others.\nThey cluster in a tight group to sleep in\na cave.$

label: gSnoruntPokedexText
en: It is said that a home visited by a\nSNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand\ncold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.$

label: gGlaliePokedexText
en: It has a body of ice that won't melt,\neven with fire. It can instantly freeze\nmoisture in the atmosphere.$

label: gSphealPokedexText
en: Its body is covered in fluffy fur.\nThe fur keeps it from feeling cold while\nit is rolling on ice.$

label: gSealeoPokedexText
en: It touches new things with its nose to\ntest for smell and feel. It plays by\nspinning SPHEAL on its nose.$

label: gWalreinPokedexText
en: It swims through icy seas while shattering\nice floes with its large tusks. It is\nprotected by its thick blubber.$

label: gClamperlPokedexText
en: It is protected by a sturdy shell.\nOnce in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent\npearl.$

label: gHuntailPokedexText
en: It lives deep in the sea where no light\never filters down. It lights up its small\nfishlike tail to attract prey.$

label: gGorebyssPokedexText
en: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant.\nWith its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed\nthat grows between rocks.$

label: gRelicanthPokedexText
en: It has remained unchanged for 100\nmillion years. It was discovered\nduring a deep-sea exploration.$

label: gLuvdiscPokedexText
en: During the spawning season, countless\nLUVDISC congregate at coral reefs,\nturning the waters pink.$

label: gBagonPokedexText
en: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders.\nIt longingly hopes for wings to grow so it\ncan fly.$

label: gShelgonPokedexText
en: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce\noff. The armor is too tough, however,\nmaking it heavy and somewhat sluggish.$

label: gSalamencePokedexText
en: It becomes uncontrollable if it is\nenraged. It destroys everything with\nshredding claws and fire.$

label: gBeldumPokedexText
en: It uses magnetic waves to converse with\nits kind. All the cells in its body are\nmagnetic.$

label: gMetangPokedexText
en: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body\nis so tough, even a crash with a jet\nplane won't leave a scratch.$

label: gMetagrossPokedexText
en: It is formed by two METANG fusing.\nIts four brains are said to be superior\nto a supercomputer.$

label: gRegirockPokedexText
en: It is entirely composed of rocks with no\nsign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery\neven to modern scientists.$

label: gRegicePokedexText
en: Research revealed that its body is made\nof the same kind of ice that is found at\nthe South Pole.$

label: gRegisteelPokedexText
en: It is sturdier than any kind of metal.\nIt hardened due to pressure underground\nover tens of thousands of years.$

label: gLatiasPokedexText
en: It can telepathically communicate with\npeople. It changes its appearance using\nits down that refracts light.$

label: gLatiosPokedexText
en: It has a docile temperament and dislikes\nfighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can\nfly faster than a jet plane.$

label: gKyogrePokedexText
en: This POKéMON is said to have expanded\nthe sea by bringing heavy rains.\nIt has the power to control water.$

label: gGroudonPokedexText
en: This legendary POKéMON is said to\nrepresent the land. It went to sleep after\ndueling KYOGRE.$

label: gRayquazaPokedexText
en: It has lived for hundreds of millions of\nyears in the ozone layer. Its flying form\nlooks like a meteor.$

label: gJirachiPokedexText
en: It is said to make any wish come true.\nIt is awake for only seven days out of\na thousand years.$

label: gDeoxysPokedexText
en: When it changes form, an aurora appears.\nIt absorbs attacks by altering its\ncellular structure.$

label: sFlashFireDescription
en: Powers up if hit by fire.$

label: sOvergrowDescription
en: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.$

label: sBlazeDescription
en: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.$

label: sTorrentDescription
en: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.$

label: sSwarmDescription
en: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.$

label: gTeachyTvString_RegisterItem
en: How do I register an item?$

label: gTeachyTvText_PokedudeSaysHello
en: Hey, all you TRAINERS out there!\nHELLO, TRAINERS!\p……… ……… ………\pCome on, let me hear you!\nHELLO, TRAINERS!\lIt's me, the POKé DUDE!\p$

label: gTeachyTvText_BattleScript1
en:
Today, the POKé DUDE's here to
tell you about how you can battle\lPOKéMON!\pSay you're out for a stroll when,
suddenly, a wild POKéMON appears!\pIt's up to you to smartly use your
POKéMON and their moves to reduce\lthe opponent's HP to nothing, and\lclaim victory!\pI'll show you how to do that in
person and for sure!\pAll righty, here goes!\pKeep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!$

label: gTeachyTvText_BattleScript2
en:
Well, did you get that?\pEven if your own POKéMON's HP
falls to zero, and it becomes\lunable to battle, not to worry!\pJust take it to any POKéMON
CENTER and heal it!\pAll righty, be seeing you!\pRemember, TRAINERS, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!$

label: gTeachyTvText_StatusScript1
en:
Today, the POKé DUDE's here to
tell you about status problems!\pStatus problems include poisoning,
paralysis, sleep, burn…\pThere are a couple others, but
they really are trouble.\pGet any one, and your POKéMON
may become useless in battle.\pYou know, it hurts the POKé DUDE
to see a POKéMON suffer…\pSo, what should you do if your
POKéMON gets a status problem?\pWell, you've got me to show you!\pAll righty, here goes!\pKeep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!$

label: gTeachyTvText_StatusScript2
en:
Poisoning or paralysis don't go
away after a battle.\pIf a POKéMON is poisoned, it loses
HP even while you're walking.\pYou should heal POKéMON of these
kinds of problems right away.\pUse an item, or try to get to a
POKéMON CENTER for healing.\pThat wasn't hard, was it?
All righty, be seeing you!\pRemember, TRAINERS, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!$

label: gTeachyTvText_MatchupsScript1
en:
Does everyone know about type
matchups?\pPOKéMON and their moves all
belong to certain types.\pFor example, there are such types
as GRASS and WATER.\pYou need to consider the type of
the move used to attack…\pAnd, the type of the POKéMON that
is hit by that attack.\pDepending on how those two types
match up, the damage can change.\pYou see, it depends on whether
the type matchup is good or bad.\pIf you don't know how matchups
work, battles will be tough.\pSo, let me demonstrate exactly
what I mean.\pAll righty, here goes!\pKeep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!$

label: gTeachyTvText_MatchupsScript2
en:
Is it possible to launch an attack
that will inflict heavy damage?\pDoes the opposing POKéMON pose
a threat to your POKéMON?\pIs there any chance that it may
have disastrously tough moves?\pWatch the type matchups to gain
the upper hand!\pAll righty, be seeing you!\pOh, for the COOL-type POKé DUDE,
AWESOME-type kids like you match\lup perfectly!\pRemember, a good deed a day
brings happiness to stay!$

label: gTeachyTvText_CatchingScript1
en:
Today, the POKé DUDE's going to
show you how to catch POKéMON!\pJust imagine… A groovy POKéMON
suddenly appearing in the wild!\pOh, you want it!
You just can't help it!\pOh, you have to catch it!
You gotta have it!\pLet me show you how you can make
it happen!\pAll righty, here goes!\pKeep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!$

label: gTeachyTvText_CatchingScript2
en:
If your first POKé BALL fails to
catch the POKéMON, don't give up!\pKeep throwing POKé BALLS…
It's bound to work sometime!\pAll righty, be seeing you!\pRemember, TRAINERS, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!$

label: gTeachyTvText_TMsScript1
en:
Hey, everyone!
Do you all have TMs?\pA TM, Technical Machine, is an
amazingly great item!\pIt teaches POKéMON a move that
it may not learn when leveling up!\pIsn't that just great? What a
convenient world we live in!\pOpen the TM CASE and check out
the TMs you have.\pYou can check them out in detail,
too.$

label: gPokedudeText_TMTypes
en:
POKé DUDE: NORMAL, WATER, GRASS…
TMs also come in types.\pCheck the type and teach it to
a POKéMON that matches up well.\pFor example, WATER PULSE is
suitable for WATER-type POKéMON.\pBULLET SEED is a move that most
GRASS-type POKéMON can learn.\pThere's one other thing!$

label: gPokedudeText_ReadTMDescription
en:
Don't just look at the type, read
the description, too.\pIt will contain hints about what
POKéMON might learn the move.\pFor example, take a move like
FOCUS PUNCH.\pIt doesn't sound like anything a
bird or fish POKéMON can learn.\pSo, try using it on POKéMON with
arms that can throw punches!$

label: gTeachyTvText_TMsScript2
en: Wow, I talked a lot today!\nAll righty, be seeing you!\pRemember, TRAINERS, a good deed\na day brings happiness to stay!$

label: gTeachyTvText_RegisterScript1
en:
A TRAINER's BAG has a bunch of
nifty, convenient features!\pTake stuff in the KEY ITEMS
POCKET, for instance.\pYou can use a key item without
opening the BAG every time.\pFor example, let's pretend I have
a TEACHY TV in my BAG.\pI can register it for instant use,
and I'll show you how!\pAll righty, here goes!\pKeep your eyes glued to the sorta
super POKé DUDE SHOW!$

label: gTeachyTvText_RegisterScript2
en:
And now, your TEACHY TV is
registered.\pHow do you use it?
Well, here's how it works.\pOnce an item in the KEY ITEMS
POKCET is registered, you can use\lit by pressing SELECT.\pSo, you've given yourself
one-touch access to TEACHY TV.\pAll it takes for you to see me is
pressing one button!\pThat kind of attention is a little
embarrassing!\pAll righty, be seeing you!\pRemember, TRAINERS, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!$

label: ITEM_SS_TICKET:description_english
en: The ticket required for sailing on\nthe ferry S.S. ANNE.\nIt has a drawing of a ship on it.$

label: ITEM_CONTEST_PASS:description_english
en: The pass required for entering\nPOKéMON CONTESTS. It has a\ndrawing of an award ribbon on it.$

label: ITEM_WAILMER_PAIL:description_english
en: A nifty watering pail.\nUse it to promote strong growth in\nBERRIES planted in soft soil.$

label: ITEM_DEVON_GOODS:description_english
en: A package that contains mechanical\nparts of some sort made by the\nDEVON CORPORATION.$

label: ITEM_SOOT_SACK:description_english
en: A sack used to collect volcanic\nash automatically during walks\nover deep ash.$

label: ITEM_BASEMENT_KEY:description_english
en: The key to NEW MAUVILLE, which\nwas constructed beneath MAUVILLE\nCITY.$

label: ITEM_ACRO_BIKE:description_english
en: A folding bicycle that is capable\nof stunts like jumps and wheelies.$

label: ITEM_POKEBLOCK_CASE:description_english
en: A case for holding {POKEBLOCK}S made\nwith a BERRY BLENDER. It releases\none {POKEBLOCK} when shaken.$

label: ITEM_LETTER:description_english
en: An extremely important letter to\nSTEVEN from the PRESIDENT of the\nDEVON CORPORATION.$

label: ITEM_EON_TICKET:description_english
en: The ticket required for sailing on a\nferry to a distant southern island.\nIt features a drawing of an island.$

label: ITEM_RED_ORB:description_english
en: An orb that glows red.\nIt is said to contain an incredible\npower from ancient times.$

label: ITEM_BLUE_ORB:description_english
en: An orb that glows blue.\nIt is said to contain an incredible\npower from ancient times.$

label: ITEM_SCANNER:description_english
en: A device used to search for\nlife-forms in water.\nIt looks too difficult to use.$

label: ITEM_GO_GOGGLES:description_english
en: A pair of protective goggles.\nThey enable a TRAINER to travel\nthrough even desert sandstorms.$

label: ITEM_METEORITE:description_english
en: A meteorite that fell from space\nonto MT. MOON long ago.\nIt is very lumpy and hard.$

label: ITEM_ROOM_1_KEY:description_english
en: A key that opens the door to Room\n1 inside the ABANDONED SHIP.\nIt is old and looks easily broken.$

label: ITEM_ROOM_2_KEY:description_english
en: A key that opens the door to Room\n2 inside the ABANDONED SHIP.\nIt is old and looks easily broken.$

label: ITEM_ROOM_4_KEY:description_english
en: A key that opens the door to Room\n4 inside the ABANDONED SHIP.\nIt is old and looks easily broken.$

label: ITEM_ROOM_6_KEY:description_english
en: A key that opens the door to Room\n6 inside the ABANDONED SHIP.\nIt is old and looks easily broken.$

label: ITEM_STORAGE_KEY:description_english
en: A key that opens the storage hold\ninside the ABANDONED SHIP.\nIt is old and looks easily broken.$

label: ITEM_ROOT_FOSSIL:description_english
en: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON. It appears to be\npart of a plant root.$

label: ITEM_CLAW_FOSSIL:description_english
en: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON. It appears to be\npart of a claw.$

label: ITEM_DEVON_SCOPE:description_english
en: A scope that signals the presence\nof any unseeable POKéMON.\nIt is made by the DEVON CORP.$

label: ITEM_TM01:description_english
en: An extremely powerful attack.\nHowever, if the user is hit before\nusing the move, they will flinch.$

label: ITEM_TM02:description_english
en: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash\nthe foe quickly and with great\npower.$

label: ITEM_TM03:description_english
en: The foe is hit with a pulsing blast\nof water. It may also confuse the\ntarget.$

label: ITEM_TM04:description_english
en: The user calms its spirit and\nfocuses its mind to raise its\nSP. ATK and SP. DEF stats.$

label: ITEM_TM05:description_english
en: A savage roar that causes the foe\nto switch out of battle. In the\nwild, ROAR ends the battle.$

label: ITEM_TM06:description_english
en: A move that leaves the foe badly\npoisoned. Its poison damage worsens\nevery turn.$

label: ITEM_TM07:description_english
en: Summons a hailstorm that lasts for\nfive turns. The hailstorm damages\nall types except the ICE type.$

label: ITEM_TM08:description_english
en: The user tightens all its muscles\nand bulks up, boosting both its\nATTACK and DEFENSE stats.$

label: ITEM_TM09:description_english
en: The user shoots seeds at the foe\nin rapid succession. Two to five\nseeds are shot at once.$

label: ITEM_TM10:description_english
en: A variable move that changes type\nand power depending on the POKéMON\nusing it.$

label: ITEM_TM11:description_english
en: The weather is turned sunny for\nfive turns. Over that time, FIRE-\ntype moves are powered up.$

label: ITEM_TM12:description_english
en: A taunted foe may become enraged.\nIt will then only be able to use\nattack moves.$

label: ITEM_TM13:description_english
en: An icy-cold beam is shot at the\nfoe. It may leave the target\nfrozen.$

label: ITEM_TM14:description_english
en: A vicious snow-and-wind attack that\nstrikes all foes in battle. It may\ncause freezing.$

label: ITEM_TM15:description_english
en: A harsh attack that inflicts severe\ndamage on the foe. However, the\nuser must rest the next turn.$

label: ITEM_TM16:description_english
en: A wall of light is created over\nfive turns. It reduces damage from\nSP. ATK attacks.$

label: ITEM_TM17:description_english
en: The user is completely protected\nfrom attack in the turn it is used.\nIt may fail if used in succession.$

label: ITEM_TM18:description_english
en: A heavy rain is summoned for five\nturns. Over that time, WATER-type\nmoves are powered up.$

label: ITEM_TM19:description_english
en: The user strikes the foe with\ntentacles or roots, stealing the\ntarget's HP and healing itself.$

label: ITEM_TM20:description_english
en: Protects the party with a shield\nagainst all status problems over\nfive turns.$

label: ITEM_TM21:description_english
en: This attack move grows more\npowerful the more the POKéMON\ndislikes its TRAINER.$

label: ITEM_TM22:description_english
en: A 2-turn attack that uses the first\nturn for absorbing sunlight, then\nblasting the foe in the next turn.$

label: ITEM_TM23:description_english
en: The foe is slammed with a sturdy\ntail of steel. It may lower the\ntarget's DEFENSE stat.$

label: ITEM_TM24:description_english
en: A massive jolt of electricity is\nlaunched at the foe. It may cause\nparalysis.$

label: ITEM_TM25:description_english
en: Strikes the foe with a huge\nthunderbolt. It may cause\nparalysis.$

label: ITEM_TM26:description_english
en: Causes an earthquake that strikes\nall POKéMON in battle, excluding\nthe user.$

label: ITEM_TM27:description_english
en: This attack move grows more\npowerful the more the POKéMON\nlikes its TRAINER.$

label: ITEM_TM28:description_english
en: A 2-turn attack in which the user\ndigs underground, then strikes.\nIt can be used to exit dungeons.$

label: ITEM_TM29:description_english
en: A powerful blast of telekinetic\nenergy strikes the foe. It may\nlower the target's SP. DEF stat.$

label: ITEM_TM30:description_english
en: The foe is attacked with a shadowy\nlump. It may lower the target's\nSP. DEF stat.$

label: ITEM_TM31:description_english
en: Strikes the foe with a rock-hard\nfist, etc. It shatters barriers such\nas REFLECT and LIGHT SCREEN.$

label: ITEM_TM32:description_english
en: The user begins moving so quickly\nthat it creates illusory copies to\nraise its evasiveness.$

label: ITEM_TM33:description_english
en: A tough barrier is put up over five\nturns. It reduces damage from\nphysical attacks over that time.$

label: ITEM_TM34:description_english
en: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes\nthe foe. This attack is impossible\nto evade.$

label: ITEM_TM35:description_english
en: The foe is roasted with a heavy\nblast of fire. It may leave the\ntarget with a burn.$

label: ITEM_TM36:description_english
en: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe\nwith great force. It may also\npoison the target.$

label: ITEM_TM37:description_english
en: Summons a sandstorm that lasts for\nfive turns. It damages all types\nexcept ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.$

label: ITEM_TM38:description_english
en: The foe is incinerated with an\nintense flame. It may leave the\ntarget with a burn.$

label: ITEM_TM39:description_english
en: Boulders are hurled at the foe.\nIt also lowers the target's SPEED\nstat if it hits.$

label: ITEM_TM40:description_english
en: An extremely fast attack against\none target. It is impossible to\nevade.$

label: ITEM_TM41:description_english
en: If enraged by this move, the target\nbecomes incapable of using the same\nmove twice in a row.$

label: ITEM_TM42:description_english
en: An attack move that becomes very\npowerful if the user is poisoned,\nburned, or paralyzed.$

label: ITEM_TM43:description_english
en: An attack move that may have an\nadditional effect depending on the\nbattle terrain.$

label: ITEM_TM44:description_english
en: A move that makes the user fall\nasleep over two turns to restore HP\nand heal any status problems.$

label: ITEM_TM45:description_english
en: The foe, if it is the opposite\ngender as the user, becomes\ninfatuated and may not attack.$

label: ITEM_TM46:description_english
en: An attack that gives the user an\nopportunity to steal the foe's hold\nitem.$

label: ITEM_TM47:description_english
en: The foe is struck with steel-hard\nwings. It may also raise the user's\nDEFENSE stat.$

label: ITEM_TM48:description_english
en: A special power is transmitted to\nthe foe, causing it to switch\nabilities with the user.$

label: ITEM_TM49:description_english
en: A move that steals the effects of\nany status-changing or healing move\nthat the foe tries to use.$

label: ITEM_TM50:description_english
en: A maximum-power attack of great\nferocity, but one that also sharply\nreduces the user's SP. ATK stat.$

label: ITEM_HM01:description_english
en: Attacks the foe with sharp blades\nor claws. It can also cut down thin\ntrees and grass outside of battle.$

label: ITEM_HM02:description_english
en: The user flies up on the first turn,\nthen attacks next turn. It can be\nused to fly to any known town.$

label: ITEM_HM03:description_english
en: Creates a huge wave, then crashes\nit down on the foe. It can be used\nfor traveling on water.$

label: ITEM_HM04:description_english
en: The user builds enormous power,\nthen slams the foe. It can be used\nfor moving large, round boulders.$

label: ITEM_HM05:description_english
en: Looses a powerful blast of light\nthat reduces the foe's accuracy.\nIt also lights up dark caves.$

label: ITEM_HM06:description_english
en: Hits the foe with a rock-crushingly\ntough attack. It can smash cracked\nboulders.$

label: ITEM_HM07:description_english
en: A powerful charge attack. It can\nbe used for climbing a torrential\nwaterfall.$

label: ITEM_HM08:description_english
en: A 2-turn attack in which the user\ndives underwater on the first turn,\nthen strikes in the next turn.$

label: ITEM_OAKS_PARCEL:description_english
en: A parcel to be delivered to PROF.\nOAK from VIRIDIAN CITY's POKéMON\nMART.$

label: ITEM_POKE_FLUTE:description_english
en: A flute that is said to instantly\nawaken any POKéMON. It has a\nlovely tone.$

label: ITEM_SECRET_KEY:description_english
en: The key to CINNABAR ISLAND GYM's\nfront door. It is colored red and\ndecorated.$

label: ITEM_BIKE_VOUCHER:description_english
en: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP\nin CERULEAN CITY and exchange it\nfor a bicycle.$

label: ITEM_GOLD_TEETH:description_english
en: A set of false teeth lost by the\nSAFARI ZONE'S WARDEN. It makes his\nsmile sparkle.$

label: ITEM_OLD_AMBER:description_english
en: A piece of amber that contains\nthe genes of an ancient POKéMON.\nIt is clear with a reddish tint.$

label: ITEM_CARD_KEY:description_english
en: A card-type key that unlocks doors\nin SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE in\nSAFFRON CITY.$

label: ITEM_LIFT_KEY:description_english
en: A key that operates the elevator\nin TEAM ROCKET's HIDEOUT.\nIt bears the TEAM ROCKET logo.$

label: ITEM_HELIX_FOSSIL:description_english
en: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON. It appears to be\npart of a seashell.$

label: ITEM_DOME_FOSSIL:description_english
en: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-\ndwelling POKéMON. It appears to be\npart of a shell.$

label: ITEM_SILPH_SCOPE:description_english
en: A scope that makes unseeable\nPOKéMON visible.\nIt is made by SILPH CO.$

label: ITEM_BICYCLE:description_english
en: A folding bicycle that allows\nfaster movement than the RUNNING\nSHOES.$

label: ITEM_TOWN_MAP:description_english
en: A very convenient map that can be\nviewed anytime. It even shows your \npresent location.$

label: ITEM_VS_SEEKER:description_english
en: A device that indicates TRAINERS\nwho want to battle. The battery\ncharges while traveling.$

label: ITEM_FAME_CHECKER:description_english
en: A device that enables you to\nrecall what you've heard and seen\nabout famous people.$

label: ITEM_TM_CASE:description_english
en: A case that holds TMs and HMs.\nIt is attached to the BAG's\ncompartment for important items.$

label: ITEM_BERRY_POUCH:description_english
en: A pouch for carrying BERRIES.\nIt is attached to the BAG's\ncompartment for important items.$

label: ITEM_TEACHY_TV:description_english
en: A television set that is tuned to\na program with useful tips for\nnovice TRAINERS.$

label: ITEM_TRI_PASS:description_english
en: A pass for ferries between ONE,\nTWO, and THREE ISLAND.\nIt has a drawing of three islands.$

label: ITEM_RAINBOW_PASS:description_english
en: A pass for ferries between\nVERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS.\nIt features a drawing of a rainbow.$

label: ITEM_TEA:description_english
en: An aromatic tea prepared by an old\nlady. It will slake even the worst\nthirst.$

label: ITEM_MYSTIC_TICKET:description_english
en: A ticket required to board the ship\nto NAVEL ROCK.\nIt glows with a mystic light.$

label: ITEM_AURORA_TICKET:description_english
en: A ticket required to board the ship\nto BIRTH ISLAND.\nIt glows beautifully.$

label: ITEM_POWDER_JAR:description_english
en: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER\nmade using a BERRY CRUSHER.$

label: ITEM_RUBY:description_english
en: An exquisitely beautiful gem that\nhas a red glow.\nIt symbolizes passion.$

label: ITEM_SAPPHIRE:description_english
en: An exquisitely beautiful gem that\nhas a blue glow.\nIt symbolizes honesty.$
